  • Assign requests to appropriate records team members based on workload and utilization metrics.

4. Handling Special Cases

  • Identify and escalate provider-specific requirements (e.g., custom forms) to the appropriate Client Success Manager (CSM).
  • Resolve missing or conflicting information by liaising directly with the law firms case manager.

Requirements

  • Experience: Prior experience requesting health records from providers on behalf of healthcare companies, law firms, or related organizations.

jobs.excerpt: Fluent is building the next generation advertising network: Partner Monetize and Advertiser Acquisition.
jobs.description:
Fluent is building the next generation advertising network: Partner Monetize and Advertiser Acquisition. Our vision is to build an ML/AI first network of advertisers and publishers working toward a common objective, elevating relevancy in e-commerce for everyday shoppers.

Fluent is hiring its first dedicated AI Engineer. Over the past year, AI at Fluent has moved from pilots to production: a service desk agent that closes tickets without a human touch, a pipeline that cut modeled audience delivery from days to hours, and an agent that audits cross-system attribution and identifies revenue reconciliation opportunities. All of it was built by people doing it alongside their day jobs. Your job is to make it your day job.

You will sit in Core Engineering and work every day with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Solution Architecture. You will build the agents and automated workflows our business teams have asked for, and you will build them on the Databricks lakehouse that is Fluent's data hub, because the hard part of most of these workflows is not the model. It is getting trusted data and reliable actions in front of it.

You are a builder who ships. You are strong in Python and SQL, you have put at least one LLM-powered application in front of real users, and you know the difference between a demo and a production system: evaluation, monitoring, cost, and a clear owner. You have worked in Databricks or a comparable lakehouse, or you have the data engineering depth to get productive there quickly. You are comfortable sitting with a support lead or an account manager, understanding how they actually work, and turning that into something that runs every day. This role is fully remote in the United States, with occasional travel to our New York headquarters.

What you'll do

  • Ship production agents and automated workflows from a prioritized, business-validated backlog. Own each one from scoping with the business owner through build, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and handoff.
  • Build the data foundation those workflows depend on in Databricks: Unity Catalog tables and views, Lakeflow pipelines, Lakeflow Connect ingestion from systems like HubSpot, and Genie spaces that let business teams ask questions in plain language. Bring data from our ad-serving and partner platforms, CRM, support desk, and finance systems into one place people can trust.
  • Work with Data Science to make agent quality measurable: evaluation sets, accuracy and drift tracking, cost and latency instrumentation, and the audit fields and failure alerts every production workflow carries.
  • Integrate with Fluent's systems through APIs, webhooks, MCP servers, and orchestration (Databricks Workflows, n8n, GitHub Actions), and replace brittle point-to-point automations with maintained, observable ones.
  • Partner with Core Engineering to expose platform data and actions as APIs, so agents and business teams can use them directly instead of routing requests through engineers.
  • Build reusable pieces, not one-offs: Claude skills, MCP connectors, prompt and evaluation libraries, and playbooks that other builders across Fluent can pick up.
  • Handle consumer data in line with Fluent's privacy and compliance standards, use only approved AI tools, and work with IT & Security on credentials and access.
  • Demo weekly, write things down in Confluence, and share what you learn in brown bags and tech talks.
  • Use AI-assisted development (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot review) as a normal part of how you work.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days you will have shipped one workflow end to end, with a named business owner and numbers Finance can validate. By six months you will have several in production, at least one reusable component another builder has picked up, and a clear view of what next quarter's backlog should be.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional software or data engineering experience, with strong Python and SQL.
  • You have built and shipped at least one LLM-powered application or agent that real users depend on, using tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs, and evaluation.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows) or a comparable lakehouse, or deep enough data engineering experience to ramp quickly.
  • Experience integrating SaaS and internal systems through REST APIs, webhooks, and OAuth.
  • You test your work, instrument it, and care about cost. You know when a workflow is ready to be owned by someone else.
  • You communicate clearly with people who do not write code, and you are comfortable running a working session with a business team.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as part of a modern engineering workflow.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Databricks Mosaic AI (Agent Framework, Model Serving, Vector Search), Genie, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakebase, or Databricks Apps.
  • Building MCP servers, or working with the Claude Developer Platform or Agent SDK.
  • Workflow orchestration tools such as n8n.
  • Integrations with HubSpot, Zendesk, NetSuite, or Jira.
  • Experience in ad tech, performance marketing, or another environment that handles regulated consumer data.

Benefits

At Fluent, we like what we do, and we like who we do it with. Our team is a tight-knit crew of go-getters; we love to celebrate our successes! In addition, we offer a fully stocked kitchen, catered breakfast and lunch, and our office manager keeps the calendar stocked with activity-filled events. When we are not eating, working out, or planning parties, Fluent folks can be found participating in recreational sports leagues, networking with She Runs It, and bonding with across teams during quarterly outings to baseball games, fancy dinners, and pizza-making classes. And we have all the practical benefits, too…

  • Competitive compensation
  • Ample career and professional growth opportunities
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Pre-tax savings plans and transit/parking programs
  • 401K with competitive employer match
  • Volunteer and philanthropic activities throughout the year

jobs.description:
Role Title: Computational Chemistry, Structural Biology & Drug Discovery Scientist (PhD)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Design and write challenging, expert-level scientific problems in computational chemistry, structural biology, and drug discovery, with clear, verifiable solutions.
  2. Review and evaluate AI model outputs for scientific accuracy, rigor, and depth of reasoning, identifying subtle errors that non-specialists would miss.
  3. Develop detailed rubrics and reference answers grounded in the primary literature and established methodology.
  4. Apply domain expertise across areas such as molecular modeling and simulation, protein structure prediction and design, virtual screening and docking, QSAR/ADMET modeling, and proteomics/metabolomics data analysis.
  5. Provide clear written explanations of your reasoning, so that other experts can follow and validate it.
  6. Meet quality standards through iterative feedback and peer review cycles.

Required Qualifications (MUST)

  1. PhD in Computational Chemistry, Structural Biology, Biophysics, Bioinformatics, Medicinal Chemistry, Biochemistry, or a closely related field.
  2. Hands-on research experience in an academic or industry lab (wetlab experience is a plus).
  3. Professional written and spoken English (C1 or higher).

Preferred Skills

  1. Postdoctoral or industry research experience (pharma/biotech) in drug discovery or structural biology.
  2. Strong publication record, particularly first-author papers in relevant journals.
  3. Molecular modeling and simulation: GROMACS, AMBER, NAMD, OpenMM, free energy methods (FEP/TI).
  4. Structure prediction and design: AlphaFold, Rosetta, homology modeling, cryo-EM / X-ray crystallography data interpretation.
  5. Docking and virtual screening: AutoDock, Glide, Schrödinger Suite, MOE.
  6. Cheminformatics: RDKit, QSAR/QSPR, ADMET prediction, fingerprinting, library design.
  7. Proteomics and metabolomics: LC-MS/MS, MaxQuant, DIA/DDA workflows, PTM analysis, untargeted metabolomics.
  8. Programming: Python (required in practice), plus R, Bash, or similar; experience with ML for molecular property prediction (GNNs, generative models) is a plus.
  9. Experience with benchmarking, model evaluation, or scientific writing/reviewing.
  10. Ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly and precisely in writing.

jobs.description:
Hiring: Full-time - Senior Full Cycle Recruiter - Remote - $9,600 to $12,000/yr

🌟 About us, WeAssist, the hiring team 💡

🌍 Led by a Founder Who Cares – Reef Colman built WeAssist to empower individuals and create meaningful opportunities that support families.
⚡ Fast & Purposeful Recruiting – We move quickly but prioritize long-term fit, stability, and growth over just filling roles.
🌎 Connecting Global Talent – With 100+ outsourced professionals and growing, we link top talent worldwide with thriving US businesses.
❤️ Giving Back Matters – From building schools to feeding the homeless, we believe true success means making a difference.
🤝 An Inclusive & Thriving Culture – Your skills and unique gifts matter. We create an environment where outsourced professionals don’t just work—they grow.

⚒️ Key Responsibilities of the Full Cycle Recruiter 📝

➡️ LinkedIn Sourcing

➡️ Conducting Interviews

➡️ Expert Interviewing Techniques
➡️ Elevated Candidate Experience
➡️ Recruiting Process Development
➡️ ATS Implementation/Management
➡️ Administrative Tasks
➡️ Occasional Project Management
➡️AI-Driven Recruiting & Automation

⚒️ Key Qualifications of the Full Cycle Recruiter 📝

➡️ AI Fluency: Hands-on experience using AI for recruiting workflows (screening, ranking, summaries, outreach, interview design) and building prompt libraries.
➡️ Automation Skills: Proven ability to create no-code automations (Zapier/Make/n8n) that connect ATS/CRM, calendars, and communication tools.
➡️ Full-Cycle Recruiting Mastery – 2+ years managing requisitions end-to-end: sourcing, screening, and interviewing, along with strong Boolean search and multi-channel sourcing
➡️ LinkedIn Recruiter Proficiency – Extensive experience sourcing top-tier candidates using advanced LinkedIn Recruiter search techniques.
➡️ CBBI & Soft Skills Screening – Skilled at conducting in-depth CBBI (competency-based behavioral interviews) and assessing soft skills to ensure cultural fit.

Additional Information:
📢 Why Are We Hiring a Full Cycle Recruiter?

As a Full-Cycle Recruiter, you're more than a talent scout—you're a pioneer in expanding our top-tier recruitment divisions worldwide. Your mission? To ace screening, conduct killer interviews, and match-make dream teams for our clients. With your keen eye and innovative strategies, you'll create mutually beneficial opportunities for clients and outsourced professionals alike, fueling growth and empowerment across the globe. Ready to make waves? Let's do this! 🚀

Responsibilities of the Full Cycle Recruiter:
Your responsibilities include:

  • LinkedIn Sourcing:
    • Utilizing either LinkedIn Recruiter (Corporate) or LinkedIn Recruiter Lite to find, source, and identify talent with a good understanding of which filters to use and why
    • How to separate key elements of the role into different Boolean brackets
    • Robust understanding of how to narrow and broaden talent pools based on the requirements of the role

  • Conducting Interviews:
    • Intro Interviews (15mins)
    • Group Interviews (if necessary)
    • 1on1 Interviews (1 hour)
    • Follow and master the Interview Flow, then begin to innovate and tailor interview processes for optimal success

  • Expert Interviewing Techniques:
    • Probe into candidate experiences to discern strengths, weaknesses, and career experience. Understanding how to identify and probe into red flags, determine suitability, and evaluate candidates thoroughly
    • Must be highly skilled at identifying skillset, talent, and culture fits
    • Impeccable Discernment - Knowing who is a good fit, and who is not a good fit, based on culture, soft skills and hard skills

  • Elevated Candidate Experience:
    • Champion a professional and positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment life cycle, from start to finish
    • Disqualify candidates who are not a fit, live-on-call, and give constructive feedback to aid them in future applications

  • ATS Implementation and Management:
    • Must be able to utilize ATS systems for our teams to ensure effective pairings between client and candidate, and ensure candidates are in the correct pipelines/stages
    • Pipeline Management - Finding existing candidates within our database that may be a great fit for current requisitions

  • AI Implementations/Automations:
    • Creating workflows and automations to streamline and automate parts of the Recruiting Process
    • Researching AI tools/technology that can support Recruiting Process Optimisation
    • Assisting the team in optimising a migration to GoHighLevel as an Applicant Tracking System
      • Creating and supporting in developing workflows, automations and pipeline processes to optimise the Recruiting Process
    • Offering support in building the highest quality, effective, and streamlined recruiting process to find high-level outsourced professionals
  • Administrative Tasks:
    • Ensuring that there are accurate and up-to-date notes on candidate profiles
    • Updating trackers with daily, weekly, and monthly metrics
    • End-of-day reporting

  • 🤖 AI-Driven Recruiting & Automation
    • Build and maintain AI-assisted workflows for sourcing, screening, and shortlisting (e.g., automated resume parsing, skill tagging, and candidate ranking using AI tools)
    • Use AI to draft/refine JDs, outreach copy, interview guides, and candidate summaries; A/B test prompts for higher response and conversion rates
    • Create automations across ATS/CRM, calendars, and comms tools (e.g., Zapier/Make/n8n) for interview scheduling, pipeline alerts, status updates, and follow-ups
    • Set up AI-powered dashboards and reports to monitor pipeline health, SLAs, and client-ready batch quality
    • Maintain a prompt library and SOPs for repeatable, high-quality outputs; continuously fine-tune based on client feedback and outcomes
    • Evaluate and implement new AI tools/models (e.g., ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity, sourcing extensions) while ensuring data privacy and compliance
    • Train team members on best-practice prompting and QA standards for AI-generated deliverables

🏡 Get To Know WeAssist!

Started by Reef Colman just five years ago, is not your typical staffing agency...

We are a dynamic recruiting firm focused on creating fair opportunities in the business world. We have a team of over 120 Outsourced Professionals. We help US businesses find skilled remote workers and connect these workers with good employers.

What makes us different is how much we care about our people! We give good benefits, support personal growth, and get involved in the community. We also support good causes like building schools, helping the homeless, and improving education. Come join us at WeAssist, where remote workers do their best! ✨

Company Culture and Core Values:

At WeAssist, we move fast, think big, and create lasting impact. 🚀 We’re more than just a recruiting firm—we’re a tight-knit community that values integrity, accountability, and growth, ensuring every professional and client finds the right fit, not just any fit. Here, you’ll thrive in an inclusive, high-performance culture that challenges you to be 1% better every day while making a real difference in the world. 🌍✨

Our core values include:

  • 🧭 Integrity– Do the Right Thing, Always
    • Even when no one’s watching, we lead with honesty, character, and trust.
  • 🎯 Expectation – Set the Target Early
    • We align from the start—no guessing games. Clarity creates confidence.
  • 🔁 Reiteration – Say It Back, Get It Right
    • We confirm understanding by repeating what we heard. Listening is a two-way street.
  • 🧱 Major Ownership – Being 1% Better Every Time
    • No blaming, no excuses. We take full responsibility and ask, “What can I do better?”
  • 🔍 Radical Transparency – Keep It Real
    • We speak with openness and honesty.
  • 🚀 Proactive Effort – Stay Ahead of the Game
    • We don’t wait for fires—we prevent them. Anticipate, act, exceed.
  • 🗣️ Communication – Listen First, Speak with Clarity
    • We listen to understand, not just to reply. The clearer we are, the stronger we move!
  • 🧑‍💼 We Talk About Projects, Not People – No Gossip Zone
    • We go directly to the source. Discuss issues, not individuals—unless it’s for solutions.
  • 🧠 Be Curious – Ask, Learn, Level Up
    • Curiosity drives growth. We ask smart questions and never stop learning.
  • 🧊 Emotional Regulation – Keep Cool Under Pressure
    • We stay calm, think clearly, and lead with emotional maturity—especially when it’s tough.
  • 🏅 A-Player Mentality – Results Over Excuses
    • We get things done. Whatever it takes to win with integrity, we’re in.
  • ➕ One More Mindset – Because It Matters to Someone
    • One more call. One more check-in. One more push. Every extra effort counts.

Join a team that values growth, action, and real impact—where what you do truly matters! 🎉

What’s in it for you? 😏

Joining us means not just filling a role but embarking on a personal development journey. The growth potential is substantial, with opportunities to:

  • 🌱 Endless Growth Opportunities – Your role evolves with you—take on more responsibility and leadership as you grow!
  • 💰 Great Starting Salary – Competitive compensation to reward your contributions.
  • 🎉 13th Month Bonus – Because we appreciate your hard work and dedication. Wild, right? 🤯
  • 🏆 Performance-Based Raises, Bonuses & Prizes – Your growth directly impacts your compensation! Hit your KPIs and enjoy rewards that reflect your success!
  • 👨‍⚕️ Health, Dental, and Mental Health Insurance – Comprehensive coverage to take care of you inside and out.
  • 💡 Proactive, Collaborative, Supportive, and Forward-Thinking Environment – Work on innovative projects that push boundaries alongside passionate leaders who value your input!
  • 🌴 Permanent Remote Set-Up – Your office is wherever you want it—whether that's your couch, bed, or hammock!

This opportunity is ideal for someone ready to spread their wings, thrive in a dynamic environment, and make a meaningful impact on our journey to success!

Specifics:

  • Time
    • Full Time, 5 am - 2 pm MNL (with a 1hr break)
      • Be available during business hours to communicate responsively with your direct supervisor and teammates
    • This is a remote position so you can have the freedom to work from anywhere
  • Miscellaneous
    • Attire - business casual when in meetings
    • Professional setup (Pains me I actually need to write this down… 👀)
      • Clean background
      • Good camera
      • Good microphone
      • Strong wifi
  • Tech Stack
    • ATS Experience
      • ClickUp
      • Breezy
      • GoHighLevel
    • AI
      • ChatGPT/OpenAI
      • N8N (ideal)
      • Zapier (ideal)
      • Workflow Automation Tools
    • Slack
    • Canva
    • G-Suite
      • Google Sheets
  • Compensation
    • $9,600 to $12,000/yr
Salary: $9,600 – $12,000 / year

jobs.excerpt: About Enroute:We love technology, and we enjoy what we do.
jobs.description:
About Enroute:

We love technology, and we enjoy what we do. We are always looking for innovation. We have social awareness and try to improve it daily. We make things happen. You can trust us. Our Enrouters are always up for a challenge. We ask questions, and we love to learn.

We pride ourselves on having great benefits and compensations, a fantastic work environment, flexible schedules, and policies that positively impact the balance of work and life outside of it. We care about who you are in the office and who you are as an individual. We get involved, we like to know our people, we want every Enrouter to become part of a great community of highly driven, responsible, respectful, and above all, happy people. We want you to enjoy working with us.

Requirements

Technical Skills:

  • Strong Data Engineering experience, including data modeling, data transformation, and data integration.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS and cloud-based data solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases and SQL.
  • Experience with Python for data processing, querying, validation, and automation.
  • Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines.
  • Experience with data mapping and transformation logic.
  • Understanding of system architecture, microservices, distributed systems, and data integration patterns.
  • Ability to read and interpret system architecture diagrams and technical specifications.
  • Experience with GitHub or other version control systems.
  • Understanding of SDLC processes and Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experience with project management tools such as Jira.
  • Familiarity with secure data handling, particularly sensitive financial data and PII

Business & Communication Skills:

  • Ability to work directly with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience gathering and documenting functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Ability to create clear technical documentation, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into clear functional and non-functional requirements and technical solutions.
  • Design, develop, and maintain data models, data mappings, and transformation logic to enable seamless integration between source and target systems.
  • Build, test, and maintain ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines on AWS, ensuring data accuracy, reliability, and timely availability.
  • Develop and optimize SQL queries for data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting across relational databases.
  • Leverage Python to process, validate, query, and automate data workflows.
  • Analyze system architecture diagrams and technical specifications to understand data exchanges across microservices and distributed systems, identifying integration points and potential gaps.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including data flows, mapping specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Participate in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) development processes, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint reviews, while tracking activities and deliverables in Jira.
  • Manage and maintain code, scripts, and technical documentation using GitHub or other version control systems.
  • Ensure the secure handling of sensitive financial data and personally identifiable information (PII), adhering to data governance, privacy, and compliance standards.
  • Support testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by defining test scenarios, validating data integrity, and collaborating with development teams to identify and resolve defects.
  • Communicate project progress, technical risks, dependencies, and key updates effectively to cross-functional teams and leadership.

jobs.title: Prior Authorization Specialist
jobs.excerpt: GeBBS Healthcare Solutions is a leading provider of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Risk Adjustment services, helping healthcare organizations optimize operations, improve financial performance, maintain compliance, and enhance the patient experience.
jobs.description:
GeBBS Healthcare Solutions is a leading provider of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Risk Adjustment services, helping healthcare organizations optimize operations, improve financial performance, maintain compliance, and enhance the patient experience. Recognized as a KLAS® Top Performer, GeBBS combines innovative technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to excellence to deliver measurable results for clients across the healthcare industry. We are dedicated to being a trusted healthcare partner by upholding the highest standards of quality, information security, and compliance.

At GeBBS, we foster a collaborative and growth-oriented culture where employees are empowered to develop their skills, advance their careers, and make a meaningful impact in transforming healthcare.

Responsibilities

The Authorization Representative will need to cover authorizations for all services (CT, MRI, echo, surgery, minor procedures, heart monitor, PFTs, sleep studies, IP, Observations, Swing Bed, ED, VA), excluding STAT requests.
Initial request and follow up required along with reporting of authorization status.

Prior Authorization and Eligibility

  • Initiate, submit, and track prior authorization requests across commercial and managed care payers.
  • Verify patient eligibility and benefits prior to authorization submission and confirm coverage, plan requirements, authorization thresholds, deductibles, copays, and other applicable benefit information.
  • Ensure authorization requests contain complete and accurate demographic, clinical, and supporting documentation.
  • Monitor pending authorization requests through payer portals and direct payer communication and proactively follow up through resolution.
  • Document authorization numbers, approved services, CPT codes, effective dates, expiration dates, session or visit limits, and other payer requirements.

Concurrent Reviews and Authorization Management

  • Manage concurrent review, continued stay, and authorization renewal requirements for ongoing services.
  • Track authorization limits and expiration dates and initiate renewals before existing authorizations are exhausted.
  • Maintain accurate authorization records and communicate pending or expiring authorizations to appropriate operational and clinical teams.
  • Help prevent gaps in authorization that could result in delayed services or lost reimbursement.

Denials and Appeals

  • Review authorization-related denials and determine whether the cause is clinical, administrative, eligibility-related, or procedural.
  • Coordinate appropriate corrective action and appeal activity within payer deadlines.
  • Prepare clear and accurate appeal documentation and coordinate with clinical and operational teams to obtain supporting information when required.
  • Track appeals through resolution and maintain complete documentation of outcomes.
  • Identify recurring denial trends and escalate systemic payer or process issues.

Payer and Revenue Cycle Coordination

  • Serve as a resource for payer authorization requirements, policies, portals, and workflows.
  • Maintain current knowledge of payer requirements and communicate material changes to appropriate teams.
  • Coordinate with billing, intake, clinical, credentialing, and contracting teams to resolve authorization-related reimbursement barriers.
  • Support single-case agreements, out-of-network authorization requests, and other payer authorization functions as needed.
  • Assist with payer audits and utilization management reviews by providing complete authorization records and supporting documentation.

Documentation and Reporting

  • Maintain accurate and timely authorization activity within applicable EHR, practice management, and tracking systems.
  • Maintain payer authorization matrices and workflow documentation, including submission requirements, turnaround times, authorization limits, and renewal requirements.
  • Track authorization performance, including approval rates, denial rates, appeal outcomes, turnaround times, and outstanding requests.
  • Identify trends and recommend workflow improvements that strengthen revenue integrity and reduce preventable denials.
  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA and all applicable privacy and confidentiality requirements.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in healthcare Revenue Cycle Management, with direct responsibility for prior authorization, eligibility and benefit verification, payer follow-up, or related revenue cycle functions.
  • Strong understanding of prior authorization requirements, payer timelines, submission processes, and authorization tracking.
  • Strong understanding of the differences between eligibility, benefits, authorization, and medical necessity requirements.
  • Experience working with commercial and managed care payers.
  • Experience using payer portals such asAvaility, NaviNet, and payer-specific platforms.
  • Working knowledge of CPT codes and their relationship to payer authorization requirements.
  • Experience managing denials and authorization appeals.
  • Experience with EHR, practice management, or other healthcare revenue cycle systems.

Requirements

  • Excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple authorization queues and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with payer representatives and internal operational teams.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and healthcare privacy requirements.
  • CPC required. PACS preferred.
  • US based candidates eligible for employment without sponsorship.

jobs.title: Annuity Sales Consultant- Internal Wholesaler (Central/Eastern)
jobs.excerpt: At TruStage, we’re on a mission to make a brighter financial future accessible to everyone.
jobs.description:
At TruStage, we’re on a mission to make a brighter financial future accessible to everyone. We put people first, and work hand in hand with employees and customers to create a diverse and inclusive environment. Passionate about building insurance and financial services solutions, we push the boundaries of what’s possible. We need you to help us shape what’s next. You’ll be encouraged to share your experiences, ideas and skills to help others take control of their financial future.

Join a team that has received numerous awards for being a top place to work: TruStage awards and recognition

Job Purpose:


This position is responsible for the successful execution of account and territory strategies for assigned broker dealers distributing TruStage Annuities. This includes acquisition, optimization and retention of business. Provide strategic support to wholesalers to enhance their efforts of F2F product distribution through affiliated representatives and external broker dealers. Develop and implement strategic plans for business development with investment advisors and help manage the relationship with key managers with external broker dealers.

Employ consultative selling approach to support retail sales activities including increasing sales and market share objectives within an assigned geographic region. This role will help manage day to day activities of designated wholesaler(s); these include setting appointments, developing sales plans, providing marketplace feedback and assisting in the building of market strategies. Utilizes appropriate judgment to allocate financial resources from the assigned territory’s business development budget and acts as a catalyst to drive sales growth, build market share and meet necessary sales and asset targets for the TruStage Annuity products. This role will be based outside of the Madison office location.


Account Specialist - Possesses detailed knowledge and/or skill on a specific subject or activity relating to financial industry and TruStage Annuity product wholesaling. Their talents are devoted to a specific business focus, and they can provide guidance, mentorship, technical leadership and training to the team when appropriate. Develops and implements solutions that align with key business strategies and initiatives. Provide public speaking support within various territories. Conducts territory reviews with National Accounts and Broker Dealer relationships. Able to conduct F2F meetings on their own within their territory as needed. Will work to obtain additional industry related licenses, certificates and/or designations.


Ideal locations for the Internal Wholesaler would be in Central or Eastern states, but we can review those from Mountain, as well. Pacific would not be ideal, at this time.


Job Responsibilities:


  • This is a focused, business-building position whose accountabilities will be accomplished through developing and expanding advisor relationships, educating, assisting and executing product sales programs and strategies via phone, virtual, and face to face channels.
  • Continuously build, maintain and enhance positive business relationships within investment advisors offering TruStage Annuity products, serving as a resource for sales support for an assigned distribution channel and/or territory. Provide outbound support, including advising on the availability and appropriate use of TruStage Annuity products, literature and sales tools. Help develop and share ideas with investment advisors that increases sales; educate advisors on new product releases and enhancements; communicate economic and industry data relevant to the use of products; help develop recognition programs and ensure their effective administration. Document field contact through established contact management tools, utilizing contact data to enhance the level of field support and improve decision-making.
  • Provide support, including answering product questions; following up on requests for information and proposals; support product education; and providing timely responses to problems encountered in the field. Serve as a troubleshooter and problem solver for advisors on product and process issues and maintain a strong knowledge of available corporate resources, referring advisors to appropriate areas as necessary to ensure problem resolution.
  • As needed, provide marketing support for advisors through periodic participation in field schools, training meetings, and sales conventions. Help design and deliver product sessions and marketing presentations; participate in product marketing booths at conventions or trade shows; and demonstrate product sales tools and concepts at meetings. Develop strong relationships with field management, home office service, marketing, and investment advisory staff, as well as employees from various business areas, working to ensure effective communication between all parties.
  • Provide proactive sales and marketing support to one or more Regional Vice Presidents, Wholesalers and/or product marketers. This support includes partnering in the development and execution of marketing plans; allocating funding for business development programs; providing sales strategies; implementing sales call procedures; provide product education and developing recognition campaigns for face-to-face representatives. Follow up on requests for information from product managers or marketers and analyze internal business information; industry and economic data; and competitive information, utilizing that data to provide effective marketing support. In conjunction with the sales directors and product marketers, provide marketing support for project efforts, including development of new products or product enhancements, related training material revisions and product promotional efforts, and introduction campaigns.
  • Maintain and build strong product knowledge, including any related economic, industry and competitor’s information. Build and maintain strong knowledge of the entire TruStage Annuities product portfolio. Maintain a solid understanding of back-office processes for the investment advisor, broker/dealer operations, and the service areas, as well as a working knowledge of associated vendor relationships.

The above statement of duties is not intended to be all inclusive and other duties will be assigned from time to time.


Job Requirements:


  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance or equivalent trade off in professional work experience.
  • 2+ years of sales, marketing or customer service experience in the financial industry.
  • Strong knowledge of investment and/or insurance products.
  • Demonstrated sales & marketing knowledge of annuities and variable products, and their appropriate applications within the context of a needs-based sales process.
  • FINRA Securities Industry Essentials Examination, Series 6 or 7 and 63 licenses required. Life and Variable Licenses required or can complete all licenses/registrations within 90 days
  • Industry designations a plus (CPA, CFA, ChFC, CLU, etc.)
  • Strong oral and written communication skills. Capable of presenting technical product knowledge with professional phone and face to face skills
  • Exercise sound judgment and solid decision making for allocating company resources for business development.
  • Highly motivated and able to work independently and perform under pressure. Proven ability to grow a sales territory.
  • Ability and desire to spend significant portion of job developing relationships virtually and over the phone.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team environment. Strong territory management, independence and organizational skills.
  • Working knowledge of office automation tools; experience with contact management tools a plus.
  • Ability to travel up to 20%.

If you’re ready to help make a difference, apply today.A resume is required to apply. TruStage may process applicant information using an Artificial Intelligence (AI) tool.This tool automatically generates a screening score based on how well applicant information matches the requirements and qualifications for the position. TruStage recruiters use the screening score as a guide to further evaluate candidates; the score is one component of an application review and does not automatically determine whether a candidate moves forward.Candidates may choose to opt out of this process.

Compensation may vary based on the job level, your geographic work location, position incentive plan and exemption status.

Base Salary Range:

$48,800.00 - $81,300.00

At TruStage, we believe a sound, inclusive benefits program is of vital importance, along with a flexible workplace that allows for work-life balance, career growth and retirement assistance. In addition to your base pay, your position may be eligible for an annual incentive (bonus) plan. Additional benefits available to eligible employees include medical, dental, vision, employee assistance program, life insurance, disability plans, parental leave, paid time off, 401k, and tuition reimbursement, just to name a few. Beyond pay and benefits, we also recognize that flexibility, including working in a place you prefer, is essential to caring for our employees. We will continue to strive to offer flexibility and invest in technology and other tools that will make hybrid working normal rather than an exception, so that when “life happens,” you can focus on what’s most important.

Accommodation request

TruStage is a place where everyone can bring their best self and thrive. If you need application or interview process accommodations, please contact the accessibility department.

Fully Remote Customer Service Manager (Self-Serve SaaS)

Remote (U.S. based only) | Full-time
Apply here:

About the Role

Are you passionate about leading high-performing teams and delivering exceptional customer experiences? Join us as Customer Service Manager during our self-serve product launch. You'll oversee a growing team of frontline representatives, guide operational excellence, and help build a world-class support experience from the ground up.

jobs.description:
Job Family:

Risk & Regulatory Compliance Consulting

Travel Required:

None

Ability to Obtain Public Trust

What You Will Do:

This role is responsible for conducting identity fraud investigations, reviewing account and identity information, analyzing potentially fraudulent activity, and making investigative determinations in accordance with established procedures and program requirements. The Fraud Investigator will leverage investigative tools, available data, and established investigative methodologies to identify indicators of identity fraud, document findings, and support appropriate case outcomes. The role requires strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to effectively manage investigative caseloads in a production-driven environment.

  • Conduct investigations of suspected identity fraud, identity misuse, account compromise, and other potentially fraudulent activity.
  • Review identity, account, transactional, and other relevant information to identify fraud indicators, inconsistencies, and patterns requiring further investigation.
  • Use investigative and identity verification tools, including LexisNexis and Socure, as applicable, to research identities and inform investigative determinations.
  • Analyze available evidence and make timely, well-supported investigative determinations in accordance with established procedures and program requirements.
  • Document investigative steps, findings, supporting evidence, and case determinations clearly and consistently within applicable case management systems.
  • Manage assigned investigative caseloads and meet established production, timeliness, and quality expectations.
  • Escalate complex cases, emerging fraud patterns, procedural questions, and potential control gaps to team leadership as appropriate.
  • Identify recurring fraud trends, investigative challenges, and opportunities to strengthen fraud detection and investigation processes.
  • Collaborate with fellow investigators, team leads, and other stakeholders to resolve complex cases and promote consistent investigative practices.
  • Participate in case reviews, calibration sessions, and team discussions to support consistent application of investigative procedures and decisioning standards.
  • As needed, draft, maintain, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), job aids, investigative guidance, and other operational documentation.
  • As needed, develop training materials and conduct onboarding, refresher, or targeted training for investigators on investigative procedures, tools, fraud trends, and operational best practices.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives intended to strengthen investigative effectiveness, efficiency, and consistency across fraud operations.

What You Will Need:

  • Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST"; candidates must obtain approved adjudication of their PUBLIC TRUST prior to onboarding with Guidehouse.
  • Due to contract requirements, candidates must be U.S. Citizens and reside within the United States.
  • Bachelor's degree
  • One (1) to Five (5) Years of experience conducting risk assessment (e.g., risk scoring, control evaluation).
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:
  • o Identity fraud investigations
  • o Fraud investigations or fraud operations
  • o Identity verification or identity proofing
  • o Account or identity-related investigative research
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to evaluate multiple sources of information and reach well-supported investigative conclusions.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to conduct investigations accurately and consistently while adhering to established procedures.
  • Ability to clearly document investigative findings, evidence, and case determinations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to identify and escalate unusual fraud patterns, emerging risks, and complex investigative scenarios.
  • Experience working in a production-based, metrics-driven, or quota-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple investigations and competing priorities.

What Would Be Nice To Have:

  • Experience using investigative and identity verification tools such as LexisNexis or similar fraud detection and identity verification platforms.
  • Experience investigating identity theft, synthetic identity fraud, account takeover, or other forms of identity-related fraud.
  • Familiarity with identity proofing, account verification, fraud prevention, and case management processes.
  • Experience identifying fraud trends or patterns across investigative cases.
  • Experience developing SOPs, job aids, investigative guidance, or other operational documentation.
  • Experience facilitating training, coaching, or knowledge-sharing sessions for investigators.

jobs.description:

When you work at Rho, it’s more than just a job—you become part of the Rho Factor. We’re a proud bunch of science nerds who love tackling big challenges together. This is your opportunity to join Rho as a Senior Safety Specialist - we are open to this role being located in Poland, UK, or Spain. This is a remote opportunity.

Product Safety Team professionals are integral for the case management of federally and commercially funded clinical studies. While ensuring adherence to study protocols and internal SOPS, this team prepares safety-related documentation, oversees day-to-day activities, manages end-to-end case processing, and collaborates with internal and external stakeholders.

What You Will Be Doing:

Study Management & Support

  • Serves as primary Product Safety Lead for assigned studies of moderate to high complexity, operating independently within defined scope and procedural frameworks
  • Leads study-level safety governance, including planning, execution, and oversight of safety data collection, processing, and reporting activities
  • Develops, authors, and maintains study-specific Safety Management Plans, ensuring alignment with protocol requirements, sponsor expectations, and internal procedural documents
  • Acts as the primary Product Safety contact for sponsors and internal project teams; manages day-to-day safety-related communications and issue resolution
  • Chairs or leads study-level safety meetings, prepares content, documents decisions, and tracks action items to completion
  • Manages study-level safety scope, timelines, and budgets; identifies and escalates risks that may impact deliverables, quality, or compliance Oversees safety start-up and close-out activities, ensuring inspection-ready documentation and adherence to internal SOPs and project-specific requirements
  • Provides guidance to Product Safety Specialists and Associates supporting the study, including review of deliverables and escalation of complex issues

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree (e.g., RN, Health Sciences, PharmD) or equivalent combination of education and relevant product safety or clinical research experience along with 5+ years of product safety/pharmacovigilance experience
  • 2 years of experience working as a Product Safety Lead on Clinical Trials is required, including developing Safety Management Plans and site training materials and supporting inspections
  • Experience with Argus is preferred; proficient in the use of business productivity software (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)
  • Strong knowledge of safety data collection, processing and reporting requirements; strong knowledge of global regulatory requirements for pharmacovigilance; advanced knowledge of safety database applications and MedDRA/WHO Drug coding
  • Effective verbal and written communication and presentation skills with proficiency in both English and local language, with the ability to convey complex or nuanced information clearly across diverse audiences.
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively within a team environment
  • Exercises strong judgment in complex or ambiguous situations by weighing risks, considering multiple perspectives, and making decisions that balance accuracy, timeliness, and broader implications.
  • Exhibits advanced detail orientation by proactively identifying issues, inconsistencies, or risks and
  • by ensuring work products are thorough, reliable, and aligned with broader objectives.

about the role: we're looking for a Payments & Recovery Specialist to manage international medical provider payments, investigate questionable invoices, negotiate medical bills, and pursue recovery and subrogation opportunities on behalf of our insurance partners.

This is not a traditional accounts payable position. We're looking for someone who can investigate, negotiate, challenge costs, and take ownership of complex cases involving hospitals, medical providers, insurers, legal representatives, and third-party administrators around the world.

You'll work closely with our Medical Assistance, Claims, Finance, and Fraud teams to ensure invoices are legitimate, charges are reasonable, payments are accurate, and recovery opportunities are pursued.

Cost Containment & Provider Negotiations

  • Negotiate directly with hospitals, medical networks, and billing intermediaries to reduce medical expenses.

Recovery & Subrogation

Fraud Prevention & Invoice Verification

Reporting & Operational Improvement

  • Prepare regular reporting on payment volumes, negotiated savings, recovery performance, and suspected fraud.

what success looks like:

Role Title: STEM Expert – Chemistry & Computational Chemistry (PhD)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Summary: In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design, evaluate, and critique chemistry and computational chemistry problems, workflows, and reasoning chains to support AI benchmarking initiatives.
  2. Provide expert-level insights on reaction mechanisms, synthesis planning, spectroscopy analysis, molecular simulations, and electronic structure methods.
  3. Assess and optimize experimental protocols, simulation parameters, and software configurations for accuracy and reproducibility.
  4. Analyze chemical, spectroscopic, and simulation data and provide actionable recommendations.
  5. Leverage domain knowledge to guide the development and validation of chemistry-related AI models and tools.
  6. Communicate complex scientific concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally, to technical and non-technical collaborators.
  7. Document findings, methodologies, and best practices to ensure knowledge transfer across the customer’s team.

Areas of Expertise (we welcome applicants from any of the following):

  1. Organic synthesis & reaction mechanisms
  2. Inorganic & organometallic chemistry
  3. Physical & theoretical chemistry
  4. Analytical chemistry & spectroscopy
  5. Computational chemistry & molecular dynamics
  6. Cheminformatics & drug discovery
  7. Materials science & polymer chemistry

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  1. PhD in chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, materials science, or a closely related field.
  2. Hands-on research lab experience, including wet lab experience for experimental subfields, or extensive simulation-heavy research for computational subfields.
  3. Deep expertise in at least one of the areas listed above.
  4. Professional written and spoken English (C1 or higher).
  5. Proficiency in Python and/or industry-standard tools in your subfield (e.g., Gaussian, ORCA, Psi4, GROMACS, LAMMPS, RDKit).
  6. Excellent quantitative, analytical, and scientific reasoning skills.
  7. Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with the ability to clearly document and explain technical concepts.
  8. Track record of rigorous scientific problem-solving in complex chemistry domains.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Academic experience (postdoc, research scientist, faculty, or equivalent), strongly preferred.
  2. Peer-reviewed publications, patents, or contributions to open-source scientific software.
  3. Experience with AI/ML-assisted chemistry workflows or benchmarking.
  4. Background in drug discovery, reaction prediction, or retrosynthesis.

Director, Technical Readiness

College Board - Operations

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

College Board's Operations division is a best-in-class digital assessment delivery and customer engagement function that supports millions of students and thousands of test centers, annually. The Operations team is also leading exciting work to advance user experience using innovative solutions, products, and technology to enhance the end-to-end delivery of digital assessments and all aspects of customer support. Within Operations, the Assessment Delivery Operations (ADO) team is responsible for the successful execution of digital assessments like the SAT and Advanced Placement (AP) examinations, working closely with partners across College Board, the education sector, and beyond to improve testing technologies, customer experience, and outcomes. ADO’s User Readiness team ensures every district-level member, school-level educator, and test taker has what they need, and takes the critical actions required, to succeed on test day. This is done through multi-channel community engagement, effective digital communications, curated technical guidance, and risk-based outreach.

About the Opportunity

As the Director, Technical Readiness, you will make sure every testing environment is technically ready for digital testing, from the networks and devices students test on to the platform changes coordinators need to know about. You will serve as the assessment delivery requirements owner and primary liaison to the Bluebook team, translating technical and platform requirements into clear guidance that coordinators, school technology staff, and internal teams can act on across all College Board assessment programs. You will help support network engineer resources dedicated to this work, working closely with product, technology, and test day delivery teams to set readiness standards, spot technical risk early, and help prevent issues before they reach students on test day.

In this role, you will:

Technical and Platform Readiness Requirements (40%)

  • Own the translation of technical and platform changes into clear requirements and guidance for each audience. Audiences include test administration coordinators, technology monitors, school technology staff, and internal technical support teams
  • Maintain current technical readiness requirements for Bluebook, College Board’s digital testing application, and coordinator tools
  • Partner with product and technology teams early in the release cycle to identify the operational and user impact of upcoming changes
  • Contribute to operational readiness for new platform pilots by documenting technical requirements and readiness procedures
  • Develop the technical content for readiness communications and resources, partnering with the Digital Engagement team on channel and delivery

Network and Device Readiness (35%)

  • Help support network engineer resources dedicated to large and commercial venue network risk analysis, providing technical direction and staying hands-on with complex readiness issues
  • Define network and device readiness standards for school-owned testing devices and College Board loaner devices
  • Design readiness checks, diagnostic guidance, and troubleshooting resources for coordinators, support teams, and field staff to use in resolving issues
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex network and device readiness issues, partnering with technology teams and vendors to resolve them
  • Analyze technical incident trends to find root causes, and recommend changes that reduce preventable testing incidents
  • Coordinate with supply chain partners on loaner device requirements and readiness

Cross-Functional Partnership (25%)

  • Partner closely with the test day delivery team to align technical guidance, share release impacts, and support technical escalations during testing windows
  • Equip community engagement and proactive outreach partners with the technical knowledge coordinators need
  • Track and manage readiness work and requests in Jira and Salesforce
  • Document durable processes and guidance so technical knowledge is shared across teams rather than held by individuals

About You

  • Expertise in technical readiness, IT operations, or technical program work, with 5-7 years of experience translating technical requirements for non-technical audiences
  • Deep, currently knowledge of network environments, such as bandwidth, firewalls, content filtering, and allowlisting, and of managed device fleets across common operating systems, with the credibility to work closely with and support network and system engineers
  • Experience managing technical change: assessing the impact of software releases or platform updates and preparing users for them
  • Strong technical writing skills, including turning complex technical information into clear, step-by-step guidance
  • Experience analyzing incident or support data to identify root causes and recommend preventive fixes
  • Experience partnering with product, engineering, and vendor teams on requirements and escalations
  • Proficiency with Jira and Salesforce
  • Preferred: Experience in K-12, higher education, or enterprise IT environments. Technical certifications such as CompTIA Network+ are welcome but not required
  • A bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
  • The ability to travel 4-6 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, a performance exercise relevant to the role, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $80,000–$140,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

Build Reliable ITSM Workflows. Support Mission-Critical Federal Healthcare.

At Rackner, we develop and support technology that helps federal healthcare organizations deliver reliable, effective services. Behind those services are the systems and workflows that connect teams, manage requests, and keep critical IT operations running.

We're seeking a ServiceNow ITSM Engineer to configure, administer, and maintain the ServiceNow capabilities supporting enterprise IT service management. In this hands-on role, you'll help strengthen service reliability, improve operational workflows, and maintain the configurations that support incident management, service requests, and change coordination.

You'll collaborate with engineering and service-management teams, solve practical platform challenges, and apply your ServiceNow expertise in an environment where dependable technology directly supports an important federal healthcare mission.

What You'll Do

  • Configure and maintain ServiceNow ITSM capabilities supporting incident management, service requests, and daily service operations.
  • Maintain incident and request routing, assignment rules, and service-level agreement (SLA) definitions, including appropriate pause handling and service-level tracking.
  • Build and maintain service catalog items, provisioning workflows, and related operational dependency documentation.
  • Implement approved platform changes, coordinate technical handoffs with release-management stakeholders, and maintain supporting records and documentation.
  • Investigate configuration issues, troubleshoot workflow behavior, and collaborate with technical teams to improve platform reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Support occasional site go-lives and exercises, including onsite assistance with designated ServiceNow field-service or mobile configurations when needed.
  • Prepare monthly SLA evidence extracts and supporting technical records for operational reporting and assurance reviews.

Required Qualifications

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM) administration experience, including configuration and maintenance of operational service-management capabilities.
  • Eligibility for a Tier 3 federal background investigation.
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally for site go-lives and exercise support.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist — IT Service Management (CIS-ITSM) certification.
  • Experience with ServiceNow Field Service Management.
  • Administering ServiceNow ITSM in complex enterprise environments.

Why Rackner?

At Rackner, we value technical ownership, thoughtful problem-solving, and collaboration. You'll have the opportunity to strengthen your ServiceNow expertise, contribute to meaningful improvements in enterprise IT service management, and work alongside professionals focused on delivering dependable technology solutions.

We are a cyber security company that is on a mission to make the internet a safer place. We do this by delivering tooling and services related to an international standard, DMARC. Our technology enables organisations to protect their staff, customers, suppliers, and the whole world from email spoofing and impersonation attacks on their domains.

We’re a fully remote company with the majority of our builders working out of South Africa and sales teams in the Netherlands, the US, Latin America, Australia and the UK.

Mission

Own and scale Sendmarc’s vendor alliances across the US, turning strong partner relationships into a growing, predictable source of pipeline and revenue.

Why This Role Exists

Alliances multiply what a sales team can do alone. Our vendor partners’ field teams meet organisations with DMARC gaps every day, and vendor alliances are already one of our strongest go-to-market motions in the Americas. The upside is in how far they spread.

You’ll take that motion from the partner reps already engaged to broad regional participation, with the enablement, relationships and events that make Sendmarc the obvious answer when a partner rep spots an opportunity. You’ll work closely with our Director of Channel and Alliances, the North America sales team and Marketing, and have real say in how our alliance programme grows.

Outcomes

The four core outcomes this role is accountable for:

  1. Scale Vendor Alliances

Grow alliance-attributed pipeline and revenue across the region. Widen engagement from a small group of AEs and Sales Managers to broad participation, through joint account mapping, deal registration and targeted outreach to accounts with DMARC gaps.

  1. Enablement

Build the training, battlecards and joint messaging that let partner reps identify and qualify DMARC opportunities on their own.

  1. Regional Presence

Build lasting relationships with partner Sales Managers, channel reps, SDRs and marketing counterparts, so Sendmarc is a known participant in their regional sales cadence and event calendar.

  1. Events and Content

Represent Sendmarc at partner events, from Black Hat and RSA to regional events, and keep a regular content cadence going with Marketing.

Who We’re Looking For

You’re a relationship builder who gets energy from helping another company’s reps win. You know an alliance works when the partner’s team wants you in the room.

You bring the discipline to track what the relationship produces, and the instincts to know when a call will land better than an email. Cyber security experience helps. A record of growing a co-sell motion with a named technology partner matters more, and we’d like to see the numbers.

Competencies

ALLIANCE MANAGEMENT

  • Track record of building or scaling a co-sell motion with a named technology partner
  • Comfortable with deal registration, joint account mapping and segmented outreach
  • Owns a number, and reports pipeline and revenue against quarterly targets

WAYS OF WORKING

  • Works fluently with sales, marketing and the partner’s own team to keep the relationship enabled and engaged
  • Builds relationships with sales managers, AEs, SDRs and channel reps at the partner
  • Happy to travel for events and quarterly business reviews

ENABLEMENT AND CONTENT

  • Builds training, battlecards and joint messaging that reps use without help
  • Digital marketing or content experience (video, social) is a plus

EXPERIENCE

  • 3 to 6+ years in channel, alliance or partner management, ideally in cyber security or B2B SaaS
  • Familiarity with the email security and DMARC landscape (Proofpoint, Mimecast, Valimail) is a strong plus

Relationships

The Homeland Sector at Leidos currently has an opening for a Data Engineer with a strong background in data analytics to support an exciting DHS software development program. The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining the data architecture, pipelines, integrations, and data structures required to transform raw operational data into reliable, accessible, and analysis-ready information. The Data Engineer works across application, database, analytics, and business teams to ensure that data is accurately collected, integrated, transformed, governed, secured, and made available for reporting, business intelligence (BI), advanced analytics, and decision support.

Expected Duties and Responsibilities

Data Architecture and Engineering

  • Design logical and physical data models appropriate for analytical workloads.
  • Develop data structures that integrate information from multiple applications, databases, files, APIs, logs, and external data sources.
  • Evaluate existing data architectures and recommend improvements to reliability, scalability, performance, maintainability, and accessibility.
  • Support the design and implementation of data warehouses, data marts, data lakes, lakehouses, and other analytical data repositories as appropriate.

Data Integration and Pipelines

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain ETL/ELT processes and automated data pipelines.
  • Extract and integrate data from relational databases, applications, APIs, flat files, logs, and other structured and semi-structured sources.
  • Develop repeatable processes for transforming raw transactional data into standardized, analysis-ready datasets.
  • Implement scheduling, orchestration, monitoring, error handling, and recovery capabilities for data pipelines.
  • Develop interfaces and data feeds supporting downstream reporting, dashboards, analytics platforms, and external systems.

Data Transformation and Quality

  • Clean, normalize, deduplicate, validate, and transform data.
  • Investigate data discrepancies and work with application developers, database administrators, analysts, and business users to determine root causes.
  • Implement controls that prevent data-quality problems from propagating into downstream reports and analytical products.

Business Intelligence and Analytics Support

  • Develop curated datasets and data models optimized for BI, reporting, visualization, and analytical workloads.
  • Work with BI analysts and business stakeholders to translate business questions into data requirements.
  • Support development of common definitions and calculation methodologies for enterprise metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Support ad hoc analytical requests when new data sources or transformations are required.
  • Assist analysts in understanding data lineage, relationships, limitations, and appropriate use.

Data Governance and Documentation

  • Document data sources, transformations, interfaces, business rules, dependencies, lineage, and data definitions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for data pipelines, models, interfaces, and analytical repositories.
  • Support development and maintenance of data dictionaries and metadata repositories.

Database and Performance Engineering

  • Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and data transformations.
  • Analyze and improve performance of analytical queries and data-processing workloads.
  • Work with Database Administrators (DBAs) to optimize database structures supporting analytical requirements.
  • Recommend indexing, partitioning, aggregation, caching, or other techniques where appropriate.
  • Ensure analytical workloads do not adversely affect production transactional systems.

Security and Compliance

  • Implement data-engineering solutions consistent with organizational cybersecurity and privacy requirements.
  • Apply appropriate access controls to sensitive data.
  • Support data classification, encryption, auditing, logging, retention, and protection requirements.
  • Work with cybersecurity personnel to ensure data movement and storage comply with applicable security requirements.
  • Support protection of sensitive information, including PII and other controlled or restricted data.

Software Engineering and DevSecOps

  • Develop maintainable data-engineering code using established software development practices.
  • Maintain data pipeline code and configuration under version control.
  • Participate in peer reviews, testing, configuration management, and change-control processes.
  • Develop automated tests for data transformations and pipelines.
  • Support CI/CD and automated deployment practices for data-engineering components.
  • Troubleshoot production data-processing failures and perform root-cause analysis.

Basic Qualifications

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen
  • Must be capable of receiving a Public Trust clearance level.
  • Must have verifiable accredited education.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical discipline.

Experience Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, database development, software engineering, BI engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and developing ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines.
  • Strong experience with relational databases and SQL.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple heterogeneous sources.
  • Experience developing analytical data models, data warehouses, or similar repositories.
  • Experience troubleshooting data-quality and data-integration issues.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with technologies such as Azure, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Airflow, dbt, Kafka, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

Required Technical Skills

The candidate should possess strong proficiency in several of the following areas:

  • Advanced SQL and relational database concepts
  • Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or comparable RDBMS technologies
  • Python or another data-processing/programming language
  • ETL/ELT development
  • Data modeling and dimensional modeling
  • Data warehouse architecture
  • REST APIs and system integration
  • Data validation and quality management
  • Git or comparable version-control systems
  • Automated testing and CI/CD concepts
  • Structured and semi-structured data processing

Knowledge and Competencies

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to understand complex relationships among applications, databases, interfaces, and business processes.
  • Ability to translate business information requirements into technical data solutions.
  • Understanding of transactional versus analytical data architectures.
  • Understanding of data lineage, governance, quality, security, and lifecycle management.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to distinguish between a data problem, application problem, business-process problem, and analytical problem.
  • Strong documentation and configuration-management discipline.
