jobs.description:
Full-time

Remote with some travel

$165,000 – $190,000

About Us

The Ammortal Chamber integrates five science-backed modalities into one immersive 25-minute session. It is used in wellness clinics, spas, hotels, and homes. Our clients include specialty spas and clinics, professional and collegiate sports teams, hospitality partners, and individuals who care deeply about their recovery and performance.

We are a small team with a startup culture. After our first full year shipping a finished product, we have shown strong growth, and we are now scaling into our next stage. Our team is made up of engineers, designers, health professionals, and startup entrepreneurs.

As we continue expanding, this role offers the chance to shape how people experience Ammortal at every touchpoint, to build a design practice from a strong foundation, and to make a tangible impact on the future of wellness technology.

What is this role and why does it exist?

The Chamber is in more places than ever, and the experience now reaches well beyond the session itself. It includes the screen a guest touches before they lie down, the guidance they hear inside, the tools our partners use to run their day, and the website where many people first meet us. Capable people design each of these today, often in parallel. What we need now is one leader who holds them together as a single experience.

The VP of Experience Design leads design across the Chamber, our software, and our digital presence. Over time you will build the experience design team, the design system, and the standards that keep the experience coherent as we grow. You will report to our Chief Product Officer and work closely with Engineering, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Operations. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set direction, and you will also sit in the work.

Responsibilities:

  1. Experience vision and strategy: Define the end-to-end experience for Ammortal, from first impression to the moment a guest steps out of the Chamber. Translate it into principles, priorities, and a design roadmap shared with Product and Engineering.
  2. Chamber and software experience: Lead the design of every interface people use with the Chamber, including on-Chamber controls, the kiosk, in-session guidance, and the apps and tools our partners and guests rely on. Make each one calm, clear, and trustworthy, for first-time guests and regulars alike.
  3. One design system across every touchpoint: Build and own a unified design system, grounded in the Ammortal brand, that spans the Chamber, our software, and ammortal.com. Partner with Marketing and other teams so the website, the product, and the session room feel like one company, one product, one experience.
  4. Team and partner leadership: Lead, grow, and mentor Ammortal's internal design team, including interaction design. Direct external design partners and agencies with clear briefs and a single bar for quality.
  5. Research and craft standards: Build a research practice that brings guests, partners, and staff into major product decisions. Set the reviews, specifications, and standards that turn design intent into shipped quality.

Skills to Excel

  • Systems thinking across physical and digital
    • The Chamber is an object, a room, a screen, and a voice. This person treats them as one system and designs the transitions between them as carefully as each surface.
  • Restraint and taste
    • Our first design tenet is "Less, but better." This person removes before adding, and can explain why a choice earns its place.
  • Calm, credible leadership
    • Earns trust with engineers, marketers, and executives. Gives clear direction to internal teams and outside partners without adding process for its own sake.
  • Research-led judgment
    • Turns what guests, partners, and staff do into decisions, and knows when the evidence is strong enough to act on.
  • Hands-on craft
    • Still designs, prototypes, and critiques at a high level. Comfortable moving between strategy, interface detail, and physical prototypes in the same week.

Requirements

What technical knowledge do you need to perform in your role?

Required

  • Figma, including shared libraries and design system management
  • Interactive prototyping tools (ProtoPie, Framer, or similar)
  • Design-to-engineering handoff and specification practices
  • Qualitative and usability research methods

Preferred

  • Touchscreen, embedded, or HMI interface design
  • Voice, audio, or lighting as interface elements
  • Motion design
  • Web platforms such as Webflow or Shopify
  • AI-assisted design and research tools
  • Linear and Notion

Qualifications (Must haves):

  • 12+ years in product, interaction, or experience design, including 5+ years leading design teams
  • A portfolio of shipped work that spans hardware and software, or physical and digital experiences
  • Experience building and scaling a design system across multiple products or surfaces
  • A track record of leading both in-house designers and external partners or agencies
  • Experience working closely with brand and marketing teams
  • Real interest in wellness and in how people feel, not only in how they click

Qualifications (Nice to haves):

  • Experience in consumer hardware, wellness, health technology, or hospitality
  • Industrial design or physical product background
  • Experience designing immersive or sensory environments (light, sound, space)
  • Experience designing operator tools such as staff consoles or business dashboards
  • Experience growing a design team through Series A and beyond

Benefits

Pay, Location, and Benefits

  • Pay range: $165,000 - $190,000
  • Equity: 25,000 options vesting over 4 years with a 1 year cliff
  • Benefits: 80% health, dental, vision covered
  • Location: Remote (US), with some travel to our studio in Mars Hill, NC, about 20 minutes north of Asheville

The ET Project Lead is the execution owner and in-market custodian of Enovis Enabling Technologies, responsible for delivering a disciplined and high-quality launch of ARVIS and ensuring consistent deployment, utilisation, and operational excellence across all ET solutions within the market.

This is both a critical launch role and a permanent capability, evolving into long-term ownership of Enovis’ growing Enabling Technologies portfolio, including digital and future robotic platforms.

  • Ensure all launch milestones are delivered on time and to defined standards
  • Coordinate cross-functional readiness across sites, teams, and stakeholders

  • Provide hands-on support during initial cases (particularly the first 3–5 procedures per site)

  • Ensure alignment with International standards for deployment and utilisation
  • Act as the local point of contact for operational issues and escalation

  • Assess and validate readiness of hospitals and surgeons prior to go-live
  • Ensure adherence to defined clinical and operational protocols
  • Support early KOL engagement and capability building

5. Ongoing System Utilisation & Performance

  • Monitor and drive utilisation of ARVIS systems post-deployment
  • Identify and address barriers to adoption or consistency
  • Support continuous improvement in system use across accounts

6. Portfolio Expansion & Future Technologies

  • Support introduction and deployment of additional ET and digital solutions
  • Act as the in-market custodian of ET standards across the portfolio
  • Provide input on scalability and readiness for future technologies (e.g. robotics and/Integrated Care)

7. Interface with International ET

  • Provide structured feedback on execution, performance, and improvement areas
  • Ensure global governance and standards are consistently applied in market

Required Qualifications & Experience


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. engineering, life sciences, business)

Experience

  • Min 7 years of experience in MedTech, preferably in:
    • surgical technologies, navigation, robotics or capital equipment
  • Proven track record in:
    • product launches
    • clinical support or field operations
    • cross-functional coordination

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strong operational execution mindset
  • Ability to manage complexity and ambiguity
  • High credibility with surgeons and clinical teams
  • Excellent stakeholder management across sales, marketing and operations
  • Structured and disciplined approach to problem-solving

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Accounting Specialist with 3+ years of experience to own the day-to-day books for our growing digital agency, from reconciliations and invoicing to payroll prep and month-end close.

You will work directly with our leadership team and outside CPA to keep QuickBooks Online accurate, get clients billed on time, and keep vendors and payroll running smoothly. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, curious, and responsive, and capable of solving routine issues independently while knowing when to escalate a decision. This is a full-time position.

Responsibilities

Reconciliations & Month-End Close

  • Reconcile every bank and credit card account in QuickBooks Online weekly and at month-end
  • Complete weekly reconciliations every Monday so QBO balances match actual bank statements
  • Catch and flag discrepancies such as missing deposits, duplicates, or wrong amounts the same day
  • Trace unusual transactions back to the bank, invoice, or contract before posting; journal entries require leadership approval
  • Deliver a monthly P&L, balance sheet, and AR aging by the 10th, with every account reconciled and nothing left in Uncategorized or Ask My Accountant
  • Keep the books clean and ready for our CPA's quarterly review

Invoicing & Accounts Receivable

  • Own monthly invoicing for all recurring clients through Nickel, sent on the 1st of every month
  • Issue one-time project invoices as new contracts are signed
  • Track open invoices and send payment reminders on anything 15+ days past due
  • Apply payments to the correct invoices
  • Ensure every contract is billed on time and continually reduce past-due AR

Accounts Payable & Payroll Prep

  • Enter vendor bills, schedule payments, and keep vendor records current
  • Pay vendors on time with zero late fees or penalties
  • Collect contractor hours, rate changes, and new-hire details for each biweekly payroll cycle
  • Submit and confirm payroll inputs before every ADP deadline

Documentation & Communication

  • Build and maintain written SOPs for every recurring process, including reconciliations, invoicing, payroll prep, and bills
  • Use QBO bank rules, templates, and available tools to resolve routine issues independently
  • Respond to client, vendor, and team questions within one business day
  • Escalate only the items that need a decision, with the research already done

Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years of full-cycle bookkeeping for US small businesses
  • Daily, hands-on experience in QuickBooks Online, including bank feeds, bank rules, and reconciliations
  • Experience with invoicing, AR collections, and AP for a service business
  • Familiarity with US payroll inputs (W-2 and 1099 workers) and a provider like ADP or Gusto
  • Strong written English for client and vendor emails
  • Proven attention to detail and a habit of documenting your work

Preferred

  • Experience with Nickel or similar invoicing and payments platforms
  • Experience supporting a digital agency or professional services firm
  • Experience working alongside an outside CPA on quarterly reviews and year-end
  • QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification
  • Experience writing SOPs or process documentation

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6 months:

  • Every bank and card account is reconciled weekly, and QuickBooks matches the bank statements every week
  • Recurring client invoices go out on the 1st every month, and past-due AR is followed up consistently
  • Payroll inputs are submitted before every ADP cycle, and vendors are paid on time with zero late fees
  • A clean month-end package (P&L, balance sheet, AR aging) is delivered by the 10th every month, ready for our CPA's quarterly review
  • Every recurring process is documented in an SOP, so less leadership time is spent in the books

jobs.title: Long and Short Form Video Editor (Social Media Clipper) (BBS927)
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Long and Short Form Video Editor to watch YouTube content from a fast-growing social media creator, identify the best clippable moments, edit them into short-form clips, and run the creator's clipping pages across social platforms.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Long and Short Form Video Editor to watch YouTube content from a fast-growing social media creator, identify the best clippable moments, edit them into short-form clips, and run the creator's clipping pages across social platforms. This is a full-time, dedicated role for one creator's content operation.

You will spend most of your time watching videos, finding the moments that hit, clipping and editing them into shareable short-form content, and posting and managing the accounts where those clips live. You do not need to be a professional editor or have a marketing degree. You need good instincts for what makes a YouTube moment worth clipping, the ability to move fast, and the discipline to stay on top of a consistent posting schedule. AI tools for transcription and content review are encouraged. If you are plugged into creator culture, understand what performs on short-form platforms, and want a focused, high-output role inside a growing content operation, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Work directly inside the content operation of a viral social media creator with a large and growing audience
  • High-output, focused role with real creative input into how the creator's content reaches new audiences

What You'll Work On

Content Clipping and Identification

  • Watch YouTube videos and long-form content to identify the best clippable moments including funny, surprising, emotional, controversial, or highly shareable sequences
  • Use AI transcription and review tools to move through content faster and surface moments efficiently
  • Develop a strong instinct for what works on short-form platforms and what will stop the scroll

Short-Form Video Editing

  • Edit identified moments into polished short-form clips ready for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and X
  • Add captions, cuts, pacing adjustments, and light visual treatments to make clips platform-ready
  • Maintain a consistent output of clips without sacrificing quality

Social Page Management

  • Run and manage the creator's clipping pages across relevant platforms
  • Post consistently to a defined schedule and keep accounts active and growing
  • Monitor basic performance metrics and flag what is working to inform future clipping decisions
  • Engage with comments and community interactions on clipping pages as needed

What You Bring

  • Genuine understanding of what makes a YouTube or long-form video moment worth clipping; good instincts here matter more than a formal background
  • Comfortable watching and processing high volumes of video content efficiently, including using AI tools for transcription and review
  • Basic video editing skills with the ability to produce clean, platform-ready short-form clips
  • Active on social media and familiar with what performs on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and X
  • Organized and consistent with the ability to maintain a regular posting schedule across multiple platforms
  • Fast and self-directed with minimal need for oversight on day-to-day clipping and posting decisions

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience clipping or repurposing long-form content for a creator, brand, or media account
  • Experience running and growing social media accounts or clipping pages independently
  • Familiarity with AI transcription and video review tools
  • Background in or passion for creator culture, entertainment, or viral content

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A portfolio link or examples showing clips or short-form content you have created or pages you have managed
  3. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your experience with content clipping or social media management, and explaining what you think makes a YouTube moment worth clipping

Only candidates who submit both examples and a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you have good instincts for viral content, can move fast through long-form video to find the moments that matter, and want a focused full-time role inside a creator's content operation, this role gives you the volume and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

CoverMyMeds is recognized across McKesson as a leader in AI adoption. Our Technology organization runs on an AI-First operating model, with AI embedded in how we plan, build, secure, and deliver software. We are looking for a Senior Director, AI Enablement to lead the next stage of this transformation.


This Sr Director, AI Enablement will own AI strategy, governance, and AI engineering platforms for CoverMyMeds, and will build and deliver AI products using an agentic, AI-native approach, where AI agents are designed into products and workflows from the start rather than added later. The role scales safe and measurable AI adoption across engineering and business teams, and partners with McKesson's Enterprise AI team so capabilities are built once and reused across business units. This is a builder's role for someone who combines technical depth, product delivery, strategic vision, and the ability to change how people work.


Key Responsibilities:


AI Strategy and Roadmap

  • Define and own the AI enablement strategy and multi-year roadmap for CoverMyMeds, aligned with business priorities and McKesson's enterprise AI direction.
  • Manage a portfolio of concurrent AI initiatives and a multimillion-dollar budget, prioritizing investments by business value, risk, and reuse.
  • Measure and report AI adoption, productivity, and ROI to executive leadership.

Agentic-Native Product Build and Delivery

  • Own the build and delivery of AI products and agents end to end, from discovery and design through production release and ongoing improvement.
  • Champion an agentic-native approach: design products and workflows around AI agents from the start, with humans in the loop where it matters.
  • Partner with Product and business leaders to identify high-value use cases and turn them into products that deliver measurable clinical, operational, and financial outcomes.
  • Use AI-accelerated delivery to move from idea to production in days and weeks, while holding the bar on quality, security, and compliance.

Governance and Responsible AI

  • Chair the AI Review Board and own AI usage policy, model-selection frameworks, and token allocation and cost management.
  • Ensure HIPAA, privacy, and security requirements are built into AI development and delivery processes.
  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, and Compliance to enable fast, safe, and responsible AI adoption.

AI Platforms and Engineering Acceleration

  • Lead the teams that build and run reusable AI capabilities, including the AI Skills Marketplace, MCP servers, agents, and developer tooling.
  • Advance the AI-embedded SDLC, including spec-driven development, AI code review, automated vulnerability remediation, shift-left testing, and self-service developer onboarding.
  • Drive build-once, reuse-everywhere practices so shared AI assets serve multiple teams and business units.

Adoption, Enablement, and Change

  • Scale AI adoption beyond engineering to product, business, legal, finance, privacy, call center, and platform teams.
  • Own the AI training curriculum and champions network, from foundational AI literacy to advanced agentic workflows.
  • Advise senior leadership and the C-suite on AI strategy, capabilities, and risk.

Partnership and Leadership

  • Partner with McKesson's Enterprise AI team, architecture, product, and platform leaders to align standards and avoid duplicate effort.

  • Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of engineers, architects, and enablement specialists.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience with AI developer tooling such as Claude, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Experience with FHIR and healthcare interoperability standards.
  • Experience in a matrixed, multi-business-unit enterprise.

Technical Skills:

  • Generative and agentic AI: LLMs, RAG, agents, prompt and context engineering, model evaluation.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer, Finance and Modeling
jobs.excerpt: At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions.
jobs.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.

As an Analytics Engineer (Finance & Modeling), you'll own the metrics, reporting and reconciliation our financial decisions rest on, turning subscription and transaction data across OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall and Custody Navigator into numbers the business can defend. As that foundation becomes automatic, the work shifts toward forecasting and modeling.

You won't start from scratch. Our dbt project is live on Databricks with a star-schema finance mart in production and documented in Unity Catalog. What's missing is the layer on top, and that layer is yours. We also run an internal AI agent that answers business questions in Slack off the semantic layer, so every metric you define and test becomes a question Finance can ask directly rather than queue.

What you'll accomplish:

  • Governed metrics. Add the definitions the finance mart doesn't have yet (ARR, renewal rate, churn, CAC), versioned in dbt and documented in Unity Catalog, with the tests that make each one defensible, and wired into the agent so Finance can ask them directly.
  • Reporting Finance can run without you. Move the recurring finance pack into marimo, retire the Tableau views behind it, and turn a monthly hand-build into something that runs on a schedule.
  • Numbers that reconcile. Reconcile transactions across the app stores, payment processors, subscription systems and the ledger, with automated checks that alert rather than surface at close. Route discrepancies upstream with the evidence attached and turn each one into a test. You build the checks and escalate. Accounting owns the treatment.
  • Forecasting for Finance. Cohort subscriber and revenue projection, and aggregate renewal and retention forecasting, feeding the CFO's forecast and board reporting. LTV by acquisition source, feeding paid spend allocation with Growth. Pricing and promo impact, modeled before we ship rather than measured after. Individual churn propensity and uplift follow once there's a retention motion ready to act on the scores.
  • Models ship as scored tables in dbt and Unity Catalog, with tests, lineage and a definition the agent can answer from. Not as notebooks.

Who you are:

  • Statistically rigorous. You know why a cohort curve is the wrong shape, what a model is leaking, and when a result is noise.
  • Fluent in finance, and unwilling to let a number you can't explain go out the door. When two systems disagree, you find out why and tell the people upstream.
  • An engineer who owns the number end to end, from a CFO's question through the model, the test, the report and the conversation that follows. A spreadsheet nobody can reproduce reads to you as a liability.
  • AI-proficient in practice, not in theory. Claude Code, coding agents and agent SDKs are part of our daily loop, and we expect you to already work this way. A lot of what used to be a week of modeling work is now an afternoon, and we're hiring for people who have internalized that.
  • Willing to wear several hats. This is a small team supporting four brands. Some weeks you're deep in a retention model, some weeks you're chasing an app store discrepancy or unblocking someone else's dashboard. The scope above is the center of the role, not a fence around it.
  • Motivated by work that matters. Families rely on these products during real moments in their lives.

What you bring:

  • 3+ years in analytics engineering, data science, BI engineering or advanced analytics.
  • Statistical modeling shipped into a business process: forecasting, survival or cohort analysis, or propensity.
  • Measuring the lift from a price change or a growth experiment. You don't need to have designed the test, but you need to be able to read the result honestly and say what it's worth.
  • Subscription metrics you've built and defended to a finance stakeholder: ARR/MRR, renewal, churn, LTV/CAC, or cohort revenue.
  • Strong SQL and real dimensional modeling. You've designed marts, not just queried them.
  • Python and Git as daily habits.
Nice to have, not a dealbreaker:
  • dbt, Databricks and Unity Catalog, or a comparable lakehouse.
  • Reconciling transactional data to a financial system of record.
  • Code-first notebook reporting (marimo, Hex, Streamlit, Quarto).

jobs.description:
The Germany Payroll Specialist is a subject-matter expert responsible for the accurate, compliant and timely delivery of German payroll across GoGlobal's in-house client portfolio. Based in Romania within RDC Central, this role will build dedicated Germany payroll capability in GoGlobal's EMEA regional delivery model, creating resilient coverage, repeatable processes and scalable support close to GoGlobal's European client base.

This is a hands-on specialist position for someone with strong practical knowledge of German payroll, including gross-to-net processing, social security and tax requirements, statutory reporting, employee lifecycle changes, payroll controls and year-end activities. The successful candidate will work autonomously in a remote environment while partnering closely with Germany subject-matter experts, local partners, internal stakeholders and the Payroll Operations Lead.

This role is ideal for an experienced Germany payroll professional who wants to apply deep country expertise in a global, fast-paced services environment while helping establish Germany payroll delivery capability within RDC Central in Romania.

Roles & Responsibilities

Germany Payroll Processing

  • Own the end-to-end processing of German payrolls for a portfolio of GoGlobal clients, ensuring accuracy, compliance and on-time delivery every cycle.
  • Process and validate payroll inputs, including joiners, leavers, salary changes, variable pay, overtime, bonuses, absences, benefits, deductions and corrections.
  • Apply German payroll tax and social security requirements accurately, including employee and employer contributions, statutory deductions and applicable payroll treatments.
  • Coordinate required payroll declarations, statutory submissions and payment outputs with internal teams and authorised local partners within agreed deadlines.
  • Process and reconcile payroll journals, ensuring payroll outputs align with client finance requirements.
  • Validate statutory benefits, leave-related payroll treatments, severance-related items and other country-specific calculations, escalating complex cases where required.
  • Produce and distribute payslips, annual employee payroll statements and other required payroll documentation accurately and on time.
  • Complete payroll year-end activities, reconciliations, reporting and audit preparation for assigned German payrolls.

Compliance & Regulatory Adherence

  • Maintain current knowledge of German payroll legislation, tax and social security requirements, collective agreement considerations and employment-related payroll changes, proactively flagging impacts to the EMEA RPO and Data & Compliance function.
  • Ensure all German payrolls are processed in line with applicable statutory requirements, authorised guidance and GoGlobal's internal compliance standards.
  • Monitor and apply relevant legislative, regulatory and statutory rate changes affecting assigned German payrolls.
  • Maintain accurate and audit-ready payroll records for all assigned clients, ensuring documentation meets regulatory and internal governance standards.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing accurate payroll data, evidence of controls and clear explanations of processing decisions.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary payroll contact for designated Germany payroll clients, managing day-to-day queries with professionalism and accuracy.
  • Communicate proactively with clients on processing timelines, legislative changes and payroll-related actions required from their side.
  • Liaise with client HR and finance teams to collect and validate payroll inputs, resolve discrepancies and ensure clean data ahead of processing.
  • Escalate complex client queries, compliance risks or payroll errors to the EMEA RPO and relevant Germany subject-matter experts in a timely and structured manner.
  • Support client onboarding, parallel runs and go-live activities for new German payrolls, ensuring configurations, calendars and controls are established correctly.

Data Quality & Process

  • Conduct pre- and post-payroll data-quality checks to identify and resolve discrepancies before outputs are delivered to clients.
  • Maintain and update Germany payroll SOPs, run guides, calendars, checklists and process documentation, ensuring they reflect current requirements and GoGlobal operating standards.
  • Identify manual inefficiencies in Germany payroll processes and contribute ideas for automation, tooling improvements and standardisation within RDC Central.
  • Support system changes or new payroll tools affecting Germany payroll delivery, acting as the Germany payroll technical point of contact for testing and validation.
  • Contribute to RDC Central and the broader EMEA payroll operations team by sharing Germany payroll knowledge, supporting cross-training and providing documented backup coverage.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on Germany payroll processing experience, with strong working knowledge of end-to-end payroll calculations, controls, statutory requirements and payroll reporting.
  • Strong understanding of German payroll tax and social security requirements, employee lifecycle processing, statutory submissions and payroll reconciliations.
  • Experience applying country-specific payroll rules and working with local advisers or authorised partners on complex payroll matters.
  • Comfortable working remotely and independently, managing multiple client payrolls simultaneously to strict deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail with a structured, methodical approach to payroll processing, controls and data validation.
  • Experience using German payroll software, bureau platforms or equivalent in-house payroll systems.
  • Professional working proficiency in German and English, with the ability to explain payroll matters clearly to clients and non-payroll stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in payroll software and Microsoft Excel; experience with cloud-based payroll or HRIS platforms is advantageous.
  • Comfortable working with AI-assisted tools and open to continuous learning as RDC Central and the payroll function evolve.

Preferred

  • A recognised German payroll, accounting or HR qualification, or equivalent relevant professional certification.
  • Experience working in a payroll bureau, outsourced payroll, EOR, shared-services or global payroll environment.
  • Experience with German payroll applications, local statutory portals or equivalent country payroll platforms; previous experience with DATEV payroll software is desirable.
  • Experience supporting payroll audits, statutory reviews or compliance assessments in Germany.
  • Experience supporting payroll implementations, transitions or knowledge transfer into a regional delivery centre.
  • Knowledge of GDPR and data-protection obligations in a payroll-processing context.

ABOUT US

GoGlobal is the leading professional services company to guide, establish and manage global operations with compliance and confidence. We bring the human touch to entering new markets and consolidating vendors through a single point of management. With a presence in over 140 countries on six continents and growing, we make running a global business easy.

  • HR Solutions: Global recruitment, Employer of Record (EOR), Agent of Record (AOR), Global benefits, Global payroll, International HR Consulting

OVERVIEW

At GoGlobal, we give you the autonomy to make decisions that create real impact. We prioritize results over hours worked, focusing on quality of outcomes rather than tracking time.

As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames.

  • We are not a family. We operate more like a high-performing sports team where each individual's contribution is crucial to our collective success

Unlike big, siloed companies, we work seamlessly to handle international deals without the headaches of territorial ownership
  • We believe in transparency and trust. Every month, we share our financials with the team so everyone knows where we stand and what's coming next. It's all about open communication, building trust and empowering every individual to be part of our journey. We don't tell you what to think - we provide the information you need to make your own informed decisions
  • We believe flexibility drives success. Our company is built on trust, and that's why we embrace fully remote work, and hybrid options in some countries. jobs.excerpt: Our Risk Solutions team is currently seeking a Commercial Auto Technical Manager in our Worcester, MA location.
jobs.description:
Our Risk Solutions team is currently seeking a Commercial Auto Technical Manager in our Worcester, MA location. Position is eligible for a fully remote arrangement. This is a full-time, exempt role.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Risk Solutions Technical Manager - Commercial Auto supports the Risk Solutions field, Technical Services team, Corporate Underwriting, Claims, and commercial business partners. The role provides technical leadership for commercial auto and fleet-related risk assessment and consultative services across a range of vehicle types, fleet sizes, operating models, industries, and regulatory environments. The Technical Manager advances disciplined risk selection, effective risk improvement, field capability, and consistent survey and report quality, with emphasis on driver management, fleet safety systems, crash reduction, vehicle maintenance, regulatory compliance, and the effective use of telematics and other vehicle safety technologies. Responsibilities/Essential Functions

Corporate Underwriting and Technical Team Support: Partner with Corporate Underwriting, Technical Directors, Claims, Industry Leadership, and business partners to evaluate commercial auto exposures and controls; contribute to new and existing class-of-business strategies; and provide technical consultation on complex, high-hazard, or emerging fleet risks. Risk Solutions Field Training and Technical Support: Lead and support commercial auto technical skill development for Risk Solutions field consultants through training, coaching, co-travel, account consultation, quality review, case studies, and practical field tools. Strategic Project Initiatives: Work closely with the Technical Director team and Corporate Underwriting on projects that strengthen commercial auto risk selection, service strategy, technical guidance, best practices, data use, and response to emerging loss trends. Account Survey and Service: Support field execution through technical account consultation and quality reviews. Travel, when appropriate, to lead or assist with complex or high-risk fleet surveys, customer consultations, and stewardship activities. Technical Standards and Governance: Develop, maintain, and promote consistent commercial auto assessment standards, service practices, recommendation guidance, documentation expectations, and quality controls that support defensible and actionable work products.

Key Job Duties

Collaborate with Industry Leadership, Corporate Line of Business Underwriting, Claims, Field Operations Leaders, underwriters, Risk Solutions service managers, agents, and customers on commercial auto risk issues and improvement opportunities. Monitor commercial auto loss drivers, emerging exposures, regulatory developments, and industry practices; translate findings into field guidance, training, tools, and action plans. Provide advanced technical consultation on driver qualification and selection, motor vehicle record standards, driver onboarding and training, distracted-driving controls, seat-belt use, fatigue management, routing and scheduling, vehicle use policies, and management accountability. Evaluate fleet safety management systems, including crash reporting and investigation, preventability determination, post-crash coaching, trend analysis, corrective action, and measurement of program effectiveness. Provide technical guidance on vehicle selection, inspection, preventive maintenance, defect reporting, load securement, towing, specialized vehicle operations, and applicable commercial motor vehicle requirements. Maintain working knowledge of Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations, DOT and FMCSA expectations, and state or local requirements relevant to the fleets and operations being evaluated. Advance effective use of telematics, in-cab and outward-facing camera systems, driver monitoring, advanced driver-assistance systems, GPS and routing tools, and other fleet technologies. Emphasize documented management review, coaching, accountability, and measurable risk improvement rather than technology adoption alone. Collaborate with Field Operations Leaders and Technical Directors to identify skill gaps, establish development priorities, and strengthen field capability for commercial auto risk assessment and consultative service. Collaborate with Risk Solutions field staff through co-travel, account consultation, quality reviews, mentoring, and technical trainings to support development and consistent survey and report standards. Develop and maintain internal technical resources, including training modules, owner manuals, best-practice guidelines, survey aids, recommendation language, and technical reference materials, as well as appropriate customer-facing resources. Partner on innovative solutions and vendor relationships that support collision reduction, driver behavior improvement, fleet maintenance, claim defensibility, and operational efficiency; assist with implementation and field execution. Support and promote Risk Solutions commercial auto services and capabilities with customers, agents, underwriting partners, and internal stakeholders. Attend industry conferences, professional development programs, technical seminars, and webinars to maintain expertise and awareness of fleet safety and commercial auto trends.

Key Measures of Success

Quality, consistency, defensibility, and business impact of technical work products. Effective partnership with Risk Solutions Field Operations, Technical Directors, Industry Leadership, Underwriting, Claims, agents, and customers. Development and adoption of innovative commercial auto tools, technical resources, guidance, and training. Measurable improvement in field capability, account consultation, survey quality, and report quality. Positive project-management outcomes, including timely delivery, stakeholder alignment, and effective implementation. Practical innovation that improves risk insight, collision-reduction efforts, quality, or operational efficiency. Timeliness, responsiveness, productivity, and sound prioritization across multiple assignments.

Required Skills, Experience and Competencies

At least 10 years of Risk Solutions, loss control, fleet safety, transportation safety, or related commercial insurance experience, including significant field-based risk assessment and consultative service experience with a national or regional commercial lines carrier, fleet operator, or comparable organization. Demonstrated expertise in commercial auto exposures and controls, including fleet safety program evaluation, driver qualification, MVR standards, driver training and supervision, loss and root cause analysis, vehicle inspection and maintenance, and management accountability. Working knowledge of DOT and FMCSA requirements and their application to commercial motor vehicle operations; ability to distinguish regulated fleet requirements from broader fleet safety best practices. Experience evaluating fleet and loss data and translating findings into clear risk insights, customer recommendations, underwriting support, field guidance, and action plans. Knowledge of telematics, camera systems, driver monitoring, ADAS, and other vehicle technologies, including how data should be used for driver coaching, accountability, and continuous improvement. Professional designation or certification preferred, such as CSP, ASP, ARM, CPCU, CDS, TRIP or equivalent transportation/fleet safety credential. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience preferred in occupational safety, risk management, transportation, engineering, business, insurance, or a related field. Motivated self-starter with demonstrated initiative and the ability to work independently with minimal direction. Strong to exceptional written, verbal, facilitation, presentation, and consultative communication skills, including the ability to influence technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Strong to exceptional analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills; sound judgment when addressing complex or incomplete risk information. Demonstrated project-management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and assignments in a dynamic environment. Results-focused, collaborative, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning and consistent technical standards. Possesses a superior consultative skillset necessary for risk assessment, risk improvement, customer engagement, and underwriting partnership.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

Ability to use a personal computer and other standard office equipment. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities. Ability to travel as necessary, including travel to customer locations and field operations. Ability to sit and/or stand for extended periods. Ability to walk through customer buildings, yards, terminals, shops, loading areas, and other operating environments. Ability to safely observe vehicles and fleet operations in active work environments and to enter or exit vehicles when necessary for the assignment.

This job posting provides cursory examples of some of the job duties associated with this position. The examples provided are not complete, and the position may entail other essential and job-related functions and responsibilities that employees will be required to perform.

We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth stor​y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

Iron Mountain is seeking an authoritative Principal BMS & Controls Engineer to join our Design & Engineering team.


In this role, you will serve as the regional technical authority shaping the next generation of control systems, instrumentation, and automation architectures across our expanding data centre portfolio. You’ll have the opportunity to set engineering standards and govern complex designs that directly safeguard operational resilience and platform reliability. Here, your senior technical leadership and engineering judgement will turn forward-thinking concepts into scalable, mission-critical infrastructure.


What You’ll Do (Responsibilities) In this role, you will:


  • Set regional technical direction: Define design principles, basis-of-design requirements, and performance outcomes for BMS, EPMS, plant PLCs, operational technology (OT), and DCIM integrations.
  • Govern standards and architecture: Maintain discipline assurance frameworks, approved specifications, and technical standards across new builds, customer expansions, and operational upgrades.

  • Foster engineering capability: Cultivate a regional community of practice, mentoring senior engineering colleagues and advising executive leadership on long-term technology roadmaps.

What You’ll Bring (Skills & Qualifications) The ideal candidate will have:


  • 15+ years of relevant experience, including demonstrated technical leadership across large-scale data centres or complex mission-critical environments.
  • Strong knowledge of data centre BMS, EPMS, plant PLC sequencing, OT cybersecurity, and DCIM architectures.
  • Proven ability to set regional technical governance, reconcile global requirements with local codes, and resolve ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.
  • Exceptional stakeholder leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams, equipment vendors, and executive leadership without formal authority.

jobs.excerpt: Why is Health Advocate a great place to work?  For starters, Health Advocate employees enjoy helping people every single day.
jobs.description:
Why is Health Advocate a great place to work? For starters, Health Advocate employees enjoy helping people every single day. Employees are given the training they need to do their jobs well, and they work with supervisors and staff who are supportive and friendly. Employees have room to grow, and many of Health Advocate's supervisors are promoted from within the company. Join our award winning team!

2025:

  • Stevie® Awards for Sales & Customer Service: Customer Service Department of the Year – Healthcare, Pharmaceuticals, and Related Industries, Bronze Winner

2024:

  • Excellence in Customer Service Awards: Organization of the Year (Small)

  • Stevie® Awards for Sales & Customer Service: Customer Service Department of the Year – Healthcare, Pharmaceuticals, and Related Industries, Bronze Winner

As part of Teleperformance in the US, we were also named #95 in the 2024 ‘Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®’ in the USA by Great Places to Work (GPTW®)

Help People. Grow a Team. Build Better Software.


Do you enjoy using technology to make a difference in people’s lives? Are you a hands-on technical leader who enjoys developing others and continuing to learn? At Health Advocate, you can help build software that makes it easier for people to navigate healthcare and access the support they need.


We’re looking for a Software QA Manager who can balance business priorities with technical improvements and innovation. You’ll lead our company-wide QA team, including offshore employees, and shape how we test and improve our applications and services. You’ll bring the judgment to decide where automation adds value, where deeper investigation is needed, and how to make the best use of the team’s time.


This role combines people leadership with hands-on engineering. You should be comfortable discussing product risks with business leaders, coaching a QA engineer, reviewing automation code, and investigating an issue across the full application stack.


Experienced SDETs and QA technical leads with demonstrated experience leading technical staff are encouraged to apply.


Key Responsibilities


Lead and Develop the QA Team

· Manage all QA employees, including offshore resources, with clear expectations, work assignments, feedback, and accountability.

· Assess individual and team capabilities, identify skill gaps, and establish training and development plans.

· Mentor staff in testing techniques, automation, troubleshooting, and effective collaboration.

· Conduct performance reviews and support hiring, onboarding, and career development.

· Coordinate work across locations and time zones, establishing effective communication and handoffs.


Set Strategy and Balance Priorities

· Lead QA planning across Health Advocate’s software portfolio.

· Evaluate and prioritize requests for QA support based on business value, product risk, delivery commitments, and available capacity.

· Balance immediate delivery needs with investments in automation, technical improvements, and new testing approaches.

· Review existing test cases, automated suites, environments, test data, and documentation to identify gaps, duplication, and maintenance needs.

· Develop a long-term QA improvement plan with clear priorities, resource needs, and measures of progress.

· Communicate staffing constraints and technical tradeoffs, recommending practical options to leadership.


Guide Full Stack Testing and Automation

· Create and review test strategies and test plans covering the full application stack, including user interfaces, APIs, services, databases, servers, connectivity, and integrations.

· Validate complete user workflows, data integrity, and interactions between systems—not just individual components.

· Design and guide maintainable automation for web, API, Windows desktop, and mobile products, drawing on team expertise where needed.

· Write, review, debug, and maintain automation code to establish sound practices and support staff development.

· Guide functional, exploratory, integration, regression, performance, and load testing.

· Investigate failures across application layers using logs, database queries, service responses, and other diagnostic evidence.

· Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and improve the reliability and usefulness of test results.

· Oversee the availability, reliability, and maintenance of test environments, test data, and testing infrastructure, including automation frameworks and test execution systems for cloud-hosted and other applications.

· Evaluate and apply AI tools to improve testing, automation, analysis, and documentation, reviewing their outputs for accuracy and usefulness.


Partner on Product Quality and Release Readiness

· Work with product, design, and engineering teams throughout development to clarify expected behavior and identify risks early.

· Promote shared responsibility for quality, including developer-owned testing and close collaboration with QA.

· Execute tests and perform exploratory testing to understand products, investigate issues, and guide the team.

· Ensure test coverage reflects realistic usage, failure conditions, and business-critical workflows.

· Communicate defects, coverage gaps, dependencies, and release risks clearly.

· Review regression, performance, and load test results, assess unresolved risks, and provide evidence-based release readiness assessments and actionable recommendations.


Required Qualifications

· Must reside in the United States.

· A completed bachelor’s degree or higher.

· Substantial software QA experience, including hands-on automation design and implementation.

· Experience managing technical employees or serving as a technical team lead responsible for work assignments, mentoring, and delivery accountability.

· Experience managing or leading offshore technical resources and coordinating work across time zones.

· Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, with the ability to write, review, debug, and maintain automation code.

· Full-stack testing experience spanning user interfaces, APIs, backend services, databases, and system integrations.

· Ability to investigate issues involving application servers, connectivity, data flow, and dependencies.

· Experience designing and executing performance and load tests and interpreting the results.

· Experience testing cloud-hosted applications or services; no specific cloud provider is required.

· Working knowledge of database querying and data validation.

· Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, defect management, and software delivery practices.

· Practical experience using AI tools professionally, including prompting AI assistants to support coding, testing, analysis, or documentation.

· Ability to assess technical capabilities, prioritize competing needs, and balance business commitments with technical improvements.

· Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical teams and business leaders.


Preferred Qualifications

· A degree in a technical or quantitative field, such as Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or Chemistry.

· Formal people-management experience, including performance reviews, hiring, and career development.

· Experience working with Git repositories and version control workflows.

· Experience testing and automating Windows desktop applications.

· Mobile application testing and automation experience.

· Security and privacy testing experience.

· Familiarity with HIPAA and practices for handling protected health information (PHI).

· Experience improving QA practices across multiple products or teams.

· Experience with Selenium, Cucumber or other BDD frameworks, TestNG, Appium, BrowserStack, Postman, or comparable testing tools is preferred.


Initial Priorities

· Assess QA staff capabilities and identify training and development needs.

· Evaluate active and incoming requests for QA support and recommend priorities and staffing assignments.

· Review existing test cases, automation, environments, and other testing assets.

· Develop a long-term plan that balances near-term delivery needs with improvements in quality, automation, and team effectiveness.


Why Health Advocate?

At Health Advocate, technology is at the heart of how we help people navigate healthcare and get the support they need. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to lead and develop a QA team while directly influencing the quality, reliability, and performance of software that supports our members and clients.


You’ll join an environment where you can stay close to the technology while also shaping people, processes, and strategy. Whether you’re improving automation, strengthening testing practices, exploring how AI can make the team more effective, or helping determine whether a product is ready to release, your work will have a direct connection to the experience we provide to the people who rely on us.


If you’re looking for a leadership role where you can help people, grow a technical team, and build better software, Health Advocate offers the opportunity to do all three.


Salary Range: Up to $140,000 annually based on experience and education.


Physical Requirements:
This position is primarily sedentary, requiring prolonged sitting while performing administrative tasks. The role involves extensive use of a computer for typing, mouse navigation, and reading information on a screen for extended periods. Frequent phone use is required for communication with team members, clients, or external parties. Essential physical functions include fingering, grasping, pulling hand-over-hand, and repetitive motions necessary for navigating software, entering data, and interacting with electronic documents.


Mental and Cognitive Requirements:
The role requires strong concentration, attention to detail, and the ability to complete tasks accurately. Critical thinking and problem-solving skills are essential to address issues that may arise in day-to-day duties. Effective verbal and written communication skills are needed for responding to inquiries and collaborating with others.


Work Environment:
This position is fully remote and requires a home office environment with appropriate lighting, a computer, and phone access. The workspace should be free from distractions to ensure effective focus and productivity during work hours.

Company Overview

Health Advocate is the nation’s leading provider of health advocacy, navigation, well-being and integrated benefits programs. For 20 years, Health Advocate has provided expert support to help our members navigate the complexities of healthcare and achieve the best possible health and well-being. Our solutions leverage a unique combination of best-in-class, personalized support with powerful predictive data analytics and a proprietary technology platform to address nearly every clinical, administrative, wellness or behavioral health need. Whether facing common issues or an unprecedented challenge like COVID-19, our team of highly trained, compassionate experts work together to go above and beyond expectations, making healthcare easier for our members and ensuring they get the care they need.

jobs.excerpt: About FreshBooks You've probably learned a bit aboutFreshBooks before making it to this point, but let us take a moment to introduce ourselves: At FreshBooks, we believe that small business owners are the backbone of the economy, yet they are often the most underserved when it comes to technology.
jobs.description:
About FreshBooks

You've probably learned a bit aboutFreshBooks before making it to this point, but let us take a moment to introduce ourselves: At FreshBooks, we believe that small business owners are the backbone of the economy, yet they are often the most underserved when it comes to technology. For over 20 years, we’ve been on a mission to support owners, from the scrappy solopreneur with a big dream to the growing business with employees to manage.

Our leading platform is more than just business software; it’s an all-in-one financial toolkit that automates invoicing, expenses, payments and payroll, allowing our customers to spend less time on paperwork and more time doing the work they love.

We believe in human-centric connections that empower teams to do their best work. Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, our team operates in clusters across North America and Europe using a variety of working environments - remote, hybrid, and in-office - all based on what’s best for the team, collaboration, and mental well-being. We are committed to creating a supportive and flexible workplace where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact on the lives of small business owners worldwide.

About the role

The Director, Payments & Financial Services is a senior leadership role within the Payments and Financial Services Line of Business, reporting directly to the General Manager, Financial Services and Payments. With Payments as a core growth engine for FreshBooks, this leader is accountable for running the Payments business day-to-day and delivering in-year P&L impact across the Payments and Financial Services Lines of Business.

This is the operational heart of the LOB, and it is a hands-on, player-coach role. The Director owns the rhythm of the business, drives cross-functional execution across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Support, and Risk, and makes the trade-offs between customer experience, operational feasibility, risk exposure, and financial performance. They translate multi-year strategy into quarterly delivery, hold teams accountable for measurable results, and intervene decisively when the numbers require a course correction — while personally rolling up their sleeves on execution, not just directing it.

The ideal candidate is a deep payments operator ready to grow into full commercial ownership — analytically rigorous, commercially sharp, and a confident executive communicator — who does the work rather than only delegating it, and who can own delivery on the biggest bets (surcharging, repricing, embedded product expansion) while keeping the day-to-day machine running.

What you'll do

Run the Payments Business — Operating Rhythm, Metrics, and Delivery

  • Own the operating rhythm: weekly business reviews (WBR), monthly business reviews (MBR), monthly P&L reviews, and the monthly KPI report in partnership with FP&A and Data & Analytics.
  • Own the TPV and revenue forecast as source of truth; monitor performance against net revenue, TPV, and net Payments-attached-user targets, and drive the actions to close gaps.
  • Translate performance insights into clear, executive-ready recommendations and deliver them in leadership and cross-LOB forums.

Drive Execution on Priority Initiatives

  • Lead delivery on the highest-value Payments initiatives — surcharging, repricing, AutoPay phases, Optimized Payments / interchange work, and launch readiness for BNPL and embedded partners (Klarna, Cash App, Affirm, Embedded IPO).
  • Manage the Payments portfolio: prioritize across initiatives, influence resource allocation, and hold cross-functional partners accountable for delivery, results, and learnings.
  • Challenge or adjust decisions that could limit business impact — default configurations, pricing changes, rollout sequencing.

Own Payment Operations Execution

  • Own the operational backbone hands-on: payouts and reconciliation health, processor and payout workflows (e.g., Stripe Connect), and the automation that reduces cost, errors, and support volume.
  • Oversee 1099 operations, compliance reviews, and PayFac sub-merchant controls (chargeback, fraud, merchant-default monitoring).
  • Own vendor and partner onboarding and operational performance — uptime, SLAs, and adherence to payment security and compliance standards.

Own Partner, Vendor, and Network Relationships

  • Manage the day-to-day relationship with Stripe (monthly ops, accelerator program, QBRs) as the most active external surface.
  • Support and execute partner and vendor negotiations across BNPL providers, processors, and card networks (Visa, Mastercard, Discover), escalating strategic terms to the GM.
  • Steward external advisor and consultant engagements supporting CoGS, pricing, and PMM work.

Own High-Value Customer and Commercial Decisions

  • Own the high-value customer strategy, including strategic account pricing and repricing initiatives.
  • Set and enforce pricing within guardrails; recommend guardrail changes and escalate significant exceptions to the GM.
  • Balance customer growth against margin discipline and PayFac sub-merchant risk exposure.

Partner and Influence Across the Organization

  • Serve as a trusted business partner to leaders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Support, and Risk, driving outcomes through cadence and influence rather than direct authority.
  • Chair the Payments leadership forums (monthly leadership review, bi-weekly POD leadership) and represent the business in cross-LOB and executive forums.

Manage Risk, Compliance, and Market Intelligence

  • Partner with Risk and Finance on risk strategy and guardrails; oversee compliance reviews and regulatory obligations.
  • Track the payments and fintech ecosystem — competitive threats, network and regulatory shifts — and translate signals into near-term action and forward strategy.

  • Collaborate with regional and global leadership to develop and implement growth strategies that accelerate GoGlobal's expansion within the China market.
  • Foster a client-centric mindset across the organization, balancing client needs with commercial objectives and operational efficiency.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in client account management, portfolio management, customer success, corporate services, professional services, consulting, or related fields.
  • Strong leadership experience managing and developing high-performing account management or client services teams.
  • Deep understanding of China's business environment and corporate services landscape, including accounting, payroll, tax, legal, entity management, HR, employment compliance, and Employer of Record (EOR) solutions.
  • Demonstrated success driving client retention, revenue growth, profitability, and strategic account expansion.
  • Strong commercial mindset with the ability to identify growth opportunities and translate client needs into business outcomes.
  • Proven experience working with multinational companies expanding into or operating within China.

The successful candidate is a commercially minded leader with deep expertise in the China market and a passion for client success. They are equally comfortable coaching Account Managers, advising multinational clients, engaging executive stakeholders, identifying growth opportunities, and driving operational excellence across a diverse portfolio. They understand the complexities of operating in China and can translate that knowledge into strategic value for both clients and the business.

OVERVIEW

As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames.

Sometimes, things just take time to do well. In our business, delivering great results is a process - and we're committed to doing it right.

We are not for sale. We believe that financial success is a natural outcome of our work, not the primary goal. Unlike many investors who view money as a goal, our focus is on long-term growth and sustainable success.

We are a global team, built for those who want to go further. Here's what your career at GoGlobal looks like:

A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact

Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team

Built for the long-haul - no VC or PE pressure, just a focus on sustainable growth

WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT

We Make Growing Your Career Possible

    • We operate with the benefits of a partnership without the complexities of a partnership. Our hybrid partnership-corporate model offers all employees the opportunity to become a partner, while maintaining a streamlined corporate structure so that decisions are made quickly.
    • We do not offer equity plans. As we are not for sale and are not chasing an exit, "stock options" hold little value in our business model. Instead, we provide opportunities for outstanding employees to make partner and share in the profits. We believe it's better to build lasting value than to chase a one-time payout.
    • We prioritize organic and sustainable growth. Expanding operations quickly by way of mergers and acquisitions might seem appealing, but the reality is integrating diverse cultures can be challenging. We're proud of our own culture and prefer to grow it our way.
    • We're global. We offer career opportunities across the world-whether it's new job roles or international locations
    • English is our official language, but for many, it's our second language. We embrace this and find it rewarding communicating with colleagues from all over the world.
    • We are not a family. We operate more like a high-performing sports team where each individual's contribution is crucial to our collective success.
    • We keep things simple and collaborative. Our structure makes it easy for teams to work together across borders so we can serve our clients with global needs more effectively. Unlike big, siloed companies, we work seamlessly to handle international deals without the headaches of territorial ownership.
    • We believe in transparency and trust. Every month, we share our financials with the team so everyone knows where we stand and what's coming next. It's all about open communication, building trust and empowering every individual to be part of our journey. We don't tell you what to think - we provide the information you need to make your own informed decisions.
    • We believe flexibility drives success. Our company is built on trust, and that's why we embrace fully remote work, and hybrid options in some countries. Forget rigid office routines - it's old school! This flexibility fuels productivity, strengthens our workforce, and ensures we remain agile in a fast-changing world.

jobs.description:
Sierra Interactive is a leading real estate SaaS platform helping agents, teams, and brokerages across the U.S. and Canada grow their businesses. Our products help customers generate more leads, close more deals, and operate more efficiently. We’re a profitable, high-growth company with a fully remote team of 60+ employees and ambitious expansion goals over the next five years.

Job Summary:

As a Sierra Interactive Support Analyst, you will provide excellent technical and account management support as our clients utilize our real estate websites and CRM platform. Your job is to ensure that our clients successfully use our software by providing the best education and technical support. You’ll also bring a technically curious mindset to the role, finding opportunities to design, build, and deploy GenAI, low-code and automated improvements that make our team and our clients more efficient.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:

Customer Support & Technical Troubleshooting

  • Become an expert in Sierra's real estate CRM, IDX websites, and platform functionality to provide knowledgeable, effective support.
  • Provide technical, educational, and account management support through phone, email, and other support channels, approaching every customer interaction with patience, respect, and enthusiasm.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and document technical issues, collaborating with platform experts and other teams to identify and resolve problems.
  • Leverage internal resources, knowledge bases, and team expertise to deliver accurate, timely solutions.
  • Recognize at-risk customers and proactively contribute to their recovery and overall success.

Technical Curiosity, AI & Automation

  • Technical Curiosity & AI Innovation: Actively explore, test, and adopt emerging technologies, including GenAI (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT), low-code/no-code platforms, and automation tools, to build practical solutions, improve workflows, and expand the team's technical capabilities.
  • Process Ideation: Observe workflows across Support and other teams, ask thoughtful questions, and identify opportunities to reduce manual effort through automation, AI, and process improvements.
  • Solution Development & Deployment: Design, build, test, and implement automation-driven solutions, scripts, and workflows that improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Documentation & Process Improvement: Develop and maintain clear documentation and repeatable processes that enable teammates to understand, support, and maintain deployed solutions. Continuously evaluate and refine workflows as tools, technologies, and business needs evolve.

Collaboration, Knowledge Sharing & Continuous Improvement

  • Create and maintain clear, accurate, and engaging internal and customer-facing documentation as Sierra's platform evolves.
  • Share customer feedback, recurring issues, and frontline insights to help improve platform functionality, product development, and the overall customer experience.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally on projects and initiatives that improve Support operations and the customer experience.
  • Identify opportunities to improve team processes, support tools, and workflows as our customer base continues to grow.
  • Stay current on product updates, new features, and emerging technologies to continuously expand your knowledge and support capabilities.

Requirements:

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • 1–3+ years of experience in customer support, technical support, product support, or customer success within a SaaS environment.

Technical Skills & Aptitudes

  • Technical Foundations: Solid understanding of IT fundamentals, including hardware, software, networking, and internet technologies, with experience troubleshooting technical issues.
  • Logical Thinking: Demonstrates analytical and logical thinking skills, including an understanding of variables, loops, conditional logic, and basic data manipulation.
  • Technical Adaptability: Eager to explore and learn new technologies, with a demonstrated ability to independently adopt unfamiliar software, tools, and technical concepts.
  • GenAI, Low-Code & Automation: Hands-on experience with, or strong interest in, GenAI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Grok), low-code/no-code platforms, and workflow automation tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, Microsoft Power Automate, HubSpot workflows).
  • Web Technologies & Integrations: Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, APIs, JSON, and DNS.
  • Business Applications: Experience using HubSpot or comparable help desk platforms, Atlassian tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence), CRM systems, Windows, and Google Workspace.
  • Additional Technical Experience: Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., Python), RPA platforms (e.g., UiPath, Automation Anywhere), or AI-assisted development tools is a plus.

Problem-Solving & Continuous Improvement

  • Problem-Solving & Automation Mindset: Approaches challenges with a natural "how can we make this easier?" mindset, proactively identifying opportunities to leverage automation, eliminate repetitive tasks, streamline processes, and build smarter, more efficient, and scalable workflows.
  • Process Improvement: Recognizes patterns, identifies inefficiencies, and proactively develops solutions that improve the experience for both customers and teammates.
  • Build-to-Deploy Ownership: Comfortable taking an improvement from idea to implementation, including scoping, building, testing, documenting, deploying, and maintaining solutions.
  • Initiative & Resourcefulness: Takes ownership of challenges, uses available resources effectively, and knows when to collaborate or seek additional expertise.
  • Organization & Adaptability: Manages competing priorities with attention to detail and can quickly adjust focus as needs change.

Communication & Interpersonal Skills

  • Customer-Centric Approach: Genuinely enjoys helping people and takes pride in providing thoughtful, effective support and solutions.
  • Clear Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts, platform functionality, and workflows in clear, conversational language.
  • Customer De-escalation: Demonstrates patience, empathy, and professionalism when navigating difficult conversations and resolving customer concerns.
  • Confidence & Accountability: Comfortable communicating directly with customers, including phone conversations to troubleshoot issues, provide updates, and deliver resolutions.
  • Collaboration & Teamwork: Works effectively both independently and collaboratively, sharing knowledge and contributing to team success.
  • Education & Knowledge Sharing: Enjoys teaching others, explaining technical concepts, and helping customers and teammates build confidence using new tools and features.

Additional Qualifications

  • Comfortable and productive working in a fully remote environment.
  • Real estate industry experience is a plus.

Benefits

  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave.
