jobs.description:
The System Architect - SME (Storage) provides senior technical leadership for enterprise infrastructure architecture and modernization in support of the SEC ISS contract. This role translates mission and functional requirements into scalable, secure technical solutions across on-premises and hybrid/multi-cloud environments. The architect leads cross-functional engineering and operations teams to improve reliability, automation, and service performance aligned to SEC OIT objectives. The position drives technology evaluations, proofs of concept, pilots, and demos while ensuring designs integrate with 24x7x365 enterprise operations and observability requirements. This role ensures architecture decisions align with Zero Trust, FISMA, and SEC governance expectations.


Location: Remote / Telework


"Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes if an offer letter is extended to you."


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES


Enterprise Architecture and Solution Design

  • Architect and manage enterprise IT systems across multiple functional areas, including server, platform, storage, and cloud domains.
  • Translate functional and operational requirements into technical architectures, integration patterns, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Define scalable, resilient target-state designs and transitional architectures for hybrid environments.
  • Develop and maintain architecture documentation, standards, and technical decision artifacts to support execution and governance.
  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise SAN/NAS and storage virtualization solutions for mission-critical systems.
  • Develop storage strategies, standards, and policies aligned with organizational and federal compliance requirements.
  • Lead complex storage projects, including migrations, upgrades, and integration with cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Ensure storage platforms are engineered for high availability, data integrity, and scalability across SEC environments.

Technology Evaluation and Modernization

  • Identify, assess, and recommend technologies that meet defined technical and business requirements.
  • Lead and execute proofs of concept (POCs), pilots, and demos to validate feasibility, risk, and operational fit.
  • Guide modernization efforts across virtualization, cloud integration, and enterprise infrastructure transformation initiatives.
  • Drive adoption of advanced technologies that improve efficiency, interoperability, and long-term maintainability.

Operations Leadership and Service Reliability

  • Provide technical leadership to multi-discipline server and system operations teams in enterprise environments.
  • Establish architecture requirements for monitoring, alerting, incident response, and operational visibility for production systems.
  • Support root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement efforts tied to SLA and performance objectives.
  • Ensure designs are supportable in 24x7x365 operations, including change/release coordination and lifecycle management.

Technical Leadership and Cross-Functional Delivery

  • Lead storage workstreams for migrations, technology refreshes, and modernization efforts with minimal operational disruption.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, network, security, virtualization, and cloud teams to integrate storage services end-to-end.
  • Conduct risk assessments and recommend remediation strategies for storage resiliency, security, and operational risk.
  • Mentor junior engineers and serve as the storage SME for incident response, strategic planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Storage Operations, Performance, and Capacity Management

  • Administer and optimize large-scale enterprise storage environments, including proactive monitoring and health management.
  • Perform capacity planning and forecasting to maintain service continuity and prevent resource constraints.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve advanced storage incidents, including latency, throughput, replication, and platform stability issues.
  • Establish and track operational metrics and trend analysis to support service-level performance.

Security, Compliance, and Integration Governance

  • Provide technical leadership for system integration, scalability, and security architecture across multi-vendor platforms.
  • Embed security controls and compliance requirements into infrastructure and platform designs.
  • Ensure architectural approaches support FISMA-aligned controls, vulnerability remediation, and secure configuration baselines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to align technical solutions with SEC policy, risk, and operational governance.

Data Protection, Recovery, and Compliance

  • Architect and maintain enterprise backup and recovery strategies to protect mission-critical data.
  • Implement and validate disaster recovery and business continuity storage controls, including cross-site replication and recovery readiness.
  • Ensure retention, recovery, and data protection practices meet organizational policy and federal compliance requirements.
  • Support audit readiness by maintaining storage documentation, configuration baselines, and implementation evidence.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS


Citizenship/Work Authorization: Must meet contract requirements.

Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain SEC Public Trust (or higher if required).

Education: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.


Experience:

  • 12+ years of experience in engineering and architecting enterprise IT storage systems.
  • Proven experience managing multi-discipline server and system operations teams.
  • Demonstrated experience translating functional requirements into enterprise technical solutions and leading integration/scalability efforts.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise storage platforms and large-scale storage administration.
  • Expertise with SAN/NAS technologies, storage virtualization, and enterprise backup/recovery solutions.
  • Experience leading complex storage migrations, upgrades, and integration with cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Experience supporting storage compliance, audit readiness, and documentation in federal IT environments.
  • Advanced expertise in storage performance tuning, capacity planning, risk assessment, and disaster recovery strategies.
  • Must have experience working with Clustered Data ONTAP software.

Technical Skills:

  • Enterprise infrastructure design and architecture

- Multi-vendor server operating systems

  • Virtualization and cloud integration architecture
  • System integration and scalability architecture
  • Security architecture for enterprise platforms
  • Technology evaluation, POC/pilot execution, and solution validation
  • Cross-functional technical leadership and stakeholder communication
  • Cross-functional integration with infrastructure, network, and security teams
  • Enterprise SAN/NAS platforms and storage virtualization
  • Enterprise backup/recovery, replication, and disaster recovery operations
  • Storage performance monitoring, tuning, and capacity management methodologies
  • Advanced troubleshooting of mission-critical storage issues and operational risk assessment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting U.S. federal IT environments with FISMA/NIST/OMB compliance requirements.
  • Experience architecting or supporting observability platforms and enterprise monitoring integrations in large environments.
  • Hands-on experience with container platforms and automation frameworks (e.g., OpenShift, Kubernetes, Ansible, GitOps toolchains).
  • Experience leading architecture initiatives in 24x7x365 enterprise operations organizations.
  • Prior support to SEC or similarly regulated financial-sector federal agencies.
  • NetApp Certified Data Administrator Certification (NCDA) or equivalent

- Proficiency in Ansible, Python, BASH

  • Assist in preparation and tie out of Proxy disclosures
  • Collaborate with Legal, FP&A, and business teams on new contracts and billing structures.
  • Support audits with technical documentation.

jobs.description:
We are recruiting on behalf of a U.S.-based tax resolution firm looking for an entry-level Tax Resolution Assistant to join their team.

This is a great opportunity for someone who is highly organized, inquisitive, comfortable working with data, and interested in developing a career in tax resolution. The role is primarily focused on data entry, document management, and maintaining accurate information throughout the tax resolution process rather than complex tax preparation.

The ideal candidate will be a quick learner who isn't afraid to ask questions, can adapt to changing situations, and is motivated to develop into a more autonomous tax resolution professional over time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and organize client tax documents, including W-2s, 1099s, and other supporting documentation
  • Review incoming client information for completeness and accuracy
  • Import client information into ProConnect tax software
  • Double-check automated data entries and identify discrepancies or missing information
  • Manually enter information where required
  • Maintain accurate and organized client records
  • Track the flow of documents and information throughout active tax resolution cases
  • Follow up on missing documentation and outstanding information
  • Support the tax resolution team with administrative and data-entry tasks
  • Help ensure cases move efficiently through each stage of the process
  • Communicate professionally and empathetically with clients when information or documentation is required
  • Learn and apply new processes, systems, and tax-resolution procedures as your knowledge develops

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 2-year college degree in any field
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Excellent data-entry and computer skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, databases, and software systems
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple cases or priorities
  • Ability to learn new software and processes quickly
  • Comfortable working independently in a relatively unstructured environment
  • Must be based in the United States or a U.S. territory, such as Puerto Rico or Guam

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ProConnect or other tax software
  • Previous experience in tax, accounting, financial services, or professional services
  • Data-entry or document-processing experience
  • Experience working with sensitive or confidential client information
  • Customer service experience, particularly in situations where clients may be stressed or frustrated

What We're Looking For

This role is not simply a data-entry position. We're looking for someone who has the potential to grow with the business.

The right person will be:

  • Inquisitive — you ask questions rather than making assumptions
  • Flexible — you can adapt when the process isn't perfectly defined
  • Resilient — you take feedback and criticism constructively
  • Empathetic — you can remain calm and professional when dealing with clients under financial stress
  • Curious — you genuinely want to understand how things work
  • Self-motivated — you don't need constant supervision to keep moving
  • Detail-oriented — you understand that small errors can have significant consequences
  • A fast learner — you're comfortable learning new systems and developing specialist knowledge

Growth Opportunity

This position is intended to provide a long-term career path within tax resolution.

Initially, the role will focus heavily on data entry, document collection, case administration, and learning the firm's systems and processes. As your knowledge and confidence develop, there is an opportunity to take on greater responsibility and eventually become a self-sufficient tax resolution professional, including developing the skills required to assist with client cases and negotiate payment plans with the IRS.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform & Ecosystem
jobs.excerpt: Wrike is the most powerful work management platform.
jobs.description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike’s Work Intelligence Unit is building the foundation for a work delivery platform for humans and agents. MCP gives AI assistants secure, permission-aware access to Wrike, Skills help them use that access effectively and GraphQL provides a structured foundation for retrieving and acting on work data.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the product direction for Wrike’s AI Platform & Ecosystem, including MCP, Skills and GraphQL. You will make Wrike easier for AI assistants and agents to understand, use and extend.

This is a platform role with broad leverage. You will lead the core MCP team, help other Wrike teams create their own MCP tools and Skills where they hold domain expertise and give the GraphQL engineering team clear product direction on how its capabilities and tools should evolve. You will also own the publishing and ongoing quality of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant AI marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

Role Scope:

You will own the strategy and roadmap for Wrike’s agent-facing platform, working closely with the core MCP and GraphQL engineering teams complemented by Architecture, Security, customer-facing and product teams across Wrike.

MCP, Skills and GraphQL Strategy:

  • Lead the core MCP team and define the roadmap for how external AI assistants and agents securely interact with Wrike.
  • Define MCP standards and enable other Wrike teams to create high-quality tools for the domains where they have expertise.
  • Lead the discovery and creation of Skills that help agents and AI assistants use Wrike effectively, while establishing standards that other teams can follow.
  • Set the product direction for GraphQL and the tools built on top of it, ensuring its evolution improves the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core.

Ecosystem, Quality and Distribution:

  • Own the publishing, maintenance and evolution of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.
  • Create a clear approach to MCP quality, reliability, governance, documentation and developer experience.
  • Work with customers, partners and internal teams to identify the highest-value agent workflows and improve them through feedback and usage data.
  • Translate technical trade-offs into clear product decisions; hands-on coding is not required.

What You Will Help Shape:

  • A scalable MCP and Skills ecosystem that lets AI assistants and agents securely understand and act on work in Wrike, while enabling Wrike teams to contribute their domain expertise.
  • GraphQL capabilities and tools that broaden the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core for MCP, Skills, and future agent experiences.
  • A strong marketplace presence and high-quality plugin experience across the AI assistants where customers want to use Wrike.

Your Impact:

  • Make Wrike a trusted, useful system of action for AI assistants and agents working across customers’ existing ecosystems.
  • Give customers reliable, permission-aware ways to let AI assistants retrieve context and take action in Wrike.
  • Turn customer needs, ecosystem signals and technical constraints into a focused roadmap for MCP, Skills and GraphQL.
  • Enable other teams across Wrike to contribute agent-ready tools and Skills while maintaining shared standards for quality and governance.

Your Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of PM experience in technical, platform, AI, developer, or enterprise software.
  • Experience with MCP and Skills, including how agents use tools and guidance to act effectively.
  • Technical fluency in AI agents, MCP, Skills, permissions, reliability, and developer experience; hands-on engineering is not required. GraphQL experience and an understanding of structured product data is a major advantage.
  • Use customer research, adoption data, experiments, and feedback to set priorities and improve outcomes.
  • Explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
  • Proactive and can-do: take ownership, solve problems, and adapt as you learn.

Why This Role Is Unique:

  • You will help define how Wrike becomes a trusted platform for AI assistants and agents, not just a destination where work is stored.
  • You will work at the intersection of agentic AI, developer experience, enterprise permissions, platform strategy and customer value.
  • The role is remote across the European Union, with a preference for Prague, Czech Republic and Cyprus.

What’s Next?

  1. Introduction Call with a Recruiter
  2. Conversation with the AI Product Director
  3. Interview with Product and Engineering, Architecture representatives
  4. Final interview with CPO and HRBP

Benefits & Perks:

  • 28 calendar days of paid vacation
  • Sick Leave Compensation (5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days)
  • Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity
  • 2 Volunteer Days
  • Health Insurance (Employees + Dependents)
  • Life Insurance Plan
  • Utility Allowance (30 EUR/month, subject to taxation)
  • Fitness Plan (800 EUR/year)
  • Full-remote & On-demand access to Co-working space

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode


Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona

💡 Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
💚 Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
🤗 Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

Our culture and Values

🤩 Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

🤝 Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

🎨 Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

💪 Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


Role Overview:
Build Workforce Management capabilities that help organizations plan, manage, and support their workforce while improving the experiences they deliver to customers. As an Associate Software Developer within the Genesys Workforce Engagement Management (WEM) portfolio, you will contribute across the full stack, building scalable backend services with Kotlin, Spring Boot, AWS Lambda, and cloud technologies, alongside intuitive frontend experiences using TypeScript, Vue.js, HTML, and CSS/LESS.

You will work with experienced engineers, product managers, designers, and cross-functional partners to turn product needs into reliable software used in enterprise environments. AI-assisted development tools will be part of your engineering workflow, helping you accelerate learning, improve productivity, troubleshoot problems, and deliver high-quality software responsibly.

Your work will directly influence the reliability, usability, performance, and scalability of Workforce Management experiences. You will gain hands-on exposure to cloud-native and serverless architecture, AI-enabled engineering practices, full-stack development, and enterprise software at global scale, building technical depth and increasing ownership as your experience grows.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop full-stack Workforce Management capabilities that improve how enterprise customers plan, manage, and support their workforces
  • Build reliable and scalable backend services and APIs using Kotlin, Spring Boot, AWS Lambda, and related cloud technologies
  • Create intuitive, accessible, and responsive user experiences using TypeScript, Vue.js, HTML, and CSS/LESS
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, designers, and cross-functional partners to translate customer and product needs into high-quality software
  • Deliver clean, maintainable, and well-tested code that strengthens product quality and supports the long-term evolution of the WEM platform
  • Resolve software defects across the full technology stack using monitoring, debugging, and root-cause analysis to improve service reliability and customer experience
  • Contribute to code reviews, technical discussions, automated testing, and continuous improvement while expanding your engineering judgment through collaboration with experienced team members
  • Strengthen the performance, security, reliability, and scalability of WEM capabilities used in enterprise customer environments

Required Qualifications:

  • 0 to 2 years of professional software development experience, including internships, co-op placements, or equivalent practical experience
  • Foundational experience with object-oriented programming and modern software development principles
  • Experience with, or demonstrated ability to learn, backend development using Kotlin, Java, Spring Boot, or similar technologies
  • Experience with frontend development using JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern framework such as Vue.js, React, or Angular
  • Working knowledge of HTML and CSS, including responsive and accessible user interface development
  • Familiarity with cloud technologies and services, preferably AWS, including serverless technologies such as AWS Lambda
  • Understanding of software engineering practices including version control, automated testing, code reviews, debugging, and continuous integration
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and an interest in using AI responsibly to support software development, learning, problem-solving, and productivity
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within a cross-functional software development team

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience gained through a software development internship, co-op placement, academic project, open-source contribution, or professional role
  • Familiarity with Kotlin, Spring Boot, Vue.js, TypeScript, or comparable full-stack technologies
  • Exposure to AWS or another major cloud platform, with an interest in cloud-native and serverless software development
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to support coding, testing, debugging, learning, or other software engineering activities

Benefits That Support You:
We invest in your well-being, because when you’re at your best, so are the experiences you create.

  • Comprehensive extended group health coverage
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation and personal leave
  • Retirement savings program with employer RRSP matching up to a prescribed maximum amount
  • Family-friendly benefits, including parental leave top-up and adoption assistance
  • Growth and development opportunities through access to learning resources and internal mobility programs

Exact details of these programs, including the conditions for eligibility, the amount of the benefit (including caps on benefits and customary pricing details), the length of the paid time off, etc. will be provided upon hire and is subject to Genesys policies.

Compensation:

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation range listed below. Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role might also be eligible for a commission or performance-based bonus opportunities.

jobs.description:
Nalco Water, an Ecolab Company, is seeking an Industry Technical Consultant to serve as a Subject Matter Expert for closed loop systems. This role is focused on closed loop chemistry, microbiology, fluid compatibility, and heat transfer performance. Direct-to-chip liquid cooling will be an important part of the role, as well as wider closed loop applications. Our Industry Technical Consultants support business growth, drive innovation, and transfer technical knowledge to help customers improve reliability, efficiency, and sustainability. If you enjoy solving complex technical problems, supporting field teams, and helping customers implement new technology, we invite you to apply.

As an Industry Technical Consultant and closed loop systems SME, you will provide practical technical leadership across customer applications, internal projects, and innovation programs. You will troubleshoot complex closed loop and thermal management challenges, train technical audiences, recommend operational improvements, and support the validation of new technologies. The role requires the ability to connect chemistry, materials compatibility, system operation, and heat transfer performance, while translating that expertise into clear recommendations for customers, sales teams, account managers, R&D, and marketing stakeholders.

Key Expertise Required:

  • Closed loop chemistry and water treatment, including corrosion control, microbiological risk management, scaling, fouling, passivation, inhibitor selection, and monitoring requirements
  • Heat transfer and thermal performance, including the impact of fluid type, temperature, flow, materials, and operating conditions on system reliability and efficiency
  • Heat transfer fluids, including water, glycol blends, low-conductivity fluids, inhibited formulations, and adjacent specialty fluids used in closed loop and liquid cooling applications
  • Direct-to-chip liquid cooling as one important application area, including cold plates, cooling distribution units, secondary loops, fluid quality, and interfaces with wider facility infrastructure

  • Lead problem solving efforts by utilizing various root cause analysis methodologies to resolve application or best practice concerns at customer sites

  • 50% or more overnight travel required

Your profile:

jobs.excerpt: A decision maker wanted in ArmeniaWe are looking in Armenia for one person who makes good calls.
jobs.description:
A decision maker wanted in Armenia

We are looking in Armenia for one person who makes good calls. Spend ten minutes on our website and LinkedIn before you apply. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. Anything generic, the sort of answer any company could receive, will not pass.

Where the role sits

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency, and our AI image service is the fastest growing thing we do. The Armenia hire gets one named area to own, and growing that service is what the area is for.

Which area comes later. The trial will show where you are strongest, and then we decide. It will be one of these:

  1. The hiring machine, meaning how we find, screen and hire. The funnel is yours end to end: sourcing, chasing, scheduling, a tracker we can believe, and a clear word to us whenever the process is the thing that is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations, meaning how work for clients is planned, briefed, chased and shipped. You keep timelines, brief the team well and catch whatever is quietly stalling.

Strip it back and it is one job. Notice the slip, decide what to do, close it without being asked.

It is not an assistant role, and it is not coordination. Daily you will make real decisions and we will rate you on their quality over their number. We are assembling people who decide well without supervision. Anyone wanting a morning to do list from us will be disappointed.

Your history, checked

There is no required count of years. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.

For any employment you list we confirm employer, dates, title and paid status, with a contract and payslips, in one exchange. Full time work at some point in the last 12 months is needed. Past that, no minimum applies and a brief history is no problem. Lying about the history you do have disqualifies you, while the honest version carries no penalty.

The qualities we look for

  1. You make decisions and take ownership of them, wrong ones too.
  2. You can say which decisions are yours and which are not, and you are right about it in both directions.
  3. Feedback is information to you. You adapt, but you keep your position where you have good reason.
  4. You get better quickly, because rising from seventy percent is better than sitting at eighty five.
  5. You say so when something is failing, our process included.
  6. You are honest and clear on paper, most of all about problems.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.
  2. A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.
  3. A 15 minute call with the founder.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

Decisions are made in the trial, which also settles your area. By week one you are making calls on live work, and we report back openly on each. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

      1. Full time on hire and this is your only job. In the paid trial you work 4 hours a day for us, with 2 at a fixed time inside our working day, and your current job stays. When you pass, you give notice and begin full time within 30 days.
      2. Reliable internet: 30 Mbps down or better and 5 Mbps up or better, tested live with us.
      3. Strong written English.
      4. Based in Armenia.
      5. From day one your working time is tracked in our time tracking tool.

Benefits

1500 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Pay and responsibility move quickly for the people who earn them. Authority over client facing decisions moves slowly, by design, and is earned on a track record rather than a good first month. We prefer to say that today over you finding out in month two.

jobs.excerpt: Wrike is the most powerful work management platform.
jobs.description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike’s Work Intelligence Unit is building the foundation for a work delivery platform for humans and agents. MCP gives AI assistants secure, permission-aware access to Wrike, Skills help them use that access effectively and GraphQL provides a structured foundation for retrieving and acting on work data.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the product direction for Wrike’s AI Platform & Ecosystem, including MCP, Skills and GraphQL. You will make Wrike easier for AI assistants and agents to understand, use and extend.

This is a platform role with broad leverage. You will lead the core MCP team, help other Wrike teams create their own MCP tools and Skills where they hold domain expertise and give the GraphQL engineering team clear product direction on how its capabilities and tools should evolve. You will also own the publishing and ongoing quality of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant AI marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

Role Scope:

You will own the strategy and roadmap for Wrike’s agent-facing platform, working closely with the core MCP and GraphQL engineering teams complemented by Architecture, Security, customer-facing and product teams across Wrike.

MCP, Skills and GraphQL Strategy:

  • Lead the core MCP team and define the roadmap for how external AI assistants and agents securely interact with Wrike.
  • Define MCP standards and enable other Wrike teams to create high-quality tools for the domains where they have expertise.
  • Lead the discovery and creation of Skills that help agents and AI assistants use Wrike effectively, while establishing standards that other teams can follow.
  • Set the product direction for GraphQL and the tools built on top of it, ensuring its evolution improves the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core.

Ecosystem, Quality and Distribution:

  • Own the publishing, maintenance and evolution of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.
  • Create a clear approach to MCP quality, reliability, governance, documentation and developer experience.
  • Work with customers, partners and internal teams to identify the highest-value agent workflows and improve them through feedback and usage data.
  • Translate technical trade-offs into clear product decisions; hands-on coding is not required.

What You Will Help Shape:

  • A scalable MCP and Skills ecosystem that lets AI assistants and agents securely understand and act on work in Wrike, while enabling Wrike teams to contribute their domain expertise.
  • GraphQL capabilities and tools that broaden the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core for MCP, Skills, and future agent experiences.
  • A strong marketplace presence and high-quality plugin experience across the AI assistants where customers want to use Wrike.

Your Impact:

  • Make Wrike a trusted, useful system of action for AI assistants and agents working across customers’ existing ecosystems.
  • Give customers reliable, permission-aware ways to let AI assistants retrieve context and take action in Wrike.
  • Turn customer needs, ecosystem signals and technical constraints into a focused roadmap for MCP, Skills and GraphQL.
  • Enable other teams across Wrike to contribute agent-ready tools and Skills while maintaining shared standards for quality and governance.

Your Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of PM experience in technical, platform, AI, developer, or enterprise software.
  • Experience with MCP and Skills, including how agents use tools and guidance to act effectively.
  • Technical fluency in AI agents, MCP, Skills, permissions, reliability, and developer experience; hands-on engineering is not required. GraphQL experience and an understanding of structured product data is a major advantage.
  • Use customer research, adoption data, experiments, and feedback to set priorities and improve outcomes.
  • Explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
  • Proactive and can-do: take ownership, solve problems, and adapt as you learn.

Why This Role Is Unique:

  • You will help define how Wrike becomes a trusted platform for AI assistants and agents, not just a destination where work is stored.
  • You will work at the intersection of agentic AI, developer experience, enterprise permissions, platform strategy and customer value.
  • The role is remote across the European Union, with a preference for Prague, Czech Republic and Cyprus.

What’s Next?

  1. Introduction Call with a Recruiter
  2. Conversation with the AI Product Director
  3. Interview with Product and Engineering, Architecture representatives
  4. Final interview with CPO and HRBP

Benefits & Perks:

  • 5 Weeks of paid vacation
  • Sick Leave Compensation
    • 5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days
    • 2 weeks fully paid w/ medical certificate, additional
    • 4 weeks paid at 80% salary rate
  • Parental Leave (fully paid): 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity
  • 2 Volunteer Days
  • Meal Vouchers (CZK 220 per working day)
  • Annual Prague Travel Card (Lítačka)
  • Benefit budget with flexible options, including a MultiSport card, Canadian Medical membership, contributions to a pension savings plan and additional choices available through Benefit Plus

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode


Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona

💡 Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
💚 Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
🤗 Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

Our culture and Values

🤩 Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

🤝 Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

🎨 Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

💪 Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform & Ecosystem
jobs.excerpt: Wrike is the most powerful work management platform.
jobs.description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike’s Work Intelligence Unit is building the foundation for a work delivery platform for humans and agents. MCP gives AI assistants secure, permission-aware access to Wrike, Skills help them use that access effectively and GraphQL provides a structured foundation for retrieving and acting on work data.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the product direction for Wrike’s AI Platform & Ecosystem, including MCP, Skills and GraphQL. You will make Wrike easier for AI assistants and agents to understand, use and extend.

This is a platform role with broad leverage. You will lead the core MCP team, help other Wrike teams create their own MCP tools and Skills where they hold domain expertise and give the GraphQL engineering team clear product direction on how its capabilities and tools should evolve. You will also own the publishing and ongoing quality of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant AI marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

Role Scope:

You will own the strategy and roadmap for Wrike’s agent-facing platform, working closely with the core MCP and GraphQL engineering teams complemented by Architecture, Security, customer-facing and product teams across Wrike.

MCP, Skills and GraphQL Strategy:

  • Lead the core MCP team and define the roadmap for how external AI assistants and agents securely interact with Wrike.
  • Define MCP standards and enable other Wrike teams to create high-quality tools for the domains where they have expertise.
  • Lead the discovery and creation of Skills that help agents and AI assistants use Wrike effectively, while establishing standards that other teams can follow.
  • Set the product direction for GraphQL and the tools built on top of it, ensuring its evolution improves the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core.

Ecosystem, Quality and Distribution:

  • Own the publishing, maintenance and evolution of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.
  • Create a clear approach to MCP quality, reliability, governance, documentation and developer experience.
  • Work with customers, partners and internal teams to identify the highest-value agent workflows and improve them through feedback and usage data.
  • Translate technical trade-offs into clear product decisions; hands-on coding is not required.

What You Will Help Shape:

  • A scalable MCP and Skills ecosystem that lets AI assistants and agents securely understand and act on work in Wrike, while enabling Wrike teams to contribute their domain expertise.
  • GraphQL capabilities and tools that broaden the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core for MCP, Skills, and future agent experiences.
  • A strong marketplace presence and high-quality plugin experience across the AI assistants where customers want to use Wrike.

Your Impact:

  • Make Wrike a trusted, useful system of action for AI assistants and agents working across customers’ existing ecosystems.
  • Give customers reliable, permission-aware ways to let AI assistants retrieve context and take action in Wrike.
  • Turn customer needs, ecosystem signals and technical constraints into a focused roadmap for MCP, Skills and GraphQL.
  • Enable other teams across Wrike to contribute agent-ready tools and Skills while maintaining shared standards for quality and governance.

Your Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of PM experience in technical, platform, AI, developer, or enterprise software.
  • Experience with MCP and Skills, including how agents use tools and guidance to act effectively.
  • Technical fluency in AI agents, MCP, Skills, permissions, reliability, and developer experience; hands-on engineering is not required. GraphQL experience and an understanding of structured product data is a major advantage.
  • Use customer research, adoption data, experiments, and feedback to set priorities and improve outcomes.
  • Explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
  • Proactive and can-do: take ownership, solve problems, and adapt as you learn.

Why This Role Is Unique:

  • You will help define how Wrike becomes a trusted platform for AI assistants and agents, not just a destination where work is stored.
  • You will work at the intersection of agentic AI, developer experience, enterprise permissions, platform strategy and customer value.
  • The role is remote across the European Union, with a preference for Prague, Czech Republic and Cyprus.

What’s Next?

  1. Introduction Call with a Recruiter
  2. Conversation with the AI Product Director
  3. Interview with Product and Engineering, Architecture representatives
  4. Final interview with CPO and HRBP

Benefits & Perks:

  • 25 calendar days of paid vacation
  • Sick Leave Compensation (5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days)
  • Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity
  • 2 Volunteer Days
  • Medical Insurance (Employees + Dependents)
  • Hybrid Working Model
  • School Allowance (Up to €600/month for school aged kids)
  • Simcard w/ Unlimited Internet Access for active employees
  • Office Lunch Allowance (via Wolt) on Wednesdays / Thursdays

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode


Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona

💡 Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
💚 Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
🤗 Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

Our culture and Values

🤩 Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

🤝 Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

🎨 Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

💪 Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

jobs.excerpt: About Haven Safety: Haven Safety AI is building the enterprise learning intelligence layer for safety.
jobs.description:
About Haven Safety:
Haven Safety AI is building the enterprise learning intelligence layer for safety. Co-founded with The AES Corporation and AI Fund, the venture studio founded by Andrew Ng, Haven helps high-risk organizations learn faster from what goes wrong so they can prevent what comes next.

Haven works alongside existing EHS enterprise systems to improve how organizations investigate, assess, and learn from incidents. INVESTIGATE guides evidence synthesis, timeline development, multi-threaded causal analysis, and corrective actions. ASSURE continuously reviews completed investigations for evidence quality, causal coverage, guideline adherence, and CAPA strength. LEARN reasons across incident history to surface recurring control failures, repeated corrective-action patterns, CAPA debt, and emerging signals.

The platform combines current incident evidence, company knowledge, historical cases, and an industry knowledge graph. A coordinated team of specialized AI agents examines evidence, controls, engineering factors, procedures, regulations, training, and organizational history, then produces one traceable assessment for human review. Customers have reported an 80% reduction in root cause analysis labor time using Haven.

About the Role:

You will work on the AI and LLM engineering layer that connects Haven’s evidence base and knowledge graph to the product experiences investigators and safety leaders use. This is a build-and-operate role reporting to the CTO. You will design the reasoning, ship it, instrument it, and improve it using production evidence.

The work is technically demanding and operationally consequential. Haven serves enterprise customers in regulated, safety-critical industries through multi-tenant and dedicated deployments. A plausible answer and a correct answer can look the same until someone acts on it, so precision, traceability, evaluation, and human oversight are core product requirements.

Haven Safety is a VC-backed pre-seed venture. This role will be a important member of the founding team and will require wearing multiple hats.

What You Will Own:

    • Production reasoning systems. Build and operate multi-step LLM pipelines that coordinate model calls, tool calls, graph queries, retrieval, quality gates, and specialist-agent handoffs.
    • Agent orchestration. Extend Haven’s coordinated agent team and the orchestration layer that carries an incident from evidence through analysis, review, and enterprise learning.
    • Grounding and retrieval. Design the context layer across Neo4j graph traversal, vector search, and hybrid retrieval so every model call receives the right evidence and organizational knowledge.
    • Evaluation. Build datasets, scoring, regression suites, model comparisons, human-label loops, and per-stage quality attribution for extraction and reasoning tasks.
    • Production AI operations. Implement tracing, tool-call audits, cost and latency monitoring, failure handling, and quality dashboards; catch loops, hallucinations, and silent drift before customers do.
    • Technical direction. Select models by task across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google; partner with product and knowledge engineering; and help shape the AI roadmap.

Requirements For the Role Include:

    • Production LLM systems. AI or ML engineering, including shipping LLM systems that real users depend on.
    • Agentic workflows. Hands-on experience building and debugging multi-step, tool-calling workflows with LangGraph, LangChain, or an equivalent framework.
    • Evaluation discipline. A repeatable approach to LLM evaluation, including representative datasets, regression testing, LLM-as-judge techniques, or human review loops.
    • Retrieval judgment. Experience assembling context for LLMs and a clear point of view on what to retrieve, how much, and why.
    • Production ownership. A track record of owning systems from deployment through monitoring and incident response, including a strong story about a failure or regression you diagnosed and fixed.
    • Model judgment. Comfort working across model providers and explaining tradeoffs in quality, latency, cost, context, and operational risk.
    • Graph reasoning. Comfort with Neo4j and Cypher, or a comparable graph store, and the ability to ramp quickly on graph data modeling. Strongly preferred.
    • Strong Python. Production habits around FastAPI, asynchronous services, testing, observability, and maintainable interfaces are required.

Nice To Haves Include:

    • Deep graph experience. Cypher fluency, schema evolution, MERGE patterns, embeddings, and operating a live knowledge graph.
    • Enterprise AI security. Prompt-injection awareness, context-leak prevention, tenant isolation, role-based access, and policy-layer separation.
    • Azure and hybrid search. Experience running production AI services in Azure and using Azure AI Search, Pinecone, MongoDB Atlas, pgvector, Elasticsearch, or a similar platform.
    • B2B Enterprise SaaS. Prior experience operating in an enterprise-level environment is strongly preferred.

Why Join Haven Safety:

    • Meaningful reasoning problems. Work across evidence, causal pathways, controls, organizational history, and corrective actions in a domain where correctness matters.
    • An evaluation-first culture. Make quality measurable, observable, and improvable instead of relying on demos or intuition.
    • Visible customer impact. Build for safety teams in energy, utilities, infrastructure, construction, and manufacturing, with direct feedback from the people using the output.
    • Small team, high ownership. Work closely with the CTO, product, and knowledge engineering, make consequential technical decisions, and see your work reach customers quickly.
Sponsorship will not be provided for this role. Please no agency inquiries!

Meet Instinct 👋

Instinct Science is at the forefront of veterinary innovation, comprised of world-class tools that have served our industry for decades: easy-to-use veterinary practice software (Instinct EMR), an essential resource for expanding your knowledge and skills (Clinician's Brief), clinical and pharmaceutical decision support (Standards of Care & Plumb's), and an AI scribing platform (ScribbleVet). At our core, WebEngage is a full-stack retention operating system that combines:

  • AI-driven personalization and recommendations
  • Deep analytics, experimentation, and revenue attribution
  • WebEngage BLACK: our AI-native layer that brings Agentic capabilities to engagement.
Learn more about us at www.webengage.com

About The Role:

WebEngage’s Data Engineering team is the backbone of our analytics, personalisation, and machine-learning capabilities. As a Data Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of data — from ingesting raw event streams and third-party feeds to building well-modelled, highly reliable datasets that power dashboards, predictive models, and customer journey orchestration. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work at the intersection of product, analytics, and backend engineering. You will be expected to think beyond just moving data — designing for data quality, pipeline observability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability from day one.

Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development & Reliability

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, databases, event streams (Kafka/Pub-Sub), and flat files into the central data warehouse.
  • Implement idempotent, incremental load patterns with built-in retry logic, dead-letter queues, and SLA-based alerting to ensure zero-data-loss pipelines.
  • Own pipeline observability — set up data freshness checks, row-count validations, schema drift detection, and anomaly alerts using tools like Great Expectations or dbt tests.

Data Modelling & Warehouse Design

  • Translate business requirements into clean dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas) and maintain a well-documented data catalogue.
  • Design slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), bridge tables, and fact tables optimised for analytical query patterns.
  • Enforce partitioning, clustering, and materialised view strategies to keep warehouse costs under control while maintaining sub-second query performance.

Code Quality & Engineering Best Practices

  • Write clean, modular, well-tested Python and SQL code. Follow DRY principles, use version control (Git), and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Build reusable transformation frameworks using dbt or equivalent tooling, with proper documentation and testing at every layer (staging → intermediate → mart).
  • Containerise data services with Docker and automate deployments via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub
Actions / GitLab CI).

BI, Visualization & Analytics

  • Build interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Streamlit, enabling stakeholders to explore metrics, run ad-hoc analyses, and make data-driven decisions without engineering dependency.
  • Design and maintain BI layers — semantic models, KPI definitions, and pre-aggregated mart tables that serve as the single source of truth for reporting across teams.
  • Translate raw data into compelling visual narratives using libraries like Plotly, Matplotlib, or Altair; present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with product managers, analysts, and data scientists to understand data needs and proactively identify gaps in current data coverage.
  • Document data lineage, transformation logic, SLAs, and known limitations in a shared knowledge base to enable self-service analytics.
  • Contribute to internal engineering guilds, knowledge-sharing sessions, and post-incident reviews for pipeline failures.

Requirements:

  • Strong SQL skills with expertise in complex queries, performance optimization, and cost-efficient design on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Strong Python scripting for data ingestion, transformation, and validation, with hands-on experience in Pandas, SQLAlchemy, APIs, and automation.
  • ETL/ELT- End-to-end ownership of data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, and loading, with understanding of incremental loads, and backfills.
  • Data Modelling- Ability to design dimensional and transactional data models (star/snowflake, SCDs) and translate business needs into optimized table structures.

Good to Have:

  • Airflow, dbt, Docker, CI/CD
  • GCP/AWS, data warehousing concepts
  • BI tools / Streamlit / visualization

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 1–3 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a backend role with significant data pipeline work.
  • Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture — know when to use wide denormalised tables vs. normalised models, and the trade-offs of each.
  • Familiarity with version control workflows (Git branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and agile development practices.
  • A data quality mindset — you instinctively validate assumptions, add assertions to pipelines, and treat silent data failures as critical incidents.

We are seeking a Manager, Central Monitoring to join our Global Clinical Trial Services team in South Africa.

As a Manager, Central Monitoring, you will play a critical role in advancing clinical research by leading centralized monitoring activities for global and complex trials. You will review key risk and operational performance data and present your insights as an integral member of the clinical study team for clinical development studies. Your analysis will bring together Key Risk Indicator (KRI) and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) data housed in an analytical tool with a comprehensive review of supplemental operational data and trends, helping study teams identify and address issues that require intervention.

This position offers the opportunity to support several studies within a therapeutic area and at the program level. You will work closely with other Central Monitors and Centralized Data Risk Analysts (CDRAs) to ensure effective identification, conduct, and reporting of central monitoring activities, while contributing to continuous process improvement, innovation, and industry collaborations in central monitoring capabilities.

  • Oversee Central Monitoring execution by working with data analysts to configure, implement, and execute the Central Monitoring RBQM system across assigned studies, ensuring effective signal detection.
  • Analyze and interpret data trends by conducting study-level Central Monitoring Reviews using data analysis tools, interpreting KRIs and KPIs, and assessing trends to identify areas requiring intervention.

  • Provide oversight of Contract Research Organization (CRO) activities by partnering with outsourcing management to align monitoring strategies and ensure CRO partners execute Central Monitoring activities according to agreed standards.
  • Drive process improvements by evaluating the effectiveness of Central Monitoring processes, identifying areas for improvement, and recommending enhancements to tools, metrics, and methodologies.
  • Represent Central Monitoring in initiatives by contributing to cross-functional process improvement initiatives and assessing emerging technologies to enhance Central Monitoring capabilities.

Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Research Scientist applies statistical, epidemiologic, and causal inference methods to large, complex healthcare datasets to evaluate clinical program performance, identify drivers of outcomes, and inform strategic and operational decisions.

This role will be part of the Quality & Cost Strategy Analytics team supporting the performance management and evaluation of clinical programs. The Senior Research Scientist will design and execute rigorous outcomes studies, conduct deep-dive analyses to diagnose program performance, and translate complex analytical findings into clear recommendations for clinical, operational, and business partners.

The role requires strong analytical judgment, structured problem solving, and the ability to independently navigate complex and ambiguous business questions.

Humana’s Quality & Cost Strategy Analytics team is seeking a Senior Research Scientist (Remote) to support the evaluation and performance management of clinical programs.

At Humana, we are focused on transforming the healthcare experience by improving health outcomes, managing healthcare costs, and advancing operational excellence. The Quality & Cost Strategy Analytics team operates at the intersection of clinical strategy, analytics, and enterprise value, using rigorous research and advanced analytics to inform clinical priorities and improve outcomes for our members.

Our team partners across the organization to identify opportunities, evaluate and optimize clinical solutions, and generate actionable insights that support high-value care. We apply rigorous performance measurement and research methods to understand what is working, for whom, and why, and translate those insights into opportunities for continuous program improvement.


Responsibilities

As a Senior Research Scientist, you will:

  • Design and execute rigorous outcomes studies to evaluate the clinical, utilization, and financial performance of clinical programs using observational and experimental methods.
  • Apply causal inference, epidemiologic, and statistical methods to estimate program impact and generate credible evidence for decision-making.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses using medical and pharmacy claims, enrollment, and operational data to identify key performance drivers, diagnose performance gaps, and uncover opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate broad or ambiguous clinical and business questions into well-defined analytical questions, hypotheses, and study designs.
  • Partner with clinical, operational, financial, and business stakeholders to translate analytical insights into recommendations that inform clinical strategy, program design, contracting, and performance improvement.
  • Develop high-quality analytical reports, presentations, and executive-level readouts for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Translate complex methodologies and findings into clear, actionable business insights, communicating both implications and analytical limitations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Independently determine appropriate analytical approaches and make sound methodological decisions in complex or ambiguous situations.
  • Manage multiple analytical priorities while maintaining high standards for methodological rigor, accuracy, and reproducibility.
  • Understand broader department, segment, and enterprise strategies and connect analytical work to key operating and strategic objectives.

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Economics, Statistics, Health Services Research, Clinical Informatics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience applying statistical, epidemiologic, econometric, or related quantitative methods to large, complex datasets.
  • Strong foundation in causal inference and study design, including observational studies, comparative effectiveness research, and randomized controlled trials.
  • 3+ years of experience manipulating and analyzing large datasets using Python, PySpark, R, SAS, or comparable analytical tools.
  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business or clinical problems into rigorous analytical approaches.
  • Ability to select and apply appropriate analytical methodologies to moderately complex to complex research and business questions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex methodologies and results into clear business insights and recommendations for non-technical audiences.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong interest in healthcare and a passion for improving health outcomes and healthcare value.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of healthcare payer economics, including healthcare utilization, medical cost, and total cost of care.
  • Experience working with medical claims, pharmacy claims, laboratory data, eligibility/enrollment data, and clinical program operational data.
  • Familiarity with clinical concepts across chronic and specialty conditions, such as cardiology, chronic kidney disease, oncology, or other high-cost clinical conditions.
  • Experience evaluating clinical programs, care management interventions, or value-based healthcare initiatives.
  • Familiarity with advanced causal inference and causal machine learning techniques, such as double/debiased machine learning, doubly robust estimation, and meta-learners.
  • Proficiency in Python and PySpark, with experience working in Databricks and Microsoft Azure.

We are an international media company with operations across Malaysia, Dubai, and India, specializing in creating impactful brand experiences across diverse media platforms. Our Markets & Expertise

  • Negotiate and finalize deals ensuring win-win outcomes for both brand and production stakeholders.

  • Stay updated with industry trends, film releases, OTT content pipelines, and brand marketing calendars.

  • Coordinate with creative and content teams to ensure smooth delivery of brand integrations and campaigns.

  • Track performance metrics, prepare post-integration reports, and ensure client satisfaction and retention.

  • Conceptualize and pitch bold, customized partnership models that fuse brand storytelling with cinematic moments.

  • Collaborate with internal creative, marketing, legal, and production experts to deliver seamless, integrated experiences on and off screen.

  • Independent hustler who thrives on accountability, targets, and creating impact.

This is an exciting opportunity to grow your skills and make a significant contribution to our team. You'll work in a supportive and collaborative environment that values creativity and professional development.

At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth.

Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond.

Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission-ready throughout space.

We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.

As a Structural Analysis Engineer II at Sierra Space, you will play a key role in the design, analysis, and development of structural systems. This position involves working under general supervision to solve a variety of technical problems of moderate scope and complexity. You will frequently apply technical principles, standards, theories, and concepts to your work, and contribute directly to the completion of designs associated with program milestones. Collaboration with other mechanical teams and occasional communication outside of Sierra Space are essential aspects of this role.

In this role, you will perform and contribute to the design and analysis of structural systems, leveraging a strong understanding of structural analysis principles, including hand calculations and Finite Element Analysis. You will frequently use and apply structural analysis standards, theories, and concepts in your work to develop solutions to a variety of technical problems of moderate scope and complexity. Working under general supervision, you will follow established procedures to complete tasks and projects while contributing to design efforts directly tied to program milestones and objectives. Collaborating with other mechanical teams, you will ensure integration across systems to achieve project goals. This is a Stanford Health Care job.

A Brief Overview
The Manager - Finance Functional Systems provides leadership for the Finance Systems team and steers a unified strategy that supports the Finance Controller's Office. Acting as the product manager for Finance systems, the role manages intake and prioritization, guides roadmap and governance activities, ensures configuration excellence, and collaborates with Finance Controller's Office, Supply Chain, HR and IT to enable scalable, compliant, and efficient financial systems and operations.

Locations

Stanford Health Care

What you will do

  • Team Leadership & Development:

  • Manage a team of analysts, including workload planning, prioritization, coaching, and performance development.

  • Ensure consistent application of best practices across configuration, testing, documentation, and issue resolution.

  • System Governance & Intake Management:

  • Own the intake, triage, and prioritization process for Finance system requests.

  • Maintain and govern the enhancement backlog, ensuring alignment with Finance Controller’s Office strategy and resource capacity.

  • Establish and enforce governance frameworks for configuration decisions, documentation standards, and change control.

  • Configuration Quality & Controls Oversight:

  • Ensure quality, consistency, and compliance of configuration decisions across financial systems.

  • Oversee system controls including posting rules, validations, approvals, and audit‑readiness documentation.

  • Product Ownership & Roadmap Execution:

  • Serve as the product manager for Workday systems roadmap, defining scope, sequencing, and business value.

  • Ensure roadmap initiatives are captured with clear requirements, developed and tested in accordance with the requirements, and delivered timely.

  • Partner with Finance Controller’s Office leadership to identify opportunities for automation, process redesign, and system optimization.

  • Cross Functional Alignment & Stakeholder Management:

  • Drive alignment across Accounting, AP, Grants, Gifts, Business Assets, Projects, Payroll, Procurement, HR, Treasury, and IT on system changes and financial impacts.

  • Influence stakeholders by presenting options, risks, standardization opportunities, and recommendations in clear business terms.

  • Coordinate with IT and business partners to ensure smooth deployment and adoption of new features.

  • Release Management & Business Readiness:

  • Lead Workday semi‑annual release planning, including impact assessment, regression testing strategy, and stakeholder communication.

  • Ensure the team delivers high quality testing, documentation, and readiness activities for each release cycle.

  • Oversee Workday Financials as the primary platform while also leading implementation, upgrade, and lifecycle management of other systems owned by the Finance Controller’s Office.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or related field.

Experience Qualifications

  • Minimum of 6 years of hands on experience with Workday Financials, including ownership of complex configuration, functional architecture, and cross domain financial processes.

  • Team leadership experience in a systems or finance function is a plus.

  • Demonstrated experience leading Workday enhancements, functional design and redesign and solution architecture, and automation initiatives across Accounting, AP, Payroll, Procurement, and other Finance functions.

  • Experience configuring Workday business process, validations and condition rules, allocations and financial frameworks, and security groups.

  • Experience leading Workday release cycles, including impact analysis, regression testing strategy, stakeholder communication, and business readiness planning.

  • Experience developing advanced and composite reports, calculated fields, and analytics datasets.

  • Experience supporting or managing multiple finance systems in addition to Workday, including participation in system implementations or upgrades.

  • Experience working with IT on Workday integrations, security, and technical escalations.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Deep expertise in Workday, including configuration leadership across business processes, validations, posting rules, approvals, and reporting logic.

  • Strong understanding of Workday core finance processes - period close, procure to pay, payroll, record to report– and how they are executed, controlled, and optimized within Workday.

  • Strong knowledge of Workday’s data model, including the FDM, cost centers, spend categories, ledger structures, and accounting rules, with the ability to guide consistent and scalable design decisions.

  • Ability to lead solution design and evaluate complex configuration impacts.

  • Ability to manage and develop a high performing functional team.

  • Strong analytical, problem solving, and decision making skills.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, with the ability to articulate system strategy, risks, and recommendations in clear business terms.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities, multiple projects, deadlines, and release cycles.

  • Strategic mindset, with the ability to connect Finance Controller’s Office priorities to Workday roadmap decisions, automation opportunities, and long‑term architectural direction.

  • Ability to oversee a multi system environment and evaluate how new tools integrate with Workday and Finance processes.

  • Strong knowledge of generative AI, cloud services programming, and database.
