jobs.excerpt: About WonderEverything’s on the menu at Wonder.  Except compromise.
jobs.description:
About Wonder

Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise.

Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. With Wonder, you can mix and match hundreds of dishes from 20+ exclusive restaurants in a single order, so everyone gets exactly what they’re craving. Enjoy everything from tacos to Thai with $0 delivery fees, plus dine-in or pick up at a Wonder location near you. Each dish is made to order on-site by our culinary team and served hot.

Behind the scenes, Wonder owns and operates every step of the dining experience, from recipe development to the technology that powers our experience, allowing us to deliver quality, variety, and consistency at scale.

Join us as we work to make great food more accessible.

About The Opportunity

Wonder’s Enterprise Technology team is hiring an Infrastructure Engineer to establish and scale the hosting, deployment, and integration foundations that support builders of all technical levels as they launch and maintain the apps and agents they’ve built with AI. You’ll work across enterprise technology, platform engineering, security, data, and business teams to turn employee-built prototypes into secure, reliable, supported applications.

The Impact You Will Make

  • Build and operate the infrastructure for employee-built applications, including deployment environments, hosting, databases, networking, and appropriate access controls.
  • Help assess and implement the right hosting and development platform for Wonder’s needs, working with platform engineering, security, data, and business teams.
  • Create repeatable deployment paths that help teams move applications from local prototypes into secure, reliable cloud environments.
  • Set up and maintain integrations with the tools employees use, which may include Slack, Gmail, Google Sheets, Salesforce, Looker, BigQuery, and other business systems.
  • Design and implement version control workflows, including Git and GitHub integration, so applications can be reviewed, tracked, maintained, and safely rolled back.
  • Build reusable infrastructure patterns and automation, using infrastructure as code where appropriate.
  • Establish secure foundations for application hosting, including identity, secrets management, environment separation, data access, backups, monitoring, and incident response.
  • Help teams understand how to deploy and operate their applications, and provide hands-on guidance from initial setup through launch and ongoing support.
  • Learn how employees work and shape the platform around their needs: reduce unnecessary complexity, make common tasks self-service, and explain technical steps in clear language.
  • Provide highly responsive, patient support to builders with different levels of technical experience. Follow through on issues and help users become confident operating their applications.
  • Gather feedback from users and use it to improve platform workflows, documentation, examples, and support.
  • Document architecture, deployment procedures, integration patterns, operational ownership, and maintenance expectations.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Experience building or operating cloud infrastructure and application deployment environments, ideally on Google Cloud Platform or another major cloud provider.
  • Strong understanding of application hosting, networking, databases, identity and access management, and production operations.
  • Experience with version control systems, especially Git and GitHub, and workflows for code review, release, and rollback.
  • Experience automating infrastructure and deployments with tools such as Terraform and CI/CD systems.
  • Experience integrating applications with APIs and business systems, and a practical understanding of authentication, authorization, and secret storage.
  • A customer-focused approach to infrastructure: you care whether people can successfully use the platform, not just whether it is technically sound.
  • Ability to make complex technical workflows approachable for users who may not be professional software engineers.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Good judgment balancing speed, simplicity, security, reliability, and cost.

Got These? Even Better

  • Experience building platforms or paved paths for internal developers, citizen developers, or low-code/no-code teams.
  • Experience with Vercel or comparable application hosting and development platforms.
  • Experience with platforms such as Superblocks, Lovable, or similar AI-assisted app-building tools.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled software development workflows and the infrastructure needed to take generated code into supported applications.
  • Experience with Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, or integrations across enterprise productivity systems.
  • Experience supporting applications that handle sensitive data or require strong access boundaries.

What Success Looks Like

  • Existing employee-built applications have a clear path to secure, supported cloud hosting.
  • Teams can deploy and update applications through documented, repeatable workflows with version history and rollback.
  • Integrations and permissions are reliable, appropriately scoped, and maintainable.
  • Employees can make progress without needing to understand every layer of cloud infrastructure.
  • Builders receive timely, highly supportive help and grow more confident using the platform.
  • The platform balances ease of use with security, reliability, and cost controls.

As a matter of company policy, Wonder does not sponsor applicants for employment visa status for this role.

CA: $208,500 - $225,000

Wonder uses geographic-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience.

Benefits


The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands.


Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here.


A Final Note

At Wonder, we build the best teams by hiring with an objective lens — evaluating people for their potential while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, marital status, disability, or any other protected class. As part of our commitment to fair and compliant hiring practices, Wonder participates in the federal government's E-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility. If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

We look forward to hearing from you! We'll contact you via email or text to schedule interviews and share information about your candidacy.

jobs.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Logic Design Engineer to join our team full-time in the Czech Republic.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

We are looking for an experienced Senior Logic Design Engineer to contribute to the development of next-generation FPGA and ASIC-based control platforms.

In this role, you will design and optimize high-performance digital logic with stringent latency and timing requirements. You will work closely with system architects, verification engineers, software developers, and hardware specialists in an international engineering environment.

Our client is an innovative technology company developing advanced control and measurement systems for quantum computing. Its hardware and software platforms enable precise, real-time control of complex quantum systems, supporting the evolution of quantum computing from individual qubits to large-scale architectures.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement complex, configurable, low-latency RTL modules using SystemVerilog
  • Develop digital logic for high-performance FPGA and ASIC applications, including signal processing, waveform generation, and real-time control
  • Participate in the complete RTL development lifecycle, from architecture and microarchitecture definition to implementation and verification
  • Optimize RTL designs for timing, latency, resource utilization, and power efficiency
  • Perform logic synthesis, timing analysis, and optimization to meet design constraints
  • Collaborate with verification engineers to ensure functional correctness and comprehensive test coverage
  • Analyze system-level and software requirements and implement appropriate hardware-software interfaces
  • Integrate proprietary digital IP into complex FPGA/ASIC architectures
  • Participate in design reviews, debugging, and continuous improvement of engineering processes

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience
  • 4+ years of professional experience in FPGA or ASIC digital logic design
  • Strong practical experience in RTL development using SystemVerilog (mandatory)
  • Solid understanding of digital logic design, computer architecture, and RTL microarchitecture
  • Experience with logic synthesis, static timing analysis (STA), and timing optimization
  • Practical experience with FPGA or ASIC design and implementation workflows
  • Understanding of clock-domain crossing (CDC), synchronous digital design, and hardware interfaces
  • Experience with simulation-based RTL verification and debugging
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • English proficiency sufficient for effective collaboration within an international engineering team

Desirable:

  • Experience with AMD/Xilinx FPGA platforms, particularly AMD Versal
  • Experience with AMD Vivado and related FPGA implementation tools
  • Familiarity with Synopsys VCS, Siemens Questa, or equivalent simulation tools
  • Experience with digital signal processing (DSP), waveform generation, or high-speed data acquisition
  • Experience developing deterministic, ultra-low-latency digital systems
  • Familiarity with AXI, PCIe, DDR, or other high-performance hardware interfaces
  • Experience with ASIC-oriented RTL development and reusable digital IP
  • Knowledge of Python, Tcl, or other languages used for development automation
  • Experience with hardware-software co-design and embedded systems
  • Experience in quantum computing, telecommunications, measurement equipment, or other performance-critical digital systems

What’s in it for you?

  • Flexible working hours
  • Home office option
  • 5 weeks of holiday
  • 5 sick days
  • Multisport Card
  • Meal allowance
  • Internal trainings including workshops and seminars
  • Paid certifications and technical as well as soft-skills training
  • Possibility to participate in international conferences
  • Fresh fruit, coffee, and a weekly company breakfast in the office
  • Loyalty bonus after 5, 10, 15 and more years with the company
  • Referral bonus programme
  • Corporate events including team building, outdoor activities, Christmas party, health week, summer ice cream, and more
  • Hybrid and remote working options available across our Czech offices in Prague, Hradec Králové, and Zlín

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

With delivery centers in Prague, Hradec Králové, and Zlín, our Czech team delivers end-to-end solutions across industries. Here, innovation thrives through collaboration, and every idea drives our partners' success.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

This role ensures the retention and achievement of revenue growth, product volumes, and share of wallet. Supporting an identified opportunity Road Map to strategically position Toll as one of the top 3 service providers. Continue to position Toll to gain and win within the defined road map and drive strategic engagement with key influencers, decision makers and internal stakeholders to ensure proper promotion of Toll within the customers network, locally, regionally and internationally where applicable.

  • Support the region in preparing for global forums and contribute to shaping best practices and process improvements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

KEY PERFORMANCE MEASURES

  • Successful implementation and governance of SOPs.

We see that as an opportunity. To be curious. To ask the right questions. And build meaningful connections. Because finding new ways to solve problems is what we do. With a bold vision to expand our global reach, our 16,000+ people bring a passion for progress. Het deelmodel WaTEM/SEDEM werd eerder via Python geoptimaliseerd, geherkalibreerd en geoperationaliseerd in pycnws. Je breidt het model verder uit met nieuwe functionaliteiten en staat in voor de herstructurering, documentatie en verdere operationalisering binnen de betrokken organisatie.

  • Je voert verbeteringen en uitbreidingen door in de Python-code.

  • Je documenteert de code en de modelwerking in GitHub.
  • Je ondersteunt de verdere inzet van de modellen voor erosiebestrijdingsscenario's in prioritaire gebieden waar sediment naar waterlopen en riolering wordt aangevoerd.

De opdracht draagt bij aan de uitvoering van de stroomgebiedbeheerplannen 2023-2027 en ondersteunt het Vlaamse bodembeschermingsbeleid. De modellering helpt om waterloopsegmenten met een grote sedimentaanvoer en de bijbehorende toestroomgebieden gericht te analyseren.

  • Je hebt ervaring met GIS, in het bijzonder ArcGIS en QGIS.

Head of Growth

Location: Ireland/UK (Remote)

About Entity

Entity is building the destination for high calibre games on the web. A curated catalogue of bestselling full-scale game titles running natively in the browser: click a link and you’re playing in seconds on the device you already own.

There are no downloads, no installs and no new hardware. This new low-friction way of playing games is powered by the latest developments in web technologies such as WebAssembly and WebGPU, allowing us to render high-quality game experiences on your device. This is not a game streaming service; this is the power of the New Web.

For developers, we’re the official, licensed channel for proper games on the web. We offer self-serve tools to publish, operate and grow their games, with social play, identity and a unique end-to-end business analytics suite built into the platform.

We’ve signed top-tier publishers representing 100s of millions of unit sales on PC and console to date and are preparing for launch in 2027. We are growing the company in preparation for welcoming players to a new way of experiencing, and discovering, a new home for their gaming experience.

We’re early, funded and moving fast. Joining Entity at this stage is a rare opportunity to help shape our company and our mission. We are an AI-native business; embracing the latest technologies and tools is essential to being successful with us.

About the role

We're hiring a Head of Growth (VP, Distribution) to build and run the engine that brings players to Entity and keeps them coming back. That covers marketing, influencers and community, distribution partnerships, and brand and PR.

You'll report to the CEO and join the senior leadership team. You'll own the growth strategy of the business, the budget and the results. This is a senior and critical role for Entity as we enter our launch phase.

The browser changes how games are distributed. A game on Entity is one link away, so it can be shared and discovered in places app stores and launchers can't reach. We want someone who sees that as the opportunity and builds a growth model around it, rather than copying the playbook of a console or mobile store. You'll need to be knowledgable of growth tactics from gaming, ecommerce, and a broad range of digital product growth strategies.

Alongside leading the marketing and distribution teams, you'll also work very closely with the Head of Games on launch plans for each title and with publishers on co-marketing.

This is a senior, hands-on role. We need someone who can set the strategy in the morning and write the brief, read the data and make the call in the afternoon.

Key responsibilities

  • Growth strategy and model. Own Entity's growth strategy and the model behind it: target players, channel mix, budget, unit economics and targets. Present it to the board and investors and keep it current.
  • Launch. Plan and run the consumer launch, from waitlist through early access to general availability. Turn the founding-member programme into early advocates.
  • Performance marketing and user acquisition. Own paid channels, creative testing, attribution and budget. Hold acquisition cost and payback to targets, and know which channels are adding players, not just counting them.
  • Influencers and creators. Build and run the creator programmes: streamer seeding, paid and organic partnerships, affiliate and referral schemes.
  • Community. Oversee Entity's player community across Discord, Reddit and social channels - by leading the community manager and team. Set the tone, build the team and turn players into advocates who share Entity with others.
  • Distribution partnerships. Find and close distribution deals that put Entity games in front of players: affiliates, media and content partners, device, telecoms and browser partners. Measure each partnership on players and revenue, not reach.
  • Brand, PR and comms. Own the consumer brand and messaging, built on our agreed pillars. Lead our PR agency, the events calendar (including GDC and Gamescom) and consumer comms. Work with the CEO on industry and investor messaging.
  • Publisher co-marketing. Work with the Head of Games and publishers on launch plans, promotional slots and joint campaigns for each title.
  • Data and measurement. Define the growth KPIs, attribution and reporting with the Product Manager, Live. Run a weekly growth review and a monthly report for the board pack.
  • Team and agencies. Hire and lead the growth team as we scale. Manage agencies and freelancers to clear briefs, budgets and results.
  • AI-native marketing. Use AI tools across creative production, testing, community and analysis, and set up how the team uses them consistently.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in growth or marketing for games or consumer digital products, including 3+ years leading a growth or marketing function.
  • A track record of growing a consumer product to scale, with numbers to show for it: players, revenue, acquisition cost, retention.
  • Hands-on experience across: performance marketing, influencer and creator programmes, community, partnerships, and brand and PR. Deep strength in at least two.
  • Experience owning a significant marketing budget and being accountable for its return.
  • Experience launching a product or platform to consumers.
  • Strong analytical skills: attribution, incrementality, cohort analysis and lifetime value. You make budget calls from data and can show your working.
  • Experience leading agencies and building teams.
  • A current, first-hand understanding of where players spend their time and how they discover games today: Discord, Reddit, Twitch, TikTok, YouTube, and the creators who shape what people play, across players aged 16 to 60.
  • The judgement and presence to represent Entity with publishers, partners, press and investors.
  • Based in the UK or Ireland, with the right to work there.

Nice to have

  • Experience growing a games platform, storefront, subscription service or launcher.
  • Experience with web or browser games, or growth through links, embeds and sharing.
  • Experience building distribution partnerships with device makers, telecoms, browsers or media companies.
  • Experience working with publishers on co-marketing.
  • Experience scaling a growth function through a Series A or similar stage.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools for creative, testing and analysis.
  • A passion for games and a network across creators, press and the industry.

Working Conditions

Entity is remote-first, but this role is only open to candidates based in the UK or Ireland, with a suitable home-working setup. We value autonomy, clear ownership, and outcome-driven work. Some flexibility in working hours is expected to support collaboration across the team. Occasional travel may be required for team sessions, industry events, or visits with development partners.

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies. We focus on building high-performing distributed teams with clear expectations, strong support, and an outcomes-first approach to work.

For this opportunity, you will support a high-volume U.S. personal injury law practice where accurate, timely medical documentation directly affects how quickly cases can move forward.

About the Role

As a Medical Records Clerk, you will own the process of requesting, tracking, and retrieving medical records and itemized bills from U.S. healthcare providers. You will step into a team managing a significant volume of outstanding documentation, so consistent provider follow-up and strong organization will be central to your success.

Your work will help prevent delays as cases move toward demand preparation and other key stages of the personal injury lifecycle. This is a strong fit for someone who already understands U.S. medical records retrieval, is comfortable spending a meaningful part of the day on outbound follow-up, and takes satisfaction in closing the loop on difficult or delayed requests.

The working schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time.

Responsibilities

  • Own medical records and itemized billing requests from initial submission through successful retrieval.
  • Prepare and submit accurate HIPAA-compliant records requests and authorizations to hospitals, physicians, clinics, and other U.S. healthcare providers.
  • Conduct consistent outbound follow-up with medical offices and provider records departments to keep outstanding requests moving.
  • Track every request, follow-up, response, and pending item accurately using internal systems and spreadsheets.
  • Review received medical records and bills for completeness, accuracy, and relevance to the client's accident and treatment.
  • Identify missing records, incomplete billing, discrepancies, or documentation gaps and coordinate corrections with providers.
  • Ensure required medical documentation is available as personal injury matters progress toward the demand stage.
  • Coordinate closely with records department leads, case managers, and other internal teams to resolve documentation issues.
  • Manage a high volume of simultaneous requests while meeting productivity, turnaround, and quality expectations.
  • Assist with claims-opening or related administrative processes when needed.

Requirements

Must-Have:

    • Prior hands-on experience requesting and retrieving medical records and medical bills from U.S. healthcare providers.
    • Experience supporting U.S. personal injury matters or working within a personal injury legal environment.
    • Strong spoken and written English, including confidence communicating directly with U.S. hospitals, clinics, physicians, and records departments.
    • Working knowledge of HIPAA authorizations and the U.S. medical records retrieval process.
    • Proven ability to manage a high volume of open requests, follow-ups, and deadlines without losing accuracy.
    • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and persistence in following requests through to completion.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, spreadsheets, and digital tracking systems.

Nice to Have:

    • Experience supporting a California-based personal injury law firm.
    • Familiarity with medical billing, liens, subrogation, insurance claims, and provider billing processes.
    • Experience using medical records retrieval platforms such as ProScan.
    • Experience with legal case management systems such as Filevine or CASEpeer.
    • Familiarity with the personal injury case lifecycle, particularly treatment documentation and demand preparation.

Renewable Integration and Dynamic Modeling RMS/EMT

Position Summary

PSC is seeking a Power Systems Engineer to support renewable energy projects, including solar, wind, and battery energy storage. The engineer will develop plant models, perform dynamic studies, investigate model performance, and prepare technical reports. Responsibilities include managing assigned work from initial data review through client comments and final delivery.

Responsibilities

·Develop detailed and aggregate plant models, including collector systems, transformers, reactive compensation, and interconnection facilities.

·Configure generic dynamic models and integrate OEM inverter and plant controller models using project data and equipment settings.

·Perform model quality tests, voltage and frequency ride-through studies, and assessments supporting PRC-029 evaluations.

·Compare positive-sequence and EMT simulation results, investigate differences, and document findings.

·Troubleshoot initialization, control response, current limits, protection operation, and fault recovery.

·Update models from IFC to as-built configurations using final drawings, settings, and OEM model packages.

·Prepare model documentation, study reports, and submission packages, and resolve review comments.

·Coordinate with clients, equipment vendors, and technical reviewers; track assigned deadlines and identify missing information early.

Required Qualifications

·Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering with a focus on power systems.

·Five (5) to Eight (8) years of relevant experience, including renewable generation or battery storage modeling and dynamic studies.

·Large Load Modeling

·Strong working knowledge of PSS/E and/or PSLF, including model development, initialization, and troubleshooting.

·Practical experience with PSCAD and OEM inverter and plant controller models.

·Understanding of inverter controls, voltage and reactive power control, frequency response, current limits, and protection.

·Ability to interpret single-line diagrams, equipment data, control settings, and per-unit quantities.

·Python experience for simulation automation, data analysis, and plotting.

·Clear technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to manage assigned studies independently and work within a peer review process.

Preferred Qualifications

· Masters degree in electrical engineering with a focus on power systems.

·Experience across PSS/E, PSLF, and PSCAD.

·Experience with ERCOT

·ASPEN short-circuit modeling experience, including inverter fault-current representations.

·Experience with PRC-029 studies and regional model testing and submission requirements.

·Experience with RMS and EMT benchmarking, weak-grid studies, and battery charging and discharging operation.

·Experience integrating user-defined models and resolving software compatibility issues.

·Consulting experience involving concurrent projects, client reviews, and scope management.

·Professional engineering registration or eligibility is an asset.

A reasonable estimate of the current range is:

·$150,000-210k,000 USD depending on years of exp

·$158,000-220,000 CAD depending on years of exp

You may also be eligible to participate in our profit share program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. U.S.-based employees have access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan and company match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, and well-being benefits, among others. U.S.-based employees also receive, per calendar year, 10 scheduled paid holidays, and 10 days of sick leave. Additionally, regular full-time employees accrue up to 15 days of paid vacation. Benefits and perks listed on our careers page vary depending on the nature of employment with PSC and the country's work location.

jobs.title: Biomedical Data Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Computercraft is seeking a Biomedical Data Analyst to support the National Library of Medicine (NLM) at the National Institutes of Health in Bethesda, Maryland.
jobs.description:
Computercraft is seeking a Biomedical Data Analyst to support the National Library of Medicine (NLM) at the National Institutes of Health in Bethesda, Maryland. NLM is the world’s largest biomedical and health research library and maintains a preeminent collection of biomedical literature and information resources. To make biomedical and life sciences literature accessible, NLM maintains PubMed (a publicly accessible search engine), which includes MEDLINE, a bibliographic database with more than 31 million references. MeSH (Medical Subject Headings), a distinctive feature of MEDLINE, is NLM’s controlled vocabulary thesaurus that gives uniformity and consistency to the references.

In this role, you will work full-time providing data analysis and computational support for data-driven efforts to evaluate and improve the MEDLINE indexing product. Working under the technical direction and oversight of the Senior Biomedical Data Analyst and within established analytical approaches, you will support the processing, preparation, validation, and analysis of datasets, including PubMed web search and API user log data, used to evaluate MeSH vocabulary and automated MeSH indexing algorithm performance. You will assist with analyses of indexing performance and user search behavior and contribute to the development of data products, reports, and other analytical outputs used to inform improvements to MEDLINE indexing.

Work performed by the Biomedical Data Analyst is subject to technical review and quality assurance by the Senior Biomedical Data Analyst. The Biomedical Data Analyst shall incorporate feedback, make necessary corrections, and maintain analytical code, documentation, and work products in accordance with established methodologies, technical standards, and quality requirements.

This is a remote position.

Job Responsibilities
  • Support quantitative analyses evaluating automatic MeSH indexing and its impact on MEDLINE and PubMed users.
  • Prepare and process PubMed GUI, API, user search and click, bibliographic, indexing, and other relevant datasets for analysis.
  • Develop and execute scripts for data extraction, cleaning, transformation, aggregation, validation, and analysis using established analytical methods and requirements.
  • Assist with the development, execution, testing, and maintenance of reproducible data processing and analytical workflows.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis and apply established statistical and quantitative methods to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and relationships in data.
  • Calculate and report established performance measures used to evaluate automated MeSH indexing, vocabulary performance, and related MEDLINE processes.
  • Conduct data quality checks and investigate missing, inconsistent, anomalous, or unexpected data and analytical results.
  • Assist the Senior Biomedical Data Analyst with analyses of PubMed user behavior and other data used to identify potential opportunities for improvements to automated indexing algorithms, MeSH vocabulary, or related processes.
  • Develop tables, charts, summaries, and other analytical outputs to communicate findings.
  • Document code, data processing steps, analytical procedures, data quality issues, results, and other information necessary to support reproducibility and technical review.
  • Submit analyses, code, calculations, documentation, visualizations, and other work products for review and quality assurance by the Senior Biomedical Data Analyst.
  • Address findings identified during technical review and quality assurance, including correcting code, data processing procedures, calculations, documentation, or analytical outputs as necessary.
  • Follow established analytical methodologies, coding practices, documentation requirements, and quality control procedures.
  • Participate in the review and interpretation of analytical findings and assist in preparing results for technical and program stakeholders.
Required Skills/Experience
  • B.S.-level or higher education in data science, computer science, statistics, mathematics, bioinformatics, computational biology, information science, engineering, or a related quantitative or computational field.
  • Five (5) years of experience in data analysis, data science, computational analysis, statistics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Proficiency in at least one data analysis/programming language, preferably Python (pandas) or R (tidyverse/dplyr).
  • Experience preparing and analyzing structured datasets, including data cleaning, transformation, aggregation, validation, and exploratory analysis.
  • Knowledge of fundamental statistical and quantitative methods used to summarize data, evaluate patterns, and compare results.
  • Ability to develop, modify, execute, test, and troubleshoot scripts used for data processing and analysis.
  • Ability to follow established analytical methodologies, technical requirements, and quality control procedures and produce accurate, reproducible results.
  • Ability to identify and investigate data quality issues, unexpected results, and potential analytical errors.
  • Ability to document analytical procedures and findings clearly and prepare work products for technical review and quality assurance.
  • Ability to incorporate technical review comments and make appropriate corrections or revisions to analytical work products.
  • Ability to work collaboratively under the technical direction of senior analytical staff and communicate questions, issues, and findings effectively.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, Teams, and Jira.
  • Ability to obtain Public Trust clearance.
Desired Skills/Experience
  • Knowledge of or experience working with biomedical, scientific, bibliographic, web usage, application, API, or user log data.
  • Familiarity with biomedical databases, especially PubMed/MEDLINE.
  • Familiarity with MeSH, controlled vocabularies, MEDLINE indexing, automated indexing, or biomedical information retrieval.
  • Familiarity with typical practices in biomedical publishing, types of scientific publications, components of citations, and basic bibliographic data.
  • Experience constructing database queries, preferably in PubMed/MEDLINE, using Boolean operators, search fields, search filters, or other advanced search features.
  • Familiarity with data visualization techniques and tools for presenting quantitative results.
  • Familiarity with version control, reproducible analytical workflows, or collaborative software development and data analysis practices.
Compensation and Benefits
The anticipated salary range for this position is $110,000–$135,000 annually. The starting salary within this range will be based on relevant experience, qualifications, and skills.

Computercraft offers an excellent benefits package that includes health, dental, vision, and disability and life insurance; a 401(k) plan with matching; paid leave starting at 128 hours/year for the first 3 years of employment; and 11 paid holidays. We also offer the opportunity for a positive work–life balance with a standard 40-hour work week and the chance to work alongside a team of highly accomplished professionals.

Gameplan | Remote | Full-time | Two open positions

Gameplan is growing, and we are looking for two hungry, coachable, high-performing Partnership Managers / Account Executives to join our sales team.

This is not a role for someone who wants to “just do sales.” We are looking for people who want to become excellent at selling, learn how to build real partnerships with schools and districts, and be part of a company with big ambitions.

Selling for us is helping and solving problems. We are not trying to push every product to every potential district, our goal is to understand their needs, goals, problems and learn if Gameplan can help them. If we see that we can, then we present what makes sense.

At Gameplan, we help schools and districts turn student interest in gaming, digital culture, game design, cybersecurity, media, and technology into career-connected learning pathways. Our platform helps educators engage students, build real-world skills, and create programs that connect to future careers.

We are looking for people who are willing to work hard, take coaching, follow a proven sales process, and improve every week.

About the role

As a Partnership Manager / Account Executive, your job will be to work with school and district leaders to understand their goals, challenges, and priorities - then help them see how Gameplan can support their students, teachers, and programs.

You will own opportunities from discovery through close. That means running sales meetings, asking strong questions, understanding district needs, presenting Gameplan clearly, creating urgency, handling objections, and moving deals forward.

You will be trained heavily on our sales playbook, including discovery, demo structure, qualification, positioning, pricing, negotiation, follow-up, and closing.

What you will do

You will:

  • Run discovery calls with school and district leaders

  • Understand each district’s goals, pains, funding priorities, timeline, decision process, and success criteria

  • Use our sales playbook to qualify opportunities properly

  • Paint a clear vision of what the district’s program could become with Gameplan

  • Present Gameplan’s pathways, platform, outcomes, support, and differentiators

  • Manage your pipeline in HubSpot

  • Follow up consistently and professionally

  • Create proposals and quotes

  • Work with leadership to improve your sales skills every week

  • Collaborate with BDRs, marketing, customer success, and leadership

  • Take ownership of your number and your development

Who we are looking for

The most important traits are:

Hungry
You want to win. You are ambitious, competitive, and willing to do the work required to become great.

Coachable
You do not need to know everything already, but you need to be willing to learn, take feedback, roleplay, review calls, and improve fast.

Structured
You can follow a process, use a CRM properly, prepare for meetings, and keep opportunities moving.

Curious
You ask good questions. You want to understand why a district is interested, what problem they are trying to solve, what success looks like, and what could stop the deal from happening.

Strong communicator
You can explain ideas clearly, build trust, and have professional conversations with school and district leaders.

Resilient
Sales comes with rejection, slow responses, and tough conversations. We need people who can stay consistent and keep pushing.

What good looks like in this role

A strong Partnership Manager at Gameplan does not just “show the product.”

They can:

  • Lead a strong discovery conversation

  • Identify real pain, goals, urgency, and decision criteria

  • Understand who is involved in the buying process

  • Connect Gameplan to district priorities like student engagement, CTE pathways, career readiness, teacher support, funding, and measurable outcomes

  • Create a clear next step after every meeting

  • Follow up with urgency and professionalism

  • Use coaching to improve quickly

  • Own their pipeline and their results

Requirements

We are open to different backgrounds, but you should have:

  • Strong English communication skills

  • Sales experience, preferably B2B, education, SaaS, EdTech, or consultative sales

  • Ability to work with US time zones

  • Comfortable speaking with school and district leaders

  • Strong work ethic and willingness to be held accountable

  • Ability to learn and follow a sales playbook

  • Comfortable using CRM tools and sales technology

  • A desire to grow fast

Nice to have

Not required, but helpful:

  • Experience selling to schools, districts, or public sector buyers

  • Experience in EdTech, workforce development, CTE, curriculum, SaaS, or technology

  • Experience managing a pipeline from discovery to close

  • Experience with HubSpot

  • Understanding of US K-12 education

Why join Gameplan?

This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow quickly.

You will get:

  • Direct coaching from leadership

  • A clear sales playbook and process

  • Real ownership of opportunities

  • A chance to sell a product with strong mission and real impact

  • A growing market with a clear need

  • A team that cares about performance, accountability, and development

  • The opportunity to grow with the company as we scale

We are not looking for someone perfect. We are looking for someone hungry, sharp, coachable, and ready to work harder than most people around them.

In your application, answer the 3rd question with "I am ready to be coached".

We are hiring quickly and will be reviewing candidates immediately.

Overview:

The Emerging BioPharma (EBP) Analytics team delivers data-driven analytical solutions that help life sciences commercial teams make better decisions, with deep expertise in oncology, rare disease, and specialty markets. By combining a strong track record in specialty commercial solutions with IQVIA’s broad commercial analytics capabilities, and by increasingly applying AI-enabled tools and workflows, the team is positioned for growth and expanded capacity to support clients in an increasingly competitive environment.


As an Engagement Manager, you will lead multiple consulting projects of varying complexity, ensuring high-quality, on-time, and on-budget delivery for our life sciences clients. You will also drive new business development by strengthening existing client relationships, identifying follow-on opportunities, and helping shape new offerings, including AI-enabled analytics solutions.

  • Leads the team in reviewing and analyzing client requirements; challenges assumptions and develops and prices proposals that ensure profitability and client satisfaction with limited senior management input.

  • Identifies issues early and recommends improvements and alternative solutions to resolve them.
  • Serves as the key day-to-day point of contact for clients.
  • Shapes the storyline and provides senior-level input on client reports and presentations, ensuring findings are clearly communicated and translated into actionable recommendations.
  • Identifies and develops new business opportunities, including follow-on work and new leads.
  • Champions the use of AI, including generative AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, to accelerate analysis, improve quality, and increase team efficiency across the project lifecycle, from proposal development and data exploration to insight generation and deliverable creation.

  • In-depth understanding of IQVIA data assets and core offerings, or comparable syndicated healthcare data (e.g., prescription, medical claims, and EMR data).

The role defines partnership program criteria, evaluates potential partners and technologies, shapes joint value propositions and product integration approaches, and leads cross-functional execution from discovery and due diligence through pilot, launch, performance management, expansion, transition, or exit.

As an Accounting Manager, you’ll manage your own portfolio of bookkeeping clients, oversee day-to-day accounting execution, and assist with answering client questions as they arise. This role works primarily behind the scenes to keep financials accurate and organized, with occasional client communication—primarily via email. It’s ideal for an experienced QuickBooks professional who can work independently, communicate clearly when needed, and keep books clean without hand-holding.

DiLucci CPA Firm has been serving business owners and real estate investors since 2005. For nearly two decades, we’ve built a reputation for doing accounting and tax differently—by prioritizing accuracy, communication, and proactive support instead of reactive clean-up. Our mission is to give clients clarity and confidence in their numbers so they can make better decisions year-round.

We hold ourselves to a high bar: Genuine Care, Great Communication, Speed to Learning, and Fun Tax Energy. We believe great bookkeeping is the foundation of great tax strategy—and that clients deserve both accuracy and responsiveness.

Key Responsibilities

Client Bookkeeping Ownership

  • Manage and maintain an assigned book of bookkeeping clients

  • Perform monthly and quarterly bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online

  • Ensure accurate categorization, reconciliations, and financial reporting

  • Maintain clean, audit-ready books aligned with firm standards

Client Communication & Support

  • Communicate clearly and professionally via email with clients regarding transactions, questions, and follow-ups

  • Proactively request missing information and resolve discrepancies

  • Escalate issues appropriately when needed while maintaining client confidence

Back-End Bookkeeping Administration

  • Handle bookkeeping-related admin tasks including transaction reviews, reconciliations, and documentation

  • Maintain organized workpapers and supporting schedules

  • Track and manage deadlines across multiple clients

  • Ensure bookkeeping workflows are followed consistently and efficiently

Quality Control & Firm Collaboration

  • Maintain high accuracy and consistency across all client files

  • Collaborate with tax, planning, and internal teams as needed

  • Identify inefficiencies or recurring issues and suggest process improvements

  • Uphold firm values through accountability, responsiveness, and attention to details

Role Expectations

  • Independently manage a full bookkeeping client load

  • Maintain timely and professional client communication

  • Deliver consistently accurate financials with minimal rework

  • Meet deadlines and proactively communicate if issues arise

  • Operate with minimal oversight while following firm systems


Qualifications

Required

  • 3–5 years of bookkeeping or accounting experience

  • Extensive knowledge of QuickBooks Online

  • Strong understanding of reconciliations, categorization, and financial reporting

  • Proven experience managing bookkeeping clients independently

  • Excellent written and verbal client communication skills

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable

Our core vision & values:

Vision:

To make valuable tax and accounting education and services available to everyone.

Non-Negotiable Values:

1) Fun Tax Energy (FTE)

  • Bring Positive Energy – Approach your work with focus and enthusiasm knowing that your energy is contagious.

  • Operational Excellence - Do great work because we care about being the best. We take pride in the details, raise the standard, and treat excellence as part of the job.

  • End of Day Mentality - Move with urgency. We do not let work sit when it can be finished, advanced, clarified, or unblocked today.

Education and Professional Experience

Applicants must meet at least one of the following criteria:

  • A degree in Translation, Linguistics, or Language Studies (or an equivalent degree); or

  • A recognized graduate qualification in another field, plus a minimum of two years of full-time professional translation experience; or

  • A minimum of five years of full-time professional translation experience.

Relevant Translation Experience

  • At least two years of professional experience in Life Sciences translation, specifically in Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD).

  • Proven experience translating medical documentation in the relevant fields.

  • Experience limited to patent translation will not be considered sufficient.

  • Ability to perform both Translation and Copy Edit tasks.

Technical Skills

  • Mandatory: Experience with memoQ, version 12.5 or higher.

Nice-to-Have

Project Details

  • Service Line: Life Sciences – Medical Devices.

  • Task Types: Translation and Copy Edit.

  • Expected Capacity: Ongoing weekly availability.

Translation is paid per word, while Copy Edit is compensated per hour or per word, depending on the task size. For smaller Copy Edit assignments, payment will be calculated per word, as minimum fees cannot be offered.

If you are requested to work on a task outside the initial project scope, or assist with a project in which you were not originally involved, you will receive a separate purchase order (PO).

As the IT Leader, Data Science on our Data Science & Engineering team, you will manage and develop a team of data scientists who deliver advanced analytics and data science solutions that create measurable value for Dow. Portfolio Leadership and Delivery Excellence

​Position Summary

The Project Controls Director is responsible for establishing, leading, and overseeing the project controls function for large-scale data center construction projects. This role provides strategic leadership for cost control, planning and scheduling, progress measurement, reporting, forecasting, and risk management across the project lifecycle. The Project Controls Director ensures project performance is measured accurately and communicated effectively to executive leadership, clients, and project teams while supporting on-time and on-budget delivery of mission-critical facilities.

The role works closely with project management, construction leadership, engineering, procurement, and finance to drive performance, identify risks early, and implement corrective actions to maintain project objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Project Controls Leadership

  • Lead and manage all project controls functions including scheduling, cost control, forecasting, reporting, change management, and risk analysis.
  • Develop and implement standardized project controls procedures and reporting frameworks for data center construction projects.
  • Establish project controls systems aligned with company governance and client requirements.
  • Provide leadership and mentoring to project controls managers, schedulers, and cost engineers.

Planning & Scheduling

  • Oversee development of integrated master schedules for large data center programs and individual projects.
  • Ensure schedules include engineering, procurement, fabrication, logistics, construction, and commissioning activities.
  • Validate critical path activities and schedule risk analysis to ensure achievable delivery milestones.
  • Monitor schedule performance and identify mitigation strategies for potential delays.

Cost Management & Forecasting

  • Lead development and management of project budgets, cost tracking, and forecasting systems.
  • Implement earned value management (EVM) methodologies where appropriate.
  • Monitor cost performance and provide early identification of cost variances.
  • Develop monthly forecasts and support executive financial reporting.

Performance Monitoring & Reporting

  • Establish project KPIs and reporting dashboards for executive leadership and clients.
  • Provide accurate weekly and monthly performance reports including schedule health, cost performance, and risk indicators.
  • Ensure transparency and data integrity in project reporting systems.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

Data extraction and vendor transfers

Reporting and analytical validation

  • Develop, run, and validate backend queries, extracts, dashboards, and reports in Solventum and Epic using authorized tools and data sources. Build or modify Epic reports, dashboards, and work queues as needed within assigned access; coordinate restricted builds with Epic analysts.
  • Validate report logic against source records and sample encounters, including filters, date fields, refresh timing, joins, exclusions, numerators, and denominators. Investigate conflicting results before distribution.

  • Compile validated weekly and monthly reporting packages with concise explanations of trends, discrepancies, limitations, and recommended follow-up. Maintain report specifications, version history, and a distribution calendar.

Systems and workflow optimization

  • Translate CDI leadership requests into clear specifications for query templates, provider response choices, reminders, escalation rules, worklists, case statuses, assignment logic, and coder to CDI reconciliation workflows.
  • Configure approved changes where access and functionality permit; otherwise coordinate builds with Epic analysts, IT, and Solventum. Validate integrated query routing, provider responses, encounter updates, and data flow between Epic and Solventum. Track changes through testing and release.

  • Analyze query response and closure patterns, unanswered queries, rejected recommendations, work queue aging, reconciliation delays, and opportunities missed between concurrent and pre-bill review. Recommend changes supported by data.

AI and reporting automation

  • Use organization-approved AI tools to help draft workflow maps, report specifications, SQL or scripts, query-template revisions, presentations, and analyses requested by CDI leadership. Verify generated logic and outputs before use.

  • Handle patient information only in approved environments. Maintain appropriate access, audit trails, and human review for AI-assisted work; route clinical content and production changes through established approval processes.

Implementation testing and technical support

  • Highly collaborative role requiring regular video-based interaction with clients, operational leaders, and technical teams, including frequent presentation and demonstration of Solventum and Epic CDI solutions.
  • Represent CDI technical requirements in implementation meetings. Maintain a consolidated request backlog, issue log, dependencies, and status updates for CDI leadership.
  • Develop test scenarios and coordinate user acceptance testing for extracts, reports, query workflows, interfaces, and application updates. Document expected and actual results, defects, retesting, and release readiness.
  • Assess downstream effects of changes, including reporting continuity, provider responses, query routing, reconciliation, and historical comparisons. Maintain release notes and coordinate rollback arrangements with the responsible technical teams.
  • Troubleshoot CDI application and reporting issues; collect evidence, reproduce defects, open vendor tickets, and escalate unresolved items. Confirm resolution with affected users.
  • Maintain operating procedures, technical references, and user guides. Partner with CDI educators on training and provide backup documentation so critical processes can continue during absences.

  • Bachelor’s degree in health informatics, health information management, information systems, data analytics, healthcare administration, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and relevant technical experience may be considered.

We're looking for a Principal Engineer to join our CSP Engagements team as the technical focal point for end-to-end performance, working directly with engineering teams of key CSP/hyperscale customers to ensure they achieve various performance targets on NVIDIA platforms. In this role, you will augment NVIDIA's performance and benchmark teams with a dedicated CSP-facing focus. You will drive work streams with CSP engineering teams to build shared understanding of platform performance characteristics, gather and incorporate their workload-specific feedback into NVIDIA's optimization priorities, and validate that performance targets are met in customer-representative configurations. Your cross-CSP visibility enables you to identify patterns and drive systemic improvements in documentation, configuration guidance, and tooling.

What you'll be doing:

  • Drive performance characterization work streams with engineering teams of key CSP/hyperscale customers — ensuring they understand platform performance expectations, profiling methodology, and tuning options for their specific workloads

  • Gather and synthesize CSP performance feedback — identify gaps between expected and actual throughput, and champion optimization priorities back into NVIDIA's CUDA, NCCL, driver, and firmware teams

  • Ensure key open-source performance and stress tools (e.g., STREAM, GPU Burn, GPU BLAST) are updated and validated for the latest NVIDIA rack-scale systems, GPU architectures, and CPU platforms — so customers and internal teams have reliable baseline measurements from day one

  • Work closely with CSPs to ensure their own performance and validation tooling reflects the latest GPU capabilities, memory hierarchy changes, and platform-specific tuning parameters

  • Conduct cross-CSP performance comparison and pattern analysis — identify configuration, software, or workload differences that explain performance gaps between deployments

  • Collaborate with CSPs to ensure performance-related integration work (profiling infrastructure, benchmark harnesses, config validation) is ready ahead of deployment milestones

  • Define test strategies and tooling requirements for performance validation — both for NVIDIA internal certification and customer acceptance

What we need to see:

  • 15+ years of experience in systems performance engineering, ideally in GPU/HPC/ML infrastructure. BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)

  • Proficiency in GPU workload profiling: nsight systems, nsight compute, DCGM metrics, or equivalent instrumentation

  • Understanding of distributed training performance dynamics: computation/communication overlap, pipeline bubbles, memory bandwidth utilization, collective efficiency

  • Statistical methods for performance analysis: regression detection, confidence intervals, A/B comparison at scale

  • Understanding of how the full software stack impacts performance: driver overhead, collective algorithm selection, memory allocation, scheduling, firmware power management

  • Strong data analysis and visualization skills (Python, pandas, dashboards). Customer obsession — genuine passion for understanding why customers aren't achieving expected performance and driving solutions

  • Ability to communicate performance findings to both deep technical audiences and executive leadership

  • Demonstrated success influencing multiple engineering teams to prioritize performance improvements

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience profiling and optimizing distributed training at 1000+ GPU scale (Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, FSDP)

  • Background in ML infrastructure performance at a CSP/hyperscaler

  • Familiarity with NVIDIA platforms (DGX, HGX, NVLink topology) and profiling tools

  • Experience building automated performance regression detection systems for production environments

  • Understanding of inference workload performance dynamics (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, continuous batching)

ABOUT GENERATION:

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have a 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. The Senior Denials Prevention Analyst is an operational subject‑matter expert in denial prevention who combines advanced revenue cycle analytics with targeted account sampling to identify trends, pinpoint root causes, and drive sustainable reductions in initial denials for maximum reimbursement. The analyst monitors denial prevention KPIs and initiative progress, quantifies net revenue opportunities and realized benefits, and maintains benefit‑tracking dashboards and concise leadership readouts. Partnering closely with revenue cycle and, as appropriate, clinical operations and IT/Epic teams, the role translates insights into actionable prevention plans, monitors and helps implement workflow and system improvements, and tracks adoption, outcomes, and barriers. Stanford Health Care

The AP Curriculum and Assessment Team at College Board (125+ staff) collaborates with colleagues across all aspects of the AP Program to develop, manage, and deliver AP’s 43 courses in a wide variety of subject areas. AP® is a rigorous academic program built on the commitment, passion, and hard work of students and educators from secondary schools and higher education. AP provides willing and academically prepared high school students with the opportunity to study and learn at the college level. AP’s course teams comprised of educators and disciplinary experts ensure that course curricula are aligned to higher education expectations and reflect the state of the art in the discipline, contribute to instructional resources and tools for teachers, and develop assessments that allow students in these courses to demonstrate their mastery of course content and skills. AP leads in strategic use of AI to expand student access, strengthen instructional design and professional support, and enhance assessment creation and exam analysis. The Science department, which includes biology, chemistry, physics, environmental science, and Research, is currently comprised of approximately 22 people supporting 8 courses in the AP portfolio.

About the Opportunity

As the Director I, APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism you will be responsible for preserving and improving the quality and validity of the AP Program’s core deliverables within the subject domain: the exam, the course curriculum, and the professional development content. You are also responsible for item development and management from authoring to administration; training and collaborating with subject-matter experts (SMEs), typically college professors and secondary school teachers. You will ethically and effectively integrate AI technologies in assessment creation and review. This includes judiciously using AI assisted tools to support fairness, validity, and innovation in AP assessments. You will train SMEs on assessment development protocols, translate between academics and technical experts (psychometricians), and collaborate to develop formative assessment materials and resources to support APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism teachers worldwide. You will serve as a point of contact in AP for committees and communities of subject-matter experts and will be responsible for the curriculum and assessment for APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism, and, in partnership with other AP teams, further the strategic growth of APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism across the globe. Additionally, you may have the opportunity to present, speak, and moderate dialogue with academic and membership audiences to ensure that ongoing change and improvement within AP courses and exams is understood, accepted, and supported in secondary and post-secondary educational communities. Your responsibilities may also include assessment development for AP Physics 1: Algebra-Based, AP Physics 2: Algebra-Based, and/or AP Physics C: Mechanics, as necessary and appropriate.

In this role, you will:


Assessment Development and Scoring (45-75%) 

  • Serve as an assessment leader for APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism, with primary responsibility for assessment development for APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism. Your work in developing and revising test content is of the quality that requires only minimal adjustments based on feedback from your manager and other program leaders.
  • Independently lead processes for authoring and revising assessment content, including training educator constituents and leveraging generative AI to author and/or review assessment content, improving and/or making more efficient assessment processes and outputs.
  • Independently lead the development and management of assessment content (formative and summative) and scoring materials for APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism through iterative review stages with multiple internal and external stakeholders, including the APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism Team, Assessment Production team, Test Development Committee, and the Chief Reader, as appropriate.
  • Independently lead the development of assessment forms for APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism, ensuring the AP Exam development aligns with approved curricula and test specifications.
  • Lead multiple face-to-face, weekend meetings, and virtual meetings (during work week, evenings, or weekends) annually with the APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism Test Development Committee. You strategize and develop an agenda and approach to ensure the committee’s meeting time is of the highest productivity; you successfully adapt and pivot during the meeting as needed; and you successfully resolve all post-meeting item content edits.
  • Train and directly supervise Test Development Committee members in AP Physics C: Electricity & Magnetism as content development contributors and reviewers. Recruit educators for the APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism Development Committee and other opportunities to support AP Program.
  • Lead the successful scoring of student responses for APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism Exams at the annual scoring event in person and online—the “AP Reading”—and produce AP Reading publications materials for teacher and student use. You plan all year, with increasing intensity in the months leading up to the Reading, ensuring all workflow steps for this incredibly complex event, as well as all post-Reading activities, are accounted for and successfully executed.

Assessment Quality and Process (10-15%)

  • Contribute to current research and best practices in assessment, and engage regularly with AP Curriculum & Assessment colleagues to align on standards and shared principles guiding AP’s assessment directions
  • Support assessment workstreams within the AP Science.
  • Contribute to processes for efficient, high-quality assessment development.
  • Contribute to initiatives to refine and improve question task models as well as exam design in collaboration with AP Curriculum & Assessment leaders and aligned to other College Board initiatives to achieve psychometric and disciplinary best practices on APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism exams.
  • Monitor exam validity, security, reliability, fairness, and quality, as well as reader reliability in accordance with established Program thresholds for APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism exam, identifying areas for improvement and executing on targeted improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with psychometrics and AP Curriculum & Assessment staff to establish fair, reliable, and valid cut scores for APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism exam.

Course Development, Program Support, and Stakeholder Engagement (5-25%)

  • Refine and improve APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism Course Framework to ensure clear and explicit learning outcomes that align with strategic priorities, including ensuring college/disciplinary standards as well as expanding the scope of reaching a broader audience of AP students.
  • Collaborate with AP teams to support the development of new products for AP Physics C: Electricity & Magnetism designed to address unmet teacher instructional needs, potentially including developing prototypes, participating in small-scale market-testing, and creating models for subsequent development in conjunction with other AP workstreams. 
  • Recruit educators for the APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism Development Committee and other opportunities to support AP Program.
  • Serve as a recognized and trusted resource within the educator community by collaboration and engagement with the community to drive teacher satisfaction with APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism and its exam.
  • Collaborate with the AP Professional learning team to support APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism consultants and teachers.
  • Work with the AP Higher Education team to co-develop and implement plans to raise college and university awareness of APPhysics C: Electricity & Magnetism courses and exams, including recruiting college faculty to participate in the AP Reading, co-leading the planning and execution of discipline-specific AP Faculty Colloquia events, and supporting Visiting and Virtual Fellows Programs. 

About You

You (have):

  • A Master’s degree in Physics or a directly related discipline, and knowledge of current trends in the discipline (required), although a doctorate in the discipline is strongly preferred
  • Expertise in Physics with at least 5 years of experience in standardized assessment development or related work; experience with digital assessment and teaching preferred
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, with solid technical proficiency and a customer-focused mindset
  • Excellent organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain close attention to detail, including proofreading
  • Demonstrated ability to implement processes and procedures, manage project plans and schedules, and maintain tracking documentation
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels, and engage in giving and receiving constructive feedback
  • Ability to travel 6-8 times per year, plus up to two additional weeks for the AP Reading; must be eligible to work in the United States

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days. The preferred application deadline is Friday, November 13th. Please keep in mind that College Board offices will be closed November 26th – November 27th and December 25th – January 1st so it is better to apply sooner than later. What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck- we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.


A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $96,000 to $135,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.
