jobs.description:
Murphy deploys AI agents for banks starting with the most straightforward business case: voice AI for debt collection. We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication.

Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and SMS to maximize results while preserving trust.

We’re live with Santander, Revolut, BBVA and dozens others. We’ve proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks. And now we need to move fast to secure leadership in this $300Bn+ industry.

💼 About the Role

Murphy is building the AI agents that will run real collections conversations for banks, lenders and collection agencies across The UK — and we need people who've actually done the job to make sure our AI does it right. We're recruitingDebt-Collection Experts to join our advisor network in a consultant/advisor capacity: no full-time commitment, just your judgment and experience, paid by the hour (roughly 5–20 hours per month).

You'll work directly with Murphy's product and AI teams to pressure-test how our voice agents negotiate, escalate, and stay compliant — bringing the floor-level and strategic reality of the UK collections into how we design and train our technology.

📝 Responsibilities

Domain Review & AI Validation

  • Review call flows, scripts and negotiation logic used by Murphy's AI agents and flag anything that doesn't match how a real collections desk would handle it.

  • Validate cadence, cure-rate assumptions, settlement/negotiation ranges, and escalation paths against real-world practice.

  • Stress-test edge cases: disputes, renegotiation, hardship, repeat promises-to-pay, and regulatory triggers.

Compliance & Local Nuance

  • Flag anything that could create compliance risk under British consumer-protection rules.

  • Advise on tone, channel mix and contact-frequency norms considered acceptable vs. abusive in the The UK market.

Knowledge Transfer

  • Join periodic working sessions (calls/async review) with Murphy's product and engineering teams.

  • Share real examples, scripts and playbooks from your own collections experience (anonymized, no client data).

🎯 What We're Looking For

We're recruiting across two profiles:

  • Bank in-house collections leaders — you've owned the creditor-side process: placement strategy, make-vs-buy decisions, and portfolio oversight.

  • DCA / servicer / BPO collections & contact-centre managers — you've run the floor: cadence, scripts, cure rates, and agent incentives.

And you likely also have:

  • 5+ years of experience in collections.

  • Current or recent (≤2 years) experience at a named bank, DCA, servicer or BPO.

  • A title of Manager, Team Lead, Head, Director or VP (front-line agent/officer/advisor titles only qualify if you've since moved into managing a team).

  • English Native speaker.

⏱️ The Engagement

  • Format: consultant/advisor, paid hourly.

  • Time commitment: approx. 5–20 hours/month, flexible around your schedule.

  • Fully remote.

🚀 Why Join

  • Shape how AI actually collects debt at some of the world's top banks

  • Flexible, low-commitment engagement that fits around your current job.

  • Work directly with a founding product/AI team backed by Northzone, ElevenLabs and Lakestar.

  • Competitive hourly consulting fee.

Job Summary: The IT Service Desk Specialist III role focuses on providing and leading remote technical support for our 1000+ associates, ensuring timely resolution of IT requests (incidents and service requests). This leadership role requires a service-oriented individual with a deep understanding of ITIL and ITSM frameworks. With a strong technical background, you will be the go-to person for making decisions as an escalation point for any technology-related processes, applications, or devices. You'll mentor, and empower a team of technical resources, fostering a collaborative environment that delivers efficient service delivery and drive continuous improvement to align IT support with business goals and customer satisfaction metrics.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement, manage and support ITIL-aligned processes including Incident, Service Requests, Problem, and Change Management.
  • Contribute to the development of service desk performance metrics (e.g. SLAs, KPIs, first call resolution, ticket response times, ticket resolution times, customer satisfaction) and provide actionable insights for continuous improvement.
  • Respond to requests for technical assistance via phone, chat, or email.
  • Provide excellent customer service by actively listening to user concerns, clearly explaining solutions, and maintaining a professional and courteous demeanor.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for complex or critical technical issues and coordinate resolution efforts with end users / customers, internal teams, external vendors, and managers for timely resolution.
  • Develop and maintain documentation such as knowledge base articles, workflows, and standard operating procedures.
  • Conduct regular training and mentoring sessions for Service Desk staff to ensure skill development and adherence to ITIL / ITSM best practices.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging user feedback and performance data to enhance service delivery.
  • Conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis for recurring Incidents to identify and address systemic issues.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, application, and security teams to implement long-term fixes and preventative measures.
  • Promote automation and self-service tools to reduce manual workload and enhance service efficiency.
  • Collaborate with the IT Service Delivery Manager to ensure alignment with overall service delivery goals.
  • Manage process for communicating outage/emergency activities to the organization where applicable.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Minimum of 8 years of IT support experience.
  • Strong understanding of the ITIL framework and service management best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, BMC Remedy, Freshservice or equivalent platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows OS, Microsoft Exchange and Office 365 , Active Directory, VOIP solutions such as Ring Central, networking fundamentals, and remote support tools.
  • Proven experience in a Service Desk or similar role within the healthcare industry.
  • Exceptional problem-solving, communication, analytical and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail, fostering a customer-centric and service-oriented culture.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • ITIL v3 or v4 Foundation certification or higher.
  • Knowledge of healthcare IT systems and regulations.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity principles and IT compliance requirements.
  • Experience in multi-site service operations.

Working Conditions:

  • Primarily remote role requiring prolonged periods of sitting and manual dexterity to operate a computer and other devices, may require occasional travel for site visits.
  • Ability to occasionally lift and transport IT equipment during on-site visits.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, as needed.

What We are Offer You

Compassion

Make Someone’s Day

Collaboration

Achieve Possibilities Together

Respect

Treat people with dignity

Accountability

Do the right thing


Beyond competitive compensation, our well-rounded benefits package includes a range of comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, HSA / FSA, 401(k) matching, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and more.


About US Urology Partners

U.S. Urology Partners is one of the nation’s largest independent providers of urology and related specialty services, including general urology, surgical procedures, advanced cancer treatment, and other ancillary services.


With a network of more than 80 locations across seven states, U.S. Urology Partners continues to play a key role in advancing innovation and access to urological services. As a partner to independent, community-based urology practices, U.S. Urology Partners enables them to focus on delivering premier care to the patients they serve and is backed by leading global investor General Atlantic.

jobs.description:
Vi på Sustainergies kan hjälpa dig matchas till uppdrag där du snabbt blir en del av arbetet med att samla in, analysera och kvalitetssäkra klimatdata. Det här är en möjlighet att bygga praktisk erfarenhet av klimatrapportering, dataprocesser och transparens i hållbarhetsarbetet samt få en inblick i de utmaningar som följer med datakvalitet, kontroll och uppföljning.

Uppdrag och arbetsuppgifter

När du gör en öppen ansökan till studentuppdrag inom klimatrapportering kommer du att ingå i vår kandidatdatabas. Det innebär att du får uppdateringar om nya relevanta uppdrag och kan komma att bli kontaktad direkt av våra rekryterare. Går du vidare med ett uppdrag kan du bli en del av arbetet med att samla in, analysera och kvalitetssäkra klimatdata. Uppdragen kan variera, men kan exempelvis innebära att:

  • Stötta insamlingen av data för klimat- och hållbarhetsrapportering.

  • Strukturera och analysera data i Excel.

  • Säkerställa datakvalitet och rimlighet utifrån GHG-protokollet.

  • Rapportera in data i system som t.ex. Position Green, Stratsys, CEMAsys eller SustainLabs.

  • Sammanställa resultat och bidra till klimatbokslut och hållbarhetsrapport.

Kompetenser och färdigheter

Eftersom ansökan är öppen och de specifika uppdragen kan variera så är kompetensprofilen bred. Vi kommer att välja ut kandidater med goda förutsättningar att komma in i arbetet snabbt och smidigt då det ofta rör sig om tidsbegränsade uppdrag. Kravet är att du har:

  • Goda kunskaper i excel och datahantering

  • Viss erfarenhet av sammanställning eller rapportering av klimat- och hållbarhetsdata

Meriterande

  • God förståelse för GHG (greenhouse gas protocol) scoop 1-3.

  • Praktisk erfarenhet av klimatbokslut eller hållbarhetsrapportering.

  • God kunskap om rapporteringskrav och datainsamling för CSRD.

  • För att lyckas väl i rollen tror vi att det är viktigt att du är noggrann, nyfiken och strukturerad och trivs i en roll där du får analysera, ordna och förstå data i detalj.

Cloud Service Provider Costing Specialist

The Cloud Service Provider Costing Specialist provides technical and financial expertise in commercial cloud pricing, cost modeling, and cloud service provider purchasing options, with a primary emphasis on Microsoft Azure. This role supports enterprise cloud migration, modernization, and hosting decisions by developing defensible cost estimates, evaluating financial alternatives, and identifying opportunities to optimize cloud expenditures.


What You Will Do

  • Develop comprehensive Microsoft Azure cost estimates, financial models, and total cost of ownership (TCO) analyses to support enterprise workload migration, modernization, and hosting decisions.
  • Evaluate and compare the financial implications of hosting alternatives, including on-premises infrastructure, Azure VMware Solution (AVS), Azure-native Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and Platform as a Service (PaaS), and other commercial cloud platforms.
  • Analyze Azure pricing structures, Microsoft licensing models, consumption-based charges, reservations, savings plans, data transfer costs, and commercial purchasing agreements to determine projected cloud costs.
  • Assess existing infrastructure configurations, resource utilization, application requirements, and workload characteristics to establish current-state cost baselines and forecast future cloud expenditures.
  • Evaluate cloud service provider pricing, purchasing options, discounts, licensing considerations, and contractual factors, with a primary emphasis on Microsoft Azure.
  • Collaborate with cloud engineers, solution architects, and other technical stakeholders to assess the financial implications of architecture, infrastructure sizing, migration strategies, and modernization decisions.
  • Develop cloud cost optimization recommendations addressing resource sizing, consumption patterns, licensing, reservations, savings plans, and cloud service selection.
  • Use Azure Pricing Calculator, Azure Cost Management, Azure Migrate, Microsoft Excel, and related tools to develop estimates, analyze expenditures, validate assumptions, and maintain detailed cloud cost models.
  • Develop financial comparisons, forecasts, and business cases that clearly document assumptions, cost drivers, financial tradeoffs, risks, and projected outcomes.
  • Present cloud cost analyses and recommendations to technical, business, and executive stakeholders in a clear and defensible manner.

What You Will Need

  • SIX (6+) years of experience in cloud financial management, IT infrastructure costing, cloud pricing analysis, or related technical financial disciplines. University degree or FOUR (4) years experience in leu of formal education
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience independently developing detailed Microsoft Azure pricing estimates, cloud financial models, and TCO analyses for enterprise infrastructure and application workloads.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Azure consumption pricing, Microsoft licensing, reservations, savings plans, data transfer charges, and commercial cloud purchasing models.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate infrastructure configurations, resource utilization, workload requirements, and architectural designs into detailed cloud consumption forecasts and cost estimates.
  • Experience evaluating and comparing the financial implications of cloud migration, modernization, and hosting alternatives, including Azure IaaS, PaaS, and VMware-based environments.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Enterprise Agreements, Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) purchasing arrangements, negotiated pricing, and cloud licensing considerations.
  • Working knowledge of Azure infrastructure architecture, including compute, storage, networking, databases, and managed services, sufficient to identify and evaluate technical cloud cost drivers.
  • Experience using Azure Pricing Calculator, Azure Cost Management, Azure Migrate, or comparable cloud financial management and estimation tools.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and the ability to independently develop, validate, document, and maintain complex cloud cost models.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop financial analyses, clearly document assumptions, and communicate cost comparisons, financial tradeoffs, and recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders.

What Would Be Nice to Have

  • Experience developing financial business cases and cost comparisons for migrations from Azure VMware Solution (AVS) to Azure-native infrastructure and platform services.
  • Experience supporting highly regulated or federal cloud environments, including Azure Government pricing, federal cloud procurement arrangements, and agency-specific financial requirements.

  • Microsoft Azure certifications or comparable cloud financial management credentials.
  • Experience developing and presenting cloud financial recommendations and business cases to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

jobs.description:
About FreedUp

FreedUp places talented Executive Assistants with founders and executives at growing US companies. We free leaders up by saving them time and effort so they can focus on the work only they can do. For our EAs, we aim to be one of the best US companies for LATAM and Filipino talent, with a supportive environment and real room to grow.

About the role

We're looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant to be the "second brain" for a fast-moving US entrepreneur. He runs a growing private aircraft sales business, where many leads come in through his social media content, and he co-owns a pool services company.

You'll own his CRM, keep his sales team on track, stay on top of his calendar, files and travel, and help with the personal details that make life run smoothly. You won't just follow instructions: he wants someone who audits how things are done, spots gaps without being told, and suggests what to hand off next. This is a behind-the-scenes role. He handles all client calls and onboarding himself.

Compensation: 1,000 to 1,700 USD (Depends on Experience)

Location: Remote, LATAM

Job Type: Full-time

What you'll do

1. Own the Notion CRM (ramps up gradually)

  • Keep the aviation sales pipeline watertight: deal stages, last-contact dates and next steps always current.
  • Add new and missing deals, including aircraft that go under contract, and flag stale records (for example, "last contact was months ago").
  • After each recorded sales Zoom call, use the transcript and Claude to create the CRM entry with the contact's details, write next steps and delegate follow-ups to the right sales rep.
  • Take over the CRM step by step as you learn the nuances of the business.

2. Coordinate the sales team

  • Follow up with the two sales reps so they stay on top of their leads and keep their deals updated in the CRM, without adding extra admin work to their plate.
  • Make sure every deal has clear next steps and that aircraft listings get the visibility they need.
  • Send him consolidated status overviews so he can see the whole pipeline at a glance.

3. Manage Dropbox filing (from day one)

  • Move aircraft photos, videos, spec sheets, sales brochures, maintenance status reports, contracts, LOIs, APAs and deposit confirmations from email into the right Dropbox folders as soon as they arrive.
  • Follow a clear SOP and keep everything consistent as the team grows. Much of this material is sensitive or client-facing, so accuracy matters.

4. Manage his calendar and reminders

  • Manage his Outlook calendar and his availability for calls booked through Calendly.
  • Handle reschedule requests and send short scheduling emails to clients when needed.
  • Send a proactive end-of-day "here's tomorrow" text with his meetings, addresses, links, documents or waivers to sign, and anything he needs to bring, plus a suggested time for his daily workout around a busy schedule.

5. Book travel

  • Plan two to three mostly domestic trips a month, comparing options on Kayak and booking through airline apps.
  • Follow his saved preferences: direct flights, no very early departures and exit row seats, with his traveler details on file.
  • Handle booking, check-in and confirmations so everything is ready on his phone.

6. Handle personal and admin tasks

  • Take care of waivers, vehicle registrations and other paperwork for his trucks and businesses.
  • Remember birthdays and anniversaries, and arrange flowers and gifts for his wife and kids within a set budget.
  • Process payroll for his pool company (about six people).
  • Possibly monitor GoHighLevel for new pool leads during your working hours and send quick text replies.

Please note: this role does not include client calls or onboarding. He handles all client conversations himself. Beyond these tasks, he wants you to audit his systems, spot the low-hanging fruit and tell him what else you can take off his plate.

Our hiring process

  1. Apply online
  2. Record a short Loom video introducing yourself/ Prescreen call with a recruiter
  3. Final Interview with our Recruiting Lead
  4. Complete a work evaluation
  5. Final interview with the client

Requirements

Must-haves

    • At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Sales Coordinator or in a similar support role.
    • A very proactive "second brain" who audits systems and spots gaps without being told.
    • Highly organized and detail-oriented.
    • Fast and responsive. He should never be left waiting.
    • Disciplined and professional.
    • Excellent written and spoken English.
    • Comfortable handling both business and personal tasks.
    • High discretion with client, financial and payroll information.
    • Available full-time from 9 AM to 5 PM US Central Time.
    • Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet home office setup.

Nice-to-haves

    • A good sense of humor and a likable personality.
    • Experience with Notion as a CRM.
    • Comfort using AI tools, especially Claude.
    • Sales operations or high-ticket sales support experience.
    • Experience with GoHighLevel.

Tools & Communication: Notion, Claude, Outlook, Dropbox, Zoom, Calendly, DocuSign, GoHighLevel, and Kayak and airline apps. Communication is mainly by text, with phone calls when needed (no Slack).

Benefits

  • Compensation in USD
  • Year-end bonus, plus other applicable bonuses
  • Health insurance allowance
  • PTO + Holidays
  • Training and ongoing support from the FreedUp team

Job Description:


Job Description

About Velonetic

Velonetic represents the joint ventures between DXC Technology, the International Underwriting Association (IUA), and Lloyd’s of London. Previously referred to as the London Market Joint Ventures, we have been operating for over 20 years in the London market (Lloyd's and Company), in both insurance and reinsurance business. Our core business services involve performing checks on insurance documents, processing premium transactions and processing claims transactions.


About the Role

Permanent, Full - time (37.5 hrs per week)

Individual will reside in the UK and have Right to Work in the UK.​


As an Insurance Premium Technician, you will be part of a supportive team, working closely with your Team Manager and colleagues to process insurance risks accurately and efficiently. You will play an important role in carrying out technical checks, reviewing documentation, and helping to ensure that service standards for quality and turnaround times are consistently achieved.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to start or build a career in the insurance industry. Full training will be provided on the insurance documentation, systems, and processes needed to succeed in the role, along with ongoing support and development opportunities to help you build your insurance knowledge, grow your confidence, and develop a rewarding long-term career.


Essential Job Functions

  • Conducting technical checks on insurance documentation to ensure accuracy and identifing discrepancies or errors
  • Using specific IT-based systems to support the technical process, with supervision or referral where applicable
  • Liaising with customers and brokers to resolve queries and issues related to the work being processed
  • Taking ownership of your own workload to ensure agreed service levels are achieved
  • Inputing details into databases to initiate settlements and process updates
  • Completing accurate reporting associated with the work being processed
  • Supporting and contributing to innovation and process improvement projects
  • Reviewing and validating insurance documentation to ensure quality and compliance
  • Meeting agreed service levels in respect of quality, accuracy, and turnaround times

Basic Qualifications

  • Strong numeracy, verbal and literacy skills
  • Computer literate with working knowledge of Outlook and MS Office
  • Ability to work to a high level of accuracy with attention to detail
  • Strong organisational, personal and time management skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Ability to demonstrate strong negotiating and influencing skills
  • Positive attitude and natural curiosity to identify improvements

Investment In Training and Development

We offer a comprehensive range of training and career development opportunities, a structured induction programme, tailored job training as well as mentoring and support for relevant sponsored professional qualifications. We’re developing an environment where people can grow and harness their careers and skills to be the best that they can be to focus on the long term.


Our Culture

Here at Velonetic we support with care and compassion. We are constantly evolving our initiatives around equality, diversity, and inclusion to ensure that everyone feels equally involved and supported in the workplace no matter of who they are or what they do. We are proud of the culture we are creating to ensure that our commitment is ongoing and have a diverse mix of employees working within an inclusive environment and culture to create a high performing workforce led by talented leaders. We aspire to be recognised for our innovative and modern thinking approach.

Find out more: Our Culture


Employee Benefits

You will also have access to ‘Perks at Work’, a discount store to purchase gift cards at reduced rates and get discounts on holidays, restaurants, activities, groceries and more.


DXC Recruitment Team will be engaging with all candidate applications on behalf of Velonetic. DXC will be managing the recruitment throughout the onboarding process.

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

jobs.title: Senior HVDC Converter Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Senior HVDC Converter EngineerAre you an experienced HVDC Engineer with expertise in HVDC converter stations and voltage source converter (VSC) technology, looking to work on major renewable energy and transmission infrastructure projects whilst developing your expertise alongside industry-leading specialists?
jobs.description:
Senior HVDC Converter Engineer

Are you an experienced HVDC Engineer with expertise in HVDC converter stations and voltage source converter (VSC) technology, looking to work on major renewable energy and transmission infrastructure projects whilst developing your expertise alongside industry-leading specialists?

Here at PSC we are growing our HVDC capability to support an expanding portfolio of offshore wind, HVDC transmission and grid infrastructure projects across the UK and internationally. We are specifically looking for engineers who have developed meaningful experience within the HVDC converter space, whether through converter station design, converter technologies, commissioning activities, owner's engineering assignments or technical consultancy roles.

This opportunity would suit an engineer with approximately 3–5 years or more of dedicated HVDC converter experience as part of a broader engineering career, who is looking to apply and further develop that expertise whilst working alongside some of the industry's most experienced HVDC and power systems consultants.

You'll collaborate with highly experienced consultants, OEMs, developers and network operators, gaining exposure to a broad range of technically challenging projects across the full project lifecycle. From technology selection and converter station design through to design review, commissioning and operational support, you'll help deliver critical transmission infrastructure that enables the integration of renewable energy onto power systems around the world.

The energy transition is vital to our future and here at PSC, we are compelled to make a difference. We are specialist consultants to the energy industry, an independent firm with global operations. Our teams have been tackling the thorniest problems for some of the most prominent industry players for 30 years. We provide critical project consulting support for large energy clients, renewable developers, sustainable energy initiatives, and everything in between.

Our vision is to empower people to transform the energy industry so that, together we will power a more sustainable world. We do the right thing, we foster bright ideas, we invest in the future and we celebrate success.

At PSC we want work to enhance your life, not dominate it. We:

  • Thrive in a culture where people are our greatest asset and we truly celebrate and value the individual.

  • Have an entrepreneurial spirit, love new ideas and are always looking to improve.

  • Understand that everyone has a personal life and provide a flexible work environment - you are an adult and we trust you to get the job done.

  • Provide amazing growth and leadership opportunities in an autonomous role.

  • Are a highly collaborative worldwide team of professionals defining the future of this industry.

  • Offer competitive compensation & benefits including BUPA private medical insurance, life insurance and annual income protection.

We encourage our people to continually learn, grow and expand their skills and knowledge. Perhaps you would like to complete a master’s or a PhD but haven’t done so yet. We will reimburse 50% of your course fees, up to a maximum of £5,000.00 a year. We have offices in Newcastle and Stafford and we have been working in a distributed fashion for years.

We have been working in a distributed fashion for years and are open to hybrid and remote working across the UK.

What You’ll Do:

This role offers a broad range of technical and consulting responsibilities, with a particular focus on HVDC converter stations and associated technologies.

Typical activities include:

· Supporting the development and delivery of HVDC transmission projects.

· Providing technical input into HVDC technology selection and converter station design.

· Supporting the specification, review and integration of HVDC converter technologies, including VSC-based systems.

· Reviewing OEM designs, technical documentation and converter station equipment specifications.

· Supporting transmission and interconnection activities associated with HVDC infrastructure.

· Contributing to the design and assessment of converter station equipment, reactive compensation systems, harmonic filtering solutions and associated electrical infrastructure.

· Assisting with factory acceptance testing, site inspections and commissioning activities.

· Undertaking technical reviews of converter station equipment, operational processes and maintenance strategies.

· Preparing high-quality technical reports and consultancy deliverables.

· Engaging directly with clients, OEMs and project stakeholders to deliver expert technical advice.

· Supporting business development activities, proposals and tender submissions.

· Collaborating with PSC's global network of HVDC and power systems specialists.

You will also have opportunities to represent PSC in industry forums, working groups and conferences, whilst building relationships with clients and supporting the continued growth of our HVDC capability.

You:

We are particularly interested in speaking with engineers who have developed meaningful hands-on experience within the HVDC converter sector and are looking to become part of a specialist consultancy where that expertise can be further developed and shared across the wider business.

Your experience may have been gained with utilities, developers, OEMs, EPC contractors or engineering consultancies, but you will already have established a strong technical foundation in HVDC converter stations, converter technologies and transmission infrastructure.

Ideally you:

· Have approximately 3–5 years or more of direct experience supporting HVDC converter stations, converter technologies or associated HVDC infrastructure.

· Have experience working with voltage source converter (VSC) technology and/or other HVDC converter systems.

· Understand converter station equipment and associated systems such as reactive compensation equipment, harmonic filters, switchgear and transmission infrastructure.

· Have experience supporting design, commissioning, owner's engineering or technical consultancy activities associated with HVDC projects.

· Have experience working on HVDC transmission, offshore wind transmission or grid infrastructure projects.

· Are comfortable working directly with clients, OEMs and project stakeholders.

· Have strong technical report writing and communication skills.

· Can manage multiple priorities across a variety of projects.

· Demonstrate a proactive approach to learning and continuous professional development.

· Are a collaborative team player with a customer-focused mindset.

· Maintain an ethical and professional approach in all interactions.

Other desirable skills include:

· Experience supporting offshore wind transmission projects.

· Experience with converter technologies such as HVDC-VSC.

· Experience with SVC, STATCOM or reactive compensation equipment.

· Exposure to factory acceptance testing, commissioning or site-based activities.

· Experience reviewing OEM designs and technical specifications.

· Familiarity with transmission system studies and grid integration activities.

· Experience with tools such as AutoCAD and other engineering software packages.

We wouldn’t be where we are today without our amazing people. We are passionate about contributing to a meaningful mission and are proud of our people. If you’ve been searching for a human-centric culture, then perhaps you’ve finally found your match with PSC.

If this sounds like something you would like to be a part of then we would love to tell you more.

PSC is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. PSC is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

jobs.excerpt: Senior Software Engineerу цій ролі — це про поєднання глибокої інженерної експертизи та готовності брати на себе лідерство.
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineerу цій ролі — це про поєднання глибокої інженерної експертизи та готовності брати на себе лідерство. Ми шукаємо людину, яка мислить системно, приймає рішення і не уникає відповідальності за результат.

Якщо ти сильний інженер, який давно мислить не лише задачами, а впливом — ця роль для тебе. В нас немає мікроменеджменту: ти сам знаходиш рішення, формуєш підхід до роботи і доводиш його до результату.

В короткій перспективі роль еволюціонує від індивідуального внеску до управління командою та напрямком. Це включає: формування команди, участь у наймі, відповідальність за делівері та якість. А згодом - повноцінне лідерство над бізнес-напрямком, де твій вплив вимірюється не кодом, а бізнес результатами.

Honeytech — динамічний, швидкозростаючий проект, що створив платформу з коміксами в азійській стилістиці та вже став № 1 у своїй ніші! Уяви Netflix, але для коміксів — лише за кілька років ми зібрали 15+ мільйонів користувачів, кинули виклик гігантам з Південної Кореї й довели, що можемо будувати продукт світового рівня з України!
Наша експертна команда налічує понад 90 спеціалістів в штаті та зростає більше ніж в 2.5 рази щороку.

Чому це може бути цікаво саме тобі?

  • Ти впливаєш на продукт. Ми маленька професійна команда, де твої ідеї мають реальний вплив на платформу.

  • Швидкий цикл розробки. Середній час до продакшену ≈1 тиждень, тож ти одразу бачиш результати своєї роботи.

  • Мінімум бюрократії. Ніяких тайм-трекерів, а всі необхідні апруви отримуєш протягом дня.

  • Повна гнучкість. Ми – full remote, але якщо тобі комфортніше працювати з офісу, є варіанти у Києві, Львові та Варшаві.

  • Ти формуєш майбутнє компанії. Ми швидко зростаємо, і твоя роль – не просто "писати код", а закладати фундамент на роки вперед.


Ми шукаємо інженера, який має сильну архітектурну та бекенд-експертизу:

  • Досвід проєктування архітектури продуктів з нуля (System Design)

  • Практичний досвід роботи з високонавантаженими системами (High Load)

  • Розуміння життєвого циклу продукту в продуктових компаніях або стартапах

Backend та інфраструктура:

  • Глибокий досвід роботи з реляційними базами даних (складні схеми, оптимізація запитів та індексів)

  • Побудова мікросервісної архітектури або SOA

  • Досвід роботи з чергами повідомлень (Kafka, RabbitMQ)

Інженерна база:

  • Сильні Computer Science fundamentals (алгоритми, структури даних, складність, патерни)

Стек технологій, з яким працюємо:

  • Back-end: PHP 8.1+, Symfony 6+, NodeJS, Kafka, Redis, SQL

  • Front-end: Twig (шаблонізація) / TypeScript, Webpack Encore

  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS (RDS, S3, Redis), Docker, GitLab

Що потрібно буде робити?

  • Розробка: брати безпосередню участь у реалізації технічних рішень і писати якісний, продуманий код

  • Бізнес-цінність: фокусуватися не лише на технічній частині, а й на тому, щоб рішення реально впливали на бізнес-результат

  • Масштабування відповідальності: у перспективі 2–4 місяців перейти до управління бізнес-напрямком — включно з делівері, people-менеджментом і контролем якості

  • Управління командою: формувати та розвивати власну команду, включно з участю в наймі та прийнятті кадрових рішень


Цікаво, що ще пропонуємо?

- Робота на найбільш конкурентних ринках Tier1 (США, Канада, Британія, Австралія і т.д), що дозволяє стати експертом у своїй справі.

- 20 робочих днів відпустки на рік (після 3 місяців співпраці) та до 30 днів sick leave з медичним підтвердженням. А також можливість трансферу робочих днів та days off по державних святах України.

- Веселі тімбілдінги та корпоративні подорожі Україною та Європою.

- Допомога в релокації, оплата коворкінгів або допомога у придбанні зарядних станцій для комфортної роботи під час відключення електропостачання (після 3х місяців співпраці).

- Різноманітні можливості для навчання: доповіді спікерів у різних напрямах, велика корпоративна бібліотека, компенсація зовнішніх курсів і, звичайно, уроки англійської мови + speaking clubs (після випробувального терміну).

- Але найголовніше: Honeytech — це команда професіоналів, де кожний відчуває підтримку та досягає своїх цілей!

Якщо ти побачив у рядках вище себе — надсилай нам своє резюме поспілкуємось та познайомимо з продуктом!

General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
  • Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

Job Description:

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Sales Operations - Data Analysis - Revenue Assurance is responsible for strengthening the accuracy, visibility, and operational effectiveness of Sparklight Business's revenue-generating activities.


This position leads sales performance analysis, data governance, and revenue assurance efforts to help leadership identify opportunities, address performance gaps, and make informed business decisions.


Working across Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Service Delivery, the Senior Manager will help connect sales activity to measurable revenue outcomes while supporting the continued evolution of an integrated Revenue Operations model.


Key Responsibilities


Sales Performance Analysis & Business Intelligence

  • Develop and maintain actionable sales performance dashboards, scorecards, and executive reporting.
  • Analyze pipeline performance, conversion rates, average revenue per unit (ARPU), sales productivity, and revenue trends.
  • Identify performance gaps across sales channels, markets, territories, and teams.
  • Support revenue forecasting, sales pacing, and business planning through reliable data and analysis.
  • Translate complex data into clear recommendations that improve business performance.

Revenue Assurance & Data Integrity

  • Establish processes to identify revenue leakage throughout the sales-to-activation lifecycle.
  • Monitor order accuracy, revenue attribution, and discrepancies between booked, installed, and billed revenue.
  • Partner with Finance and Service Delivery to investigate revenue exceptions and support corrective action.
  • Improve CRM data quality, reporting consistency, and operational accountability.
  • Develop measurable controls that strengthen revenue capture and reduce preventable losses.

Sales Operations & Process Improvement

  • Evaluate sales workflows and recommend improvements that increase efficiency and execution consistency.
  • Support the standardization of sales processes, performance metrics, and reporting practices.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and technology-enabled productivity improvements.
  • Partner with sales leadership to evaluate territory performance, resource allocation, and operational effectiveness.
  • Support the integration of acquired businesses, systems, and reporting processes.

Strategic Planning & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Provide analytical support for annual operating plans, budgets, and strategic growth initiatives.
  • Develop business cases, financial impact assessments, and ROI models for proposed investments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to improve revenue visibility and operational alignment.
  • Establish performance measurement frameworks for strategic sales initiatives.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership with a focus on measurable business outcomes.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Intelligence, Finance, or related analytical functions.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing sales performance and developing executive-level reporting.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with business intelligence tools such as Sigma, Power BI or Tableau.
  • Working knowledge of CRM systems, preferably Salesforce.
  • Strong understanding of sales pipelines, forecasting, revenue metrics, and operational performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across departments and influence business decisions through data.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and project management skills.

Preferred

  • Experience in telecommunications, cable, broadband, SaaS, or subscription-based services.
  • Familiarity with order management, billing systems, and revenue reconciliation.
  • Experience with SQL, data modeling, or reporting automation.
  • Experience supporting business integrations and organizational transformation.
  • Prior experience leading analysts, projects, or cross-functional operational initiatives.

Measures of Success

Success in this position will be evaluated through:

  • Improved accuracy and reliability of sales performance reporting.
  • Increased visibility into pipeline health, conversion, and revenue performance.
  • Identification and reduction of preventable revenue leakage.
  • Improved alignment between booked, installed, and billed revenue.
  • Increased adoption of standardized performance metrics and reporting.
  • Demonstrable improvements in operational efficiency and decision-making.

Organizational Impact

This position strengthens the analytical and operational capabilities of Sparklight Business by connecting sales execution to revenue performance.

The Senior Manager will help establish the data discipline, revenue controls, and performance intelligence necessary to support a more scalable and integrated Revenue Operations organization.


Core Competencies 

  • Committed: Values each and every customer, while working hard to keep their business and support our communities. 
  • Helpful: Delivers support in the ways that are most useful to our customers and addresses their needs with expertise, respect, and empathy. 
  • Proactive: Understand what our customers need, and actively works to make their relationship with use seamless, easy, and rewarding. 
  • Personal: Knows our customers well, and tailors our communications and interactions to address their needs and expectations. 

Benefits

Cable One and our family of brands appreciates the role our associates play to help the company grow, and in return an excellent benefits package is offered to our associates to recognize the importance of their contributions, such as: 

  • Medical, dental, and vision plans – start when you start! 
  • Life insurance (self, spouse, children)
  • Paid time off (vacation, holiday, and personal/sick days) 
  • 401(k) - 100% company match (match program starts first day of service, up to 5% of eligible compensation)
  • Group Legal plan with Identity Theft Protection

Additional Perks 

  • Tuition reimbursement (up to $5,250 on 1st year) 
  • Annual community support to various organizations across the U.S. 
  • Associate recognition & awards programs
  • Advancement opportunities 
  • Collaborative work environment 

Our Commitment

Diversity lies in the communities we serve and among the associates who dedicate themselves to ensure our continued success. Here at Cable One and our family of brands, we believe it is our individual and unique talents, backgrounds and perspectives that, when combined, truly make us an unstoppable force. "Stronger Together" is not just a verbal cue, it is the motto that our associates live by, exemplify, and embody each and every day.

Cable One and our family of brands is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or disability.

Pre-hire Processes

Cable One and our family of brands is committed to keeping our associates and customers safe. Job offers are contingent upon the results of background, drug screening, and reference check. Only after successfully passing these pre-hire clearances are individuals approved for hire and ready to start their successful and rewarding career. 

Individuals hired into DOT regulated positions must be able to meet and maintain the requirements under the Company’s DOT program, including successfully complete and pass a road test examination, driver’s record safety review, drug testing, DOT physical, and past employer safety performance history. AI Engineer | India

Department: Engineering
Reports To: Product & Engineering Leadership
Location: India - Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience Level: Mid-Level
Compensation: ₹15,00,000 – ₹22,00,000 per year (15–22 LPA), commensurate with experience and technical expertise

Position Overview

The AI Engineer at Volga Partners will design, develop, and deploy advanced, production-ready AI solutions, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation technologies.

This role requires a strong combination of AI research, hands-on model training and optimization, and software engineering expertise, with the ability to translate innovative AI concepts into scalable, reliable, and practical business applications.

Working closely with software engineers, product teams, and leadership, the AI Engineer will lead the development and integration of high-performance AI solutions that solve complex business challenges, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver measurable value to our global clients.

Key Responsibilities

AI System Development

  • Design, develop, and deploy AI systems, including LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, and ML/DL solutions.
  • Select appropriate models and architectures while balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and complexity.
  • Train and fine-tune models using PyTorch or Keras, including data preparation and evaluation.
  • Implement and benchmark research methods before adoption.
  • Build APIs, inference pipelines, and backend integrations.

Production & Optimization

  • Own evaluation of metrics and track quality, latency, and cost.
  • Monitor, debug, and optimize AI systems post-launch.
  • Ensure production readiness and identify regressions before they impact users.

Collaboration

  • Partner with software engineers and product teams to integrate AI into applications.
  • Contribute to technical discussions and technical decision-making.
  • Document architecture, implementation approaches, and key technical decisions.

Research & Experimentation

  • Read and evaluate ML research papers.
  • Implement promising methods and reproducing results where applicable.
  • Adapt emerging techniques into production-ready systems.
  • Contribute to continued innovation across AI and engineering initiatives.

Working Relationships

The AI Engineer will collaborate with:

  • Engineering leadership and product teams.
  • Software engineers and backend developers.
  • Global AI research and development teams.

Success in This Role

Success means you can build with AI and deliver reliable production solutions, not simply experiment with AI models.

You should be able to:

  • Deliver production-ready AI systems with measurable impact.
  • Translate research into practical engineering solutions.
  • Collaborate effectively across distributed teams.
  • Document and share technical knowledge for scalability.
  • Adapt to evolving technical and business priorities.

Work Environment

This is a fully remote position based in India. Candidates should be comfortable working independently and collaborating with globally distributed teams across different time zones.

Required Work Schedule

This AI Engineer role requires working Monday through Friday, 7:30 PM–4:30 AM or 8:30 PM–5:30 AM IST in India, depending on U.S. daylight saving time?

The ability to consistently work the assigned schedule is a required and non-negotiable condition of this role. Candidates must be comfortable working overnight hours and maintaining reliable availability throughout the assigned shift.

Due to project deadlines, production needs, client requirements, or other business priorities, occasional weekend availability or schedule adjustments may be required. Weekend work is not intended to be the standard schedule but flexibility to support business needs when necessary is expected

Our Hiring Process

We value your time and aim to keep our recruitment process transparent, efficient, and engaging.

1. Initial Recruiter Screening

An introductory video call with a member of our Recruiting team to discuss your background, experience, career goals, salary expectations, and any initial questions you may have about the role or Volga Partners.

2. Practical Skills Assessment

Candidates who successfully complete the initial screening will receive a practical assessment to complete asynchronously.

The assessment is designed to evaluate technical knowledge, problem-solving ability, and how you approach a real-world engineering scenario.

3. Assessment Review

Our team will review your submission against the technical requirements of the role.

Candidates who meet the required criteria will advance to the final interview stage.

4. Technical / Coding Interview

Candidates who pass the assessment will meet with our Engineering team to further evaluate their technical skills, experience, and AI Engineering knowledge

5. Final Interview – CTO

A deep-dive conversation with our Chief Technology Officer focused on technical alignment, your assessment approach, architectural thinking, problem-solving, and overall alignment with the role and team.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with at least one system deployed to production.
  • Strong NLP fundamentals, including tokenization, embeddings, classification, NER, and information extraction.
  • Strong engineering skills across coding, Git, testing, API/system design, and debugging.
  • Hands-on model training experience using PyTorch or Keras.
  • Understanding generative model architectures, including Transformers and VAEs.
  • Production experience with LLMs, including RAG, embeddings/vector databases, and prompt/evaluation design.
  • Experience with FastAPI or similar frameworks, Docker, and at least one cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Ability to read ML research papers and translate ideas into working code.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning, including LoRA and RL-based methods.
  • SQL database knowledge.
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and model-serving infrastructure.
  • Open-source contributions or experience reproducing research results.

Benefits

Compensation & Benefits

  • Annual Compensation: ₹15,00,000-₹22,00,000 (15-22 LPA), based on experience and technical expertise.
  • Contract and payment administration facilitated through Deel.
  • 90-day probationary period.
  • Benefits eligibility upon successful completion of probation, including:
    • Paid Time Off (PTO) in accordance with company policy.
    • Holiday pay for company-observed holidays.
    • Career growth and professional development opportunities.

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.


We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. Responsibilities include designing and implementing complex technology solutions, managing system integrations, leading change management initiatives, and providing expert guidance on safety database platforms and emerging pharmacovigilance technologies.

  • Train, coach, and provide work directions to team members in system administration, database support, and strategic implementation activities
  • Collaborate with Global Pharmacovigilance Intelligence Office to ensure safety systems maintain regulatory compliance and proactively meet evolving requirements

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Advanced technical expertise in pharmacovigilance safety technology systems, including complex configurations, system administration, and application support
  • Exceptional interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a client-focused approach
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to mentor team members and represent the organization in cross-functional environments

  • Knowledge of emerging pharmacovigilance technologies, including AI, with a flexible attitude toward continuous learning and new challenges

  • Strong technical writing capability and proven ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BSc in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field; master's degree preferred
  • 1+ years of direct mentorship, training, or peer oversight experience
  • Demonstrated lead participation in system/process improvement initiatives and 1+ years of system validation design and execution

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

Why choose iVigee?

iVigee is a physician-lead pharmacovigilance exclusive company, combining deep regulatory expertise with AI-enabled tools (such as iViReg, iViTracker, iViSight) to support clients' drug safety life cycles.

Founded in 2021, all our leaders have years of experience in all areas of pharmacovigilance - science, regulations, and technology. Our acquisition strategy allows us to attract and choose both the best global talent, and companies.

Our world leading Pharmacovigilance Intelligence platform iViReg is the first to truly focus on the needs of PV professionals, and as we open that system up with our AI interface, we continue to embrace the current and future needs of the pharmacovigilance community and demonstrate our commitment to it.

Our advanced expertise in pharmacovigilance and technology keeps us two steps ahead, delivering sustainable, progressive, and seamless solutions. With strategic centres of excellence in Europe and the US, and our network of experts in over 150 countries, we service the complex global needs of our clients with speed and ease.

We hire for values as much as we hire for expertise. Our culture is built on a shared belief in doing PV the right way, with honesty, ambition, and a genuine care for the work. If these values resonate with you, you'll fit right in.

Fearless

We are not afraid of big tasks and challenges. Not timid to speak up, not timid to ask. Always seek and speak the truth.

Trustworthy professionals

Our competence gives us confidence that we will deliver on our promises. We do it with integrity and quality that earns trust. We do it with a smile, as we love our work that makes our clients happy, saves life and prevents harm.

Enabling innovation

Best practices and tools are giving us our competitive advantage. We are early adopters. We iterate frequently to be better than yesterday, every day.

Sustainable manner

We are interested in long-term relationships, lasting solutions, and good work-life balance. We improve our environment, support communities, raise talent, and build our company to last.

As a company applying the Topgrading methodology, we conduct a thorough recruitment process covering your career history, achievements, challenges, important decisions and key professional relationships. At the final stage, shortlisted candidates will be asked to arrange reference calls with selected former supervisors.

Purpose of the job position:

The Head of QPPV Network and PV Governance is responsible for leading, overseeing, and optimizing the provision of regional Qualified Persons for Pharmacovigilance (QPPVs) and local PV roles (e.g. PV Person at National Level, Person Responsible for Local Literature Screening, or similar), as well as the oversight activities associated with these functions.
This includes ensuring the effective operation of the PV system and its associated Quality Management System (QMS), maintaining the Pharmacovigilance System Master File (PSMF), monitoring the portfolio safety profile, supporting the implementation of risk minimization measures, managing communication with PV stakeholders and Health Authorities, and overseeing overall regulatory compliance. This leadership role ensures harmonized service delivery across the above functions, sustained inspection readiness, and the robust operation of iVigee's pharmacovigilance system. The role is performed remotely from anywhere in Europe.

MAJOR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Leadership of QPPV Office

  • Provide direct line management to the QPPV Network and PV Governance staff, fostering growth, regulatory compliance, and scientific rigor.

Functional Strategy, Organisation and Commercial Acumen

  • Own and set the strategy for the QPPV Network and PV Governance function, aligned with company objectives, and contribute the function's perspective to company-level decisions.
  • Carry accountability for the function's outcomes and cross-company alignment, including resource planning for the function's growth.
  • Apply commercial acumen in vendor relationships — negotiate pricing with Local PV expert vendors — and contribute PV expertise to iVigee business proposals and the resulting contracts.
  • Build the function's organisational structure and succession, and develop the managers and senior staff within it.

Quality and Compliance Oversight

  • Own and continually optimize the PV Quality Management System, including:
    • SOPs, Work Instructions, templates, and controlled documents
    • Audit and inspection readiness activities
    • Internal audit planning and execution
    • CAPA management and documentation
  • Promote compliance awareness and a quality-first mindset across all PV teams.

QPPV Network and PV Governance Operations

  • Ensure that all regulatory responsibilities associated with the provision of regional (i.e. EU, EAEU) QPPV or local PV roles — whether fulfilled by iVigee staff or by third parties - are met in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and industry standards, including:

oMaintaining a compliant PV system, including PSMF management, KPI monitoring, and timely remediation of any identified non-compliance

oOverseeing product safety profiles and emerging safety concerns, including support in risk minimization measures implementation

oTracking safety commitments and regulatory obligations to ensure ongoing awareness and fulfilment

oEnsuring that all PV information submissions are prepared and filed in accordance with applicable regulations

oServing as the 24/7 PV contact point for Competent Authorities

oRepresenting Clients during PV audits and inspections

Vendor Management

  • Manage the network of Local PV expert vendors — sourcing, searching, qualifying and contracting vendors to meet client and regulatory needs.
  • Provide ongoing oversight of vendor performance and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and contractual obligations.

Contribution to Business Development

  • Support iVigee business proposals and bids with QPPV network and PV governance expertise, including scoping and effort estimation for the offered services.
  • Provide time and effort estimates for QPPV and local PV role services offered in proposals, and vendor cost estimates for the covered territories; service pricing remains with Business Development.
  • Participate in client meetings and bid defenses as the subject matter expert for QPPV network and PV governance services.

Training and Regulatory Awareness

  • Lead internal training strategy and delivery across PV compliance topics.
  • Monitor changes in PV regulatory requirements and cascade updates to relevant stakeholders.
  • Promote continuous learning and mentoring to the staff under the line management and to audit contributors.

Collaboration and Representation

  • Collaborate with heads of other PV units and other departments to ensure seamless integration and service delivery.
  • Act as the subject matter expert in regulatory authority interactions and client audits.
  • Represent iVigee at conferences, forums, and external initiatives related to QPPV or local PV practice and PV compliance.

Education

M.D., Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or equivalent advanced degree

Experience

Minimum 5 years in pharmacovigilance, with at least 3 years in similar senior compliance function

Special skills

In-depth knowledge of EU and global/local pharmacovigilance legislation, including GVP Modules I–XV, Proven ability to lead teams and complex quality/compliance systems

Active, hands-on use of AI tools in daily work — able to demonstrate concrete examples, including how outputs are verified.

jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Due to continued growth, Parexel is looking for a Clinical Feasibility Leader (CFL) to be home based from select EMEA locations.


The Clinical Feasibility Leader (CFL) acts as the functional lead assigned as part of the core project team responsible to drive site identification activities immediately after award on all types and phases of studies. Working independently with limited supervision from management, the CFL is responsible to deliver an optimized operational strategy, based on selection of countries and clinical sites best positioned to successfully execute the trial. The CFL must demonstrate strong communication and leadership skills resulting in the completion of all deliverables within required timelines meeting departmental quality standards. Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills are a pre-requisite to the job to allow CFL to fully adopt a consistent data-driven approach site identification.


Key Accountabilities:


Site Identification

  • Develop and implement protocol-specific site identification strategy to produce initial lists of sites as per departmental quality standards.
  • Using the standard template, design a protocol-specific site questionnaire based on the available study information, the Sponsor questionnaire (if any), and agreed site selection criteria that will enable an in-depth analysis of the responses and will highlight the protocol challenges as viewed by the investigators as well as enable the selection of most appropriate sites.
  • Lead the team of locally assigned individuals to successfully deliver prequalified sites including but not limited to provide initial training on the study protocol and specifics during survey kick-off meeting, officially launch the survey via the standard initiation email, and resolve resourcing/performance issues via standard escalation paths. Stand as accountable for survey completion within the agreed timelines.
  • Deliver revised enrolment scenario and final list of pre-qualified sites following quality review of investigator responses, identification and clarification of inconsistencies, recommendations against agreed site selection criteria, and analysis of recruitment capabilities.
  • Develop comprehensive slide deck and/or integrated report to present the outcome of the site selection process including methodology, high level results, and recommendations inclusive of adjustments to scenario models as needed.

Country Selection

  • Revise pre-award protocol feasibility assessment taking into account new data received/collected after award via standard sources of information.
  • Adjust pre-award country selection analysis via available country selection tool/platform based on new data received/collected after award using standard sources of information and deliver protocol-specific country recommendations including solid data-driven rationale.
  • Independently manage country clinical operations survey including collection and review of country data, follow-up discussions with local clinical operations representative, and compilation of collected information into country selection analysis, scenario modeling, and site identification strategy.
  • Contribute to the development of an integrated optimized operational strategy to successfully recruit patients for clinical trials and deliver enrolment scenarios aligned to the agreed strategy utilizing available modeling tools and techniques.
  • Develop comprehensive slide deck and/or integrated report to present the outcome of the country selection analysis including methodology, high level results, and recommendations.
  • Articulate and defend the proposed country and site selection strategy and enrolment scenario models in PAREXEL internal meetings and Sponsor meetings.

Miscellaneous

  • Under management supervision, act as Project Leader on stand-alone feasibility studies, which includes the following additional responsibilities: Sponsor liaison, project assessment and initiation, resource procurement and planning, project implementation, milestone planning and tracking, ensuring that projects are progressing according to contract and quality standards, production of key project progress reports, management of communication between PAREXEL project team, Sponsor, contract and financial management.
  • Attend Bid Defense Meetings and/or Sponsor Kick-Off Meetings for projects as named CFL and present post-award feasibility/prequalification services, processes, and timelines.
  • Serves as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for an identified feasibility system, tool, or process.

Knowledge and Experience:

  • Relevant clinical research experience in management of international clinical trials; feasibility and recruitment
  • Demonstrated clear understanding of country and site feasibility requirements.
  • Previous exposure to development of clinical trial strategy, modeling of enrollment scenarios, and selection of country/sites

Skills:

  • Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills applied to business needs
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication
  • Demonstrated leadership and ability to influence others
  • Problem-solving skills allowing Client focused approach to work
  • A flexible attitude with respect to work assignments and new learning
  • Ability to prioritize workload with attention to details
  • Willingness to work in a matrix environment and to value the importance of teamwork
  • Ability to work independently and in a decentralized reporting model (as applicable)  Fluent in written and spoken English

Education:

  • Preferred degrees may include but are not limited to: Bachelor of Science, Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Masters, MD, PhD and/or comparable life skill experience.
