jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tasks and responsibilitiesIn a public-sector digital-services environment, you will develop secure, accessible and responsive business applications that support citizens, healthcare professionals and internal users in Belgium.
jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

In a public-sector digital-services environment, you will develop secure, accessible and responsive business applications that support citizens, healthcare professionals and internal users in Belgium. You will work across the application stack, from the Blazor user interface to the .NET services behind it, while contributing to technical decisions and supporting colleagues.

You will join an ICT department of approximately 250 professionals working on more than 50 projects in different development phases. The organisation is modernising its application landscape towards a cloud-native architecture on Microsoft Azure, using Azure Service Bus and containerised workloads. A platform engineering team provides shared libraries, the design system, DevOps pipelines and standards for the application teams.

Web user interfaces are standardised on Blazor, allowing one .NET skill set to cover the complete application. The UI is the part of the application used by citizens, healthcare professionals and employees, so it must be accessible, consistent and responsive. The organisation is also exploring the responsible use of AI in business applications and software development.

Job purpose

As Senior .NET Developer with a UI focus, you will design, develop, integrate and maintain modern business applications. You will take ownership of their user interfaces while contributing to the underlying services. The role combines advanced hands-on development with technical leadership, coaching and close collaboration with analysts, architects, UX stakeholders, security specialists, the platform engineering team and operations.

You will translate functional and technical requirements into reusable, accessible solutions. Your work will support a consistent user experience across devices and browsers, correct integration with services and APIs, reuse of the shared component library and design system, and compliance with standards for architecture, security, quality, maintainability and delivery.

As a senior developer, you will help resolve complex technical issues, make well-founded design choices, improve engineering practices and support colleagues through coaching and code reviews. The role remains strongly hands-on, with direct contributions to feature development, testing, troubleshooting and continuous improvement across both the UI and its supporting services.

Key responsibilities

  • Provide technical direction for Blazor development across teams and promote consistent UI architecture, reusable components, coding standards and engineering practices in line with the platform team's standards.
  • Develop features, reusable components, prototypes, technical improvements and bug fixes using C#, modern .NET, Blazor, Razor components and the .NET Web APIs on which they depend.
  • Design scalable, maintainable and reusable front-end structures that align with the organisation's architectural principles, and contribute to the shared component library built on MudBlazor and the shared design system.
  • Build responsive interfaces with semantic HTML and modern CSS that meet WCAG 2.1 level AA, as required of Belgian public bodies under the European Web Accessibility Directive. Consider usability, browser compatibility and the public-service context throughout the development process.
  • Work with functional and business analysts and UX stakeholders to clarify requirements, assess feasibility and translate user and business needs into sound technical solutions.
  • Integrate Blazor applications with REST APIs and JSON-based services, including typed clients, suitable error handling, state management, validation and resilience. Extend the Web APIs when a feature requires it.
  • Implement secure authentication and authorisation flows using OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect for internal users, healthcare professionals and citizens, each with its own identity provider. Apply secure development practices throughout the application lifecycle.
  • Maintain code quality through structured pull-request reviews, refactoring, SonarQube static analysis, coding standards and clear, reusable and testable components.
  • Define and maintain unit tests, Blazor component tests with bUnit, service-level integration tests and, where appropriate, automated UI tests with Playwright. Follow the test pyramid to support reliable releases and prevent regressions.
  • Use Git, Azure DevOps repositories, boards and CI/CD pipelines for controlled versioning, automated builds, testing and deployment to Azure environments.
  • Select the appropriate Blazor render mode for each application, monitor and improve loading time, rendering behaviour and responsiveness, and use Dynatrace and browser tools to diagnose issues in test and production.
  • Coach developers, share Blazor and accessibility expertise, document solutions and contribute to continuous technical improvement.
  • Lead the analysis and resolution of complex end-to-end issues from the browser through the API to the database across development, test and production environments.
  • Evaluate relevant .NET and web technologies and patterns, including AI-assisted development practices, and recommend adoption when they provide sustainable value and align with architectural and security decisions.

Key technical expertise

You should have recent, substantial hands-on experience in the following areas:

  • C# and modern .NET: Advanced proficiency in C# and current .NET, including .NET 10 or later, asynchronous programming, dependency injection, clean code and maintainable application design.
  • Blazor and Razor components: Recent experience developing production-grade Blazor applications, including the Blazor Web App model and its render modes: static server-side rendering, interactive Server, WebAssembly and Auto. You understand prerendering, streaming rendering, component lifecycle, state handling, forms, validation and reusable component libraries such as MudBlazor.
  • HTML, CSS and responsive design: Strong command of semantic HTML, modern CSS and responsive design for consistent use across devices and screen sizes.
  • Accessibility: Practical experience delivering interfaces that meet WCAG 2.1 level AA, including keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, contrast, focus management and accessible forms. You are comfortable testing with assistive technologies.
  • REST API integration and JSON exchanges: Experience consuming and building REST APIs with ASP.NET Core, handling JSON exchanges and implementing robust validation, error handling and integration patterns.
  • OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect: Practical experience implementing secure authentication and authorisation in web applications with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and claims-based authorisation.
  • Data access: Working proficiency with Entity Framework Core and SQL, sufficient to implement features end to end and diagnose data-related issues.
  • Testing: Strong experience with unit testing, Blazor component testing with bUnit and service-level integration testing. Automated UI testing with Playwright is an advantage. You can design testable code and integrate automated tests into delivery pipelines.
  • Git, Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines: Advanced use of Git, branching and pull-request workflows, Azure DevOps repositories and boards, and CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test and deployment.
  • Engineering quality and security: A demonstrated focus on code quality, code reviews, application security, maintainability, observability and reusable components.
  • AI-assisted development: Experience using GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or a similar coding assistant in a professional setting, with sound judgement about when to use these tools and how to review their output.
  • JavaScript and TypeScript interoperability: Knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript and JavaScript-Blazor interoperability is an asset, particularly when integrating browser APIs or specialised front-end libraries.
  • Front-end architecture and design patterns: Ability to select and apply suitable patterns for component design, separation of concerns, state management, dependency management and scalable application structures.
  • Performance and browser diagnostics: Experience analysing rendering, network calls, memory usage and client-side performance with browser development tools, together with an understanding of the scalability characteristics of each Blazor render mode.
  • Cloud and containerised environments: Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and an understanding of containerised deployment for application delivery and troubleshooting.
  • Distributed systems: Sufficient understanding of messaging, including Azure Service Bus and NServiceBus, and distributed systems to collaborate effectively with integration-focused colleagues and diagnose end-to-end issues.
  • Additional ecosystem assets: Knowledge of SharePoint as a document management system or of legal document stores with WORM requirements is an asset where relevant to the assigned application domain.

Key soft skills

  • Technical leadership and mentorship: Guide developers, provide constructive feedback, share knowledge and support professional growth while remaining hands-on.
  • Collaboration: Work effectively with analysts, architects, UX stakeholders, security specialists, testers, platform engineering, operations and business representatives in a multidisciplinary public-service environment.
  • Problem-solving and decision-making: Identify root causes, compare options, explain trade-offs and make pragmatic, sustainable technical decisions.
  • User focus: Understand the needs of citizens, healthcare professionals and internal users, including users of assistive technologies, and translate them into clear, accessible and efficient digital experiences.
  • Communication: Explain complex technical matters clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders and produce concise, useful technical documentation.
  • Resilience and adaptability: Manage changing technologies, priorities and requirements while maintaining quality, security and delivery commitments.
  • Continuous improvement: Follow relevant developments in .NET, Blazor, web standards, accessibility, security and software engineering, and apply them with sound judgement.

Language proficiency: Mastery of French or Dutch and professional proficiency in English are required. Passive understanding of the second national language is an asset.

Expected seniority

You should be able to work autonomously on complex application challenges, take ownership from requirements through production support, influence technical choices and raise the quality and consistency of the wider development team, particularly on the user-interface side. Seniority must be demonstrated through recent hands-on delivery, not only through coordination or advisory experience.

Required technical skills

  • C# (8 years)
  • Modern .NET / ASP.NET Core (6 years)
  • Blazor and Razor components, including Blazor Web App render modes (3 years)
  • HTML, CSS and responsive design (6 years)
  • Web accessibility, WCAG 2.1 AA (3 years)
  • REST APIs and JSON exchanges (6 years)
  • OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, JWT, claims-based authorisation (5 years)
  • Entity Framework Core and SQL (5 years)
  • Testing: unit, component, integration and UI automation (6 years)
  • Git, Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (6 years)
  • Agile / Scrum (8 years)
  • AI-assisted development with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or a similar tool (1 year)

Assets

  • Microsoft Azure (3 years)
  • .NET Framework maintenance (2 years)
  • Azure Service Bus / NServiceBus (2 years)
  • JavaScript / TypeScript and JS interop (2 years)

📝 Your profile

Demonstrated experience as a front-end developer with a strong .NET and Blazor background.

Skills

  • Agile / Scrum
  • AI-assisted development (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or similar)
  • Blazor and Razor components, including Blazor Web App render modes
  • C#
  • Entity Framework Core and SQL
  • Git, Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines
  • HTML, CSS and responsive design
  • Modern .NET / ASP.NET Core
  • OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, JWT, claims-based authorisation
  • REST APIs and JSON exchanges
  • Testing: unit, component, integration and UI automation
  • Web accessibility, WCAG 2.1 AA

Languages

  • Dutch
  • English
  • French

💼 Offer

You will be part of a growing Belgian SME where initiative and personal development are encouraged. We will provide you with an enjoyable work environment with fun colleagues. We will work out a career plan with you, with attention and a budget for extra education/certification. You can count on an attractive salary, supplemented with extra-legal benefits, including a company car.

Thriveworks is one of the leading mental healthcare companies in the U.S., with over 2,800 employees. Founded and led by clinicians, our mission is to help people live happy, healthy lives. Vision:

To make valuable tax and accounting education and services available to everyone.

At Instinct Science, we believe in leading with compassion. Our team, our customers, and their patients and clients are the foundation of everything we do. Our culture is guided by our U.C.A.R.E. values: We move fast because our mission matters, we put customers at the center of every decision, and we treat each other with kindness and high standards.

A Sneak Peek of Your Role 🔭

This is a fully remote role.

The Customer Onboarding Manager is the primary point of contact and strategic driver for every hospital going live on Instinct. You are the project lead, the workflow expert, and the trusted advisor all in one — responsible for keeping implementations on track, on time, and on scope while earning the confidence of hospital leadership throughout the process.

This is not a task-management role. You bring executive presence, a strong sense of urgency, and the consultative skill to navigate a hospital's operational complexity while holding them accountable to the milestones that matter. You know that a delayed go-live is a delayed relationship, and you take that seriously.

You own end-to-end project coordination — from kick-off to go-live — working closely with Implementation Specialists, Training Specialists, integrations, and internal teams to deliver a seamless, high-quality experience. Your strength is your ability to make every hospital feel like their implementation is the most important project you are running — even when you are managing several simultaneously

What You'll Do 🛠️

Project Leadership & Management

  • Project Ownership: Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned onboarding projects from signed contract through go-live and handoff to the active CS team.
  • Timeline Management: Build, manage, and enforce project plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and accountability — targeting go-live within the 8-week SLA.
  • Risk & Escalation: Identify project risks proactively and escalate effectively — to the hospital, to the Team Lead, and across internal teams — so nothing sits quietly off track.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate across Implementation Specialists, Training Specialists, Integration partners, and Medical Review to keep all workstreams moving in sync.

Customer Relationship & Consultative Approach

  • Trusted Advisor: Position yourself as a knowledgeable, credible partner throughout the project — not just a task tracker. Help hospital leaders see the full picture of what a successful go-live enables for their team.
  • Executive Presence: Communicate confidently and credibly with practice owners, medical directors, and hospital administrators — matching your communication style to the audience while maintaining clarity and urgency.
  • Workflow Development: Lead workflow discovery and design sessions with the hospital, translating their current clinical and operational processes into Instinct-configured workflows that fit how their team actually works.
  • Sense of Urgency: Keep the hospital engaged and moving — because a delayed implementation is always a risk to go-live. You are skilled at creating accountability without creating friction.

Technical & Product Coordination

Job Description

A licensed dental hygienist will play a vital role within Devoted Health's Clinical Operations team by performing first-level clinical reviews of dental claims and pre-treatment estimates using established clinical guidelines, policies, and delegated authority. Schedule: The position follows a five-day, eight-hour work schedule, totaling 40 hours per week. Shifts are scheduled within the hours of 8:00 AM–8:00 PM ET and will include weekend and Holiday rotation coverage.


Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • First-Level Clinical Evaluation: Review assigned dental claims and pre-treatment estimates requiring clinical evaluation, approving claims that meet clinical, contractual, and documentation requirements.
  • Documentation & Image Review: Evaluate radiographs, dental charting, narratives, treatment records, and claim histories using evidence-based guidelines and clinical expertise.
  • Case Referral & Coordination: Refer complex cases, potential denials, or adverse benefit determinations to Dental Advisors or designated clinical authorities for final determination (the Dental Hygienist Clinical Reviewer does not deny authorizations).
  • Documentation & System Entry: Identify required documentation for clinical review, clear processing instructions, and document review findings accurately in claims systems.
  • Coding & Policy Application: Consistently apply ADA CDT coding knowledge, dental terminology, clinical documentation standards, and contractual provisions.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Dental Advisors, Claims, Provider Relations, and team leads to support smooth operations and constructive provider communications.
  • Compliance: Maintain full compliance with HIPAA, privacy standards, organizational policies, and regulatory requirements.

Required skills and experience:

  • 5+ years of clinical experience as a dental hygienist in a private practice or comparable dental healthcare setting. Dental claims review or utilization management experience is a plus.
  • Active Registered Dental Hygienist (RDH) license or relevant clinical dental credential in good standing.
  • Strong working knowledge of ADA CDT coding, dental terminology, dental procedures, and clinical documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to read and interpret dental radiographs, charting, clinical narratives, and treatment records.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with claims-processing systems, electronic health/dental records, and standard digital tools.
  • Experience with technology-enabled workflow improvements, particularly with AI/LLM tools.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Prior experience in dental insurance claims review, utilization management, or health plan clinical operations, ideally within a Medicare Advantage or managed care setting.

jobs.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our team full-time in India.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Responsibilities:

  • Take an initiative from an open problem to production: write the design, divide the work so several engineers can contribute, ship it, and support it after release
  • Partner with Product and Design on scope and timing. Say when a feature costs too much, and propose a cheaper path that still meets the outcome
  • Think through risks before the build starts. Escalate early when you find a surprise or the scope changes
  • Replace legacy Oracle ADF/JSF screens with React and TypeScript screens built on Holocron, Tangos shared design system
  • Design and build the Java APIs (Spring Boot) those screens need, so the same APIs can also serve integrations and AI agents later
  • Make pragmatic calls on where to rewrite and where to wrap. Accept a less-than-perfect solution when there is a good reason
  • Drive improvements to code health, test coverage, and long-term maintainability in the team's codebases
  • Take part in on-call and incident response. Lead or contribute to postmortems, and turn the learnings into better patterns
  • Fix security findings in the code you own. Ship through the paved-road CI/CD pipeline
  • Mentor and ramp up newer engineers through pairing, design reviews, and code reviews
  • Weigh in on technical decisions that affect the team. Take a position, and stay open to better ideas
  • Help the team improve how it works through retros
  • Build prompts, AI workflows, or lightweight agents that speed up the team's work, and teach others to use them well
  • Check AI-generated code with the same rigor as human code. Guard against over-reliance on it

Requirements:

  • You have owned the design, build, and rollout of a large feature or initiative in a production B2B application, including the coordination, documentation, and support that came with it (Typically 6+ years of professional software engineering)
  • You are fluent in Java on the server side, including Java EE and/or Spring Boot, and comfortable with relational databases. Oracle SQL and PL/SQL experience is a clear plus
  • You have shipped production React (ideally with TypeScript) and can build a screen against an API you designed
  • You have modernized or refactored a legacy system without stopping delivery, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made
  • You have mentored other engineers and made them measurably better
  • You use AI coding and research tools every day, you know their failure modes, and you can integrate an LLM API into a product when the problem fits

Desirable:

  • Experience with Oracle ADF or JSF
  • Experience with a shared component library or design system
  • AWS experience, especially infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines
  • Domain experience in real estate, facilities, maintenance, or workplace software (IWMS, CAFM, CMMS)

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

Career-defining. Life-changing.

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. About This Role:

iRhythm is seeking an experienced Director, HR Business Partners – Commercial & Product to provide strategic Human Resources leadership to our Commercial & Product Management organization, including Sales, Marketing, and Product teams.

As a key partner to Commercial & Product executives and their leadership teams, you will help shape and execute people strategies that support business growth, organizational performance, and an engaging employee experience. You will lead a team of business-facing HR partners and operate as a player-coach, providing direct strategic partnership to senior leaders while developing a high-performing HR Business Partner team.

The successful candidate will combine strong business acumen, executive-level influence, and broad HR expertise with the ability to translate business priorities into practical workforce, talent, leadership, and organizational strategies.


Responsibilities

Leadership Partnership

Serve as a trusted advisor and strategic thought partner to executives and leadership teams.

  • Develop a deep understanding of the Commercial & Product strategy, operating model, workforce, and market environment.
  • Translate business priorities into integrated people and organizational strategies.
  • Advise and coach executives on organizational effectiveness, leadership, talent, workforce planning, culture, and change.
  • Use workforce data, employee insights, and business metrics to identify risks, trends, and opportunities.
  • Build strong partnerships across Sales, Marketing, Service, Finance, Legal, and the broader Human Resources organization.

HR Business Partner Team Leadership

Lead, develop, and enable a high-performing team of HR Business Partners supporting the Commercial organization.

  • Establish clear priorities, expectations, operating rhythms, and measures of success for the HR Business Partner team.
  • Function as a player-coach by providing direct strategic support to senior Commercial leaders while guiding the team’s day-to-day partnership with the business.
  • Coach HR Business Partners on consulting, executive influence, organizational diagnosis, talent strategy, employee relations, and change leadership.
  • Allocate HRBP resources based on business priorities, organizational needs, and the complexity of supported client groups.
  • Promote consistency, sound judgment, collaboration, and strong execution across the HRBP team.
  • Foster the professional development and career growth of team members.
  • Partner with HR Centers of Excellence and HR Operations to provide a coordinated and effective experience for leaders and employees.

Strategic Workforce Planning

Create and execute talent and workforce roadmaps that enable the organization to achieve its short- and long-term objectives.

  • Partner with leaders to identify the organizational and people capabilities required to deliver the Commercial & Product strategy.
  • Develop workforce scenarios based on business plans, growth expectations, productivity objectives, and changing capability requirements.
  • Advise and support business leaders with talent planning, org design, and integration activities during Mergers & Acquisitions.
  • Assess workforce and talent gaps and partner with Talent Acquisition to build proactive talent pipelines.
  • Partner with our AI Transformation and Org Design leader to advise on organizational structure, role clarity, spans and layers, team design, and workforce deployment.
  • Participate in hiring-readiness activities for critical roles, including organizational design and role-profile development, in partnership with Talent Acquisition and Total Rewards.
  • Partner with leaders and Finance on headcount planning, workforce investments, and resource prioritization.
  • Provide insights into people and workforce trends and help develop proactive strategies, programs, and policies.

Leadership and Talent Development

Partner with leaders and Learning & Development to strengthen leadership capability, build a sustainable talent pipeline, and improve organizational performance.

  • Influence and support the business in establishing proactive leadership and management development plans.
  • Lead talent reviews and succession-planning processes, identifying critical roles, high-potential talent, succession risks, and development priorities.
  • Partner with leaders to build meaningful development plans for key talent.
  • Recommend targeted development, coaching, assessment, and team-effectiveness solutions.
  • Coach leaders in delivering feedback, managing performance, building inclusive teams, and strengthening leadership effectiveness.
  • Support internal mobility and career development across the Commercial organization.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen manager capability and accountability throughout the organization.

Organizational Effectiveness and Culture

Help the Commercial organization achieve strong and sustainable performance while reinforcing iRhythm’s culture and values.

  • Diagnose organizational challenges and recommend solutions that improve effectiveness, accountability, collaboration, and execution.
  • Use tools such as employee surveys, workforce metrics, and organizational assessments to measure effectiveness and identify priorities.
  • Partner with leaders to create an environment that encourages employee engagement and inspires performance excellence.
  • Ensure organizational and talent decisions align with company culture and business strategy.
  • Guide leaders and teams through organizational change, growth, restructuring, and evolving business priorities.

Performance, Rewards, and Employee Relations

Ensure that performance, feedback, talent, and rewards practices are consistently connected and effectively executed.

  • Partner with the Employee Relations Center of Excellence to proactively identify employee relations trends and consult on complex and executive level situations.
  • Recommend tools, programs, and approaches to attract, retain, recognize, and engage talent and improve performance.
  • Partner with Commercial leaders, Learning & Development, and Total Rewards to execute annual compensation, performance, and talent processes.
  • Provide HR guidance related to sales compensation and commission-based incentive programs.
  • Promote consistent application of company policies and people practices.

Change Leadership

Enable the Commercial organization and HRBP team to successfully navigate growth, transformation, and organizational change.

  • Develop people and change strategies that support business transformation and evolving Commercial priorities.
  • Assess stakeholder needs, organizational readiness, talent implications, and workforce risks.
  • Coach leaders on change sponsorship, communication, employee engagement, and organizational adoption.
  • Partner across HR to ensure that change initiatives are coordinated and supported by appropriate talent, communication, and organizational interventions.
  • Monitor organizational sentiment and workforce indicators and recommend adjustments when needed.

About You

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent professional qualification required; MBA, master’s degree, or other advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 15 years of progressive Human Resources experience, including significant strategic HR Business Partner experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and developing HR Business Partners or similar business-facing HR professionals.
  • Extensive HR generalist experience and strong working knowledge of HR practices across talent management, organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, employee relations, performance, rewards, and change management.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, influence, and support executive-level leaders.
  • Experience developing and implementing people strategies for a Commercial organization, including Sales, Marketing, and Product teams.
  • Experience supporting sales organizations with commission-based or similar incentive compensation plans.
  • Experience leading talent reviews, succession planning, organizational design, leadership development, and workforce-planning processes.
  • Strong understanding of the people and organizational requirements of a fast-growing business with a global footprint.
  • Experience operating in a matrixed environment and partnering effectively with HR Centers of Excellence, HR Operations, Finance, Legal, and business leaders.
  • Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to connect people strategies to Commercial priorities and operating results.
  • Excellent relationship-building, interpersonal, influencing, consulting, and negotiation skills.
  • Curious and pragmatic problem-solver who approaches challenges with empathy, sound judgment, and structured strategic thinking.

Greenpark is a global, award-winning digital agency specialising in omnichannel search and social. Our raison d’etre is to create amazing content that people and algorithms love. How? Through data-led and performance-driven search and social content to help brands create meaningful connections that impact people's lives. Want the real inside scoop? Our Playbook gives you a peek into how we work, collaborate, and get things done at Greenpark. Check it out here

Our Values

As a company, we strive and act together in our ambition to make a positive impact for the people and brands we serve, we do everything with kindness and respect at the core. ‘We Strive’, ‘Acting Together’, ‘With Kindness’ are the values that guide us.

About the role

The Senior Project Manager strengthens the core of Greenpark’s EMEA Delivery team. You will independently lead several complex digital projects and workstreams from brief to completion, coordinating specialist teams and managing competing priorities. You will own project plans, resources, budgets, risks and documentation, keeping clients and colleagues informed and resolving problems proactively. You will use approved AI tools where they improve delivery, applying sound judgement and appropriate human review Working within Greenpark’s delivery standards, you will also coach less experienced PMs and contribute practical improvements based on project experience. This role is UK-based.

What you’ll do

Client delivery

  • Independently lead multiple complex projects and workstreams, managing agreed scope, timelines, budgets and quality.
  • Work with Client Services and specialists to define deliverables, estimates, assumptions, exclusions and acceptance criteria.
  • Lead project setup and kick-offs. Create and maintain delivery plans covering milestones, dependencies, responsibilities, review stages and approvals.
  • Anticipate risks, assess their likelihood and impact, and agree mitigation. Resolve issues and lead recovery planning, escalating matters beyond your authority with options and a recommendation.
  • Assess the impact of scope changes on time, cost and resources, and obtain approval before committing to revised delivery.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients and internal teams. Lead clear delivery communications, secure decisions and negotiate achievable priorities.
  • Support pitches and scope extensions with realistic estimates, delivery approaches, resource requirements and risks

Resourcing, forecasting & commercial delivery

  • Forecast the skills and hours required for assigned projects, secure bookings through the greed resourcing process and coordinate specialist inputs and handovers.
  • Identify resource conflicts early and work with resource and discipline leads to agree solutions.
  • Build project estimates and budgets with specialists and secure approval before work begins.
  • Track actual and committed costs, forecast cost to complete, monitor margin and act on variances.
  • Maintain accurate project data and contribute reliable assigned-account revenue forecasts with Client Services and Finance, making assumptions and risks clear.
  • Coordinate purchase-order and invoicing requirements, and complete project financial reconciliation with Finance.

Team & practice

  • Keep project documentation accurate, current and useful, including status reports, risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, decisions, actions and change records. Remain accountable for accuracy and follow-through when updates are delegated.
  • Apply Greenpark’s delivery standards and maintain reliable information in its project-management and job-costing systems.
  • Build specialist quality reviews, relevant rights and claims checks, client approvals and launch readiness into project workflows. Coordinate measurement requirements with specialists where relevant.
  • Confirm acceptance, complete handovers and lead project closure and retrospectives. Assign and follow through on agreed actions.
  • Raise wider improvement opportunities with the Head of Delivery.

AI-enabled delivery

  • Coach less experienced PMs and Project Executives, sharing practical guidance and providing clear handovers and agreed cover.
  • Use approved AI tools where they improve planning, reporting, documentation or analysis, following Greenpark’s policies, protecting confidential information and checking outputs.
  • Ensure AI-assisted content workflows include appropriate specialist QA and human approval.
  • Share lessons and propose improvements through the Head of Delivery, supporting agreed changes within your projects.

Reporting and working structure

  • The role has one designated line manager: a Digital Project Director, or the Head of Delivery where no Project Director is assigned. On individual accounts, delivery direction may come from an assigned Project or Programme Director.
  • Your line manager will lead performance and development reviews, with input from the Head of Delivery where applicable.
  • You will work closely with Client Services, resource and discipline leads, Finance and Operations. You will coordinate specialist delivery while discipline leads retain responsibility for specialist recommendations and quality sign-off.

About you

  • Experience delivering projects for global brands, ideally in FMCG, healthcare or similarly complex sectors involving multiple stakeholders and approval requirements.
  • Strong planning, estimating, resource coordination, budgeting, forecasting, risk management and change-control skills.
  • Practical understanding of integrated delivery across relevant areas such as SEO, AEO, content, social, digital PR and paid media. You can coordinate specialist teams and manage dependencies; expertise in every channel is not required.

The Sales Executive, Small Business, New Construction acquires new Small Business builder partners through targeted outreach and value-driven selling, building a strong pipeline and closing net-new business for Promoted Homes, a new product built for builders who buy a single lot and build a spec home to sell to a buyer, rather than developing a full community.

  • Experience managing sensitive or high-value data (PII, PHI), implementing strong security, governance and access control mechanisms
  • Understanding of enterprise data ecosystems and integration patterns (CRM, ERP, knowledge management or workflow systems)

Business-related requirements:

  • Proven experience delivering production-grade AI solutions that achieve measurable business and operational outcomes
  • Strong ownership of the full AI engineering lifecycle — from problem framing and architecture design to deployment, optimization, and continuous improvement
  • Ability to align technical decisions with business priorities, ensuring scalability, reliability, and measurable value from AI initiatives
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, delivery teams, and clients
  • High degree of autonomy, accountability, and attention to detail in managing complex, multi-component AI systems

Desirable:

This role is designed as a technician-first position, combining hands-on technical skill development with proactive fiber route patrol and damage prevention responsibilities. This role operates with a high degree of independence and serves as a subject matter expert in field technician, damage prevention, route patrol, and locating activities.

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant field or construction experience preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of telecommunications, underground utilities, or fiber optic systems preferred.
  • Familiarity with fiber testing equipment (e.g., OTDR, light meters, 10G–100G testers) is a plus.
  • Exposure to Layer 1–Layer 4 testing concepts and network troubleshooting preferred.
  • OSHA or other safety certifications preferred.
  • Ability to learn technical skills related to fiber installation, testing, and maintenance.
  • Ability to work outdoors in varying weather and environmental conditions.

The Summer 2027 Technical Analyst enGen Undergraduate Internship provides students with an opportunity to gain practical, hands-on experience supporting enterprise network infrastructure and technology operations within a large healthcare technology environment. This internship is designed to develop the next generation of infrastructure and networking professionals through direct exposure to enterprise networking, data center technologies, troubleshooting, monitoring, technical documentation, and infrastructure project delivery.


As a member of the Network Infrastructure team, the intern will work alongside experienced Network Engineers to support the day-to-day operation, monitoring, maintenance, and improvement of a large enterprise network environment. Participants will gain valuable experience troubleshooting network connectivity and infrastructure issues while developing an understanding of how enterprise networks support critical applications, business operations, and technology services.


The internship provides exposure to industry-leading networking and operational technologies, including Cisco routing, switching and wireless, Cisco Nexus/Data Center technologies, Meraki, BlueCat DNS/DHCP/IPAM, SolarWinds, and ServiceNow. Interns will have opportunities to support network monitoring, incident investigation, change activities, equipment deployments and upgrades, infrastructure documentation, and network lifecycle projects.


Typical responsibilities include assisting with network troubleshooting, monitoring network health and capacity, supporting incident and problem resolution, maintaining network diagrams and inventories, assisting with infrastructure changes and implementations, analyzing operational data, and identifying opportunities to improve monitoring, documentation, automation, and team processes.


Through mentorship, hands-on technical experience, and collaboration with infrastructure and application teams, participants will strengthen their networking, troubleshooting, analytical, customer service, and communication skills while building a strong foundation for a future career in enterprise networking and infrastructure technology.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are looking for an experienced Senior CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager - B2C Growth & Monetisation to join the Growth team of a fast-growing international consumer AI technology company.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager - B2C Growth & Monetisation to join the Growth team of a fast-growing international consumer AI technology company. This is a commercially focused position responsible for transforming CRM into a major revenue-generating channel across a high-volume B2C consumer platform.

You will take ownership of the entire customer lifecycle, with a particular emphasis on converting registered users into first-time paying customers, increasing repeat purchase frequency, improving retention, reactivating inactive users and maximising customer lifetime value (LTV). Working directly with the Co-founder & CMO, you will develop and execute CRM strategies, build automated customer journeys, optimise segmentation and run data-driven experiments that deliver measurable commercial results.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of personally driving significant revenue improvements through CRM within consumer businesses operating on subscriptions, repeat purchases, deposits, tokens, credits or virtual currency models. This is a highly autonomous role requiring someone who can identify commercial opportunities, implement solutions and demonstrate clear before-and-after performance improvements without relying on an established playbook.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take end-to-end ownership of CRM performance, with a focus on first-purchase conversion, token revenue, repeat purchase frequency and customer lifetime value.

  • Develop and execute CRM initiatives designed to increase customer acquisition monetisation and recurring revenue.

  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion from registered users to first-time paying customers.

  • Drive repeat purchases, customer engagement and revenue growth through targeted lifecycle marketing initiatives.

  • Establish CRM as a significant contributor to overall business revenue.

  • Define commercial priorities and translate them into actionable CRM strategies and campaigns.

  • Design, build and optimise customer segments, behavioural triggers, campaigns and automated lifecycle journeys.

  • Own CRM initiatives across onboarding, first-purchase conversion, retention, churn prevention and reactivation.

  • Develop personalised customer journeys based on user behaviour, purchase history and engagement patterns.

  • Optimise customer communication strategies to improve conversion, repeat monetisation and long-term engagement.

  • Identify opportunities to increase purchase frequency and reduce customer churn.

  • Continuously improve lifecycle automation and customer segmentation strategies.

  • Design and execute CRM experiments to identify high-impact revenue and conversion opportunities.

  • Analyse customer behaviour, purchase patterns, engagement data and revenue performance.

  • Measure campaign effectiveness using clear attribution, incrementality and before-and-after performance analysis.

  • Evaluate CRM initiatives against conversion, retention, revenue and LTV metrics.

  • Translate analytical insights into practical improvements and scalable lifecycle strategies.

  • Establish measurable success criteria for CRM campaigns and experiments.

  • Identify successful initiatives and scale them across relevant customer segments.

  • Work closely with the Co-founder & CMO and cross-functional teams to implement CRM growth initiatives.

  • Collaborate with product, data, marketing and technical stakeholders to improve customer lifecycle performance.

  • Independently identify challenges, develop solutions and drive execution in a fast-paced environment.

  • Contribute to building and continuously improving the company's CRM function.

  • Take ownership of commercial outcomes and clearly communicate individual contributions and results.

  • Use AI-powered tools where relevant to support customer analysis, segmentation, personalisation, experimentation and content development.

  • Lead, support or coach CRM specialists where applicable.

Requirements

  • Proven professional experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, retention marketing or customer monetisation, with a strong commercial focus.

  • Demonstrated track record of personally driving significant measurable revenue or conversion improvements through CRM.

  • Ability to present clear examples of CRM initiatives, including initial performance baseline, actions taken, individual ownership, timeframe and final measurable results.

  • Strong hands-on B2C CRM and lifecycle marketing experience within a high-volume consumer business.

  • Experience with consumer monetisation models involving subscriptions, repeat purchases, deposits, tokens, credits, virtual currency or similar recurring transactions.

  • Proven ownership of both first-purchase conversion and repeat customer monetisation.

  • Practical experience designing and implementing customer segments, behavioural triggers, campaigns and automated lifecycle journeys.

  • Strong understanding of customer acquisition monetisation, conversion rates, repeat purchase frequency, retention, churn and LTV.

  • Experience measuring CRM performance through attribution, incrementality and commercial impact analysis.

  • Strong analytical capabilities and ability to translate customer data into actionable revenue growth initiatives.

  • Proven experience developing and executing CRM experiments and optimisation strategies.

  • Ability to clearly distinguish personal contributions and measurable results from wider team achievements.

  • Strong commercial judgment and a results-oriented mindset.

  • Ability to independently identify opportunities, prioritise initiatives and execute without a fully established playbook.

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth international environment.

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1-C2).

  • Willingness to work under a B2B contractor agreement.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in iGaming, free-to-play gaming or other high-frequency repeat-purchase consumer businesses.

  • Experience optimising monetisation journeys involving virtual currencies, tokens, credits or repeat deposits.

  • Previous responsibility for leading, mentoring or coaching CRM specialists.

  • Experience using AI tools for CRM analytics, segmentation, personalisation, experimentation or content generation.

  • Experience building or scaling CRM functions within rapidly growing consumer technology companies.

Benefits

  • Competitive senior-level compensation package.

  • Additional performance-based bonus opportunities.

  • Fully remote working arrangement from Europe.

  • B2B contractor engagement preferred.

  • Direct reporting line to the Co-founder & CMO.

  • Significant autonomy and ownership over CRM strategy, revenue growth and lifecycle performance.

  • Opportunity to develop CRM into a major commercial growth channel.

  • Exposure to a high-volume international consumer AI platform.

  • Opportunity to lead high-impact initiatives across conversion, monetisation, retention and customer lifetime value.

  • International working environment within a rapidly growing technology business.

  • Opportunity to shape and improve the company's CRM function.

  • Professional development opportunities within an innovative AI-focused organisation.

You will also play a key role in maintaining an awareness and training program aligned with NIST to educate the organization to foster a culture of security awareness and responsibility.

  • Develop and deliver an awareness and training program aligned with NIST to educate the organization.

jobs.excerpt: About the companyMindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems.
jobs.description:
About the company

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.

Project Highlights

  • Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
  • Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
  • Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All contributors are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

What this project involves

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
  • Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

jobs.description:
Rockefeller Philanthropy Advisors (RPA) is a nonprofit organization that currently advises on and manages more than $400 million in annual giving by individuals, families, corporations and major foundations. Rockefeller Philanthropy Advisors accelerates philanthropy in pursuit of a just world.
Continuing the Rockefeller family’s legacy of thoughtful, effective philanthropy, RPA remains at the forefront of philanthropic growth and innovation, with a diverse team led by experienced grantmakers with significant depth of knowledge across the spectrum of issue areas. Founded in 2002, RPA has grown into one of the world’s largest philanthropic service organizations and, as a whole, has facilitated more than $3 billion in grantmaking to nearly 70 countries. RPA serves as a fiscal sponsor for more than 120+ projects, providing governance, management and operational infrastructure to support their charitable purposes. For more information, please go to www.rockpa.org.

Role Overview

The Director, Core Infrastructure is responsible for the strategic leadership, governance, and evolution of the organization's infrastructure ecosystem, ensuring secure, reliable, and resilient technology services that enable a global, remote-first workforce. Reporting to the VP, Technology, the Director translates the broader technology vision into the strategy, priorities, and roadmap for core infrastructure capabilities, including end-user computing, identity and access management, cloud platforms, service operations, cybersecurity enablement, and disaster recovery. The Director anticipates emerging technology, security, and operational risks, establishes long-term infrastructure strategies and standards, and resolves critical issues with lasting impact across functions ensuring infrastructure investments and capabilities align with organizational priorities, regulatory requirements, and future growth.

Role Accountabilities 

User Infrastructure Strategy and Governancernance

Lead the strategic direction, governance, and continuous evolution of the organization's user infrastructure environment, including endpoint computing, asset management, identity and access management, and end-user technology services.

  • Establish enterprise standards, policies, and long-term roadmaps for device lifecycle management and workforce technology, ensuring secure, scalable, and cost-effective technology solutions.
  • Govern identity and access management strategy, controls, and standards to strengthen security, support compliance requirements, and enable a seamless user experience across the organization.

User Support Services

Ensure technology support services deliver a consistently high-quality user experience by driving service excellence, operational effectiveness, and measurable outcomes across the organization's global workforce.

  • Set the strategic direction for Information Technology Infrastructure Library-based service management, including Service Strategy, Service Design, Service Transition, Service Operation and continual Service Improvement, establishing policies, performance expectations, and continuous improvement initiatives for incident, request, and support service delivery.

Device & User Computing Strategy

Define and lead the organization's enterprise device and digital workplace strategy, establishing long-term direction for endpoint technologies, operating platforms, workforce productivity tools, and modern workplace capabilities.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and investment opportunities, setting strategic priorities that balance user experience, security, scalability, operational efficiency, and cost effectiveness.
  • Establish enterprise-wide policies, standards, and governance for endpoint management, software deployment, and acceptable use, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives, risk management requirements, and technology roadmaps.

Information Security Operations

Direct infrastructure security operations and risk management activities to ensure the organization's technology environment remains secure, compliant, and resilient.

  • Partner with CISO resources to establish and embed infrastructure security strategies, standards, and operational controls that effectively manage enterprise risk and support organizational objectives.
  • Direct security operations within the infrastructure environment, ensuring the effectiveness of vulnerability management, endpoint protection, incident response, and remediation programs.
  • Monitor security performance, control effectiveness, and compliance outcomes, driving continuous improvement and ensuring readiness for regulatory, audit, and organizational requirements.
  • Ensure infrastructure services and operations align with data protection obligations, privacy requirements, and industry standards, proactively addressing emerging risks and evolving compliance expectations.
  • Lead the infrastructure response to significant security incidents and cyber events, coordinating cross-functional partners to minimize organizational impact, strengthen resilience, and implement long-term corrective actions.

Cloud & Azure Infrastructure

Define and lead the organization's cloud infrastructure strategy, ensuring scalable, resilient, secure, and cost-effective technology platforms that support business objectives, enable innovation, and drive long-term operational sustainability.

  • Establish the long-term cloud infrastructure strategy, establishing roadmaps, standards, and investment priorities for Azure services, platform capabilities, and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
  • Govern cloud governance, capacity planning, performance, resilience, and cost optimization, ensuring technology investments support organizational objectives and future growth.
  • Lead the evolution of the organization's infrastructure ecosystem, driving platform integration, modernization, and architectural decisions that enhance security, scalability, operational effectiveness, and enterprise-wide interoperability.

Disaster Recovery & Resilience

Lead the organization's disaster recovery and technology resilience strategy, ensuring critical systems, data, and infrastructure capabilities can withstand, recover from, and adapt to disruptions while supporting business continuity objectives.

  • Define and govern the organization's disaster recovery and technology resilience strategy, establishing recovery objectives, resilience standards, and long-term roadmaps for critical technology services.
  • Maintain disaster recovery preparedness, testing, and continuous improvement activities, ensuring risks are identified, assessed, and addressed to strengthen organizational resilience.
  • Lead infrastructure contributions to enterprise business continuity planning, ensuring technology capabilities, recovery processes, and resilience investments align with organizational priorities and risk management objectives.

Complexity and Problem-solving

  • Works with full autonomy, contributes to creating strategies and setting priorities within broad strategic goals, and anticipates and resolves critical problems with long-term impact across functions, balancing long-term infrastructure modernization with immediate operational needs such as system reliability, IT support, and regulatory compliance.
  • Applies comprehensive knowledge to act independently while providing guidance and training to others on using clear and effective communication to express ideas, request actions, and formulate plans or policies, translating technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Works without supervision and provides expert technical guidance, having expert knowledge of systems and tools, on collecting, analyzing, and diagramming infrastructure, security, and service performance data from multiple sources to draw appropriate conclusions and make suitable recommendations.
  • Recognized as an expert on analyzing data trends and conducting gap analyses between current and future states for use in reports and infrastructure and security roadmaps that guide decision-making for clients and the business.
  • Navigates the complexity of securing and supporting systems across functions and jurisdictions, with a keen awareness of nonprofit fiscal and legal constraints; develops positive relationships across boundaries to align solutions and establishes and maintains a high level of trust and confidence.
  • Anticipates emerging risks and organizational needs, developing and implementing policies and solutions that position Technology Services ahead of the business.

Supervisory Responsibility

  • Lead and develop a team and external partners; foster a culture of listening, teaching, and learning by creating frameworks, shared resources, and clear processes that enable strategic decision-making and ensure quality, accountability, and cost-effective delivery.
  • All facets of this position are self-directed within the policies and procedures approved by the CEO and broad guidelines established by the VP, Technology.
  • This position is responsible to the VP, Technology for the fiscal management of infrastructure, support, and security operations, and in this capacity rules on the allocation of expenditures.
  • This position is responsible for budget input, contracts, and service agreements associated with the function’s programs and initiatives, including vendor, licensing, and managed service agreements.

Key Qualifications and Experiences

  • Advanced degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field preferred, or equivalent experience required.
  • 10-12+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure and operations, including responsibility for endpoint management, identity, and user support.
  • 3-5+ years in a leadership role within a nonprofit, philanthropic, or mission-driven global organization preferred.
  • Proven record in IT service management, including help desk operations, ITIL-based processes, and infrastructure support for a distributed workforce.
  • Hands-on expertise with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and Azure infrastructure services (compute, storage, networking, identity).
  • Demonstrated experience in security operations, including vulnerability management, endpoint protection, and incident response, and in partnering with security leadership or CISO functions.
  • Experience designing and testing disaster recovery and backup solutions for cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Strong vendor and project management experience, with ability to drive results through external partners and internal teams.

Travel Requirements


  • Some travel may be required.

Mission and Values
The incumbent in the role must demonstrate a commitment to RPA’s Mission and Values:


At Rockefeller Philanthropy Advisors, our mission is to accelerate philanthropy in pursuit of a just world, by providing deep global expertise to make philanthropy more thoughtful, equitable and effective.


  • We believe that philanthropy can help create a better world.
  • We make decisions that center people and communities.
  • We believe philanthropy has a responsibility to pursue equity.
  • We uphold the highest standards of integrity and trust.
  • We are committed to learning and sharing knowledge.

If our mission resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. You may bring valuable perspectives and experiences that aren’t captured here but could contribute meaningfully to our work. We’re excited to learn what you can offer.

Compensation & Benefits

Rockefeller Philanthropy Advisors offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including health coverage, retirement benefits, paid sick leave, vacationand holidays, tuitionreimbursement and access to professional development resources.

The salary range is one component of the total compensation package for employees.

Pay Range: $173,000 - $180,000 salary per year.

Application Process

Applications will be reviewed as received. In order to be considered, all applications must include a cover letter describing your interest and qualifications and your resume. The position will remain open until filled.

Rockefeller Philanthropy Advisors celebrates the uniqueness of our staff, our partners, and the communities we serve. We are committed to inclusion with the goal of cultivating a culture of belonging and acceptance. We strive to embed this value in our philanthropic work to advance a more just, equitable and sustainable world.
