jobs.description:
Remote | United Kingdom | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $15–$35 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Healthcare

What if the medical knowledge and clinical skills you have or you're developing could help improve how artificial intelligence understands complex healthcare information, evaluates medical scenarios, and delivers more accurate, reliable responses?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting healthcare professionals, medical students, residents, and advanced healthcare trainees with opportunities to contribute to the evaluation and improvement of advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) models.

We're seeking individuals currently active in or pursuing medical education or completing supervised clinical training in General Practice, Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Nurse Practitioner, or Physician Assistant pathways.

This opportunity is designed for candidates who can apply their academic knowledge, clinical training, and evidence-based reasoning to evaluate AI-generated medical information.

This is not a traditional clinical position. You will not provide direct patient care, diagnose actual patients, or make treatment decisions for real patients. Instead, you'll assess medical scenarios, evaluate clinical reasoning, identify inaccuracies, and provide structured feedback to help improve AI model performance.

Previous AI experience is not required. We're looking for candidates with a strong foundation in medical knowledge, analytical thinking, and an interest in applying their education to emerging healthcare technology.

Areas of Medical Education & Clinical Training

We're seeking qualified professionals, students and trainees in the following five areas:

1. General Practice:

Ideal candidates have education or clinical exposure in:

  • General patient assessment and clinical evaluation.
  • Recognition and management principles for common medical conditions.
  • Preventive medicine and general healthcare practices.
  • Medical history review and interpretation of clinical findings.
  • Fundamental diagnostic reasoning and evidence-based medical decision-making.

2. Family Medicine

Relevant experience may include:

  • Primary care across different age groups and patient populations.
  • Evaluation of acute and chronic medical conditions.
  • Preventive care, wellness, and health screenings.
  • Differential diagnosis and general treatment planning principles.
  • Interpretation of medical histories, clinical findings, and evidence-based guidelines.

3. Internal Medicine

Relevant knowledge and experience may include:

  • Adult medicine and management principles for common or complex conditions.
  • Interpretation of laboratory results and diagnostic findings.
  • Recognition of multisystem diseases and related complications.
  • Development and evaluation of differential diagnoses.
  • Evidence-based approaches to clinical assessment and medical management.

4. Nurse Practitioner (NP)

Students currently enrolled in a recognized Nurse Practitioner educational program, particularly those completing advanced coursework or supervised clinical training.

Ideal candidates have education or experience in:

  • Advanced health assessment and patient evaluation.
  • Pathophysiology, pharmacology, and clinical management principles.
  • Diagnostic reasoning and interpretation of medical findings.
  • Evidence-based treatment planning and healthcare practices.
  • Patient education, preventive care, and healthcare quality standards.

Candidates pursuing Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) or Adult-Gerontology Primary Care Nurse Practitioner (AGPCNP) pathways are especially encouraged to apply.

5. Physician Assistant (PA) / Physician Associate

Relevant educational and clinical experience may include:

  • Patient assessment, medical history review, and physical examination.
  • Clinical rotations in primary care, internal medicine, or family medicine.
  • Differential diagnosis and interpretation of diagnostic findings.
  • Evidence-based treatment and patient management principles.
  • Medical documentation and evaluation of clinical scenarios.

What You'll Do

As a Medical AI Evaluator, you'll apply your medical education and clinical training to assess how accurately AI systems interpret healthcare information and reason through medical scenarios.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate AI-Generated Medical Content: Review AI-generated healthcare information for factual accuracy, completeness, clinical relevance, and consistency with established medical knowledge and guidelines.
  • Assess Clinical Reasoning: Evaluate AI-generated assessments, differential diagnoses, and treatment-related explanations to determine whether conclusions are medically sound and supported by appropriate evidence.
  • Identify Medical Inaccuracies: Recognize factual errors, unsupported assumptions, missing clinical considerations, and potential patient safety concerns in AI-generated responses.
  • Conduct Medical Research and Verification: Validate information using credible sources, including peer-reviewed medical literature, clinical practice guidelines, and established healthcare resources.
  • Review Clinical Scenarios: Analyze hypothetical patient cases, symptoms, medical histories, laboratory findings, and diagnostic information to evaluate AI-generated interpretations.
  • Provide Evidence-Based Feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify inaccuracies, and recommend appropriate corrections supported by medical evidence and clinical standards.
  • Apply Evaluation Standards: Consistently follow project-specific scoring rubrics, annotation instructions, and quality assurance guidelines.
  • Complete Assigned Evaluations: Perform independent evaluation tasks using designated online platforms, including DataCompute, while meeting established deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Maintain Confidentiality and Professional Standards: Protect sensitive project information and comply with applicable privacy, ethical, and data security requirements.

Compensation & Project Structure

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on educational background, clinical training, relevant experience, geographic location, and assignment complexity.

Specialty & Experience Level

General Practitioner

    • $15-$35; dependent upon years of experience

Family Medicine

    • $15-$35; dependent upon years of experience

Internal Medicine

    • $15-$35; dependent upon years of experience

Nurse Practitioner

    • $15-$28; dependent upon years of experience

Physician Assistant

    • $15-$30; dependent upon years of experience

Eligibility Requirements

  • Second-year medical students must be enrolled at a top medical school
  • Third-year students and above: open to all qualifying programs
  • Relevant specialty or with years of experience

Final compensation is subject to client approval, project requirements, and geographic eligibility.

This is a freelance, task-based opportunity intended for individuals interested in applying their medical knowledge to AI evaluation projects while continuing their education or clinical training.

Assignments are distributed based on project needs and availability. Workloads may be irregular or intermittent, and specific hours or future assignments are not guaranteed.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Medical Education in a New Way

Use the medical knowledge and clinical reasoning skills gained through your coursework, clinical rotations, or supervised training to contribute to advanced AI evaluation projects.

Help Improve Healthcare AI Accuracy

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI-generated medical information and support the development of more reliable and medically informed AI systems.

Explore Emerging Healthcare Technology

Gain exposure to AI evaluation, medical content assessment, and evidence-based research while expanding your experience beyond traditional clinical settings.

Work Remotely

Participate in specialized project assignments from an eligible location, with schedules and workloads based on project availability.

No AI Background Required

We're looking for candidates who can think critically, recognize accurate medical reasoning, identify errors, and explain their conclusions using credible medical evidence.

Project Details

  • Engagement Type: Project-Based Independent Contractor
  • Work Arrangement: Remote
  • Primary Location: United States, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, India, and the Philippines, subject to client approval
  • Schedule: Variable, including potential weekday and weekend assignments
  • Evaluation Platform: DataCompute
  • Project Duration: Based on client requirements and project availability
  • Selection Process: Qualified applicants may be required to complete a medical knowledge or clinical reasoning assessment before selection.

Specific assignments, schedules, and workloads will be communicated as they become available.

Bring Your Medical Knowledge to the Future of AI

Whether you're completing medical school, advancing through residency, or pursuing Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant training, this is an opportunity to apply your developing clinical expertise to emerging healthcare technology.

At Volga Partners, we value candidates who demonstrate strong medical knowledge, thoughtful clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and the ability to evaluate complex information using evidence-based principles.

Join us in helping shape the next generation of healthcare AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

Candidates should possess the following qualifications:

  • Medical or Advanced Healthcare Education: Current enrollment in the third or fourth year of a recognized medical degree program, an eligible medical internship or residency, or an advanced NP or PA educational program with relevant clinical training.
  • Relevant Clinical Focus: Academic coursework, clinical rotations, or supervised training related to General Practice, Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Nurse Practitioner practice, or Physician Assistant practice.
  • Foundational Medical Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, pathology, pharmacology, and clinical concepts relevant to their area of training.
  • Clinical Reasoning and Evaluation: Ability to assess medical scenarios, interpret clinical information, and distinguish evidence-based reasoning from inaccurate or unsupported conclusions.
  • Research and Evidence Verification: Ability to research medical literature, interpret clinical guidelines, and validate findings using authoritative healthcare resources.
  • Analytical and Critical Thinking: Strong analytical reasoning, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.
  • Written Communication: Excellent written English skills, with the ability to clearly explain clinical findings, document evaluations, and support conclusions with credible evidence.
  • Technical Proficiency: Comfort working with computers, web-based platforms, digital documentation, and online research tools.
  • Independent Work and Accountability: Ability to follow detailed instructions, complete assignments independently, and consistently meet established quality requirements.
  • Project-Based Availability: Willingness to participate in a remote, freelance engagement where assignments and schedules are determined by project needs.

Independent medical licensure and previous employment as a licensed physician, Nurse Practitioner, or Physician Assistant are not required for eligible student-level evaluation assignments.

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience or qualifications may strengthen a candidate's application:

  • Clinical rotations, clerkships, internships, or supervised training in general practice, family medicine, internal medicine, or primary care.
  • Enrollment in the clinical phase of an accredited or recognized medical, NP, or PA educational program.
  • Experience reviewing medical records, clinical case studies, laboratory results, or diagnostic documentation.
  • Familiarity with evidence-based medicine, differential diagnosis, and established clinical practice guidelines.
  • Participation in medical research, literature reviews, clinical case presentations, or healthcare-related academic projects.
  • Exposure to healthcare quality assurance, medical documentation review, or clinical evaluation.
  • Interest in artificial intelligence, healthcare technology, or medical informatics.

Previous AI evaluation experience is beneficial but not required.

Audience Strategy & Product Development

Build differentiated products using first-party, behavioral, contextual, geographic, and advertiser-permissioned data.

Create packaging, activation, pricing, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

Advance segmentation, enrichment, identity, insights, and responsible data use.

Define the target experience across planning, order management, inventory, campaign delivery, optimization, and measurement.

Connect advertising, commercial, data, and reporting capabilities through clear platform boundaries.

Build business cases, launch plans, adoption strategies, and success measures.

Lead across Sales, Client Success, Marketing, Data, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Privacy.

Guide roadmap, investment, dependency, and trade-off decisions with senior stakeholders.

Develop product talent and influence matrixed teams across the organization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of product management experience in digital advertising, advertising technology, media platforms, data products, or related fields.

Strong understanding of programmatic advertising, digital media monetization, audience products, campaign workflows, and advertising operations.

Experience translating customer and commercial problems into platform strategy, roadmaps, product requirements, and measurable outcomes.

Strong analytical and commercial judgment, executive communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Deep working knowledge of Google Ad Manager or a comparable enterprise ad server, including orders, line items, targeting, pacing, creative trafficking, and reporting integrations.

Experience with advertising order-to-cash ecosystems, including booking, pricing, fulfillment, billing, and revenue-recognition processes to connect with ad-serving and reporting platforms.

MBA or equivalent experience leading product strategy and commercial transformation.

About Us:
Effortless Office partners with our customers to make IT effortless so they can focus on their business. As a Hybrid Managed Services Provider (MSP) with a focus on providing world-class customer experience, we deliver and fully support secure cloud solutions as well as comprehensive managed IT and network services.

About the Role:

Effortless is looking for a Network Operations Manager who is an excellent leader and engineer. This is a player-coach role: you will lead our network engineering team while remaining one of the company's top escalation and design resources for enterprise, high-availability, multi-platform networks.

You will own the health, security, and continuous improvement of the networks we manage for our customers and within our own Switch data center infrastructure. We expect you to be proactive: you will not wait for tickets. You and your team will regularly review client environments, find risk, capacity, and performance gaps before they become outages, and bring clear, cost-effective recommendations to our customers and Service Delivery Teams.

The ideal candidate has served as a Senior Network Engineer, has the technical depth to earn the respect of senior engineers, and has the leadership skills to develop them. You set a high standard, communicate clearly, take ownership, and care about the customer experience.

Position Details:

Reports to: President

Direct reports: Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers

Location: Remote with a preference for someone in/near Las Vegas, NV.

Travel: Some travel required for data center work, client site visits, and special projects.

Schedule: Monday - Friday 8:00-5:00 PST, with 24/7 escalation availability for major incidents and management of the team's on-call rotation.

Benefits:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401K + employer match
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Opportunities for career growth and development
  • Training and certification support

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Engineering Excellence

  • Serves as the company's senior network engineering authority and final escalation point in core routing and switching, network security, and network diagnostics.
  • Designs, reviews, and approves complex network configurations and architecture, including hardware and software technology, site locations, business continuity, disaster recovery, and integration of technologies.
  • Personally assesses and resolves the most complex data network problems and incidents, and leads major incident response through to resolution and root cause analysis.
  • Owns the design, standards, and lifecycle of Effortless's own network infrastructure at our Switch data centers, including Cisco Nexus, Firepower, and SDWAN (Meraki and Cisco Viptela) environments.
  • Sets and maintains network engineering standards, configuration baselines, and documentation requirements in IT Glue, and reviews the team's work for quality and consistency.
  • Reviews analyses and technical feasibility to develop data network deployment strategies, resource requirements, and cost estimates.

Proactive Client Improvement

  • Leads a regular program of proactive network reviews across client environments to find security, reliability, capacity, and performance gaps before they cause issues.
  • Uses Auvik monitoring, ticket trends in Autotask, and assessment data to identify recurring problems and drive permanent fixes rather than repeated reactive work.
  • Assesses data network growth forecasts and ensures business needs are translated into network capacity requirements.

  • Tracks hardware and firmware end-of-life, vulnerabilities, and configuration drift across managed networks and plans remediation.
  • Brings the customer's perspective to every recommendation: leads with business outcomes, not technology features.

Leadership

  • Hires, onboards, coaches, and develops Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers, including technical mentoring and certification planning.

  • Manages team workload, project priorities, and resource availability, and plans and coordinates cross-functional or cross-company work.
  • Owns network change management: reviews and approves changes, maintenance windows, and rollback plans.
  • Manages the team's 24/7 on-call rotation and escalation process, and ensures after-hours coverage meets Effortless's service standards.
  • Communicates status, risk, and outcomes clearly to leadership, Service Delivery Teams, and customers, following our CWC (Communicate, Work, Communicate) value.

Operations and Compliance

  • Defines, tracks, and reports on network operations KPIs (see Success Measures below).
  • Manages relationships with network vendors and carriers, including escalations, and supports procurement and licensing decisions.
  • Ensures all compliance aspects of the position and team are known and followed; understands and complies with all policies, codes, and regulations applicable to the position and company, including client HIPAA, PCI, and NIST requirements.
  • Maintains sensitive and confidential information regarding company and customer information.
  • Performs related duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Education and Work Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, or a related technical field
  • 10+ years of experience with Service Provider, MSP, or enterprise networking or general telecommunications
  • 3+ years in a Senior Network Engineer (or equivalent) role, serving as the top escalation and design resource for complex networks (required)
  • 2+ years leading engineers as a manager, team lead, or technical lead, with direct responsibility for work assignment and mentoring
  • MSP or multi-client environment experience strongly preferred

Specialized Knowledge and Skills

jobs.description:
About the company

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.

Project Highlights

  • Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
  • Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
  • Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All contributors are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

What this project involves

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
  • Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

jobs.description:
🌍 Global SaaS Scale-up | Series B 📍 Fully remote in EU or from our offices (Bratislava, Prague, Barcelona) 💰 From €3k gross/month depending on experience and location

About CloudTalk

CloudTalk is an AI-powered business phone system and AI Voice Agent platform built for sales and support teams. It brings business calling, AI-powered call intelligence, and autonomous AI voice agents together in one platform, helping small and mid-sized businesses make more calls, handle more conversations, and deliver better customer experiences.

Serving customers in 160+ countries, CloudTalk is backed by $36M in funding from leading investors, including KPN Ventures, Point Nine, and HenQ. We’re investing in making AI a natural part of every business conversation and helping companies get more value from every call.

With a team of 200 people, CloudTalk values growth, innovation, teamwork, customer focus, and human connection. The company moves fast, builds for the future, and cares deeply about creating products and a culture that people genuinely love.

About the role

A feature ships on Tuesday. By Friday, the docs, the in-app tour and the answers our AI tools give are correct, and a person has reviewed them. This role makes that the normal week.

We're creating a new role in Product Marketing to own how we teach customers and our own teams how CloudTalk works. We're looking for a product educator who can build systems: someone who knows how to teach, and uses AI and automation to do it at the pace we ship.

CloudTalk ships more than 100 releases a quarter. Keeping documentation, guides and in-app help in step with that pace by hand doesn't scale, so this role is about building the systems that do it: documentation that updates as the product ships, AI that drafts and checks, and a clear view of what people need to learn. You'll put AI to work in a structured, repeatable way, decide what we teach, and keep improving the rules behind the systems so quality gets better over time.

It starts with the product. You'll know CloudTalk inside out, understand what each change means for the people using it, and decide which parts of the work AI does and which parts need you. If you get excited about product and enjoy explaining it, you'll feel at home: you'll present to customers and to our own teams, in webinars, sessions and how-tos.

We want someone who has built the workflow, not just used ChatGPT to draft content. This is a new role with no playbook: we'll set priorities together, and the first 90 days focus on the docs system and the most-asked topics. You'll work closely with Product, Support and Marketing.

The work runs at three levels:

  1. Keep up with releases. Systems that keep docs, tours and screenshots in step with what ships. Success: docs are current within a week of a release, without anyone having to ask.
  2. Educate on bigger changes in how the product works. How-to launches that help customers and our teams adopt bigger changes. Success: a how-to launch run end to end, with in-app guidance reported against activation and adoption goals.
  3. Improve what we have. Systems that show what customers and our teams keep asking, so we fix the content that matters most. Success: fewer "how do I" tickets on the topics we fixed.

What success looks like

First 90 days

  • A working system that turns product changes into documentation updates, with a weekly review in place.
  • A recurring view of the most asked topics, with the first ones fixed.
  • Product tours checked against the current product, with a system to keep them current.
  • One how-to launch run end to end.

Ongoing

  • Docs are current within a week of a release, without anyone having to ask.
  • Fewer "how do I" tickets on the topics we fixed.
  • In-app flows and education content reported against activation and adoption goals.
  • Our AI tools give the same answer a good Support agent would.

What you'll do

1. Keep up with releases

  • Build systems that update product documentation automatically as the product ships.
  • Set up the review process: every change checked by a person, whether a person or AI wrote it, and every mistake fed back into the rules.
  • Run and extend our release notes automation.
  • Build regular checks that compare docs, tours and screenshots against the live product and flag what drifted.
  • Keep product facts accurate for the AI tools that answer customers and our teams.

2. Educate on changes in how the product works

  • Run how-to launches end to end for changes in how the product works, like a new analytics experience or navigation: from docs and in-app guidance to technical how-to for our teams.
  • Keep in-app guidance up to date and report on how it performs against activation and adoption goals.
  • Keep interactive demos and how-to content current for prospects and new customers.
  • Run internal and external product education sessions and webinars for new releases.

3. Improve what we have

What we're looking for

  • You've owned product content in a SaaS company: docs, onboarding, product education or enablement. Teaching people how a product works is the core of what you do.
  • You can look at a product change and see what it means for customers and our teams: what they need to know, do differently or set up.
  • You write clearly and plainly, and you can explain a setup in five steps instead of fifteen.
  • You also build: you've built systems with AI, not just used it: a workflow, an automation, a docs pipeline. You use them to scale your teaching, not to replace it.
  • You know where AI helps and where it doesn't, and you decide which work AI takes on and which work stays with you.
  • You decide from data: what people search, ask and get stuck on, and what moves activation.
  • You're comfortable in Claude, GitHub and Markdown, or keen to learn fast.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Mintlify, Appcues, Storylane or similar tools.
  • Background in telephony, contact center or sales software.
  • Additional languages.

Why you will love to be a CloudTalker

Unlimited PTO that people actually take. Fully remote with four European hubs. A coach you can book, a career path in writing, and equity when you deliver. Here's the full package.

Get better, faster

  • 💬 A coach you can actually book. Recurring 1-on-1 sessions with our resident coach. A real conversation about your career, on company time.
  • 🪜 Promotions without guesswork. Our job-leveling framework is transparent: every level and its expectations, in writing. You'll always know what the next step requires and where you stand.
  • 📈 A path to equity. At CloudTalk, equity is earned over time. Seniority, tenure, and consistent impact, together, are what get you there. Not an automatic perk. Something you grow into.

Work the way you work best

  • 🌴 Unlimited PTO, and we mean it. Taking 30 days a year is normal here. Deliver beyond expectations, and you've bought yourself room for more.
  • 🌍 The right setup for your role. Depending on the team, you’ll either work from one of our hubs four days a week or have the option to work fully remotely. Our offices are fully equipped and centrally located.
  • ⏰ Flexible hours, built around your team. Start early or shift late as life needs it. Be there for meetings and your team's core overlap; how you arrange the rest of your day is yours.
  • 💻 Gear that doesn't fight you. A MacBook for work, plus a home-office allowance to build a setup you like sitting at.

Rest like you mean it

  • 🔋 Recharge Fridays: 4 extra all-company days off a year. Once a quarter, everyone is off at the same time. You come back to zero pings, not a doubled backlog. That's the point.
  • 🏃 Fitness allowance. Gym, climbing, yoga, whatever keeps you moving. You choose, we pay.

People worth staying for

  • 💸 Up to €5,000 per referral. You know great engineers. When we hire one of them, you get paid for it.
  • ✈️ Two offsites a year worth packing a bag for. The all-company offsite (last year: Tuscany 🇮🇹) plus a dedicated R&D offsite, both somewhere remote enough that people actually talk.
  • 👕 Fresh CloudTalk swag every year, with a points system to earn more.

What to expect from our hiring process

  1. 30-min Call with our TA Team.
  2. 45-min Interview with our Product Marketing Director
  3. 60-min Case Study Presentation
  4. 30-min Culture Bar Raiser Call

Become a part of our caring community

The Payment Integrity Lead uses technology and data mining, detects anomalies in data to identify and collect overpayment of claims. Contributes to the investigations of fraud waste and our financial recovery. The Payment Integrity Lead works on problems of diverse scope and complexity ranging from moderate to substantial.

The Payment Integrity Lead - Strategy & Audit Optimization is a strategic leadership role responsible for identifying, evaluating, and advancing new Payment Integrity opportunities that drive sustainable medical cost savings.


This role will serve as a key leader within Payment Integrity's Trend Bender and Data Mining strategy, proactively identifying emerging industry trends, regulatory and reimbursement changes, payment policies, claims patterns, provider behaviors, and new analytical opportunities that can be translated into actionable Payment Integrity concepts.


The Lead will operate with significant independence and is expected to work effectively in areas where the opportunity, solution, or path forward may not yet be clearly defined. This individual will move beyond identifying issues to developing hypotheses, assessing financial opportunity and operational feasibility, testing new concepts, and influencing cross-functional partners to operationalize successful ideas across Prepay and Postpay Payment Integrity.


Success in this role requires strong Payment Integrity and healthcare claims knowledge, intellectual curiosity, sound business judgment, comfort taking calculated risks, and the ability to turn ambiguous or emerging opportunities into measurable results.


This role directly supports the organization's top Payment Integrity goals, including net-new Data Mining trends, Trend Bender savings, concept optimization, audit effectiveness, and medical cost savings.


Key Responsibilities

New Opportunity & Trend Identification

  • Proactively identify net-new Payment Integrity and Data Mining opportunities through analysis of industry trends, reimbursement and policy changes, provider billing patterns, claims data, and portfolio performance.
  • Monitor Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial reimbursement trends to identify changes that may create new Payment Integrity opportunities.
  • Independently research potential payment leakage and develop hypotheses for new audit concepts, including opportunities that do not fit existing processes.
  • Maintain awareness of external Payment Integrity practices, technology, and emerging analytical approaches that could strengthen Humana's strategy.

Concept Development & Testing

  • Translate identified opportunities into clearly defined audit concepts and testable business hypotheses.
  • Define concept intent, claims population, expected payment behavior, policy rationale, preliminary logic, and expected financial opportunity.
  • Partner with analytical, clinical, coding, policy, technology, and operational teams to test and validate new concepts.
  • Evaluate results and recommend whether to advance, modify, scale, or discontinue concepts, balancing speed with validation so concepts are operationally sound and defensible.

Operationalization & Influence

  • Drive promising concepts from idea through validation and implementation, creating accountability and momentum across teams.
  • Influence partners across Payment Integrity and the broader organization without direct authority over required resources.
  • Resolve barriers to high-value concepts and establish clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, and success measures.
  • Communicate recommendations clearly to leaders and stakeholders, including when they challenge existing processes or assumptions.

Concept & Audit Optimization

  • Evaluate existing concepts for opportunities to improve accuracy, financial performance, uphold rates, efficiency, and provider experience.
  • Identify concepts generating unnecessary rework, disputes, appeals, overturns, or administrative expense and determine remediation.
  • Recommend opportunities to refine, automate, move upstream, consolidate, or retire concepts based on performance data, keeping resources focused on high-value, sustainable interventions.

Strategy & Leadership

  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to Payment Integrity leadership on emerging opportunities, portfolio performance, and industry developments.
  • Provide concise, executive-level recommendations supported by claims analysis, financial impact, operational considerations, and risk assessment.
  • Lead complex initiatives spanning analytical, operational, clinical, technology, and business stakeholders.

  • Competitive hourly consulting fee.

Executive Communications & Thought Leadership

Corporate Messaging & Content Development

Media Monitoring, Issues Management & Reputation

Cross-Functional Partnership & Agency Management

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

jobs.title: Global Security Operations Engineer
jobs.excerpt: The Global Security Operations Engineer is a senior technical role responsible for strengthening the firm's ability to detect, investigate, respond to, and recover from cybersecurity threats across its global environment.
jobs.description:
The Global Security Operations Engineer is a senior technical role responsible for strengthening the firm's ability to detect, investigate, respond to, and recover from cybersecurity threats across its global environment.

Working as part of the Global Security operations team, the successful candidate will lead complex security investigations, develop and optimize threat detection capabilities, and implement automation to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of security operations.

The role combines hands-on incident response with proactive security engineering, helping the firm move from reactive alert management toward an increasingly automated, intelligence-led security operating model.

Operating within a geographically distributed organization, the successful candidate will work closely with global and regional technology and security teams, provide technical leadership during significant incidents, and contribute to the continuous improvement of security capabilities. Based in APAC, the role will provide critical regional coverage as part of a coordinated global security operations function.

Responsibilities

  • Advanced Investigation and Incident Response
    • Serve as a senior escalation point for security incidents, assuming ownership of complex, ambiguous, and high-severity events that exceed first-line triage capability.
    • Conduct detailed investigations to establish initial access vectors, attacker activities and objectives, scope of compromise, and dwell time, documenting findings to an appropriate evidentiary standard.
    • Perform root cause analysis on confirmed incidents and near misses, identifying underlying security control or process failures rather than simply addressing immediate symptoms.
    • Act as technical lead during significant incidents across containment, eradication, and recovery, coordinating activities across global and regional teams.
    • Conduct host and network forensics and malware triage, engaging specialist forensic providers where investigations exceed internal capabilities.
    • Translate technical findings into clear statements of business risk for leadership and drive post-incident corrective actions through to closure.
    • Investigate identity-based attacks, account compromise, unauthorized access, and suspicious activity across cloud platforms and enterprise applications, including Microsoft 365 and Entra ID.
    • Participate in an on-call rotation and provide out-of-hours escalation support during serious incidents, and undertake additional projects and activities as required.
  • Security Automation & Detection Engineering
    • Design, build, tune, and maintain detection content mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework, identifying and reporting coverage gaps against threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures relevant to the firm.
    • Reduce false-positive volume and analyst alert fatigue through systematic tuning, suppression logic, and automated alert enrichment.
    • Operationalize threat intelligence by translating reporting and indicators of compromise into actionable detections, threat-hunting hypotheses, and preventive controls.
    • Design, develop, and maintain automated response playbooks, including Logic Apps, automation rules, and SOAR workflows, to reduce mean time to detect and respond.
    • Write and maintain queries, scripts, and code (KQL, PowerShell, Python, or equivalent) supporting detection, enrichment, automated triage, and reporting.
    • Integrate security tooling and data sources through APIs and connectors, including onboarding new log sources with appropriate parsing, normalization, and validation.
    • Continuously assess and improve security monitoring, detection, and response capabilities, identifying opportunities to strengthen coverage, reduce operational complexity, and improve effectiveness through automation and technology optimization.
    • Identify opportunities to apply AI-assisted investigation, alert triage, and security automation capabilities to improve detection effectiveness, reduce manual effort, and accelerate incident response.
    • Conduct proactive threat hunting to identify suspicious activity, validate detection effectiveness, and uncover threats that may evade existing security controls.

Requirements

This is a hands-on technical role requiring demonstrated depth in security operations, sound technical judgment, and the ability to work with limited supervision. We value analytical rigor, curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to share knowledge and develop others as highly as any individual technology or certification.

Compulsory Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or detection engineering, including demonstrable experience working in a Security Operations Center (SOC).
  • Proven experience leading complex technical investigations end to end, from escalation through root cause analysis to documented remediation.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with modern SIEM and endpoint detection and response (EDR) platforms, including authoring and optimizing detection logic, conducting investigations, and managing data onboarding.
  • Strong practical automation and scripting abilities, including KQL and at least one of PowerShell or Python, with demonstrated experience developing and operating automation in production.
  • Experience designing and maintaining automated response playbooks using Logic Apps, automation rules, or comparable SOAR capabilities.
  • Advanced knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework, Cyber Kill Chain analysis, and established incident response methodologies, such as PICERL.
  • Strong working knowledge of TCP/IP and networking, Windows and Linux operating systems, Active Directory, Entra cloud identity and authentication, and security operations across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Experience with host and network forensics, malware triage, and the analysis of malicious email headers, links, and attachments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical findings and security risks to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with geographically dispersed teams, with flexibility to provide out-of-hours support during significant security incidents.
  • Occasional travel to support global cybersecurity operations and incident response may be required

Preferred Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Industry certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GREM, OSCP, CySA+, SC-200, AZ-500, or CISSP.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft security technologies, including Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience operating within a global, federated, or shared-services model, ideally in professional services or another highly regulated sector.
  • Familiarity with ISO 27001, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or comparable control frameworks

Empowerly (Empowerly.com) is an education technology company that personalizes college and career counseling, with a mission to empower students to become the most successful version of themselves.

Each student is offered a three-pronged approach to evaluate academics, essays, and extracurricular activities, providing them with a 360-degree view of how to be competitive against other applicants.

We also prefer College Admissions Counselors who have graduated from top 50 colleges and have a STEM background (preferably in computer science, engineering, and/or medicine).

Many of our students live in the San Francisco Bay Area and apply for top 50 colleges, including the UCs and Ivy League schools. We particularly have many aspiring pre-med students (BS/MD programs) and computer science students.

College Admissions Counselors create academic and extracurricular road maps, provide college application structure and feedback, and assist with passion discovery and early career development.

Graduate School Counselors help students through graduate school admissions process. Requires knowledge and experience in specific graduate school admissions processes such as medical school, law school, MBA programs, PhD programs, and more.

Career Counselors provide career advice to get accepted to competitive internships and jobs, including passion discovery, resume and cover letter editing, interview prep, networking tips, and more.

Responsibilities

  • Experience with 6th - 10th grades.

  • Attend monthly team meetings.
  • Utilize resources available within Empowerly to provide optimal advice for all students.
  • Monitor Empowerly email account and Slack account for up-to-date Empowerly communications.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Graduate from a top 50 national university (advanced degrees like MD, PhD, MBA, JD, or Masters are a plus)
  • Experience as a college counselor for high school students, with a track record of acceptances into a top 50 national university
  • Have consistent availability in the afternoons (after 3:00 p.m.) and/or on weekends to meet with students.
  • Possess passion for education, talent for teaching, essay writing, and essay editing.
  • Possess exceptional oral and written communication skills
  • Able to plan around and meet deadlines
  • Possess dedication to client service
  • Able to commit to students for multi-year packages

Preferred Qualifications

  • Former admissions officers at top 50 colleges
  • Experienced independent college counselors (NACAC, WACAC, IECA, etc)

jobs.title: Senior Partnerships Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Can You Spot An Influencer Who’ll Actually Sell?  You know that good partnerships don’t just “create buzz.
jobs.description:
Can You Spot An Influencer Who’ll Actually Sell? You know that good partnerships don’t just “create buzz.” They drive revenue, build authority, and make competitors wonder how the heck you’re everywhere at once. You know how to build a scalable affiliate program where the right partners drive sales, the right experts build trust, and every campaign has the tracking and reporting to prove it.

If that sounds like you, you might have what it takes to be the Senior Influencer and Partnerships Specialist at AlgaeCal.

Small Print ⇒ If you think influencer marketing is about collecting “likes” this role isn’t for you. We’re looking for someone who can build a performance-driven partnership ecosystem, manage creators and affiliates, negotiate smart deals, and sniff out wasted spend faster than a bloodhound chasing a runaway sausage cart.

This job will give you ALL the feels:

We create clinically supported, natural solutions for some of the biggest health challenges women over 40 face today. And your work will help more women discover those solutions. The creators, affiliates, and experts you bring into our world will help women find information they can trust, feel more confident in their choices, and take action on their health.

If that excites you, you’ll find no better place to continue your career than here.

This job might be for you if…

  • You know how to find the right partners. A creator with 500,000 followers doesn’t automatically make your pulse race. You look at audience fit, engagement, credibility, brand alignment, and whether there’s a realistic path to revenue. You’re not here to collect vanity metrics. You’re here to build a pipeline of influencers, creators, affiliates, and healthcare experts who can actually perform.
  • You’re comfortable working with performance data. ROAS, CAC, conversion rate, attributed revenue, and performance by partner aren’t things you leave for someone else to figure out. You know how to read the data, spot what’s working, kill what isn’t, and put more money behind the partnerships that deserve it.
  • You know how to build strong relationships. Great partnerships aren’t built by firing over a contract and resurfacing three months later asking for a report. You know how to build trust, communicate clearly, create offers people actually want to say yes to, and keep good partners wanting to work with us again. From first conversation to signed agreement to live campaign to reporting, you know how to keep the whole thing moving.
  • You understand how affiliate programs work. You’re not the kind of person who opens Impact and stares hopefully at the dashboard. You understand recruitment, activation, commission structures, incentives, optimization, and what it takes to turn a handful of affiliates into a real growth channel. Experience with Impact, Klear, GRIN, Shopify Affiliates, or similar platforms will definitely come in handy.
  • You know how valuable the right expert can be. Healthcare professionals and science experts aren’t there to make the About Us page look impressive. The right expert can build trust, strengthen credibility, and make people pay attention. You know how to help find, nurture, and manage those relationships while keeping advisory agreements, expert content, and ongoing initiatives moving forward.
  • You know how to make campaigns measurable. UTMs, GA4, attribution, affiliate links, conversion paths, dashboards—you want the plumbing in place before anyone hits publish. If a campaign launches and nobody can tell where the sales came from, you start developing an eye twitch. You can build clean tracking systems, spot reporting holes, and make sure every partnership has a clear line of sight to performance.
  • You know how to manage a budget. You know when a creator is worth the fee, when the numbers don’t stack up, and when it’s time to negotiate harder, change the deal, or walk away. You pity the fools who throw five figures at an influencer because “their engagement looks really strong.”
  • You know how to get campaigns over the finish line. Brief → negotiation → content → compliance → approvals → launch → tracking → reporting → optimization. You’ve managed the whole thing before. You can keep multiple campaigns moving at once, chase down loose ends without becoming everyone’s least favourite Slack notification, and make sure things actually launch on time.
  • You keep an eye on the competition. Which creators are competitors using? What offers are they testing? What messages keep showing up? Who seems to be everywhere all of a sudden? You notice the patterns, find the gaps, and turn what you learn into better ideas for us. Not a 53-slide competitor deck that gets presented once and then quietly dies in Google Drive.
  • You’re good at getting different people to work together. Creative, paid media, compliance, analytics, external partners—you can keep everyone aligned without turning every decision into a meeting about whether we need another meeting. You communicate clearly, keep momentum high, and generally make complicated things feel less complicated.
  • You’ve got the experience to prove you can do all of the above. We’re looking for 3+ years in influencer marketing, affiliate management, partnerships, creator growth, or a similar role. Bonus points if you’ve worked in health, wellness, supplements, D2C, eCommerce, women’s health, or another category where credibility matters just as much as conversion.

Now, time to be honest… is this really you?

If you’re nodding your head and already thinking about which partners, systems, and campaign levers you’d tackle first, then we can’t wait to meet you.

Other Qualities You’ll Need

At AlgaeCal, we’re going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:

  • You’re humble–you put the team and others’ needs ahead of your own
  • You’re hungry to learn more
  • You’re people-smart–in the sense that you’re a great teammate

The truth is, if you don’t have these qualities, you won’t last long at AlgaeCal. So if you’re missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.

What Will You Earn?

We believe in rewarding top talent. So let’s talk about salary once we’ve had the chance to get to know you better. Rest assured, we’re generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skills and experience, we’ll make sure the compensation reflects that.

You’ll also enjoy the following benefits:

  • A generous healthcare package
  • Monthly team events and activities
  • Flexible Stat Holidays with the option to bank days for later use
  • Weekly team lunches
  • Casual dress code
  • Incredible dog-friendly, Yaletown office one block from SkyTrain

And above all, you’ll join a team that you’ll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many people’s lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.

How To Apply

So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal?

Job opportunities like this don’t come along often, and we’ve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future Senior Influencer and Partnerships Specialist is the real deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application:

If this sounds like a position for you, please respond to this advertisement with your resume and cover letter. Please read carefully:

1. Write a cover letter addressing:

Why are you the best Senior Influencer and Partnerships Specialist for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements like campaign ROI, ROAS, CAC, incremental sales lift, volume of creators managed, or others that show the impact of your work.

Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here:

What's the toughest challenge you’ve ever overcome in your life? How did you overcome it?

What are the last three books you’ve read?

What do you do for fun?

2. Explain what you’re doing now for a job:

If you have one, explain why you’re looking elsewhere.

3. Upload your cover letter and resume

Ensure that your cover letter and resume are saved and sent as one file.

Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but it’s our way of selecting the best–and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.

Click the “Apply Now” button on this page and upload your cover letter and resume.

Note: Please include your cover letter WITH your resume in one document. Applications without a cover letter will not be read!

About the Company

At Rezilient, we’re redefining what primary care looks like, making it more accessible, seamless, and patient-centered than ever before. Through our innovative CloudClinic model, we combine virtual provider visits with smart, tech-enabled infrastructure to deliver timely, personalized care. By removing traditional barriers to access and continuously expanding our specialty offerings, we’re building a healthcare experience that’s as convenient as it is comprehensive.

About the Role

Rezilient is seeking a People Operations Business Partner to help build and scale the people programs, manager support, and employee experience practices that enable our teams to do their best work. This role will partner closely with leaders across the business to support employee relations, performance management, learning and development, organizational effectiveness, employee engagement, and day-to-day people operations.

Key Responsibilities

Employee Relations and Support

  • Oversee employee relations conversations and investigations with discretion, empathy, and consistency, documenting properly and ensuring every step reflects Rezilient's standards.
  • Serve as a trusted resource for employees across all levels, bringing sound judgment, a steady presence, and a genuine commitment to getting it right.
  • Apply working knowledge of federal and state labor law to employee relations matters, leave administration, and policy interpretation, with particular depth in ADA and FMLA, and actively grow that knowledge as Rezilient expands into new states and markets.
  • Stay current on state-by-state HR practices and requirements, researching proactively as we hire in new geographies and flagging compliance considerations.
  • Set and model the documentation standard for People Ops, building the habits and templates that make thorough, clear ER documentation the default.
  • Lead employee separations and offboarding processes in partnership with the Head of People Operations and alongside hiring managers, ensuring every exit is handled fairly, in line with Rezilient's processes, and with respect for everyone involved.

Performance Management

  • Partner on the launch and execution of company-wide performance management through bi-annual reviews, helping drive the program end to end: design, communication, tooling, timelines, and follow-through.
  • Work with hiring managers to build function- and role-level KPIs that connect directly to the company-wide performance program, translating team-specific needs into consistent, measurable outcomes.
  • Help identify and build out People Ops KPIs that reflect what the team is actually delivering, surfacing gaps, trends, and opportunities before they become blockers.
  • Use data and feedback to spot risks early and bring grounded recommendations forward, acting on what the numbers and the conversations are both saying.

Manager Coaching and Enablement

  • Build trusted, working relationships across every level of the organization, from new managers navigating their first performance conversation to senior leaders and executives thinking through team design and organizational health.
  • Meet managers where they are, knowing a new manager may need different support than a seasoned director or a senior leader. This role requires the range to show up effectively for all of them.
  • Coach managers on the fundamentals: giving feedback, handling performance conversations, building accountability, and creating the conditions where people do their best work.
  • Proactively reduce uncertainty for managers, functions, and employees, making sure people have clarity on where things stand, what to expect, and how to move through it.
  • Help embed Rezilient's culture into how managers lead every day, not just in big moments or formal programs, but in the small, consistent choices that actually shape team experience.
  • Design and continuously improve manager enablement resources, frameworks, templates, and guides that make strong leadership more accessible and more repeatable across every level.
  • Grow into a subject matter expert on Rezilient's business model, including our clinical care delivery, operational structure, and growth strategy, so that your People Ops guidance is always grounded in how our business actually works, not just general HR best practice.

People Ops Programs and Infrastructure

  • Own leave policy administration end to end, fielding requests, tracking usage, staying current on federal and state requirements, and ensuring managers and employees have clear guidance when they need it.
  • Partner on onboarding program design and execution, ensuring company-wide consistency while allowing for function- and team-level customization that makes the experience feel relevant from day one.
  • Identify L&D needs, tools, and content that match where Rezilient is right now, connecting learning back to mission, values, performance outcomes, and where the business is headed.
  • Help design, document, and improve scalable People Ops processes, policies, and templates that hold up as the company grows, and flag proactively when something needs a rebuild rather than a patch.

Knowledge Management and Cross-Functional Work

  • Co-own the Notion knowledge base with the Operations function, keeping content clear, current, and organized so employees, managers, and leaders can find what they need and trust what they find.
  • Take ownership of the knowledge base's scalability, proactively identifying where content is outdated, missing, or not holding up as the team and company grow.
  • Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Operations, Clinical, Growth, Business Services, and TA on People work that touches other functions, showing up as a reliable and informed partner.
  • Support change management as Rezilient scales, helping the organization absorb and move through change without losing momentum or cultural grounding.

Requirements

  • 7+ years in People Operations, HR Business Partnering, employee relations, or a closely related role.
  • Experience in a high-growth startup, healthcare, digital health, or multi-site operations environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of core HR: employee relations, performance management, onboarding, offboarding, policy creation, and manager coaching.
  • Ability to handle sensitive matters with discretion, empathy, fairness, and sound judgment, and to document them properly.
  • Experience designing or significantly improving People Ops programs rather than just running existing ones.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills across employees, managers, and senior leaders.
  • Highly organized, execution-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Comfortable working in HR systems, people platforms, documentation tools, and AI-enabled tools.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate ambiguous situations into clear, actionable next steps.
  • Familiarity with Notion or similar knowledge management tools used as an operational backbone.
  • Thrives working alongside a small team where you are both building and executing at the same time.

Benefits

At Rezilient Health, we're on a mission to make humane healthcare truly abundant, and we invest in the people who make that possible. This is a high-impact role where your ideas directly shape how care is delivered, within a supportive, collaborative, and diverse team that believes healthcare is fundamentally a human experience. We back that commitment with a robust total rewards package:

  • Meaningful ownership through stock options, allowing you to share directly in the value you help create as we grow
  • Competitive base compensation
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage options, with Rezilient contributing toward your premiums
  • Complimentary access to Rezilient's clinical programs for you and your household members, the same connected care we deliver to our patients
  • 401(k) retirement plan to support your long-term financial well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off, so you can recharge without counting days
  • Dedicated Paid Sick Leave, separate from your FTO, for when health needs come first
  • 11 paid company holidays each year
  • Paid family leave to support you through life's biggest moments
  • Optional ancillary benefits, including life insurance, disability coverage, and a Health Savings Account (HSA)

ABOUT GENERATION:

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have a 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. About Real Geeks

Real Geeks is a leading real estate technology company helping agents and teams build their

brands, generate leads, nurture relationships, and grow their businesses.

Our integrated platform combines IDX websites, CRM, marketing automation, AI-powered tools,

and lead generation solutions to help real estate professionals build stronger, more sustainable

businesses.

We're a relatively small, fast-moving technology company with ambitious goals. We're looking

for a marketing leader who can help us sharpen our positioning, elevate our brand, and

accelerate growth.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a strategic, hands-on marketing leader to own and drive our marketing

strategy.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who knows how to turn great positioning into

compelling campaigns, brand awareness into demand, product innovation into customer

adoption, and marketing investments into measurable business results.

You'll lead a small team of marketing professionals and work closely with our Sales, Product,

and Training teams to ensure our messaging, campaigns, product launches, and customer

experience are aligned.

We don't need someone who simply manages marketing activities. We need a driver, a

changemaker, and a builder. Someone who challenges the status quo, brings fresh ideas, sets

a clear direction, and inspires others to execute.

You'll need to think strategically, act decisively, and be comfortable getting into the details. We're

a lean organization, and everyone — including our leaders — rolls up their sleeves when

needed.

What You'll Own

Marketing Strategy & Positioning

  • Develop and own a comprehensive marketing strategy aligned with company objectives and revenue goals.
  • Define and sharpen our brand positioning, differentiation, value propositions, and messaging across key customer segments.
  • Translate market insights, customer needs, and competitive intelligence into clear marketing priorities.
  • Build integrated marketing plans that connect brand awareness, organic growth, demand generation, product marketing, and customer engagement.
  • Establish a consistent, compelling brand narrative across all marketing channels and customer touchpoints.

Team Leadership & Execution

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of three marketing professionals, creating clarity around priorities, ownership, and expectations.
  • Build a focused, accountable, high-performing team that works collaboratively toward shared goals.
  • Create a culture of ownership, creativity, continuous improvement, and results.
  • Establish effective planning and execution processes so that every major initiative has a clear what, why, who, when, and definition of success.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly, manage resources effectively, and keep the team focused on the work that matters most.
  • Step in and execute when needed. This is a hands-on leadership role, not one for someone who prefers to delegate everything.

Budget Management, Data & Performance

  • Own the overall marketing budget, ensuring investments align with company strategy, priorities, and revenue objectives.
  • Define and own marketing KPIs, performance dashboards, and reporting.
  • Use data to guide strategy, prioritize investments, evaluate results, and continuously optimize performance.
  • Build a culture where decisions are grounded in customer insights, market evidence, and measurable outcomes.
  • Ensure initiatives begin with clear objectives, success metrics, owners, timelines, and execution plans.
  • Regularly assess what's working, what's not, and where to double down, adjust, or stop.

Organic Growth & Demand Generation

  • Balance long-term brand building with near-term lead generation and revenue opportunities.
  • Develop integrated campaigns across organic, paid, email, social, events, and other channels that support both new customer acquisition and existing customer engagement and expansion revenue.
  • Lead organic growth initiatives that expand Real Geeks' visibility, authority and market position, including content marketing, SEO/AEO/GEO strategy, social media, partnerships, and thought leadership.
  • Provide strategic direction and oversight for demand generation, empowering the Demand Generation Manager to own channel strategy, paid media allocation, and campaign optimization within agreed budgets and goals.
  • Ensure the Marketing and Sales teams are aligned on sales goals and underlying metrics, including demand gen spend, lead volume and conversion rates
  • Ensure the Sales team has a predictable pipeline of qualified leads that enable them to achieve or exceed sales targets.
  • Partner with the Sales team on strategies to improve conversion throughout the lead funnel.
  • Establish clear accountability for campaign performance, lead quality, pipeline contribution, and marketing ROI.

Product Marketing & Launches

  • Own the marketing strategy for launching new products, features, and enhancements.
  • Ensure product innovation translates into clear, differentiated customer value and compelling reasons to choose Real Geeks.
  • Partner closely with Product, Sales, and Training to develop compelling positioning, messaging, and launch plans, and ensure consistency in messaging and tactics across internal and external channels.
  • Develop integrated launch campaigns to drive awareness, interest, and adoption of new and existing products among prospects and customers.

What We're Looking For

Experience & Expertise

  • Significant experience in B2B marketing, ideally in SaaS, technology, or a subscription-based business.
  • Proven success developing marketing strategies, positioning products, and building brand awareness in competitive markets.
  • Experience leading product marketing, go-to-market strategies, and successful product or feature launches.
  • Deep understanding of organic growth, content marketing, SEO, AI search trends, and modern demand generation.
  • Experience owning marketing budgets and managing investments against measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience leading small, high-performing marketing teams and managing cross-functional initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of the relationship between marketing, sales pipeline, customer acquisition, product adoption, and revenue.
  • Excellent analytical skills and experience using data, attribution, and performance metrics to inform decisions.
  • Exceptional communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience in real estate technology or the real estate industry is strongly preferred.

Leadership & Mindset

We're particularly interested in how you work, not just what you've done.

  • You're a driver. You create momentum, challenge assumptions, make decisions, and move things forward.
  • You're a strategic thinker. You see the big picture, understand the business, and connect marketing activities to meaningful outcomes.
  • You're a builder and a changemaker. You thrive on improving what's already there, introducing better ways of working, and creating something stronger.
  • You're collaborative. You build strong relationships across teams, welcome different perspectives, and know that great marketing doesn't happen in a silo.
  • You're scrappy and resourceful. You know how to make a big impact with a small team and limited resources.
  • You're hands-on. You're equally comfortable developing a strategy, reviewing campaign data, refining messaging, or jumping in to help execute.
  • You're data-obsessed. You ask questions, test assumptions, measure results, and make evidence-based decisions.
  • You're focused and organized. You don't confuse activity with progress. You bring structure, discipline, and accountability to execution.
  • You're an empowering leader. You set clear goals and guardrails, give your team ownership of their areas of expertise, and hold people accountable for outcomes without micromanaging.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means:

  • Real Geeks has a clear, differentiated market position and a consistent, compelling brand story.
  • Brand awareness and organic visibility are growing among our target customers.
  • Marketing is generating an increasing volume of qualified inbound leads and contributing measurably to sales pipeline and revenue.

  • Sales, Marketing, Product, and Training are closely aligned around messaging, priorities, and go-to-market initiatives.
  • The marketing team is focused, accountable, collaborative, and consistently delivering high-impact work.
  • Marketing investments are managed responsibly, with clear ownership of channel-level decisions and measurable returns.
  • Marketing decisions are guided by clear plans, meaningful metrics, and continuous learning.

What We Offer
