This Role Is Not for You If:

  • You need step-by-step direction to know what to do next
  • You fix the symptom and move on without asking why
  • You treat documentation as someone else's responsibility
  • You're comfortable letting a ticket sit without following through
  • Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus
  • You're looking for a stable, low-pressure remote job with a predictable routine

There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.

Responsibilities:

  • What You'll Do
  • You'll walk into a fast-moving MSP environment where clients depend on you and junior engineers look to you. Your job isn't just to solve the problem in front of you — it's to make sure the team and the environment are better because you were there.
  • That looks like:
    • Serving as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex issues across servers, networks, cloud platforms, and endpoint security — diagnosing root causes, not patching symptoms
    • Proactively auditing client environments to catch risks, vulnerabilities, and inefficiencies before they become incidents
    • Building monitoring, alerting, and automation that catches problems early — or eliminates them entirely
    • Leading infrastructure projects end-to-end — cloud migrations, M365 deployments, network overhauls, security implementations — from scoping through delivery
    • Writing and maintaining PowerShell scripts that turn repetitive manual tasks into automated, reliable processes
    • Mentoring junior engineers so that when they come to you stuck, they leave sharper and more capable — not more dependent
    • Communicating clearly with clients and vendors — technical enough to be credible, human enough to build trust
    • Documenting everything you touch so clearly that others can build on it without asking you a single question

Requirements

    • 5+ years of IT experience, minimum 2 in an MSP or multi-client environment — you've seen enough environments to know what good looks like
    • Deep proficiency in Windows Server (2016–2022), Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, Group Policy, and virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V) — you don't need to look up the basics
    • Strong networking fundamentals — routing, switching, VLANs, firewall management (SonicWall, Fortinet, or Meraki); you can trace a problem through the stack
    • Solid Microsoft 365 and Azure experience (AZ-104 level or equivalent) — you know the platform well enough to administer, troubleshoot, and advise clients on it
    • PowerShell scripting proficiency — you write scripts that work, that others can read, and that solve real operational problems
    • Hands-on experience with RMM and PSA platforms (Datto, HaloPSA, NinjaRMM, or equivalent) — you know how to use your tools, not just log into them
    • VOIP support experience (3CX or similar) — you can configure, troubleshoot, and advise without escalating
    • Strong diagnostic skills — you find root causes, not just the closest available fix
    • Natural mentor — you make the engineers around you better without making them dependent on you
    • Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there
    • Honest communicator — you say what's happening clearly and on time, even when the update isn't good news
    • Long-term mindset — you want to grow with a company, not job-hop

How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)

We're honest about how we work with new team members.

In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand client environments, our standards, our tools, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.

As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape their work, their tools, and their clients' environments.

We don't want to over-direct people who don't need it. But we also don't believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.

What Success Looks Like

At three months: You've taken full ownership of your client environments. Escalations from junior engineers are getting cleaner answers — and fewer of them. You know where the gaps are and you've already started closing them.

At six months: Recurring issues in your client environments are measurably down — because you automated them away, not just resolved them faster. Your documentation and scripts are becoming what the team reaches for first.

At twelve months: Clients notice the quality difference. The "this issue again?" moments have dropped significantly. Junior engineers are visibly sharper from working with you. You've shaped how we operate — and RemotePro.ph is investing in your next step.

How We Work

We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it. There's real work to be done — clients depend on us — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. That's how we find the right path. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.

We're a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That's part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the automations, processes, and systems that make us better as we grow.

Job Description:

Position Purpose

The Inventory Coordinator supports inventory and logistics operations by ensuring shipments, delivery milestones, and inventory transactions are recorded accurately and on time.

This role is responsible for monitoring shipment activity, maintaining accurate records in OTM and NetSuite, supporting inbound and outbound logistics processes, and helping ensure compliance with Nextracker’s procedures, Incoterms, title-transfer requirements, and audit controls.

The coordinator will work closely with Inventory, Logistics Operations, OTM support, internal business teams, and freight forwarders/3PL partners to resolve discrepancies, improve shipment visibility, and support timely IR/IF transactions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review shipments for missing, delayed, or incorrect OTM milestones.
  • Compare freight forwarder delivery records with OTM data.
  • Coordinate with Logistics Operations to obtain shipment schedules, pickup confirmations, delivery information, and supporting documentation.
  • Follow up with freight forwarders, in coordination with Logistics Operations, to ensure all required milestones are updated accurately and on time.
  • Coordinate with the OTM team to resolve system issues, missing milestones, and transaction exceptions.
  • Maintain an open-issue tracker and follow up through resolution.
  • Provide regular status updates and escalate overdue or high-risk issues.
  • Support month-end and quarter-end reconciliation activities.
  • Identify shipments that may impact inventory receipts, fulfillments, revenue transactions, payment processing, audit compliance, or delivery visibility.
  • Process inventory receipts and fulfillments in NetSuite in accordance with Incoterms, title-transfer, and risk-of-loss requirements.
  • Maintain accurate and timely inventory transaction records in NetSuite.
  • Validate shipment, ASN, receipt, and fulfillment data for completeness and accuracy.
  • Support SOX and other audit requirements by maintaining appropriate documentation and audit trails.
  • Collaborate with 3PL partners and internal teams to improve data accuracy, service levels, and operational performance.
  • Prepare and maintain Excel, Power BI, and other operational reports.
  • Support process improvements and other special projects assigned by management.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Looking for 5+yrs experiences
  • Prior experience in logistics, inventory management, supply chain operations, or a related field is preferred but not required. Entry-level candidates who are eager to learn, highly detail-oriented, analytical, and strong problem-solvers are encouraged to apply.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data-reconciliation skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience with ERP and transportation management systems; NetSuite and OTM experience is preferred.
  • Strong Excel skills; experience with Power BI and reporting tools is preferred.
  • Understanding of global logistics, 3PL operations, Incoterms, and title-transfer concepts is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with teams across different time zones.
  • Knowledge of logistics processes and continuous improvement practices.

Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.

Department Overview

WDTech is Walker & Dunlop’s technology organization, bringing together product, design, engineering, data, infrastructure, information security, and operations to build, operate, and protect the technology that powers our business.

You will have the opportunity to apply modern technology and AI within one of the nation’s leading commercial real estate finance and advisory services firms. W&D’s market position, deep industry expertise, client relationships, and proprietary data provide a strong foundation for solving meaningful business problems, improving how we work and serve our clients, and creating new sources of competitive advantage.

Across WDTech, we combine business context with disciplined technology practices and a high standard for security, resilience, and quality. The Impact You Will Have

As the VP, Analytics, Data Science & AI Data Enablement at Walker & Dunlop (W&D), you will lead the company's Business Intelligence, Analytics, and Data Science functions while advancing how AI is used to analyze data and inform business decisions.

In this role, you will set the strategy for how W&D turns data into actionable insights, accelerates delivery, and expands access to trusted information across the organization. You will lead the development of modern analytics capabilities, establish consistent data definitions and governance standards, and enable business users and AI tools to access and interpret data reliably. By connecting analytics strategy with business priorities, you will help ensure that data-driven insights are timely, consistent, and accessible to the people and systems that depend on them.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Set the vision and develop a phased roadmap for business intelligence, analytics, data science, and AI-assisted analysis aligned with W&D's strategic priorities.
  • Establish an operating model for partnering with business lines to identify needs, prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, and deliver high-value analytics solutions.
  • Define and maintain standards for analytical quality, key performance indicators (KPIs), business metrics, and reporting consistency across the organization.
  • Improve the speed and quality of analytics delivery by establishing performance targets, measuring results, and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Oversee the development and delivery of business intelligence solutions, advanced analytics, and predictive models that support decision-making across capital markets, credit risk, servicing, sales, and other business functions.

  • Lead the development and maintenance of shared business definitions, metrics, and semantic frameworks to ensure consistent interpretation of data across reporting, analytics, and AI applications.
  • Make trusted business context and data definitions accessible to analysts, business users, and AI tools to support consistent and reliable analytical results.
  • Partner with AI Enablement, Data Engineering, and Product leaders to maintain the data structures, knowledge resources, and retrieval approaches needed to support AI-assisted analysis.
  • Expand shared data definitions and analytical capabilities based on business priorities, established reporting needs, and evolving demand.
  • Lead, coach, and develop analytics and data science leaders and their teams, establishing hiring and development plans aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Provide technical direction and oversight by reviewing analytical models, queries, dashboards, and methodologies to ensure quality and effectiveness.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field required; master's degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, applied data science, or a related field, including at least 7 years of experience leading multiple teams.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing analytics strategies aligned with business priorities and measurable organizational outcomes.
  • Proven ability to improve analytics delivery, operational efficiency, and analytical quality.
  • Experience implementing machine learning models, predictive analytics, and AI-assisted analysis in production environments.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing analytics and data science teams.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms, preferably AWS, and cloud analytical databases such as Amazon Redshift or Snowflake.
  • Experience in commercial real estate, financial services, or capital markets preferred.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of statistical analysis, machine learning, and data modeling, with the ability to evaluate analytical quality and provide technical direction.
  • Working knowledge of business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau, as well as SQL and Python.
  • Practical understanding of modern AI analysis tools, their applications, and responsible practices for implementation and use.
  • Strong knowledge of data governance, data quality, access controls, and analytical standards.
  • Understanding of semantic layers, metric definitions, and business context required to support consistent reporting and AI-assisted analysis.
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business priorities into actionable analytics initiatives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts and technical trade-offs to executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
  • Strong leadership and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, build partnerships, and collaborate across business functions.
  • Ability to balance long-term strategic planning with technical oversight, operational priorities, and timely execution.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a results-oriented approach and commitment to delivering measurable business value.
  • Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes
  • Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders

    - 401(k) + match

﻿Position Summary

The E-commerce Development Specialist is responsible for developing, managing, optimizing, and continuously improving Ultra Football's online store to deliver an exceptional shopping experience for customers.

The role focuses on driving online sales, improving website functionality, enhancing customer engagement, and ensuring the effective presentation of products across the website. This position works closely with the merchandising, marketing, inventory, customer service, and IT teams to support the company's digital growth and commercial objectives.

For Ultra Football, the role should be particularly focused on the online football retail experience, including football jerseys, boots, training apparel, equipment, accessories, and other football-related products.

Key Responsibilities

1. Website Development & Management

  • Manage, maintain, and continuously improve the Ultra Football e-commerce website.
  • Ensure website functionality, navigation, product pages, and shopping cart features operate efficiently.
  • Identify website issues, coordinate technical fixes, and implement improvements to enhance user experience.
  • Work with developers and IT teams to implement new website features, integrations, and enhancements.
  • Ensure the website is mobile-responsive, user-friendly, secure, and optimized for performance.
  • Monitor website speed, functionality, accessibility, and overall customer experience.

2. Product & Content Management

  • Manage product listings, product descriptions, images, pricing, specifications, sizes, colours, and stock availability.

  • Create and maintain product collections, landing pages, promotional banners, and featured product sections.
  • Coordinate product launches and updates for new football boots, jerseys, teamwear, apparel, and accessories.
  • Ensure product pages are optimized for search engines and customer conversion.
  • Collaborate with the merchandising and inventory teams to ensure product information and stock levels are accurate.

3. E-commerce Strategy & Sales Optimization

  • Develop and implement strategies to increase online sales, website traffic, and customer conversion rates.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer shopping journey and reduce cart abandonment.
  • Monitor sales performance and recommend initiatives to improve revenue and profitability.
  • Optimize product recommendations, cross-selling, upselling, and promotional campaigns.
  • Support seasonal campaigns, major football tournaments, new product releases, and exclusive product drops.
  • Develop strategies to maximize customer engagement and repeat purchases through Ultra Rewards and other loyalty initiatives.

4. SEO & Digital Marketing Support

  • Implement search engine optimization (SEO) strategies to improve organic website visibility.
  • Optimize product titles, descriptions, metadata, URLs, and website content.
  • Coordinate with the marketing team to execute digital campaigns, promotions, and product launches.
  • Ensure website content aligns with advertising campaigns, email marketing, and social media promotions.
  • Monitor website traffic, search rankings, and campaign performance using analytics tools.

5. Website Analytics & Performance Reporting

  • Monitor and analyze e-commerce performance using Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and other reporting tools.
  • Prepare regular reports on:
    • Website traffic and visitor behavior.
    • Online sales and revenue performance.
    • Conversion rates.
    • Average order value (AOV).
    • Cart abandonment rates.
    • Product performance and best-selling items.
    • Customer acquisition and retention.
  • Identify trends, issues, and opportunities through data analysis.
  • Recommend data-driven improvements to increase website performance and sales.

6. E-commerce Operations & Integration

  • Coordinate with warehouse, inventory, customer service, and logistics teams to ensure smooth online order fulfillment.
  • Monitor product availability and inventory synchronization between online and physical stores.
  • Support online ordering, payment gateway, shipping, returns, and click-and-collect functionality.
  • Ensure a seamless integration between the website and relevant third-party applications and platforms.
  • Assist in troubleshooting order processing, payment, checkout, and website-related issues.
  • Ensure accurate implementation of website promotions, discount codes, and loyalty rewards.

7. Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Research emerging e-commerce technologies, tools, and industry trends.
  • Conduct regular website audits and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Perform A/B testing on website layouts, landing pages, product presentations, and checkout processes.
  • Recommend innovative features to enhance customer experience and increase sales.
  • Stay updated with e-commerce best practices, digital retail trends, and competitor activities.

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Marketing, E-commerce, or a related field.

Work Experience

  • At least 2–4 years of experience in e-commerce management, website development, or digital commerce operations.

Technical Skills

A UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY– GreenGen is tackling climate change for the world’s leading investors. As part of our team, you will work collaboratively across the company and directly with clients to build and facilitate strategies that reduce energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions, advancing them towards a net-zero carbon world. Share your passion for solving the world’s most challenging issues at a place where you can effect real change that creates a more sustainable future – energize your career at GreenGen! Join our team of outstanding professionals who are focused on performance, thought leadership, innovation, and the power of ideas that come from a diverse and inclusive workforce where every employee believes in our mission and contributes to our success. GreenGen offers an opportunity to design and enhance a rewarding and fulfilling career. We are dedicated to growth creating the success of our employees through competitive base salary, incentives, education, and health and retirement benefits.

WHO WE ARE– Founded in 2011, GreenGen is an award-winning global leader assisting the world’s leading investors with executing net-zero carbon strategies to drive financial outcomes and decarbonize their assets. Our unique approach to integrating energy, capital markets, real estate, and technology helps us support our clients across diverse asset portfolios. We believe that investing in climate is profitable, and all team members have the responsibility to help our clients meet their sustainability goals while creating both financial and climate outcomes.

POSITION SCOPE– This is an entry-level position suited to a person with 0-2 years of relevant experience looking to gain access to the exciting energy efficiency/green industry. The Associate position is an integral role in our pre-assessment, solutions design, solutions implementation, and measurement and verification process. Training and support will be provided to build skills quickly in this exciting, growing, global industry; however, it is expected that the right person will take initiative to go above and beyond to learn the business.

Specific attention to detail is a vital characteristic of the position as Associates are held accountable for providing reports and documentation at the various stages of the project from design through solution implementation and measurement and verification, tracking utility rebate applications, and for communication within the team and to clients when necessary. As an Associate, you will be responsible for:

  • collection and analysis of utility bills and consumption data
  • responding to the team project managers and energy engineers’ requests for research and reporting
  • supporting the project and client needs

Tasks will include utility bill analysis, energy simulation modeling, utility rebate program analysis, ASHRAE Level I and II energy auditing, technology feasibility studies, cost-benefit analysis, building commissioning participation, report generation, energy efficiency research, and project development.

WHAT WE NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, sciences, or other relevant disciplines
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Excel including the use of pivot charts, mathematical functions, statistical functions, and regression analysis
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and PowerPoint
  • Understanding of major building components including HVAC, lighting, and building control systems
  • Basic understanding of building construction and structural design
  • Ability to identify and analyze energy savings opportunities and use Excel-based tools for generating cost and savings estimates for solutions in HVAC, lighting, building controls, and building envelope
  • Ability to read and analyze utility bills including an understanding of common rate structures, tariffs rates, and the ability to differentiate between ‘demand’ and ‘energy’ charges
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work in team environment with minimal supervision

WHAT WE WANT

  • Familiarity with building energy modeling software (eQUEST, Trane TRACE 700, or other relevant modeling software)
  • Understanding of commercial-scale renewable energy and CHP systems, supply-side energy procurement strategies, and demand response
  • Familiarity with a wide variety of commercial energy efficiency rebate programs and rebate application processes

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES

  • Prepare assessment reports for commercial and light industrial facilities that outline key building operating metrics and operating procedures
  • Analyze utility bills and organize energy information into usable charts and graphs in Excel
  • Prepare presentations and marketing materials that show analysis, solution recommendations, and cost and savings estimates in a compelling and concise manner
  • Research new energy efficiency technologies, companies, and products
  • Conduct payback analysis on energy savings measures
  • Present analysis and solutions to multiple levels within client organizations
  • Manage custom and prescriptive rebate application process
  • Perform measurement and verification on solution performance including regression analysis
  • Management of large data sets
  • Travel approximately 5-10% of the time
  • Modifications to our existing Excel-based tools to suit new energy savings analysis needs
  • Perform other duties as assigned

LOCATION– Remote (United States)

GreenGen operates internationally, requiring regular travel; however, GreenGen’s corporate headquarters is located in Bethesda, MD. This position does not require relocation to Bethesda. West Coast preferred.

TRAVEL – Travel to client locations within the US, and possibly South America, Caribbean, and UK will be required for this role up to 15% - 20% of the time

BENEFITS

You will be accountable for all aspects (strategy, roadmap, planning, delivery and support) of the end-to-end digital lifecycle of the Service & Repair and aftermarket product portfolio, and you will directly affect the organization's ability to meet its service, repair turnaround time, quality and cost objectives. You will have significant autonomy, and you will need a high level of strategic and operational judgment to balance competing business priorities and deliver results.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Product vision & strategy Set the vision, strategy and roadmap for the Service & Repair and Aftermarket product portfolio, aligned with Avionics & Electric Power & Propulsion Aftermarket business priorities.
  • End-to-end ownership Act as the technical IT owner for the full repair lifecycle: quotation, repair order induction, inspection and repair execution, materials and spare parts, shipment, invoicing and warranty.

  • Simplify & modernize Standardize and simplify the Service & Repair process across sites and D&S ERP Oracle instances, eliminate technical debt and customizations, and drive cost-out and modernization initiatives, including cloud and ERP transformation.
  • Data-driven decisions Define and track product KPIs (repair turnaround time, on-time delivery, quote cycle time, system availability, customer satisfaction) and use them to prioritize the roadmap and demonstrate value.

  • Executive influence Influence executive-band stakeholders and shape strategy, resource allocation and policy for the area of responsibility.
  • Compliance by design Ensure solutions meet Aerospace quality, regulatory and compliance requirements, including traceability, airworthiness release documentation, export control, cybersecurity (CMMC, UK Cyber Essentials, etc.) and SOX.

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
  • Experience with Service & Repair / MRO, aftermarket or supply chain business processes.

  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.

jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

​Senior Specialist Account Executive, Data 360 & Agentforce


Team: Data 360 Specialist Sales | Location: [Germany / remote] | Languages: German and English

​The Experience

Make an impact on how organizations run
Data and AI are changing how every organization works, and this is where it’s happening. Leaders everywhere are asking how to become an agentic enterprise, where AI agents work alongside people to serve customers, solve problems, and take action in real time. Most are held back by the same obstacle: their customer data is scattered, inconsistent, and not ready for AI.

Data 360 unifies customer data in real time. Agentforce turns that data into AI agents that act for customers and employees. This is no longer a bet on the future. In Salesforce’s second quarter of fiscal 2027, Agentforce and Data 360 annual recurring revenue reached nearly $3.9 billion, up over 210% year over year. That makes them the fastest-growing part of Salesforce and the core of its growth path. They are proven at scale with world-leading organizations: Siemens uses Data 360 to power its SiePortal customer platform, AT&T uses Agentforce, Data 360 and MuleSoft to give retail experts real-time customer context, and L’Oréal uses Service Cloud and Data 360 to cut case handling time by 64% for advisors across 25 brands. Salesforce Delivers Record Second Quarter Fiscal 2027

Demand is strong and growing fast, and so is the opportunity to shape it. As a specialist, you own the growth of Data 360 and Agentforce in your assigned segment. You close deals, and you also build the market: turning proven use cases into repeatable plays, equipping colleagues to sell, and creating the reference stories that bring in the next customers.

Your impact will show up in four places:

  • On customers: you help them move from AI experiments to agents that deliver measurable results.
  • On the market: your wins become the reference stories others follow.
  • On colleagues: you equip account teams to spot and sell the opportunity.
  • On your career: high visibility and responsibility, in the fastest-growing part of Salesforce and at the center of one of the biggest shifts in business technology.


What you’ll ​Actually Be Doing

Win business

  • Identify, qualify, and close Data 360 and Agentforce opportunities, with annual contract value (ACV) as your core target.
  • Support and, where it makes sense, lead deals together with account teams, solution engineers, product specialists, and partners.
  • Lead discovery that uncovers real business problems, then judge honestly whether and how Data 360 can solve them.
  • Build clear business cases that link our solutions to measurable outcomes.
  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals through negotiation and close.

Grow your segment

  • Analyze ACV, pipeline, and pipeline generation for your segment, spot the gaps, and plan and carry out fixes.
  • Plan and run events and campaigns that generate pipeline and move deals forward.
  • Enable account executives with training, talk tracks, and coaching so they can spot and sell Data 360 opportunities.
  • Create and maintain selling assets such as case studies, knowledge bases, and customer stories.
  • Turn customer wins into reference stories and proven use cases into repeatable plays for your segment.
  • Share your expertise with audiences at company events, customer seminars, or other formats that suit your strengths.
  • Align with sales leaders at all levels on priorities and plans for your segment.

​Y​ou're Our Person If...

We hire for what you can do, not where or how you learned it. You don’t need every skill listed here. Tell us where you’re strongest.

Selling complex solutions

  • You can run a structured process for high-value, multi-stakeholder deals, from qualification through negotiation to close.
  • You can sell solutions customers may not yet see as urgent by connecting them to a business problem, rather than selling from a catalog.
  • You can show results against targets, in whatever context you’ve worked (enterprise, commercial, partner-led, or another model).

Analytical and strategic thinking

  • You break problems into parts, prioritize, and take action.
  • You read numbers such as pipeline, conversion, and revenue, and turn them into a plan.
  • You think about growth over the mid to long term, not just this quarter.

Ownership and adaptability

  • You take ownership of a goal and lead without needing formal authority.
  • You change your approach quickly when something isn’t working.
  • You thrive in a fast-growing market where products, competitors, and playbooks evolve every quarter.

Discovery and storytelling

  • You lead discovery conversations that surface needs customers hadn’t yet put into words.
  • You tell persuasive, evidence-based stories to both technical and business audiences.

Technical fluency

  • You understand how modern data platforms work (for example, cloud data warehouses, data lakes, customer data platforms, integration, and BI tools) well enough to hold credible conversations with technical buyers.
  • You can explain data and AI concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • You’re curious about AI agents and how they change the way businesses operate.

Collaboration and communication

  • You work well across teams and bring others along, including by teaching and enabling them.
  • You communicate and negotiate clearly in business-level German and English.


​Even Better If...

  • Experience selling or working with customer data platforms, data warehouses, data lakes, analytics, or AI products
  • Experience scaling a fast-growing product or offering
  • Familiarity with the Salesforce platform, Tableau, Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery
  • Experience working with partners and system integrators

Where your skills can come from

There’s no required degree, number of years, or job title. You might have built these skills in:

  • Sales, consulting, or customer-facing technical roles
  • Product, marketing, or business development roles that owned growth for a market or segment
  • Data, analytics, or engineering roles that moved toward customers
  • Entrepreneurship, partnerships, or customer success
  • Self-study, certifications, bootcamps, military service, or a career change

If you can show you can do the work, we want to hear from you, and we want to see the impact you can make here.


How we’ll evaluate you

We assess skills directly, and every candidate goes through the same steps:

  • A conversation about your background and motivation
  • A practical exercise with two parts to choose from or combine: a mock discovery call or business-case presentation, and a short segment-growth plan based on sample pipeline data
  • A structured interview with the team, scored against the same skills criteria
  • A conversation on how you collaborate and what support you need to succeed

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

We warmly invite applications from individuals with a severe disability status (Schwerbehinderung). Salesforce is committed to equality and creating a workplace that reflects society. We set ambitious goals for representation, emphasize accessibility and inclusion, and continuously learn and improve. Learn more about our inclusion initiatives here ( In 2019, Salesforce joined The Valuable 500 to champion disability inclusion in business leadership.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: Patent Data Specialist (Enrichment Quality & AI Readiness) Do you enjoy working hands-on with messy patent data, using SQL, Python and AI tools?
jobs.description:
Patent Data Specialist (Enrichment Quality & AI Readiness)

Do you enjoy working hands-on with messy patent data, using SQL, Python and AI tools?

Do you revel in finding the root cause of an error, then making sure it never happens again?

Come join us and help build the world's most trusted patent data, ready for the AI that professionals worldwide rely on.

About the team:


LexisNexis Intellectual Property, part of RELX, helps the world's innovators, IP professionals, law firms, and investors understand patents: their own, their competitors', and those of the companies they are assessing. Our products, including PatentSight+, IPlytics and TotalPatent One, and the patent data we deliver directly into customers' own systems, inform decisions on R&D investment, licensing, litigation, M&A and competitive strategy.

Every one of those decisions rests on the same foundation: patent data that is grouped, attributed, and kept up to date correctly. We are looking for someone who wants to help get that foundation right.

About the role:


Patent data is hard for people and machines alike. One invention can be filed in dozens of countries under different numbers and rules; one company can hold patents under many names, subsidiaries, and spellings; and whether a patent is still alive depends on events spread across years and jurisdictions. Any data or AI system built on top is only as good as the answers to a few basic questions. Which filings belong to the same family? Who really owns a patent once subsidiaries, acquisitions and spelling variants are untangled? Is a patent still in force, and do we know this for every country we are interested in? A single wrongly grouped family or misattributed owner can quietly change how a customer sees a competitor.

In this role, you will work alongside senior patent data experts to define what correct looks like for these foundations, test our data against it, and track down why things go wrong. It is a rare chance to combine patent knowledge with hands-on data work, and to grow into a recognised expert in an area that underpins everything we do.

Key Responsibilities:


  • Work with our senior patent data experts to define and maintain governed quality standards and acceptance criteria for patent families, ownership, legal status, and coverage, including how to handle tricky edge cases.
  • Build and maintain versioned test sets and worked examples, such as correctly grouped families or correctly resolved owners, that engineering teams build closed-loop evaluations on, so data quality is checked automatically and continuously.
  • Analyse our data to find quality problems, investigate their root causes with engineering teams, recommend fixes, and help design checks so they do not recur.
  • Lead smaller quality-improvement projects end to end, with support from senior colleagues.
  • Assess the quality of data from new sources and patent authorities before and after it enters our platform.
  • Review the output of automated and AI-assisted enrichment, such as ownership mapping, and feed what you learn back into the standards and evaluations.
  • Document rules and decisions clearly so they can be applied consistently, by people and by automated tools, including agentic workflows.
  • Help resolve data questions raised by product teams and customers, sometimes against tight timelines, and turn recurring ones into reusable guidance.
  • Present findings to colleagues and stakeholders

Requirements:


  • Experience working with patent data or patent information, for example as a patent analyst, patent information specialist, searcher, or in a data role at a patent office, data provider, or IP firm.
  • Understanding of how patent data is structured: families, priority claims, kind codes, legal status, assignees, and the differences between patent authorities.
  • Hands-on data skills: you are comfortable querying and analysing data yourself, for example in SQL, Python, or similar tools.
  • A methodical approach to data quality: spotting anomalies, finding root causes and checking that fixes work.
  • Practical use of AI tools in your own work beyond basic chat, for example AI-assisted data analysis, coding assistants or automated extraction, and an understanding of where automated and AI-based enrichment can go wrong.
  • Precision and care with detail, combined with the judgment to know which problems matter most.
  • Clear written communication: you can explain a data rule or an edge case so others can apply it.

Experience and education.


  • Typically, 2 or more years in patent information, patent analysis, or data roles involving patents or similarly complex data.
  • A degree in a scientific, engineering, technical, information science or related subject, or equivalent practical experience


It would be great if you also have.


  • Experience with company ownership data, corporate hierarchies, or entity resolution
  • Experience with non-English patent data, for example Chinese, Japanese or Korean
  • Familiarity with data modelling, taxonomies, or classification systems
  • Experience with data quality tooling or automated testing of data

You do not need to have worked for a data or software company before. We will help you learn how our platform works; you bring curiosity, rigour, and a feel for patent data.


This role is probably not for you if you'd rather analyse patents for specific end clients than work on the data behind the analysis, if you don't enjoy working hands-on with data, or if you're not keen to use AI tools in your work.

Why Join Us?

You'll help make sure the data behind patent decisions worldwide is right, learning from experienced experts, with the backing of a global group that has been building data, analytics and AI products for many years, and with colleagues who care about getting things right.


In your application


Please tell us briefly about one of the following:

  • A time you found an error in patent data or other complex data: how you spotted it, what caused it, and what you'd put in place to stop it happening again.
  • A time you used an AI tool on a complex data analysis task, or to parse complex data: where it helped, where it got things wrong, and how you checked.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.


· Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

Working for you


We know that your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

  • Generous holiday allowance with the option to buy additional days.
  • Health screening, eye care vouchers, and private medical benefits
  • Wellbeing programs
  • Life assurance
  • Access to a competitive contributory pension scheme
  • Save As You Earn share option scheme.
  • Maternity, paternity, and shared parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Access to employee resource groups with dedicated time to volunteer.
  • Access to extensive learning and development resources
  • Access to employee discounts scheme via Perks at Work

About the business -


At LexisNexis Intellectual Property (LNIP), we believe that whenever a person works on a patent and understands the future trajectory of a specific technology, that person has the potential to fundamentally change how society operates. We are proud to directly support and serve these innovators in their endeavors to better humankind. We enable innovators to accomplish more by helping them make informed decisions, be more productive, comply with regulations, and ultimately achieve superior results. By harnessing the latest advances in machine learning combined with expert analysis, LexisNexis Intellectual Property is disrupting how actionable insight is extracted from patent data. Information can now be accessed with efficiency, accuracy and at a speed that is just not possible by traditional methods. Our overall success is measured by how well we deliver these results

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.

Project Highlights

  • Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
  • Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
  • Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All contributors are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

What this project involves

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
  • Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

jobs.excerpt: About usAt Koltin, we’re redesigning the way we care for our moms, dads, and grandparents to help them remain healthy and independent for as long as possible.
jobs.description:
About us

At Koltin, we’re redesigning the way we care for our moms, dads, and grandparents to help them remain healthy and independent for as long as possible.

How do we do it? Through our health memberships, which provide personalized, preventive care to support our members’ long-term well-being.

We are the first company in Mexico offering health memberships that include major medical insurance coverage for older adults-up to 84 years old-backed by BBVA Seguros Salud.

Sobre el rol

Buscamos a nuestro primer(a) Senior Software Engineer - Agents & LLMs. Nuestros miembros nos escriben decenas de miles de veces al mes, muchas veces con miedo, enojo o una historia detrás de la pregunta. Vas a poner agentes en producción para atenderlos, en un dominio donde la respuesta que suena bien y está mal es el peor error posible.

Lo que construyas se vuelve la base de cómo toda la empresa construye con LLMs. Trabajas con producto, data y otros ingenieros, y decides qué construimos, qué compramos y qué ensamblamos.

Generalista con una especialidad fuerte (modelo T): te mueves por todo el stack, con inclinación a LLMs y agentes.

Lo que harás

  • Agentes en producción. Orquestación, tool calling contra nuestros sistemas y el contexto del miembro armado desde múltiples fuentes, sobre WhatsApp y los canales que vengan.
  • La barra de calidad. Evals sobre casos reales y criterios de aceptación definidos antes de lanzar.
  • La plataforma. Observabilidad de LLMs (trazas, costo, latencia, calidad), evals como infraestructura, acceso a modelos agnóstico de proveedor y versionado de prompts, para que otros equipos no empiecen de cero.
  • Seguridad en un entorno regulado. Guardrails, PII, verificación de identidad y human-in-the-loop donde el riesgo lo pide.
  • Proyectos de punta a punta. Vas por el problema detrás del pedido, lo partes en fases y lo llevas a producción con visibilidad de riesgos y decisiones.
  • Subir la vara. ADRs, review, pairing y patrones que otros equipos reusan.

Lo que buscamos

Contratamos por fundamentos, modelos mentales y patrones. El stack se aprende.

  • Debe contar con un recorrido de al menos 5 años en el ciclo completo de desarrollo.
  • Haber llevado LLMs en producción, con al menos un sistema frente a usuarios reales que operaste después del lanzamiento.
  • Tool calling en serio. Diseñaste las tools y sabes qué hacer cuando el modelo llama la equivocada o con los argumentos equivocados.
  • Evals en serio. Datasets de casos reales, LLM-as-judge calibrado contra humanos, regresiones antes de cada cambio de prompt o modelo.
  • Datos sensibles en producción: PII, retención, acuerdos de procesamiento con proveedores.
  • Español nativo o fluido, inglés profesional.

Suma puntos

  • Context engineering: compactación, memoria, context provisioning vía tools.
  • Retrieval agéntico y servidores MCP, más allá de RAG sobre embeddings.
  • Seguridad de agentes: prompt injection directa e indirecta, permisos mínimos por tool, red-teaming.
  • Multi-agente, subagentes y ejecución durable.
  • Costo y latencia: prompt caching, routing entre modelos, structured outputs.
  • Evals online: shadow mode, A/B entre prompts o modelos, feedback humano que vuelve al dataset.
  • WhatsApp, voz, salud o seguros.

Cómo trabajamos

  • Usamos IA para todo, y eres dueño(a) de lo que llega a producción.
  • Self-merge por defecto, con CI, tipos y pruebas como bloqueo. Las decisiones de arquitectura viven en ADRs, y ahí enfocamos el review.
  • Ingeniería se sienta con producto, data y operaciones.

Qué NO es este rol

  • Investigación o fine-tuning: construimos sobre modelos de frontera.
  • Demos: lo que cuenta es lo que se sostiene en producción, medido.

Proceso de selección

  1. Revisión de CV
  2. Entrevista con People (15 min)
  3. Entrevista con Producto (45 min)
  4. Entrevista técnica y live coding con el equipo (1 hora)
  5. Entrevista Hiring Manager (45 min)
  6. Cierre con Founders (30 min)

Cuidamos el tiempo de las personas: te damos retroalimentación en cada etapa y buscamos cerrar el proceso en pocas semanas.

Ciklum is looking for a Expert Logic Design Engineer to join our team full-time in Ukraine.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

We are looking for an Expert Logic Design Engineer to take a leading technical role in the architecture, design, and optimization of next-generation FPGA and ASIC-based control platforms.

Our client is an innovative technology company developing advanced control and measurement systems for quantum computing. Its hardware and software platforms enable precise, real-time control of complex quantum systems, supporting the evolution of quantum computing from individual qubits to large-scale architectures.

This position involves solving challenging digital design problems with extremely demanding timing, latency, and performance requirements. You will work closely with system architects, verification engineers, software developers, and hardware specialists, driving technical decisions and contributing to the development of proprietary digital IP.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architecture, microarchitecture, and RTL implementation of complex, high-performance FPGA/ASIC digital subsystems
  • Design and optimize highly configurable, ultra-low-latency digital logic using SystemVerilog
  • Drive end-to-end digital IP development, from system requirements and architectural trade-offs to RTL implementation and integration
  • Make architectural decisions to optimize timing performance, latency, resource utilization, scalability, and power efficiency
  • Address complex timing closure, clock-domain crossing, synchronization, and critical-path optimization challenges
  • Develop advanced digital processing and control architectures, including signal processing pipelines, waveform generation, and deterministic real-time control
  • Define hardware-software interfaces and collaborate with software and system architecture teams to ensure efficient system integration
  • Work closely with verification engineers to define verification strategies and ensure robust functional coverage
  • Review RTL designs, identify architectural and implementation risks, and provide technical guidance to other engineers
  • Contribute to the evolution of FPGA-based platforms and the development of reusable digital IP for future ASIC implementations
  • Drive engineering best practices, design quality, and technical improvements across the development lifecycle

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience
  • 6+ years of professional experience in complex FPGA or ASIC digital logic design
  • Expert-level proficiency in SystemVerilog RTL design (mandatory)
  • Extensive experience defining digital architectures and microarchitectures for complex hardware systems
  • Proven track record of independently delivering complex digital IP or subsystems from specification to implementation
  • Deep understanding of RTL optimization, logic synthesis, static timing analysis (STA), and timing closure
  • Strong experience optimizing digital designs for deterministic latency, high clock frequencies, resource utilization, and power efficiency
  • Advanced knowledge of synchronous digital design, CDC, clocking architectures, and hardware interfaces
  • Strong understanding of FPGA and/or ASIC development methodologies and implementation constraints
  • Experience with simulation-based verification and debugging of complex digital systems
  • Ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs, resolve challenging technical issues, and guide implementation decisions
  • Strong technical leadership, analytical, and communication skills
  • English proficiency sufficient for effective collaboration within an international engineering team

Desirable:

  • Extensive experience with AMD/Xilinx FPGA architectures, particularly AMD Versal
  • Advanced experience with AMD Vivado, FPGA implementation, and timing closure
  • Familiarity with Synopsys VCS, Siemens Questa, and related verification/debugging tools
  • Experience with ASIC digital IP development and FPGA-to-ASIC design considerations
  • Experience designing complex DSP pipelines, waveform generation engines, or real-time control architectures
  • Deep understanding of deterministic, nanosecond-scale timing and synchronization
  • Experience with high-speed interfaces such as AXI, PCIe, DDR, or proprietary interconnects
  • Experience with performance, area, and power (PPA) optimization
  • Knowledge of Python, Tcl, or other languages used for EDA workflow automation
  • Experience leading technical design reviews or mentoring senior engineers
  • Background in quantum computing, semiconductor development, telecommunications, high-performance instrumentation, or similar advanced technology domains

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Flexibility: Enjoy radical flexibility – work remotely or from an office, your choice
  • Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

As one of Ukraine’s largest IT companies and a top employer recognized by Forbes, we’ve spent over 20 years delivering meaningful tech solutions. We proudly support diverse talent and military veterans, recognizing their unique skills and perspectives they bring to shaping the future.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

jobs.description:
Syniverse is the world’s most connected company. Whether we’re developing the technology that enables intelligent cars to safely react to traffic changes or freeing travelers to explore by keeping their devices online wherever they go, we believe in leading the world forward.Which is why we work with some of the world’s most recognized brands. Eight of the top 10 banks. Four of the top 5 global technology companies. Over 900 communications providers. And how we’re able to provide our incredible talent with an innovative culture and great benefits.

Who We're Looking For

The Machine Learning Operations Consultant enhances the reliability, quality, and automation of Syniverse's ML model development and deployment lifecycle. This role focuses on modernizing Ground Truth (GT) dataset management, strengthening model quality assurance and validation practices, and designing a fully automated model re-training pipeline. The consultant works independently and collaboratively with the Technical Curation (TC) team and other stakeholders, delivering recommendations, designs, and implementation support through workshops, analysis, and documentation. This is an engagement-based, time-and-materials advisory role rather than a traditional full-time position.

-

Some of What You'll Do

Ground Truth (GT) Maintenance

  • Assess current S3-based GT storage and versioning practices.
  • Recommend and design a scalable GT management system supporting seamless, criteria-based (age, source, quality) replacement or updating of records at the record level, while preserving vital historical data needed for domain-specific classifiers.
  • Evaluate migration toward a more structured storage solution (e.g., database-backed repository) to enable advanced filtering, automated quality/validation checks, and access by multiple downstream services.
  • Provide implementation support or a prototype for automated GT refresh and validation processes tailored to the training pipelines.

Model Quality Assurance and Validation

  • Evaluate the current post-training assessment approach, including use of small live-data snapshots and empirical accuracy/degradation thresholds.
  • Design and set up an independent integration testing framework using small, highly curated test datasets targeted to specific product requirements, run alongside the latest production data snapshots.
  • Recommend additional quality checks, including methods to detect and quantify data distribution shifts (data drift) between historical GT blends and live production data.
  • Define procedures and tools for ongoing model quality monitoring post-deployment.

Re-training Automation

  • Design and support implementation of a fully automated monthly re-training pipeline that ingests new material from the TC team and integrates with the updated GT management system.
  • Recommend best practices for handling imbalanced datasets, including evaluation of privacy-aware, LLM-based synthetic data augmentation techniques where appropriate.
  • Select and configure orchestration tooling (e.g., MLflow, Apache Airflow, or a custom system) to establish a formal, well-documented, and reproducible re-training process that reduces reliance on manual curation or any single individual.
  • Integrate GT maintenance and model quality checks into the automated pipeline, and deliver comprehensive documentation, knowledge transfer, and handover.

Program and Communication

  • Participate in regular progress review meetings and provide periodic status updates against the agreed work plan and milestones.
  • Maintain written documentation of issues, proposed solutions, and any agreed changes to scope or priorities.
  • Track and report hours/effort weekly in accordance with time-reporting requirements.

Experience, Education, and Certifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Demonstrated experience designing or operating machine learning data pipelines, including dataset versioning, storage, and validation practices.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud object storage (e.g., AWS S3) and evaluating relational/NoSQL database-backed alternatives.
  • Experience with ML orchestration/automation tools such as MLflow, Apache Airflow, or comparable platforms.
  • Familiarity with model validation techniques, including drift detection and integration/regression testing for ML models.

Additional Requirements:

  • Understanding of supervised learning workflows and Ground Truth dataset management at scale.
  • Familiarity with privacy-conscious, LLM-based synthetic data generation approaches for addressing imbalanced datasets.
  • Working knowledge of data quality and distribution-shift (data drift) monitoring methods.
  • Strong documentation skills, with the ability to produce clear, reproducible technical designs and runbooks.
  • Good communication and analytical skills; able to work independently in an iterative, workshop-driven engagement.
  • Ability to comply with client data-handling protocols and security requirements, including when using personal equipment.

-

Join us as we write a new chapter, guided by world-class leadership. Come be a part of an exciting and growing organization where we offer a competitive total compensation, flexible/remote work and with a leadership team committed to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and transparent organizational culture.

About Us:

Voyant Photonics, is transforming machine perception with a new class of LiDAR devices that are compact enough to fit in the palm of your hand and powerful enough to measure range, velocity, and reflectivity with unparalleled accuracy. By leveraging cutting-edge silicon photonic chips smaller than your fingertip, we deliver sensors that are not only revolutionary in performance but also affordable enough to integrate into any system.

Our technology disrupts the status quo of bulky, expensive, and power-hungry LiDAR systems, making high-precision sensing accessible for widespread adoption in robotics, autonomous vehicles, drones, industrial automation, and beyond. With Voyant, the next generation of machines can see, understand, and navigate the world like never before.

Discover how we’re redefining what’s possible by making real products out of cutting edge research in silicon photonics.

The opportunity:

As a growing company, we’re looking for engineers who want to move fast, solve hard problems, and leave their mark on a foundational technology. You’ll join a mission-driven team at the intersection of product design, silicon photonics and machine perception.

Location: Remote with travel

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architect and develop analog and mixed-signal electronics for compact, high-performance hardware modules, using TIAs, ADCs, precision current sources, and power supplies like LDOs and switching regulators.

  • Own designs from concept through production, including schematic capture, component selection, and PCB layout in collaboration with layout engineers.

  • Ensure signal integrity, power integrity, and EMI/EMC compliance across high-speed and noise-sensitive interfaces.

  • Define and execute bring-up, characterization, and validation plans (e.g., DVT, EVT), with a focus on robustness, repeatability, and manufacturability.

  • Analyze design trade-offs (performance, cost, power, integration complexity) in the context of tightly constrained product architectures.

  • Partner closely with system architects, mechanical engineers, and firmware teams to ensure seamless integration and system-level reliability.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: 7+ years in hands-on hardware development, with end-to-end ownership of systems that shipped at scale.

  • Execution: Demonstrated ability to deliver high-reliability designs under tight constraints on power, cost, form factor, and schedule.

  • Technical Strengths:

    • Deep expertise in low-noise analog and high-speed digital design.

    • Strong grounding in signal/power integrity, high-density interconnect, and EMI mitigation techniques.

    • Familiarity with high-volume design-for-manufacturing (DFM), reliability testing, and yield optimization.

  • Tools & Skills:

    • Proficient in schematic capture and simulation (e.g., SPICE), with working knowledge of Altium or similar.

    • Experience with SI/PI simulation tools (e.g., HyperLynx, SiWave) and measurement tools (GHz-range scopes, VNAs, spectrum analyzers).

    • Familiarity with board-level integration of FPGAs, microcontrollers, and custom analog ASICs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with high-speed ADCs, custom analog IC interfaces, or photonics-related electronics.

  • Knowledge of flex and rigid-flex PCB design.

  • Familiarity with Verilog-AMS or mixed-signal modeling.

  • Exposure to Verilog HDL or FPGA development.

  • Experience designing for high-reliability or harsh environments (e.g., automotive, aerospace).

Benefits Package:

  • Comprehensive health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision).

  • Team events and company meetups.
