About the team / Role:

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be the primary architect and execution lead for leading the platform changes for the Digital Credit Application.


We are pivoting from a legacy monolith to a high-performance, pluggable API ecosystem. Your mission is to decouple core adjudication logic, enable rapid A/B testing of the customer journey, and lay the technical foundation for future AI-driven chat and automated decisioning experiences.


This is a high-impact role designed for a true "builder" who thrives on the duality of supporting a live production environment while aggressively migrating mission-critical services to a modern, microservices-based backbone. You will encounter varied customer scenarios where your out-of-the-box approach is a better fit than standard industry practices. We expect you to make a true difference for the customer, leveraging technology and AI to best serve and solve for good.


The AI Edge: We are a forward-thinking engineering org. You are expected to be an expert in leveraging AI Software Development Lifecycle (ADLC) tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Amazon Q, LLM-based code gen and architecture agents) to accelerate migration, write bulletproof tests, and automate documentation.

How you'll make an impact:

Architectural Migration & Strategy:

  • Strangler Fig Migration: Lead the decoupling of core credit application logic out of the legacy monolith and into a scalable, cloud-native Java/Spring Boot micro services environment.
  • Migration with Zero Downtime: Design and execute high-volume traffic migration strategies from legacy systems to new stacks seamlessly without disrupting live customers.
  • Salesforce Proficiency: A significant portion of existing systems is embedded within various Salesforce capabilities throughout the application lifecycle. Proficiency in Salesforce is a strong advantage, as different integrations will require the new stack to support bidirectional data and state synchronization within the Salesforce ecosystem.

Pluggable Adjudication & API Ecosystem:

  • Modular Architecture: Design and implement a modular adjudication layer allowing the business to swap or update credit rules and third-party data providers without impacting core application flows.
  • API-First Design: Build and maintain robust, versioned REST/gRPC APIs that support a multi-channel experience (Mobile, Web, and future AI Chat interfaces).
  • A/B Strategy Enablement: Engineer backend infrastructure for dynamic routing and experimentation, allowing real-time testing of various application flows.

AI Readiness & Process Acceleration:

  • AI DLC Mastery: Champion the use of AI tools across the development lifecycle to write code faster, refactor legacy code into modern Java, and generate robust test suites.
  • Data Science Partnership: Partner with Data Science teams to ensure data pipelines and backend schemas are optimized for LLM integration and real-time credit decisioning models.

Operational Excellence & Leadership:

  • Observability & CI/CD: Establish rigorous standards for CI/CD, observability (OpenTelemetry), and automated contract testing.
  • Technical Mentorship: Provide guidance to mid-level and senior engineers, fostering a culture of high engineering standards, clean code, and AI-assisted productivity.

Experience you will bring:

Technical Architecture & Stack:

  • 10+ Years of Engineering Excellence: Proven track record in backend architecture, specifically within Fintech, Lending, or Credit systems.
  • Modern Java Stack: Expert-level proficiency in Java 17/21, Spring Boot 3.x, and Spring Cloud.
  • Monolith-to-Distributed Migration: Significant experience extracting tightly coupled business logic from legacy backends into external, scalable cloud microservices (AWS).
  • Complex Adjudication & Rules Engines: Experience building or implementing rules engines (e.g., Drools, Camunda, or custom JSON-logic) for automated decisioning.
  • Event-Driven Design: Deep experience with Kafka or RabbitMQ for maintaining asynchronous data consistency between the new API layer and legacy systems of record during migration phases.
  • Contract-First Development: Strict adherence to API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger) to ensure seamless collaboration with frontend teams.

AI & Modern Delivery Tools:

  • AI DLC Proficiency: Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants (Cursor, Copilot, etc.) to optimize workflows, refactor legacy code, and accelerate delivery.

Leadership & Education:

  • Strong analytical skills and a proven capability in resolving complex, cross-functional problems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex technical concepts clearly to stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

About the Role

Some problems don’t fit in a ticket. A customer’s platform is misbehaving in ways no error message explains, across environments running different versions, and more than one team already has a theory. Those are the problems that land with you.

As a Staff Technical Support Engineer, you are one of the most senior technical minds in the Support organization. Your job isn’t to be the last line of defense, it’s to get upstream of the queue: to own Proscia’s hardest customer problems end-to-end, find the systemic faults before they become ticket clusters, and shape how our platform is built, deployed, and supported so the root causes are treated and not just their symptoms.
You set the technical bar for the team and partner directly with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to make what you learn in the field visible for cross-functional use and feed it back into how Proscia works beyond the Support organization.

About You

You’re drawn to the hardest, most ambiguous problems in the room: the multi-system ones with no runbook yet, where three teams have three theories and none of them is quite right. You’d rather find a systemic fault before it becomes ten tickets than be the hero who closes them one at a time.

You reason from evidence, not hunches: you gather what the systems actually show, hold competing explanations honestly instead of forcing a tidy story, and follow the thread across code, infrastructure, and live customer environments until the real cause surfaces.

You treat AI as a native part of how you work, leveraging the powerful tools available without losing the edge of human judgement required as you correlate across complex systems, reproduce a defect faster than anyone thought possible, or untangle multiple disparate root causes that others see as a unified whole. You don’t hoard what you learn: every hard-won diagnosis becomes something the whole team can stand on next time.

What You’ll Own

  • Get ahead of the fire. Hunt down systemic risks and recurring failure patterns before they surface as a wave of tickets. Read the signals across the customer base at scale, stay ahead of every new release, and drive the fixes that quietly remove whole categories of issues.
  • Own the hardest investigations. Take the ambiguous, business-critical, multi-system problems no one else can crack. Gather evidence, form and test hypotheses, reproduce the worst defects in lab environments, and follow the thread across application, infrastructure, and live customer environments until the true root cause is undeniable.
  • Shape how the platform is built and supported. Turn field patterns into influence: partner with Engineering, Product, and QA on roadmap decisions, define how issues move from customer to engineering, and carry the voice of the customer into product and infrastructure planning.
  • Multiply the team. Make everyone around you better. Mentor and coach engineers, lead technical training and pairing, set the standard for documentation and knowledge quality, and build the onboarding and career frameworks the team grows into.
  • Lead the deep deployment work. Run the complex upgrades, migrations, and provisioning efforts where both the technical depth and the stakes are highest and where divergent customer environments fly in the face of runbooks and expectations.
  • Be there when it counts. When a critical incident hits, you lead: steady, high-touch customer communication and live troubleshooting on major incident calls.

What You Bring

  • Document no-show and cancellation activity within applicable healthcare systems.

  • Use cancellations and open appointments to backfill available provider capacity whenever possible.

Waitlist and Provider Utilization

  • Maintain and actively manage patient waitlists across providers and service lines.
  • Identify available appointment capacity and match eligible patients to open appointments.
  • Support provider utilization by minimizing unfilled appointment slots.
  • Monitor scheduling activity for capacity constraints, access issues, and recurring scheduling barriers.
  • Coordinate with operational leadership when scheduling trends indicate provider capacity or workflow issues.

Authorization and Revenue Cycle Coordination

  • Confirm that required prior authorizations are in place before scheduling services subject to payer approval.

  • Flag expired, pending, or incomplete authorizations before additional services are scheduled.

  • Provide appointment links, instructions, and basic connection support when applicable.

Documentation and Compliance

  • Maintain complete and accurate documentation of scheduling activity, appointment changes, cancellations, no-shows, patient communications, and authorization coordination.
  • Ensure scheduling information within EHR, practice management, and other applicable healthcare systems remains current and accurate.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and applicable healthcare privacy requirements.
  • Support accurate documentation required for billing, payer audits, operational reporting, and revenue cycle performance monitoring.

Performance and Reporting

  • Track scheduling performance indicators such as appointment fill rates, cancellations, no-show rates, rescheduling activity, and provider utilization.

  • Participate in workflow improvement initiatives designed to improve scheduling efficiency, patient access, utilization, and billing readiness.

You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Urdu-English Video-Phone Interpreter


Job Title: Urdu Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

Pay: $15 - $17 per hour

  • Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.
    • For Colorado applicants, the expected pay range is $15.16 - $19.29 per hour.

We Offer:

  • Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.
  • Incentives for meeting attendance targets.
  • Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.
  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview:


The Urdu Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Urdu and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**


Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.
  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inUrdu and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages – highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**


Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer and webcam the majority of the workday.
  • Must use a headset for prolonged periods of time.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

At the final stage, shortlisted candidates will be asked to arrange reference calls with selected former supervisors.

Purpose of the job position:

This role exists to grow revenue from iVigee’s digital products and keep the customers who buy them successful. You will be the dedicated sales and support contact for our digital portfolio only, you will not sell iVigee’s outsourced PV services, which remain with the wider BD team.

You’ll run the full cycle for digital products: qualifying inbound interest, running demos, managing trials, closing deals, onboarding new customers, and handling their day-to-day support questions. It’s an ideal role for someone early in their career who wants to combine commercial and technical skills in a fast-growing corner of life sciences.

MAJOR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Digital sales

  • Respond to and qualify inbound leads for iVigee’s digital products from the website, events, campaigns and partner referrals
  • Run discovery calls to understand a prospect’s PV workflow, safety database, case volumes and pain points
  • Manage / deliver product demonstrations and manage trials or pilots through to conversion
  • Carry out targeted outbound prospecting to biotech, pharma and CRO contacts, working with Marketing on campaigns

  • Close subscription and licence deals independently; support senior colleagues on larger opportunities

Customer support

  • Act as first-line support for digital customers by email, ticket, chat and video call
  • Onboard new customers: account setup, user training and getting them to first value quickly
  • Troubleshoot user issues, reproduce problems and escalate product and technical issues to the relevant product owner or IT team with clear documentation
  • Track support tickets through to resolution within agreed service levels

Job Summary:

The Data Engineer III independently designs, develops, implements, and supports complex enterprise data pipelines, data models, and analytical solutions that deliver reliable, actionable information to the business. This role contributes to solution architecture, strengthens data quality and governance, and applies hands-on artificial intelligence (AI) experience to build AI-ready data assets and integrate AI capabilities into data engineering workflows. The Data Engineer III owns technical delivery within assigned initiatives, resolves non-routine problems, and collaborates with business and technology partners within established architecture, security, and governance standards.


Essential Functions:

  • Independently design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, data models, and analytical data assets; improve performance, reliability, and maintainability throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Serve as a key contributor to data stewardship workgroups and cross-functional teams supporting data management and governance.
  • Promote metadata management and data quality practices through knowledge-sharing sessions, technical guidance, and collaboration across the organization.
  • Translate stakeholder priorities, business definitions, and data quality requirements into appropriate data models, technical specifications, and engineering solutions.
  • Own the technical delivery of assigned data governance engineering initiatives, including metadata cataloging and data quality solutions, within established program standards.
  • Analyze data and business processes to develop and maintain glossary definitions, policies, standards, guidelines, and workflows that support data management and governance programs.
  • Lead the development and maintenance of metadata catalogs for assigned data domains, including technical metadata, business definitions, and data lineage.
  • Identify and quantify data-related issues, assess business impact, and collaborate with stakeholders to develop and implement remediation plans.
  • Partner with subject matter experts, end users, and data modelers to define business rules and implement automated controls that measure and improve data quality.
  • Lead the investigation and resolution of reported data quality issues; develop and report metrics that demonstrate remediation progress, data quality trends, and adherence to established standards.
  • Set objectives and manage technical delivery for assigned work, accounting for dependencies and impacts on related teams. Contribute to operational goals and work independently within established procedures, seeking direction for new domains or unique assignments.
  • Resolve ambiguous, non-routine technical problems through analysis, data trends, and sound engineering judgment. Improve work methods based on experience, engage appropriate resources, and escalate risks or decisions outside established boundaries.
  • Build and maintain governed, AI-ready datasets and pipelines for AI and machine learning use cases, including data preparation, validation, lineage, and access controls; collaborate with data science and application teams on integration requirements.
  • Implement and support approved AI capabilities within data engineering solutions, such as AI-assisted data quality checks, metadata enrichment, or unstructured data processing. Validate outputs against defined acceptance criteria and monitor accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development tools to support coding, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation. Independently review and test generated outputs, protect sensitive data, and follow established security, privacy, and responsible AI requirements.
  • Perform any other job duties as requested

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent years of relevant work experience, is required.
  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience designing and developing ETL/ELT and/or business intelligence solutions is required.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience independently implementing and supporting AI-enabled data engineering solutions in a production environment is required. Experience must include preparing and governing data, integrating AI services or models into data workflows, validating outputs, and monitoring operational performance; familiarity with AI concepts or use of AI chat tools alone does not satisfy this requirement.
  • Healthcare payer experience is preferred.

  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex query development, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
  • Proficiency in Python or a comparable programming language for data transformation, automation, testing, and integration with AI services or model APIs.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop moderately complex to complex data profiling, data quality, and metadata analysis processes using industry-standard tools.
  • Ability to manage technical deliverables across multiple medium- to large-scale projects, prioritize competing demands, and communicate dependencies and delivery risks promptly.
  • Strong understanding of data management and governance, including data quality, metadata management, lineage, stewardship, and access controls.
  • Strong understanding of relational database theory, data modeling, and data warehouse design principles.
  • Working knowledge of AI and machine learning data requirements and practical AI integration patterns, including model inference APIs and, where applicable, embeddings and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Ability to evaluate AI-enabled workflows using representative test data and defined quality measures; identify inaccurate or unsupported outputs, data leakage, and privacy risks, and implement appropriate validation and human review controls.

ABOUT GENERATION:

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have a 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

Position Overview:

This role will lead the testing, evaluation, implementation, and scaling of AI-enabled learning and instructor-facing tools across Generation's LATAM and Europe regions. The role will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities for AI-enabled learning, establishing pilot hypotheses and success measures, generating evidence on effectiveness, and translating successful interventions into scalable learning models.

Working closely with country teams, implementation teams, vendors, and technical stakeholders, the role will ensure AI-enabled learning solutions are effectively embedded into learner and instructor experiences and continuously improved through evidence, feedback, and iteration.

Operating at the intersection of curriculum design, learning science, instructional delivery, and applied AI, the role will help shape the evolution of Generation's AI-enabled learning strategy through regional implementation, pilot outcomes, learner and instructor insights, and recommendations for future product enhancements and scaling decisions.

The role will also act as a key partner to external AI and learning technology providers, helping identify opportunities for product improvements, influencing feature development, and ensuring solutions continue to meet the needs of learners, instructors, and country teams.

jobs.excerpt: What Business Analysis contributes to Cardinal Health Business Analysis serves as a liaison between the organization's businesses and IT systems development teams to align business strategies and capability needs and to ensure IT systems enable their desired value.
jobs.description:
What Business Analysis contributes to Cardinal Health

Business Analysis serves as a liaison between the organization's businesses and IT systems development teams to align business strategies and capability needs and to ensure IT systems enable their desired value. This job family identifies and analyzes business needs, defines requirements and objectives, and makes recommendations for solutions using new and existing technologies. This job family researches and documents relationships between the components of the application system (i.e., end users, business processes, data, applications, and devices) and translates business requirements into application requirements.

Job Summary

The Consultant, Pricing Solutions Analysis supports custom pricing applications and data solutions for Cardinal Health’s Global Medical Products and Distribution segment. This role acts as a liaison between the organization's businesses and iPrice application development teams to align business strategies and capability needs to ensure the iPrice system enables their desired value. This role identifies and analyzes business needs, defines requirements and objectives, and makes recommendations as a subject matter expert (SME) on the iPrice system.

Location: This position is remote. Candidates must be based within the United States and able to work EST or CST business hours.

Responsibilities

  • Develop subject matter expertise of iPrice (a custom pricing application), business processes, and master data.
  • Focus on continuous improvement to deliver solutions that improve profitability and customer experience.
  • Elicit and document business requirements with stakeholders and subject matter experts.
  • Convey business requirements to developers with appropriate level of detail.
  • Perform functional and regression testing and facilitate user acceptance testing with business teams.
  • Deliver timely and effective communication to stakeholders and impacted partners for progress updates and implementations.
  • Support analysts, developers, and business stakeholders with data questions and investigations
  • Document data structures, business logic, and ETL processes – including conducting recurring trainings and data information sessions with end users.
  • Identify, design, and implement process improvements by automating manual processes and optimizing data delivery for greater scalability
  • Maintain Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Compliance.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Enablement and Learning Business Partners to develop training programs and job aids.
  • Create and maintain documentation for team processes and supported applications including SOPs, user guides, and data catalogs.
  • Maintain SQL Server and Oracle databases.
  • Perform ad hoc analytics and database development to support applications and cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field, or equivalent work experience, preferred.
  • 4+ years experience in related field, preferred.
  • Proven track record that demonstrates curiosity, creativity, innovation, and initiative preferred.
  • Strong communication skills in writing, speaking, presenting, and listening preferred.
  • Ability to efficiently project manage, organize and prioritize tasks preferred.
  • Experience with JIRA or similar project management tools, preferred.
  • Experience in SQL (SQL Server preferred), including creating stored procedures, views, scripting, and automation, preferred.
  • Familiarity with other database technologies: e.g., HANA, Oracle, PostgreSQL, BigQuery, preferred.
  • Experience with Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) applications or other Price Management software, preferred.
  • Understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), preferred.
  • Experience managing projects that span both technical and non-technical teams, with an emphasis on engaging stakeholders and building business requirements and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), preferred.
  • Proficient in creating comprehensive, user‑friendly documentation that communicates pricing workflows, business logic, and standard procedures across cross‑functional teams preferred.
  • Established background in launching software or services in partnership with and high degree of proficiency in prototyping, iterative development, and understanding of development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Kanban), preferred.
  • Familiarity with ETL processes, data pipelines, and working with structured/unstructured data, preferred.

Anticipated salary range: $82,100 - $117,200

Bonus eligible: No

Benefits: Cardinal Health offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well-being.

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Paid time off plan
  • Health savings account (HSA)
  • 401k savings plan
  • Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
  • Short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Work-Life resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Healthy lifestyle programs

Application window anticipated to close: 11/30/2026 *if interested in opportunity, please submit application as soon as possible.

The salary range listed is an estimate. Pay at Cardinal Health is determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s geographical location, relevant education, experience and skills and an evaluation of internal pay equity.

Cardinal Health supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience and background. jobs.description:
Deputy Program Manager — Federal Health IT Operations

Location: Remote — United States (National Capital Region preferred)
Security Clearance: Active Secret required

Lead Complex Operations. Keep Mission Delivery Moving.

Rackner is seeking an experienced Deputy Program Manager to lead day-to-day service operations supporting a complex federal health IT mission. This role brings together clinical, training, field, and technical teams to keep services coordinated, resources available, and operational commitments on track.

You'll work closely with program leadership to manage competing priorities, coordinate workforce capacity, and address operational challenges across multiple service-delivery functions. This opportunity offers meaningful leadership responsibility in a DoD environment, where sound operational decisions help support military health services and mission readiness.

What You'll Do

  • Lead day-to-day service operations across multiple teams supporting a complex federal health IT mission.
  • Coordinate operational schedules and priorities across training, field activities, military exercises, and ongoing service delivery.
  • Manage workforce capacity and resource coordination to support operational readiness and service continuity.
  • Identify and address scheduling conflicts, staffing challenges, and competing operational priorities.
  • Coordinate supplemental staffing and surge support in response to changing mission needs, ensuring activities remain within authorized work requirements.
  • Lead weekly operational and monthly service reviews, communicating progress, risks, and priorities to program leadership.
  • Support the Program Manager and maintain operational continuity when acting on their behalf.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in service management or operations leadership supporting Department of Defense (DoD) programs.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
  • Active U.S. Government Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ITIL 4 Managing Professional certification.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  • Experience with ServiceNow Field Service Management.
  • Coordinating schedules and operational resources across globally distributed teams.

Why Rackner?

At Rackner, you'll work alongside multidisciplinary teams supporting important federal missions and solving complex operational and technical challenges.

We value collaboration, practical problem-solving, and continuous improvement. Our environment encourages professional growth and provides opportunities to strengthen service delivery and contribute to meaningful mission outcomes.

Benefits & Perks

Rackner offers a comprehensive benefits package, subject to applicable eligibility requirements and plan terms, including:

  • Company-supported certifications and professional development opportunities.
  • Career development and leadership opportunities.
  • 401(k) with a 100% company match on contributions up to 6%.
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage.
  • Generous paid time off and paid holidays.
  • Home-office equipment and remote-work support.
  • Fitness and wellness reimbursement.
  • Weekly pay and team events.

Work Arrangement

This position is remote within the United States, with a preference for candidates located in the National Capital Region.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Rackner is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

At Cube, we're redefining how organizations deliver, consume, and automate data and analytics across teams, tools, and AI agents. Our mission is to enable Agentic Analytics, where AI agents work alongside humans on a shared semantic foundation.

If you're fascinated by building core data and AI infrastructure, the kind that powers analytics at the world's most advanced technology companies, but want the agility and ownership of a startup, Cube is where you'll thrive.

With 19,000+ GitHub stars and 13,000+ community members, Cube is trusted by 400+ companies, including Maersk, Kimberly-Clark, Freshworks, Patagonia, Webflow, Brex, Deel, Tubi, Walmart, and Drata. Our platform empowers AI agents with a universal semantic foundation, enabling autonomous analytics at scale while maintaining consistency, security, and performance across BI tools, spreadsheets, and embedded applications.

As a Solutions Architect at Cube, you'll be the technical bridge between our product and our customers' data infrastructure. You'll work hands-on with prospects and customers across industries to design, implement, and optimize semantic layer architectures that solve complex data challenges. This is a highly technical, customer-facing role where your SQL expertise and data analysis skills have a direct impact on customer success.

What you will do:

  • Design and architect end-to-end semantic layer solutions using Cube, integrating with customers' existing data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Build comprehensive data models in YAML or JavaScript that define metrics, dimensions, and business logic.
  • Develop proof-of-concepts and technical demonstrations on customer data, and lead technical discovery sessions to understand data architecture and requirements.
  • Guide customers on best practices for data modeling, caching strategies, access control, and performance optimization.
  • Run hands-on workshops and training to enable customer teams, and partner with Sales to provide technical expertise during the evaluation process.
  • Write complex SQL to analyze customer data and validate solution designs, and build integrations between Cube and downstream BI tools, notebooks, and custom applications.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor across the customer lifecycle, and bring customer feedback back to Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.

Who you are:

  • Expert-level SQL proficiency: you can write complex queries, optimize performance, and understand query execution plans.
  • Strong data analysis skills: you explore data, identify patterns, validate metrics, and communicate insights.
  • Programming experience in JavaScript or Python, comfortable working with APIs and building data transformations.
  • 3+ years in solutions architecture, data engineering, analytics engineering, or a similar technical customer-facing role.
  • Deep understanding of the modern data stack: data warehouses, transformation tools, and BI platforms.
  • Experience with semantic or metrics layers, or BI modeling frameworks (LookML, dbt metrics, or similar).
  • Strong communication skills: you can translate technical concepts for both technical and business audiences.

Bonus points:

  • Prior experience with Cube.js or similar semantic layer platforms.
  • Background in analytics engineering or data platform roles, and familiarity with dimensional modeling best practices.
  • Familiarity with REST/GraphQL APIs and how applications consume analytics.
  • Knowledge of caching strategies and performance optimization for analytics workloads.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift) and an understanding of multi-tenancy, access control, and data governance.
  • Experience with embedded analytics or building data-powered applications.
  • Familiarity with AI/LLM integration with semantic layers, and contributions to open-source data projects.

This role is customer-facing and involves occasional travel to customer sites and company events.

We're a fully remote company based in San Francisco. You can work from anywhere and join our highly collaborative team.

  • Deep hands-on experience designing and delivering production GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.

  • Strong Databricks experience, including Mosaic AI capabilities, Model Serving, MLflow, Unity Catalog, Databricks Apps, Vector Search, and Lakehouse architecture.
  • Ability to design secure, scalable, governed enterprise AI architectures integrating structured and unstructured data.
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, including APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, testing, and production deployment patterns.
  • Experience with model evaluation, observability, guardrails, performance optimization, and cost management.
  • Working knowledge of classical ML and how GenAI, ML, data engineering, and analytics fit into broader AI solutions.
  • Strong client-facing consulting and executive communication skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills and Experiences:

  • Advanced Databricks certifications and strong familiarity with the broader Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
  • Experience with DSPy, GEPA, automated prompt optimization, fine-tuning, synthetic data generation, and advanced evaluation techniques.
  • Experience building multi-agent systems, MCP-based integrations, tool-calling architectures, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

What We Promise You:

jobs.description:
Title: Marketing Asset Manager
Location: Remote (eastern or central US time zone-based)

Position Summary:
MOCA is seeking a Marketing Asset Manager to improve how prospective and current customers find information, understand our software and services, and take the next step across our corporate, Touchplan, and MOCA Services websites. This hands-on role combines website design, WordPress and Elementor expertise, and making data-informed improvements to the customer journey.

You will turn business goals and audience needs into clear navigation, effective page layouts, and useful content experiences. Working with marketing colleagues and external developers, you will own day-to-day website execution and maintain a prioritized plan for improving usability and conversion performance. You will also manage and maintain our marketing and brand assets, ensuring materials remain current, organized, and consistent with approved branding and messaging. While this is a remote position, the company is seeking applicant located in either the eastern or central time zone of the United States.

Essential Functions:

Customer Journey and Website Design

  • Map key visitor journeys, from initial discovery through evaluation, inquiry, and access to customer resources. Identify confusing navigation, missing information, and barriers to taking action.
  • Recommend and implement improvements to site structure, navigation, page hierarchy, internal links, and calls to action based on audience needs and business priorities.
  • Design and build pages and landing pages in WordPress using Elementor. Apply strong visual judgment to typography, spacing, imagery, and content hierarchy across desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts.
  • Create reusable page templates and components that support consistent branding and efficient updates across the websites.

Website Performance and Conversion

  • Use Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Microsoft Clarity/heatmap tools, user feedback, and behavior analysis tools to identify where visitors struggle and prioritize improvements.
  • Improve inquiry and demo request journeys, including forms and confirmation experiences. Coordinate with marketing operations to verify tracking, CRM connections, and lead routing.
  • Develop testable recommendations for page layouts, messaging, and calls to action. Use A/B testing where traffic supports meaningful results and usability testing to inform other changes.
  • Report on website performance with clear recommendations, tracking priority actions and qualified inquiries alongside traffic and engagement.
WordPress Management and Website Quality
  • Manage routine WordPress content updates and publishing, including page edits, announcements, and job postings. Coordinate hosting, plugin and theme updates, backups, and troubleshooting with hosting and development providers.
  • Test pages, navigation, links, and forms across browsers and devices. Apply accessibility practices for headings, contrast, alternative text, keyboard access, and form labels, and coordinate remediation with developers.
  • Monitor page speed and site health, optimize images and page assets, and collaborate regularly with developers to identify, prioritize, and resolve performance and technical issues.

Search Visibility and Content

  • Apply on-page SEO practices, including descriptive page titles, meta descriptions, logical headings, and internal links. Monitor indexing and crawl issues and coordinate technical fixes with developers as needed.
  • Work with content and marketing colleagues to organize and adapt product, service, industry, and customer content for website visitors. Keep claims, statistics, client logos, and resource links current.

Digital Asset Management and Brand Support

  • Maintain website design standards and document reusable templates and publishing practices. Apply approved brand guidelines consistently across digital content.
  • Support the organization and upkeep of marketing assets, ensuring teams can find current, approved versions.
  • Package emails and newsletters using approved copy and assets. Build and format email layouts, apply brand standards, and test mobile display, links, and calls to action. Coordinate with marketing operations on audience targeting and sending.

Qualifications/Experience - Required:
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, web design, graphic design, digital media, communications, or a related field preferred.
  • At least three years of relevant experience in website management, digital design, or digital marketing, with direct responsibility for improving business websites.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building and maintaining WordPress websites with Elementor, including responsive layouts, reusable templates, and routine troubleshooting.
  • A portfolio showing strong web design judgment and examples of customer journey, usability, or conversion improvements.
  • Practical understanding of user experience, website navigation, accessibility, on-page SEO, and conversion rate optimization.
  • Experience interpreting Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console data and using findings to recommend website changes.
  • Strong editing, quality assurance, and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing requests and collaborate with marketing, sales, and development teams.
  • Strong attention to detail, practical problem-solving abilities, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Qualifications/Experience - Preferred:
Experience with B2B software, professional services, and/or the AEC industry; Elementor; basic HTML and CSS; Pardot/MCAE, Figma or Adobe design tools; behavior analysis or usability testing tools; and marketing automation or CRM integrations. Familiarity with Flywheel hosting and SEO tools such as Yoast or Semrush is helpful.

MSI delivers innovative solutions to Owners, Engineers, Architects, and Contractors working on some of the world’s largest, most complex construction projects. Job Description

The Director, HR Business Partner serves as the senior HR advisor to the Regional Vice President and regional leadership team, translating business priorities into an actionable people strategy across 600+ stores. As a member of the regional leadership team, this role uses workforce insights and business acumen to strengthen leadership capability, build talent pipelines, improve organizational effectiveness, and support regional performance.

The Director leads a team of HR Business Partners and is accountable for consistent, high-quality HR partnership across the region. Working across HR Centers of Excellence, Employee Relations, and Legal, this role anticipates workforce needs and risks, delivers integrated talent solutions, and leads organizational change aligned with regional and enterprise priorities.


What will you do?

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Partner across HR Centers of Excellence to integrate talent acquisition, organizational development, compensation, benefits, and employee relations solutions into a cohesive regional people strategy.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of field operations through regular store and market visits, using firsthand insights to shape regional people strategies and enterprise HR decisions or program design
  • Use workforce data (case trends, turnover, staffing, engagement, labor spend) to diagnose region-level issues, influence decisions, and develop proactive plans that strengthen leadership practices and team member experience
  • Partner with Employee Relations and Legal to identify and proactively address workforce risks, recurring employee relations trends, and compliance concerns across the region
  • Ensure leaders consistently apply company policies, performance expectations, and talent practices while balancing business needs, team member experience, and organizational risk

Talent, Organization & Culture

  • Own regional talent and succession planning, identifying critical roles, talent risks, bench gaps, and development actions that strengthen leadership capability and internal mobility.
  • Partner with Organizational Development and Training to build targeted development strategies that address regional capability needs.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to establish workforce and staffing priorities, leadership selection standards, and talent-pipeline strategies.
  • Lead organizational design and change initiatives that align structure, roles, talent, and labor models with current and future business needs.
  • Own the regional engagement and retention strategy, using employee feedback and workforce insights to address the underlying drivers of turnover and performance.
  • Champion an inclusive, high-accountability culture and consistent team member experience across all districts.

Team Leadership & Execution

  • Lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of HR Business Partners, establishing clear priorities, consistent service expectations, and measurable outcomes aligned with regional business needs
  • Build HRBP capability through ongoing coaching, talent development, succession planning, and differentiated performance management
  • Create an effective operating rhythm across the regional HRBP team to identify emerging workforce trends, align priorities, share best practices, and ensure consistent execution across districts
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex or high-impact people matters, coordinating the appropriate Employee Relations, Legal, and HR Center of Excellence partners

Qualifications:

  • Proven multi-unit, geographically dispersed retail, restaurant or field-based HR experience
  • Demonstrated success partnering with and influencing senior executives to improve business outcomes
  • Strong analytics capability; comfortable building a people plan with data
  • Demonstrated ability to apply critical and strategic thinking to complex business and workforce matters, make sound decisions amid ambiguity, and translate insights into practical, measurable actions.
  • High degree of business and financial acumen
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, as well as champion change
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, and conflict management skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Workday
  • Ability to travel as necessary

Certifications, Experience, and Education:

  • Certifications: PHR or SPHR preferred, not required
  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive HR experience preferably in a business partner capacity including at least 3 years in a leadership role; and
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications or related field; or equivalent combination of education and/or experience

Location & Work Availability:

This position is a Remote based role, up to 50% travel required for market visits and leadership team engagement. Overnight travel may be required. This role will cover territories in West Virginia, Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia and Kentucky.


Benefits Summary:

We believe in supporting our Team Members and those they love through comprehensive health & wellness benefits. Learn more here:


Company Overview:

Advance Auto Parts, Inc. is a leading automotive aftermarket parts provider that serves both professional installer and do-it-yourself customers. You'll work across the stack, from on-chain programs to the front ends investors, traders and integrators use. You'll be working on systems that move real capital: liquidity venues, lending markets, and market-making infrastructure. This is a hands-on role for someone who has a genuine interest in bringing regulated finance on-chain and has already shipped DeFi protocols on Solana and understands the operational realities of running them under load.

As an early team member, you will play a crucial role in shaping the Corda Protocol. You should care as much about security, compliance, and auditability as you do about shipping quickly.

  • Work directly on market-making and liquidity systems and the plumbing that keeps venues liquid and solvent.

  • Design, implement, and optimize SDKs that will power our integration with centralized partners (exchanges, wallets, neobanks).

Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.

This is NOT for you if

  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing is given up front. For proven partners, things grow with your results, agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • You can reach us directly with any question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

jobs.description:
募集背景

ThreeTraderでは、日本市場向けのマーケティングクリエイティブを担うシニアグラフィックデザイナーを募集しています。

求めているのは、優れたビジュアル表現力とAIを活用した高い制作効率を兼ね備えたデザイナーです。

本ポジションは、デザインの企画から制作、改善までを主体的に担う実務中心のポジションです。

業務内容

1. デザイン制作・クリエイティブ開発

  • Adobe Firefly、Midjourney、RunwayなどのAIツールを活用し、制作効率とクリエイティブ品質を向上させる
  • デジタル広告やマーケティングキャンペーンにおけるビジュアルコンセプトの開発と実制作

2. ブランド管理・デザイン品質の維持

  • ThreeTraderのブランドガイドラインに基づいた一貫性のあるビジュアル表現の維持
  • デザインテンプレートやコンポーネントの作成・管理による制作効率の向上
  • 日本の金融サービスに関する広告・マーケティング規制を踏まえたクリエイティブの制作および品質管理

3. マーケティング成果の向上・ローカライゼーション

  • GrowthおよびPerformance Marketingチームと連携した広告クリエイティブの制作・改善
  • A/Bテストに向けた複数のクリエイティブバリエーションの制作
  • グローバルキャンペーン素材の日本市場向けローカライゼーション
  • 日本独自の文化、消費者心理、デザイン感覚を踏まえたビジュアル表現の最適化
  • 広告パフォーマンスデータを分析し、次のクリエイティブ制作・改善に活用

4. クロスファンクショナルな連携

  • Marketing、Product、CX、Contentなどの各チームと連携し、顧客体験全体におけるビジュアルの一貫性を確保
  • 複数のデザインプロジェクトを並行して管理し、スピード感のある環境で期限内に成果物を納品

Requirements

応募資格・必須スキル

デザイン経験・専門スキル

  • グラフィックデザインまたはデジタルデザインの実務経験5年以上
  • デジタルマーケティングや広告キャンペーンに関する実績を示すポートフォリオ
  • FinTech、金融サービス、その他サービス業または規制のある業界におけるデジタルデザイン経験
  • Adobe Creative Suite（Photoshop、Illustrator、After Effects）およびFigmaの実務スキル
  • Adobe Firefly、Midjourney、RunwayなどのAIデザインツールの活用経験
  • SNS広告、ディスプレイ広告、メール、LPなどのパフォーマンスマーケティング向けクリエイティブ制作経験
  • A/Bテストの基本的な理解と、データに基づいたデザイン改善能力

日本市場・言語スキル

  • 日本語ネイティブレベル、または日本語能力試験（JLPT）N1相当の日本語能力
  • 日本のビジュアル文化、デザインのトレンド、金融サービスにおける消費者の期待や表現に対する深い理解

  • デザインの細部にまでこだわり、高い品質基準を持っている方
  • MarketingやProductなど、デザイン以外のチームとも円滑にコミュニケーションできる方

  • 新しいデザイン手法やAIツールを積極的に取り入れ、継続的な改善を楽しめる方

歓迎スキル・経験

  • スタートアップ企業やアジャイルなチーム環境での業務経験

ThreeTraderで働く魅力

  • AIを活用した新しいデザイン制作手法に積極的に取り組める

  • ブランドの成長と日本市場におけるクリエイティブの進化に貢献できる

応募について

特に、デジタルマーケティング、広告クリエイティブ、金融サービス関連のデザイン経験をお持ちの方を歓迎します。

jobs.description:
Relae (formerly Carbon Direct) helps organizations like Microsoft, Mitsubishi, and JPMorgan Chase make defensible, high-stakes decisions across energy strategy, decarbonization, environmental markets, and natural capital. Our teams combine scientific rigor with commercial and policy fluency to answer questions that matter, and we invest just as seriously in the people answering them, with a clear path for career growth, structured manager development, and real ownership of hard problems from day one.

The Role

Overview

Relae is seeking an AI/ML Engineer for our Power, Data and Innovation team. This role will be responsible for designing, building, training, and maintaining machine learning models for production. You will be directly working with Relae’s existing and prospective clients to provide insights and analysis on power hedging and procurement of electricity, gas and other energy commodities to help analyze operational and market risks and flexible load opportunities, including assessments of associated emissions impacts.

This is an individual contributor role, and this role will work closely with software engineers, data scientists, energy economists, and power systems engineers to build models that support hyperscaler, utility, and corporate energy buyer clients navigating the AI-driven data center power boom.

Responsibilities

  • Leveraging a deep understanding of power systems data, identify, gather, and validate appropriate datasets for relevant power-sector applications, including assessment of uncertainties and data gaps, and develop analytical approaches to mitigate them.
  • Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for energy market forecasting and grid analytics (data ingestion from ISO/utility feeds and weather sources, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring).
  • Productionize forecasting and optimization models such as nodal price, load, or renewable generation forecasts with robust testing, observability, and documentation, in collaboration with cross-functional software and power advisory teams, and automated evaluations to ensure safe, frequent releases.
  • Collaborate with power systems engineers and energy market analysts to translate research insights and domain expertise into performant, scalable forecasting and optimization systems.
  • Contribute to technical design reviews, coding standards, and mentoring of best practices with the Tech & Software teams at Relea.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment in power trading, energy procurement, commodity risk management, utility strategy, energy markets, or related roles.
  • A master’s or a Ph.D. degree in applied statistics, applied economics, computer science, or a related field.
  • Monitor real-time data for wholesale power markets, gas markets, congestion, basis, capacity, ancillary services, tariff developments, and regulatory changes that could affect portfolio cost or reliability.
  • Strong Python skills, with hands-on experience in ML frameworks and time-series forecasting techniques applied to the power industry, along with a solid understanding of current ML approaches — including LLMs, predictive analytics, and agent-based modeling — as well as time-series-specific challenges such as non-stationarity, seasonality, avoiding data leakage, and appropriate cross-validation techniques.
  • Ability to translate model outputs and technical tradeoffs into clear communication for non-technical audiences, including Relea’s existing and prospective clients
  • Experience working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where the product surface may evolve based on client needs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Power and energy advisory/consulting experience or experience in power product design
  • Familiarity with weather-driven forecasting platforms or techniques (e.g., NWP data, ensemble weather models) and experience with grid optimization problems (e.g., storage dispatch, unit commitment, OPF)

Salary Range

$159,000-$195,000 a year

Benefits:

While we love our work, our lives aren’t defined by it. At Relae (formerly Carbon Direct), we offer a robust benefits package that considers the whole person, their partners, and their families – and we’re always looking to improve.

Our U.S. benefits* include:

  • Comprehensive nationwide medical, dental, and vision coverage. See a preview of our coverage here.
  • Time off as needed: Flexible vacation policy and ten company-wide holidays, plus annual winter break between Christmas and New Year's
  • 16 weeks of fully paid parental and family leave with no tenure requirement
  • Remote-friendly work culture with annual company-wide retreats
  • Reimbursement for your work-from-home setup

*These benefits apply to U.S.-based employees only. Employees outside of the U.S. receive benefits that vary by country. To learn more, contact

Equal Opportunity Employer

Diverse perspectives and experience enhance the way Relae selects and approaches the climate crisis, as well as the creativity and applicability of Relae's advisory and investment work.

jobs.description:
The main purpose of the Account Manager is to manage their assigned clients and their stores by planning, briefing, monitoring, and executing marketing campaigns aimed at driving conversions and sales.

This includes managing, overseeing, and taking charge of the client-agency relationship for all the clients that have been assigned to you. It also includes developing and executing marketing strategies, handling client communications, writing client reports, and communicating the client’s marketing needs to other team members. You will be responsible for supplying the information your team needs to ensure that all marketing campaigns are written, designed, and executed as well as possible. Your goal as an Account Manager is to assist your clients in meeting their revenue goals using the products and services of our company.

The Account Manager will report directly to the Head of Account Managers, the Account Managers’ Leads, and the Service Director while working collaboratively with other departments.

About the Role:

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Account Manager is to be in charge of maintaining a good relationship with your assigned clients while ensuring that our products and services are bringing results for our clients. This will include coming up with innovative ideas for clients’ marketing campaigns, monitoring the performance of such marketing campaigns, and keeping an open channel of productive and fruitful communication with our clients.

You will also be responsible for leading teams consisting of professional Copywriters, Designers, and Account Managers’ Associates to ensure that your assigned clients’ marketing campaigns are executed smoothly. This involves activities such as outlining the client's campaign calendar, briefing new campaigns, delegating creative work, and ultimately overseeing the timely delivery of marketing campaigns.

General Responsibilities:

  • Effectively managing, overseeing, and ensuring that the marketing campaigns of your assigned clients are executed and performing well
  • Building and maintaining a strong relationship with your assigned clients to ensure peak productivity, open communication, and establishing trust between our clients and Hustler Marketing
  • Being in charge of the planning, development, and execution of marketing strategies (consisting of email campaigns, SMS campaigns, pop-ups, and flows) for your assigned clients (meaning that you’ll be managing about 40 unique marketing campaigns per month)
  • Ensuring that the needs and expectations of your assigned clients are managed and met
  • Working to improve the results from email marketing for your assigned clients
  • Collaborating with team members to respond to client requests promptly
  • Working alongside a team of experienced marketing professionals productively and harmoniously to ensure that the highest quality marketing campaigns are delivered to our clients
  • Continuously staying in contact with your assigned clients, including leading and attending regular meetings with your clients
  • Collecting and analyzing data to understand the consumers’ demographics and trends to forward the clients' marketing agenda and drive better results, setting new goals weekly

jobs.description:
Equity-Based Opportunity for a Skilled Developer

Join Our Growing Startup!

We're Omnitrain, a dynamic and innovative marketing automation SaaS startup bootstrapped from zero to a rapidly expanding user base of over 50 paying subscribers. We are building an AI driven Marketing SaaS platform hosted on the Google Cloud Platform and are tapping into the latest generative AI models. We're seeking a highly skilled and motivated Full Stack Engineer to join our team on an equity-based compensation model, with the option for salary upon achievement of revenue goals.

We are in the process of raising a pre-seed fund -- this is your chance to get in on the ground floor.

This is an exceptional opportunity to make a significant impact on a promising venture and share in its future success.

Our Mission

Omnitrain’s very name communicates our ambitious goals for our roadmap and market impact.

Think of each aspect of digital marketing as a car on a train.

The moving parts of marketing work together in a linear fashion.

  1. Companies make ads to tell the world about their product.

  2. These ads are circulated online to a variety of marketing platforms, such as Facebook, Google, TikTok, etc..

  3. When people click those ads, they go to a landing page that continues the promise of the ad.

  4. People persuaded by the landing page’s message proceed to convert.

  5. Analytics are collected about the customer journey in order to identify what’s working well and what isn’t.

  6. Automation is leveraged to adjust the ads accordingly based on their performance.

We seek to expand our platform to provide solutions for each part of the train.

Marketers are responsible for potentially thousands or even millions of dollars in ad spend every month. And the reality is that the numbers can turn sour at any time, 24/7. There’s been brands who have literally lost millions in ad spend in as little as an hour or two due to human errors and misconfigurations. Many marketers are utterly chained to their work for fear that things could fall apart at any time and require immediate recalibration.

Our mission is to liberate these folks from their shackles.

In 2024, we released our MVP, the world’s first and only Text-to-Ads solution, which solves for the first car of the train (ad creation) in a way that no other solution in the market has been able to do. Thanks to our innovative proprietary systems in place, our solution instantly creates winning image ads for practically any business or service.

Now we’re looking to expand this concept to other kinds of ads (reels, video, UGC, etc), leveraging emerging technology to do so.

And of course, we plan to tackle the rest of the cars of the train in the future.

We have in-house talent that have many years of experience in building brands from zero to millions as well as a successful exit. We want to do it again, and we want you to be a part of it.

Benefits

  • Equity Ownership: Opportunity to own a stake in a high-growth startup.

  • Impactful Work: Make a meaningful contribution to a product that is already generating revenue.

  • Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a remote work arrangement with flexible hours.

  • Learning and Growth: Expand your skills and knowledge in a challenging and supportive environment.

  • Potential for High Returns: Share in the financial rewards if the company achieves significant success. Paid salary possibilities are available upon achieving revenue targets.

Responsibilities

  • Full stack coding: Develop and maintain high-quality software components across the full stack on GCP, emphasizing cloud functions, Firestore database, Firebase authentication, REST APIs, and integrating with a complex UI app written in Nuxt with Vue 3, and other tools or frameworks such as Quasar, PWA features etc.

  • API Development and Integration: Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable APIs to support our core product functionality and integrations with third-party services. This can include AI products such as LLMs or image/video generation, marketing platforms (Meta, Google, etc), payment platforms (Stripe)

  • Microservices and data management: Write, edit, debug microservices as Firebase functions (gen 1 and gen 2), Firestore triggers, Pub/Sub queue processing code etc.

  • Generative AI: Explore and integrate generative AI technologies and techniques, ensuring their application is as pivotal as traditional API integration.

  • Problem Solving: Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to UI/UX, APIs, database, deployment to GCP, writing test cases, debugging. Write high-quality, efficient, and testable Javascript code adhering to best practices and standards across the stack.

  • Collaboration: Collaborate closely with the CTO and the development team to translate business requirements into technical solutions, assisting the team in overcoming obstacles and achieving milestones.

  • Commitment: We are looking for a part time commitment of about 20 hours a week. Less is acceptable. The more time, effort, and skill you can commit to the venture, the more you stand to gain in percentage of the operation.

Qualifications

  • Vue 3 Expertise: Experience in building modern apps with Vue 3 Composition API, preferably in a Nuxt 3 environment. This is non-negotiable - experience with React or Angular will not be considered. You must be a Vue developer to succeed here.

  • JavaScript experience: A compelling record of work with Javascript, front end and back end (Node.js 20+). Solid understanding of CRUD principles and best practices in creating APIs and calling external APIs. You must be able to demonstrate your ability to write front end and back end code in JavaScript or TypeScript. Experience with CSS or SCSS is also necessary.

  • GCP experience: We use Firebase and many other GCP services, and experience with the platform is essential. You should be able to write and deploy functions as microservices, work with Firestore and Google storage, Firebase authentication

  • Database Proficiency: General knowledge of, and working experience with SQL and NoSQL databases. We use Firestore at the moment, PostgreSQL down the road. Knowledge of BigQuery is useful but not essential.

  • Problem-Solving Abilities: Ability to analyze and solve complex technical challenges. Familiarity with building hybrid web apps for diverse operating systems and devices from a common code base. A holistic approach to development, with skills or interests that span beyond coding, including project management, user experience design, and data analysis.

  • Passion for Startups: Enthusiasm for working in a fast-paced, agile startup environment. We have many challenges to solve, and we must pivot priorities based on changing market conditions.

  • Equity-Based Compensation: Willingness to work for equity in exchange for potential future financial gains. We understand you have other commitments and are only asking for a part time commitment, as well as passion for our project.

  • Team player: We only hire people who are team players. We operate on respect. This is not a place for a lone wolf. We are fully remote and regular communication is essential for our success.

  • US Residency: Must be a resident of the United States.

Benefits

  • Equity Ownership: Opportunity to own a stake in a high-growth startup.

  • Impactful Work: Make a meaningful contribution to a product that is already generating revenue.

  • Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a remote work arrangement with flexible hours.

  • Learning and Growth: Expand your skills and knowledge in a challenging and supportive environment.

  • Potential for Enormous Returns: Share in the financial rewards as we achieve significant success. You decide how much time, effort, and skill you put in, and you will get a corresponding amount of equity % of the operation. Paid salary possibilities are available upon achieving revenue targets.

This position offers a unique opportunity to join a rapidly growing team at an early stage,

where your work will directly influence the trajectory of our product and company. We

value creativity, dedication, and a team-oriented mindset, and we're excited to welcome

individuals who are prepared to take on significant challenges and contribute to our

shared success.

About Centific

Centific is a frontier AI data foundry that curates diverse, high-quality data, using our purpose-built technology platforms to empower the Magnificent Seven and our enterprise clients with safe, scalable AI deployment. Our team includes more than 150 PhDs and data scientists, along with more than 4,000 AI practitioners and engineers.
