Our zero-distance innovation™ solutions for GenAI can reduce GenAI costs by up to 80% and bring solutions to market 50% faster.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI creators and industry leaders by bringing best practices in GenAI to unicorn innovators and enterprise customers. We aim to help these organizations unlock significant business value by deploying GenAI at scale, helping to ensure they stay at the forefront of technological advancement and maintain a competitive edge in their respective markets.

About Job

Lead Research Scientist – Foundation Models for Vision AI & Physical AI

Company: Centific

Location: Seattle, WA or Palo Alto, CA (Hybrid/Remote)

About the Team

Centific’s Physical AI Lab is building the next generation of embodied intelligence at the intersection of multimodal foundation models, simulation, agentic AI, and real-world robotics. Our mission is to move from perception and reasoning to robust real-world action across safety, industrial, healthcare, warehouse, autonomous systems, and smart environment use cases.

We are looking for a Research Leader with deep foundational model-building experience, a strong publication record, and the ability to translate frontier research into deployable systems and long-term IP.

The Role

As Lead Research Scientist, you will define and drive Centific’s research agenda in Vision AI, multimodal foundation models, simulation-first learning, agentic AI, and embodied intelligence. You will lead a small team of researchers, engineers, and interns while contributing directly to model design, large-scale training, benchmarking, and external scientific visibility.

This role is for someone who has gone beyond applying existing models and has materially advanced architectures, training methods, datasets, or evaluation frameworks in AI, robotics, vision, autonomous driving, or multimodal learning.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead high-impact research in multimodal foundation models, world models, embodied AI, vision-language-action systems, and agentic AI.
  • Develop new approaches for perception, temporal reasoning, spatial intelligence, affordance understanding, autonomous decision-making, and sim2real transfer.
  • Advance challenging robotics capabilities including dexterous manipulation, contact-rich interaction, bimanual coordination, long-horizon task execution, navigation in dynamic environments, and robust action under uncertainty.
  • Contribute to large-scale model building, including multimodal pretraining, distributed training, fine-tuning, distillation, and evaluation of models for vision, robotics, and autonomous systems.
  • Help shape research relevant to autonomous driving and mobile autonomy, including scene understanding, multimodal sensor reasoning, planning-aware perception, and edge-case robustness.
  • Guide integration of research with simulation and digital twin platforms such as Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Omniverse, or related environments.
  • Establish rigorous benchmarks and reproducible evaluation frameworks for robustness, safety, generalization, manipulation success, policy performance, and real-world deployment readiness.
  • Mentor Ph.D. interns and engineers, and help build a strong research culture grounded in rigor, speed, originality, and scientific excellence.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Autonomous Systems, or a related field.
  • Strong publication record in top venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CoRL, RSS, or leading autonomous driving/robotics venues.
  • 5+ years of research experience in academia, industry, or advanced R&D environments.
  • Demonstrated experience building or advancing large-scale foundational models, novel architectures, or training methods in multimodal AI, vision, robotics, autonomous driving, embodied AI, world models, or simulation-based learning.
  • Deep expertise in PyTorch and/or JAX, GPU training, distributed experimentation, and large-scale model development.
  • Proven ability to lead ambitious technical programs and mentor junior researchers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Publications or patents in multimodal foundation models, dexterous robotics, autonomous driving, spatial intelligence, simulation-based learning, manipulation, or embodied AI.
  • Strong experience in Vision AI, including perception, tracking, grounding, 3D scene understanding, video understanding, sensor fusion, or multimodal reasoning.
  • Familiarity with agentic AI systems, tool-using agents, planning frameworks, and memory-based architectures; experience with agentic memory, knowledge graphs, or long-horizon reasoning systems is a plus.
  • Experience with Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, OpenUSD/Omniverse, Open3D, PyTorch3D, NeRF/3DGS, or related simulation and 3D stacks.
  • Familiarity with imitation learning, reinforcement learning, planning, MPC, control, teleoperation data pipelines, or policy learning for robotics and autonomous systems.
  • Experience with Ray, Kubernetes, Triton, TensorRT, Docker, W&B, or large-scale training and deployment infrastructure.
  • Background in trustworthy AI, robotics safety, evaluation, or explainability for autonomous systems.

What Success Looks Like

  • Publishable, reproducible, and deployable research that strengthens Centific’s Physical AI portfolio.
  • New technical IP in multimodal AI, simulation, dexterous robotics, autonomous systems, and embodied intelligence.
  • Strong mentorship and research leadership across a growing team.
  • Demonstrable impact on model robustness, large-scale training capability, sim2real performance, manipulation capability, and real-world deployability.

Our Stack

Modeling: PyTorch, JAX, Hugging Face, xFormers

Simulation: Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, OpenUSD, Omniverse, Open3D

Systems: Python, Ray, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, Triton, TensorRT

Multimodal AI: CLIP, SAM, VLMs, world models, vision-language-action architectures, agent frameworks

Why Join Centific

Help define Centific’s research direction in Physical AI, publish frontier work, mentor the next generation of researchers, and see your science move into real systems.

How to Apply

Email your CV, publication list, GitHub/Google Scholar, and optional 1-page research statement to

Subject: Principal Research Scientist – Foundation Models, Vision AI & Physical AI

Salary Range: $200,000-$300,000 + OTB

jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Bill Review Specialist connects our clinical data with strategy. In this role, you will apply specialized expertise in medical data entry, and national repricing systems to analyze complex, high-exposure medical claims and litigation demands. By conducting precise line-item audits, you uncover billing irregularities and deliver clear, defensible insights that attorneys and adjusters rely on to make fair, evidence-based decisions. Your work directly safeguards reimbursement integrity and upholds Dane Street’s reputation for excellence in the legal and healthcare communities.

Mission, Culture and Values

At Dane Street, we believe exceptional employee experiences create exceptional client experiences. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous improvement, accountability, and care.

We care for our customers, we care for our employees, and we care for one another. Every team member plays an important role in creating an environment where people feel respected, supported, empowered to grow, and inspired to do meaningful work.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct regular quality control of reports
  • Software & Payer System Repricing Optimization
  • Apply knowledge of repricing payer guidelines to maximize accuracy and identify erroneous billing/overbilling.
  • Ensure correct application of fee schedules, line-item audits,CCI edits, and clinical validation rules across commercial, auto/PIP, and workers' compensation lines.
  • Translating complex coding systems (CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, DRG) into plain language for attorneys.

What Makes this Role Successful

The Bill Review Specialist role combines analytical precision with a sharp eye for clinical coding and reimbursement integrity. You thrive in the details, moving effortlessly between line-item audits and national repricing platforms to spot billing anomalies, unbundling, and fee schedule discrepancies. By consistently applying NCCI edits and clinical validation rules, you ensure every report produced is audit-proof, accurate, and aligned with current payer guidelines. You can also successfully translate dense coding structures into straightforward, plain-language insights that attorneys and adjusters can confidently stand behind during litigation and settlement negotiations.

What Your First 90 Days May Look Like

First 30 days

  • Become familiar with Dane Street's Medical Bill Review processes, systems, and workflows.
  • Learn national repricing systems, payer guidelines, and client-specific requirements.
  • Understand fee schedules, UCR benchmarks, NCCI edits, and coding guidelines.
  • Review sample medical bills and reports to understand quality and accuracy expectations.
  • Become familiar with CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, and DRG coding.

First 31-60 days

  • Independently review and audit medical bills and supporting documentation.
  • Identify duplicate, excessive, unsupported, unbundled, or incorrectly billed charges.
  • Apply appropriate fee schedules, repricing guidelines, and coding edits.
  • Prepare accurate and detailed bill review reports.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and turnaround time expectations.
  • Communicate billing discrepancies and findings clearly to the appropriate teams.

First 61-90 days

  • Consistently manage assigned bill review workload with accuracy and efficiency.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in repricing systems and medical billing guidelines.
  • Produce accurate, complete, and defensible reports.
  • Independently identify billing irregularities and reimbursement discrepancies.
  • Translate complex billing and coding information into clear, understandable findings.
  • Identify opportunities to improve review accuracy, workflow efficiency, and overall quality.

WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Any lifting, bending, traveling, etc. required to do the job duties listed above. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role. Examples:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting or remaining stationary at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Constant operation of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other digital productivity tools.
  • Close visual acuity required to view computer screens, analyze data, and read extensive digital documentation.
  • Frequent communication with team members, leadership, and external partners via email, chat, phone, and video conferencing platforms.
  • Occasional moving or positioning of office equipment or files weighing up to 10–15 pounds.

Why Join Dane Street?

  • Collaborative remote culture
  • Professional growth opportunities
  • Meaningful work supporting the healthcare industry
  • Comprehensive benefits
  • Great Place to Work Certified since 2021
  • Commitment to employee development

WORK FROM HOME TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Supply and support your own internet services.

Maintain an uninterrupted internet connection.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

At Dane Street, caring for people is at the heart of what we do. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every employee feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees and make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Requirements

EDUCATION/CREDENTIALS:

A High School Diploma or equivalent

Must Haves:

  • Experience reviewing invoices, billing statements, or financial documentation.
  • Ability to identify incorrect, duplicate, or unsupported charges.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to identify improperly bundled, unbundled, or redundant charges (if this is essential to the role).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience identifying improperly bundled, unbundled, or redundant charges.
  • Experience in the specific industry or billing environment.
  • Familiarity with applicable billing guidelines and regulations.
  • Experience resolving billing discrepancies and communicating findings.
  • .Experience in Fee schedule UCRs /Bench Mark surveys.

Benefits

Join our team at Dane Street and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and peace of mind. We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. We also offer other voluntary benefits which include hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident indemnity, and pet insurance plans. Employees receive basic life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage at no cost. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have time to relax and recharge, while our 401k plan with a company match helps you plan for your future. Apple equipment and a media stipend are provided for remote workspace.

Job Title: Master Class - Business Consultant - Life Sciences Commercial (Germany)

Job Location: Berlin, Germany

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences to help companies work in a more efficient and connected way. Learn more about our products, vision and values, and status as a public benefit corporation on our website.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Veeva Business Consulting was launched in 2019 and has grown quickly and organically to a global organization of over 400 people. Our team is focused on making the Life Sciences industry more efficient and effective through software, data, and consulting working together.

We expect significant growth in Business Consulting as we look towards 2030, and are looking for great people to make it happen.

The Role

We are hiring high potential people who are early in their careers and want to pivot into Life Sciences Consulting through our Master Class Program.

Breaking into business consulting after starting your career down a different path can be hard. As an alternative to an MBA, this program is intentionally designed as the entry path to shape experienced professionals as Business Consultants capable of making an impact for the Life Sciences industry.

Early in the program, you will own key workstreams on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions while collaborating with team members at all levels of Veeva. You will be given the tools and resources to accelerate your consulting skills development.

Our Business Consulting team builds effective business and operational improvement strategies powered by Veeva’s unique industry insights, and market-leading technology. Our offerings are focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers.

If you’re graduating with an advanced degree or have 3-5 years of industry experience and are excited to pivot your career into consulting for a critical industry, Master Class is for you.

The anticipated start date is April 2027.

What You'll Do

    • Support and deliver all components of customer engagements (e.g., customer communications, workshops, stakeholder interviews, process and data analysis, managing timelines)
    • Collaborate with Business Consultants to create deliverables that optimize customer operating and engagement models, processes, and business performance
    • Leverage Veeva’s software and data to pull through tangible business and operational solutions
REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for people who meet the following requirements:
    • 3-5 years of experience from one of the following paths: Life Sciences Industry experience; Advanced Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD); or Other non-Consulting work experience
    • Desire to work within an intense, challenging program and environment
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
    • A problem-solving mindset: anticipating issues early, analyzing, and proactively finding solutions
    • A process-driven person who loves digging into operations, numbers, and other data to find opportunities for improvement
    • High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
    • High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees
    • Willingness to travel up to 20% of your time per year. Travel varies per customer engagement, coworking, internal meetings, and events with your team
THE PROCESS | Our process is different than most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:
    • You submit your resume, short cover letter of questions, and take a personality test
    • Within one week we will notify you via email if we would like to go to the next step or not
    • The next step is a 45-minute interview with the Executive Leader of the practice, followed by a case exercise. You will have one week to prepare for the case exercise
    • Within one week after this step, we will give you an offer, or let you know that we do not wish to move forward
    • You will have two weeks to accept our offer or not. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview would be an ethical violation in our view

Compensation

    • Starting Salary: 70,000 EUR
    • After one year, if you perform well, you will receive a significant salary increase and be granted equity

Work Authorization: Qualified candidates should be legally authorized to be employed in the EU.

Work Environment: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can choose to work in an office or remotely from home on any given day of the week. There is no requirement to live near a Veeva office if a candidate is in proximity to an airport and able to meet travel requirements.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. Sales Assistant – CRM, Sales Support & Pipeline Coordination

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Sales Assistant to support day-to-day sales operations, CRM management, scheduling, pipeline coordination, reporting, proposals, and client communication.

This is a hands-on sales support role designed to keep the sales process organized and moving forward so Account Executives and sales leaders can focus on selling, closing deals, and building client relationships.

You’ll maintain CRM accuracy, coordinate meetings and follow-ups, prepare sales materials, track pipeline activity, and ensure no lead, task, or opportunity falls through the cracks.

What You’ll Own

CRM Management & Pipeline Support

  • Maintain accurate records for leads, contacts, deals, and opportunities
  • Update pipeline stages, activity notes, next steps, and follow-up tasks
  • Work within CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, or Pipedrive
  • Identify and clean duplicate, incomplete, or outdated CRM records
  • Maintain strong CRM hygiene and pipeline visibility
  • Ensure sales activities and next steps are properly documented
  • Flag stalled opportunities and overdue follow-ups

Scheduling & Sales Coordination

  • Schedule discovery calls, sales meetings, product demos, and follow-ups
  • Coordinate calendars across multiple time zones
  • Manage scheduling through Google Calendar, Outlook, Calendly, or similar tools
  • Handle confirmations, reminders, reschedules, and calendar changes
  • Ensure sales representatives have the necessary context and materials before meetings
  • Keep follow-ups and next steps moving on schedule

Proposals & Sales Documentation

  • Draft, format, proofread, and organize:
    • Proposals
    • Quotes
    • Presentations
    • Sales collateral
    • Client-facing documents
  • Support RFP and RFI preparation when required
  • Create polished materials using Google Slides, PowerPoint, Canva, or similar tools
  • Maintain organized records of contracts and sales documentation
  • Ensure client-facing materials are accurate and professional

Sales Reporting & Pipeline Tracking

  • Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports
  • Maintain pipeline summaries and leadership dashboards
  • Track:
    • Pipeline movement
    • Sales activity
    • Conversion rates
    • Follow-up completion
  • Assist with sales forecasting and operational reporting
  • Keep reporting data accurate, organized, and accessible
  • Provide leadership with clear visibility into pipeline activity

Client Communication & Follow-Up

  • Draft professional follow-up emails, meeting recaps, reminders, and client communications
  • Support inbound lead routing and prospect coordination
  • Track outstanding follow-ups and ensure timely completion
  • Coordinate communication between prospects, sales representatives, and internal teams
  • Maintain a professional customer experience throughout the sales process

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations
  • Coordinate contracts, approvals, documentation, and internal handoffs
  • Support smooth transitions from prospect to customer onboarding
  • Track outstanding internal requirements and task ownership
  • Identify and help resolve administrative bottlenecks affecting deal progression

Requirements

  • 1–2+ years of experience in sales support, sales coordination, administrative support, or operations
  • Hands-on experience with CRM platforms such as:
    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • Zoho
    • Pipedrive
  • Strong proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office
  • Experience coordinating meetings, calendars, and sales follow-ups
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational ability
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and priorities
  • Strong follow-through and accountability
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting B2B sales teams or Account Executives
  • Experience preparing proposals, quotes, or sales presentations
  • Familiarity with SDR/BDR and lead-generation workflows
  • Experience in SaaS, agencies, professional services, or other sales-driven businesses
  • Excel or Google Sheets experience with pivot tables, dashboards, and KPI tracking
  • Familiarity with sales forecasting and pipeline reporting

Tools & Platforms

HubSpot | Salesforce | Zoho | Pipedrive | Google Workspace | Microsoft Office | Calendly | Google Slides | PowerPoint | Canva | Excel / Google Sheets

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Are highly organized and naturally detail-oriented
  • Proactively follow up instead of waiting for reminders
  • Enjoy keeping CRMs, calendars, and pipelines organized
  • Communicate clearly and professionally
  • Can manage multiple priorities without sacrificing accuracy
  • Take ownership of tasks through completion
  • Thrive in fast-paced, sales-driven environments
  • Enjoy helping sales teams operate more efficiently

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start your day by reviewing the CRM for missing information, upcoming meetings, stalled opportunities, and overdue follow-ups.

Throughout the day, you’ll coordinate demos and sales calls, prepare proposals and presentations, update pipeline stages, communicate with prospects, maintain reports and dashboards, and ensure Account Executives have everything they need before client conversations.

In short: you keep the sales engine organized, accurate, and moving so the sales team can focus on generating revenue.

What Success Looks Like

  • High CRM accuracy and data cleanliness
  • Consistent completion of sales follow-ups
  • Accurate and timely meeting coordination
  • Error-free proposals and sales documentation
  • Reliable sales reports and dashboards
  • Improved pipeline organization and visibility
  • Smooth sales-to-onboarding handoffs
  • Strong responsiveness and follow-through
  • Positive feedback from Account Executives and sales leadership

Career Growth

This role can provide a path into:

Sales Coordinator | Sales Operations Specialist | Revenue Operations | Account Management | SDR/BDR | Executive Sales Support

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Practical Task – CRM Cleanup + Proposal Exercise
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you have experience in sales support, CRM management, scheduling, pipeline coordination, or sales operations and enjoy keeping teams organized and opportunities moving forward, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and build your career in sales operations while directly supporting a high-performing sales team.

Join the Future of Connectivity with Metronet!

Enterprise Network Engineer

As an Enterprise Network Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, implementing, securing, optimizing, and supporting Metronet's enterprise network infrastructure and network security systems. You will help ensure the reliability, scalability, performance, and security of our wired, wireless, WAN, data center, cloud-connected, and remote-site environments while supporting critical business operations across the organization.

This role is ideal for an experienced network professional who has successfully designed, deployed, and supported enterprise-scale network and security solutions within medium to large business environments. You will lead network and security initiatives, manage infrastructure upgrades, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and contribute to the continued modernization of our enterprise technology environment.

We're looking for a self-directed engineer who can take ownership of projects from planning through implementation, work independently with minimal supervision, and bring practical, real-world experience with enterprise networking technologies. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting large-scale firewall deployments, data center networking, routing and switching infrastructures, and multi-site enterprise environments. Success in this role comes from combining strong technical expertise with sound decision-making, problem-solving skills, and the ability to drive results in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Lead the design, deployment, maintenance, and ongoing optimization of enterprise network infrastructure and network security platforms, including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, WAN circuits, VPNs, and related technologies.
  • Independently manage assigned network engineering projects from planning and design through implementation, documentation, testing, and operational support.
  • Design and maintain enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, data center, and cloud-connected network architectures to support business requirements, remote site connectivity, resiliency, performance, security, and future growth.
  • Develop, maintain, and evolve network and network security standards, reference architectures, implementation practices, and engineering best practices that support scalability, security, and operational excellence across the enterprise.
  • Design, implement, review, and maintain network security controls including firewall policies, ACLs, segmentation, VPN access, NAT, secure management access, zero trust-aligned controls, and access control frameworks.
  • Serve as an escalation resource for complex network and network security incidents, including routing, switching, wireless, firewall, VPN, DNS, DHCP, WAN, cloud connectivity, performance, availability, and policy-related issues.
  • Perform firewall rule reviews, network access reviews, security policy cleanup, and assist with vulnerability remediation efforts related to network infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain network and security documentation including diagrams, standards, configurations, procedures, support records, implementation plans, firewall rule documentation, and maintenance window documentation.
  • Respond to, document, update, and resolve assigned network and security operations tickets in accordance with established service levels, escalation procedures, and change management practices.
  • Drive network growth initiatives, capacity planning, infrastructure refresh projects, technology standardization efforts, and network security platform modernization across the enterprise.
  • Lead and collaborate with vendors, service providers, contractors, security teams, and internal stakeholders to successfully deliver network projects, site deployments, migrations, cutovers, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Occasional travel to Evansville, IN for team meetings and collaboration events (approximately twice per year).
  • All other duties as assigned

JOB QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree or better in related field or 4+ years of related network engineering and network security experience minimum.
  • Strong experience with NGFW firewalls such as Cisco Firepower, Palo Alto, or FortiGate, including firewall policy management, NAT, VPN, logging, troubleshooting, rule review, and problem resolution.
  • Experience with enterprise networking technologies and management platforms such as Arista, Juniper, Cisco Nexus, Cisco ISE, Cisco ACI, NDFC, or similar enterprise networking and infrastructure management solutions preferred.
  • Experience designing, deploying, and supporting enterprise-scale network infrastructure within medium-to-large multi-site business environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking architectures, standards, and protocols, including routing, switching, VLANs, spanning tree, wireless, WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, NAT, QoS, and high availability concepts.
  • Experience with network security concepts including segmentation, ACLs, least privilege access, secure remote access, zero trust principles, logging, monitoring, and incident response support.
  • Experience with Cisco Catalyst 9000 switching platforms and enterprise wireless solutions such as Cisco Catalyst Wireless or Meraki preferred.
  • Experience with dynamic routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, or EIGRP, including route filtering, redistribution, and troubleshooting preferred.
  • Experience with SD-WAN technologies, VPN technologies, WAN provider coordination, and remote-site connectivity preferred.
  • Experience configuring, deploying, and maintaining Cisco network devices in enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, security, and data center environments.
  • Understanding of cloud networking and hybrid network connectivity concepts, including public cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure and related security controls.
  • Experience with network monitoring, firewall logging, NetFlow, SNMP, Syslog, packet analysis, and performance troubleshooting tools preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex network engineering projects, troubleshoot advanced technical issues, and drive solutions with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to communicate technical and security matters clearly to peers, leadership, vendors, contractors, and non-technical counterparts.
  • Good oral and written communication skills with the ability to document technical designs, changes, security decisions, and operational procedures.
  • Detail-oriented organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, operational issues, and security-related requests.
  • Dependability, adaptability, flexibility, creativity, professional attitude, and the ability to understand complex issues, drive troubleshooting efforts, escalate appropriately when needed.

Director of Talent Acquisition

About SSA

Scientific Safety Alliance (SSA) exists to Accelerate Science. Delightfully. We provide mission-critical safety and compliance services to pharmaceutical, biotech, hospital and research organizations across the US, Puerto Rico, the UK and Europe. Since 2023 we have grown from $0 to $20M EBITDA with no outside equity (#175 on the Inc. 5000).

The Opportunity: Director of Talent

SSA has acquired 28 companies in three and a half years, and our ability to keep growing depends on finding, hiring, and keeping exceptional people. As our Director of Talent, you will oversee SSA's talent acquisition function and build our global talent attraction strategy across every branch in the United States, Puerto Rico, the United Kingdom, and Austria. You will lead our recruiting team and turn a decentralized, branch-by-branch approach to hiring into one scalable, global engine that brings in field service technicians, engineers, scientists, and corporate professionals at the speed our business demands.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who loves both strategy and execution. You will partner closely with branch leaders and the executive team to forecast hiring needs, build pipelines for hard-to-fill technical roles, build an employer brand that attracts top talent in every market where we operate, and give leaders the data they need to make good hiring decisions. You will also play a key part in our acquisition strategy, helping integrate newly acquired teams and planning the talent needed as each branch grows. If you want to build a best-in-class talent function at a fast-growing, employee-owned company, we want to talk to you.

How You Will Make an Impact

  • Global talent attraction strategy: Design and execute SSA's global talent attraction strategy across the U.S., Puerto Rico, the U.K., and Austria, defining how and where we find talent in each market and aligning it with business growth, acquisitions, and branch-level forecasts.
  • Talent acquisition oversight: Own SSA's full talent acquisition function, including recruiting operations, sourcing, hiring standards, and candidate experience, for every branch and corporate role.
  • Team leadership: Lead, coach, and develop SSA's team of recruiters; set clear goals, manage priorities across branches, and build a high-performing, accountable culture.
  • Branch partnership: Act as a strategic advisor to branch leaders and executives on workforce planning, role design, compensation positioning, and selection decisions.
  • Technical and field hiring: Build sourcing channels and talent pipelines for hard-to-fill roles such as field service technicians, certification specialists, engineers, and laboratory professionals, including partnerships with technical schools, military transition programs, and industry networks.
  • Process and systems: Standardize the end-to-end recruiting process, from requisition approval through offer; own SSA's applicant tracking system and recruiting technology, and hand new hires off seamlessly to the HR team for onboarding.
  • Global employer brand: Build SSA's employer brand across all of our markets, including careers content, social presence, and candidate messaging, highlighting our employee ownership, culture, and mission to Accelerate Science. Delightfully.
  • Metrics and reporting: Build talent dashboards covering time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance, and new-hire retention, and use the data to improve results.
  • M&A integration: Support due diligence and integration of acquired companies, including talent assessments, retention of key employees, and post-close hiring plans.
  • Vendors and budget: Manage recruiting agencies, job boards, and talent acquisition budget to get the best return on every dollar spent.
  • Compliance: Ensure hiring practices comply with employment laws in every country and state where we operate, including EEO, pay transparency, and background check requirements.

Deliverables & Outcomes

  • A documented global talent attraction strategy, with clear sourcing plans for each country and role family.
  • A single, documented recruiting process used consistently across all branches.
  • A recognizable SSA employer brand that drives a growing share of direct applicants and referrals.
  • Reduced time-to-fill, with clear targets set by role family (field, technical, corporate).
  • Healthy pipelines in place for critical, hard-to-fill technical roles before openings occur.
  • Strong offer acceptance rates and 90-day and first-year retention of new hires.
  • Lower reliance on, and spend with, outside recruiting agencies.
  • Monthly talent reporting delivered to branch and executive leadership.
  • A recruiting team that is well-trained, accountable, and consistently meeting its goals.
  • Acquired companies integrated with key talent retained and hiring plans in place.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of talent acquisition experience, including 3+ years leading a recruiting team.
  • Proven success building a talent attraction or employer branding strategy across multiple countries or regions.
  • Proven success building or scaling a talent function in a high-growth, multi-location organization; experience in a private equity-backed or acquisitive company strongly preferred.
  • Track record of hiring field service, skilled trades, technical, or scientific talent at volume.
  • Experience with recruiting across multiple states and, ideally, internationally (U.K., EU, or Puerto Rico).
  • Strong command of recruiting metrics, with the ability to turn data into action.
  • Experience selecting, implementing, or managing an applicant tracking system and modern recruiting tools.
  • Excellent influencing and communication skills, with credibility among executives, branch leaders, and candidates alike.
  • A builder's mindset: comfortable creating structure where little exists and moving quickly.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field preferred.

Benefits

  • Equity ownership in SSA
  • 401k Match
  • 100% paid Medical Dental & Vision insurance
  • Health insurance (100% for employee and family)
  • Life insurance
  • Generous Paid time off
  • Parental leave
Salary: $140,000 – $180,000 / year

Join Us as a Senior Clinical Team Manager within our Internal Medicine Therapeutic Business Unit- Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation

The role involves working to ensure that all clinical deliverables meet the customer's time/quality/cost expectations, and maintaining profitability by ensuring clinical activity is conducted within contract scope, through efficient management of the clinical team. Typically the Senior Clinical Trial Manager works independently on projects of moderate to high complexity, and may assume regional lead or Clinical Study Manager responsibilities.


The therapeutic scope includes Cardiovascular & Internal Medicine- This need is for Nephrology, Dermatology, GI, (UC/CD), Cardiovascular (in particular Cardiovascular outcome trials), Liver, Nephrology, Immunology, Rare Disease, Diabetes, Obesity, Dyslipidemia, Women's Health, Rheumatology, (RA, SLE, Gout), Endocrinology.

jobs.description:
South Africa, a role for someone who decides

This opening is for South Africa. Take ten minutes over our website and LinkedIn first. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. If your answers could belong to any company, they will fall at this stage.

The company and the job

Drop Zero Digital is a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person in South Africa who is good at making decisions. The AI image service is our fastest growing line, and your area, whichever it is, will help it along.

You will have one named area. It is chosen in the trial, after we have seen where your strengths lie. It will be one of two:

  1. The hiring machine: how people are found, screened and hired here. The funnel runs through you from sourcing to scheduling, with chasing, an accurate tracker, and a warning to us when the process has a fault.
  2. Client delivery operations: how client work is planned, briefed, chased and shipped. You hold the timelines, brief the team in full and keep tasks from going quiet.

At heart it is one job. You see something slip, decide the answer and close it before being asked.

We want a decider, not an assistant and not a coordinator. Every day brings real calls, and we weigh the quality of them above the volume. We want a team that decides well without management, which means this is not the job for anyone who waits for instructions each morning.

What we need to see in you

  1. You make decisions and answer for them, including bad ones.
  2. You know whose call it is, yours or someone else's, and you get that right either way.
  3. You use feedback and change, without giving up a view you have good reason for.
  4. You get better fast. A person at seventy percent and climbing is worth more than one flat at eighty five.
  5. You tell us when something is failing, even when it is our process at fault.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially when the subject is a problem.

Steps from application to trial

  1. Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.
  2. A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.
  3. A 15 minute call with the founder.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

Our decision is made in the trial, and so is the choice of your area. You work on live work from week one and hear straight how each decision landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

On experience

No number of years is asked for. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.

Whatever you list is verified, covering employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. Having held a full-time job in the last 12 months is the one requirement. Beyond that there is no minimum, so a short history costs you nothing. Misrepresenting what you have is disqualifying, and the true account is never held against you.

Requirements

      1. Full time once hired, and it is your only job. During the paid trial you put in 4 hours a day, 2 of them at a fixed time within our working day, and you can keep your current job. Pass, and you give notice and come on full time within 30 days.
      2. Internet you can rely on: minimum 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
      3. Strong written English.
      4. Based in South Africa.
      5. You track your working hours in our time tracking tool from the start.

Benefits

1300 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

For those who earn it, responsibility and pay grow quickly. Authority over decisions that reach a client grows slowly and deliberately, and comes from a track record, not a good first month. We would rather you knew that now than found out two months in.

Managed Services Quality & Continuous Improvement Lead The Managed Services Quality & Continuous Improvement Lead provides independent oversight of the quality, effectiveness, and efficiency of Managed Services delivery across the client portfolio.
jobs.description:
Make a difference. Be happy. Grow your career.

Managed Services Quality & Continuous Improvement Lead


The Managed Services Quality & Continuous Improvement Lead provides independent oversight of the quality, effectiveness, and efficiency of Managed Services delivery across the client portfolio.

The role operates separately from day-to-day Service Delivery and Service Management. While those teams manage operational performance, SLAs, incidents, requests, problems, changes, and client governance, this role looks beneath traditional service metrics to identify opportunities that may not surface through normal operational management.


The role uses ticket-level, analyst-level, knowledge-management, client-process, and service-performance data to identify opportunities to:

  • Improve the consistency and effectiveness of analyst execution.
  • Identify analyst coaching, training, and knowledge needs.
  • Improve ticket resolution quality, speed, and efficiency.
  • Reduce unnecessary escalations and handoffs.
  • Improve knowledge articles and knowledge utilization.
  • Identify recurring demand that could be eliminated.
  • Increase client self-service and automation.
  • Recommend client process changes that reduce ticket volumes.
  • Identify systemic opportunities that can be applied across multiple Managed Services clients.

The overarching objective is not simply to determine whether Nordic is meeting SLAs, but to determine how the service can continuously become better, faster, more consistent, and less dependent on manual support.


Experience Required

  • 10+ years of experience in IT services, managed services, IT operations, service management, continuous improvement, or related disciplines.
  • 5+ years of experience working within a managed services or recurring IT support environment, preferably supporting complex enterprise or healthcare clients.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing ticket-level and operational performance data to identify recurring issues, resolution inefficiencies, knowledge gaps, and improvement opportunities.
  • Experience evaluating analyst-level work patterns to identify coaching, training, knowledge, and process improvement opportunities.
  • Strong understanding of the end-to-end service lifecycle, including incident, request, problem, change, escalation, and knowledge management.
  • Experience identifying drivers of ticket demand and developing strategies for:
    • Ticket elimination and deflection
    • Shift-left
    • Self-service
    • Automation and self-healing
    • Knowledge improvement
    • Process simplification
  • Experience conducting root-cause analysis and translating findings into corrective and preventive actions.
  • Experience identifying systemic issues across multiple clients, teams, applications, or service areas rather than evaluating individual incidents in isolation.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently from Delivery and Service Management while constructively challenging existing practices and identifying issues that may not be visible through routine operational reporting.
  • Experience presenting quality findings, trends, and recommended improvements to senior operational leaders and client stakeholders.
  • Healthcare IT experience strongly preferred, particularly within Epic application support, Service Desk, infrastructure, security, ServiceNow, or other healthcare managed services environments.
  • Establishing or leading a Managed Services quality or continuous improvement function.
  • Developing quality frameworks, assessment methodologies, or service health scorecards.
  • Building cross-client benchmarks and identifying reusable best practices.
  • Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, ITIL continual improvement, or similar improvement methodologies.
  • Experience converting operational findings into measurable client outcomes such as reduced ticket demand, faster resolution, greater self-service adoption, or improved end-user experience.

Education & Certifications

  • Equivalent combination of education and significant relevant managed services experience may be considered.

Preferred Certifications

One or more of the following would be beneficial:

  • ITIL 4 Foundation or advanced ITIL certification
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
  • ServiceNow certifications or formal ServiceNow training
  • Quality-management or continuous-improvement certifications
  • Relevant Epic certifications or significant Epic operational experience for candidates coming from healthcare IT

Nordic is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital or veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable federal, state, or local laws. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply, including women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and veterans.

Buscamos uma pessoa profissional de nível pleno, especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções de automação de processos, combinando tecnologias de RPA tradicional com recursos de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar processos e ampliar a eficiência operacional.

  • Experiência com integração de sistemas por meio de APIs REST, serviços web e bancos de dados.

  • Familiaridade com Inteligência Artificial Generativa, LLMs e agentes inteligentes.
  • Conhecimento em testes de software, tratamento de exceções e monitoramento de automações.

  • Experiência com arquiteturas RAG e integração de IA com bases de conhecimento.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Ciklum is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team in Brazil.
jobs.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team in Brazil.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experience of tomorrow. We are looking for a talented Senior DevOps Engineer to support our engineering work, with a strong focus on the underlying infrastructure that we need to get from source code to production, plus keep it happy once it's there. We need someone who understands software development and enjoys working with developers on all the things necessary to improving, deploying, monitoring, and operating production services.

Responsibilities:

  • Build complex, highly available, and cost-optimized cloud infrastructure solutions on Azure and in Kubernetes (AKS)
  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade AKS clusters, including private cluster networking, node pool sizing and autoscaling, workload identity, ingress, certificate management, and cluster upgrade lifecycle
  • Own infrastructure as code end to end in Terraform: author and refactor reusable modules, manage per-environment workspaces and state, and drive changes through pull request, plan review, and apply
  • Design and implement advanced CI/CD pipelines ensuring quality, security, and efficiency, including container image build/publish and progressive promotion from lower environments to production
  • Establish comprehensive monitoring and observability strategies across cluster, application, and Azure platform services
  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks, leading troubleshooting efforts for complex issues across compute, networking, identity, and data layers
  • Implement high-level security practices, integrating vulnerability scanning and threat modeling, and manage secrets through a centralized secrets store with identity-based (rather than credential-based) access
  • Maintain and exercise multi-region high availability and disaster recovery, including failover and failback procedures for Kubernetes workloads and managed databases
  • Work with application engineering to cultivate operational standards

Requirements:

We know that sometimes, you can't tick every box. We would still love to hear from you if you think you're a good fit!

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years of experience in a DevOps engineering role with significant Azure experience
  • Proven track record of designing and implementing large-scale Azure solutions
  • Hands-on experience running AKS in production, not just in development or proof-of-concept environments — including private clusters, cluster upgrades, autoscaling, and incident response on live workloads
  • Advanced, production-level Terraform experience: module design, state and workspace management, and multi-environment/multi-subscription deployments
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems and architect robust solutions
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Certified Kubernetes Administrator)

Desirable:

  • Cloud: Deep knowledge of Azure services, architectures, and design patterns, including Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities and workload identity federation, Key Vault, and subscription/landing zone structure
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Advanced skills in Terraform, or other IaC tools
  • CI/CD: Strong experience with pipeline-as-code (Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or equivalent), service connections and federated pipeline authentication, and GitOps-style continuous delivery to Kubernetes (Argo CD, Flux, or similar)
  • Programming and Scripting: Strong scripting skills (PowerShell, Bash, Python) and proficiency with one or more programming languages (e.g., Go, C#/.NET, Node.js)
  • Containerization and Microservices: Extensive experience with Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), Helm, container registries, and microservices architectures
  • Complex Configuration Management: Expertise in configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet, etc.)
  • Robust Networking: In-depth knowledge of networking concepts, Azure virtual network and subnet design, private endpoints and private DNS zones, hybrid connectivity (site-to-site VPN, network virtual appliances/firewalls), and network security
  • Data and Messaging Services: Familiarity with Azure managed data services such as SQL Managed Instance (including failover groups), Cosmos DB, Redis/managed cache, Storage, and Functions
  • Observability: Experience with Azure Monitor/Log Analytics and KQL, plus at least one third-party observability platform (Datadog, Grafana, or similar)
  • Resilience: Experience designing and testing multi-region redundancy, RTO/RPO-driven DR runbooks, and failover automation
  • Security Focus: Strong understanding of cloud security principles, penetration testing, and compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS)
  • Multi-cloud: ScriptCycle's footprint spans both Azure and Google Cloud, with an active workload migration track. Exposure to GCP and GKE (including Autopilot) and to cross-cloud networking and identity is a strong plus, though Azure is the primary focus of this role; experience supporting a GCP migration

What’s in it for you?

  • Care: your mental and physical health is our priority. We ensure comprehensive company-paid medical insurance and mental health programs, 5 undocumented sick-leave days per year
  • Tailored education path: boost your skills and knowledge with our regular internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy license, language courses and company-paid certifications
  • Growth environment: share your experience and level up your expertise with a community of skilled professionals, locally and globally
  • Long-term employment with 20 working-days paid vacation and local bank holidays
  • Flexibility: 100% remote work mode
  • Opportunities: we value our specialists and always find the best options for them. Our Internal Mobility Program helps change a project if needed to help you grow, excel professionally and fulfill your potential
  • Global impact: work on large-scale projects that redefine industries with international and fast-growing clients
  • Welcoming environment: feel empowered with a friendly team, open-door policy, informal atmosphere within the company and regular team-building events

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

As we expand into Latin America, every Ciklumer is helping to shape our story. Collaborate with seasoned experts and make a global impact backed by two decades of industry leadership.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

jobs.description:
Senior Developer

Olsen specializes in the implementation and optimization of enterprise resource management systems, particularly Vista ERP, for high-revenue construction companies across North America. As a trailblazer in the industry, our goal is to propel our clients toward digital transformation by automating and enhancing their business processes. We are committed to driving impactful changes through data analytics and technology, harnessing our collective expertise, innovation, and commitment to excellence. To further our mission, we are seeking an exceptionally skilled Senior Developer to join our team of professionals. This role focuses primarily on internal development and collaboration with internal teams, with a strong emphasis on technical leadership, long-term architectural strategy, and infrastructure ownership.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical maturity, with the ability to design and implement robust systems, make informed infrastructure and architectural decisions, and guide technical direction while remaining actively involved in development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, build, and enhance custom software solutions supporting ERP integrations, analytics, automation, and AI-driven workflows.
  • Define and drive scalable application and data architecture, owning long-term technical strategy, roadmaps, and architectural direction across internal platforms.
  • Lead technical decision-making across system architecture, cloud infrastructure, deployment strategies, and integration patterns.
  • Design, build, and evolve scalable backend services, APIs, and system architectures, with a focus on performance, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Own and evolve cloud infrastructure (Azure), including architecture, networking, security, identity and access management, and cost optimization.
  • Proactively identify system-level risks and drive improvements in performance, reliability, scalability, and security, while troubleshooting and enhancing existing applications.
  • Provide technical mentorship, contribute to system design and code reviews, and maintain clear and thorough documentation for architecture, infrastructure, and development workflows.

Essential Qualifications and Experience

  • 7-10+ years of professional experience in software development across backend, frontend, and data-focused systems.
  • Strong proficiency in C#/.NET and/or Python, with extensive experience building scalable APIs and backend services.
  • Demonstrated experience designing system architecture and operating complex, production-grade systems.
  • Strong experience with cloud architecture, particularly within Azure environments.
  • Deep understanding of relational database design, performance tuning, and data architecture (SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL).
  • Experience designing and managing cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized applications.
  • Ability to demonstrate technical expertise through prior systems, projects, or architectural contributions.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications and Experience

  • Hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks and TypeScript/JavaScript.
  • Experience designing data architectures that support scalability, performance, and long-term maintainability.
  • Experience with backend performance optimization, scalability patterns, and distributed systems is a strong asset.
  • Exposure to Data, AI, or ML solutions (e.g., OpenAI/LLMs, document processing, analytics pipelines) is considered a strong asset.
  • Experience working within complex system integrations or ERP environments is highly preferred.

Must-Have Skills

  • Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly with teammates and document work effectively.
  • Strong problem-solving ability and systems-level thinking.
  • Ability to take ownership of complex technical initiatives and make independent technical decisions from design through implementation across projects.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage priorities across multiple technical initiatives.
  • High level of integrity and ability to handle the confidentiality of sensitive information.
    - Backend: C#/.NET, Python, Django, Azure Functions, SQL
  • DevOps & Cloud: Azure Cloud, CI/CD pipelines, Docker

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with frontend frameworks (React, Vue.js) and modern CSS frameworks (e.g., Tailwind)
  • Data & AI: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis (nice to have), OpenAI/LLMs, document processing, data integrations

Benefits of Working at Olsen

  • Big thinking is the baseline. We hire curious people and then actually give them room to run.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build NeMo Platform, NVIDIA’s product for developing, evaluating, deploying, and operating AI systems at scale. Our roadmap is increasingly focused on agentic development and automated agent improvement: giving teams the infrastructure they need to compare versions, understand behavior, and make empirically grounded improvements over time.

  • Build reusable systems for observing behavior, measuring progress, detecting regressions, and turning runtime evidence into product decisions

  • Build systems for ingesting, normalizing, validating, and analyzing agent execution data and evaluation datasets

  • Partner with research, product, platform, and infrastructure teams to integrate agentic capabilities broadly across NVIDIA agent runtimes and developer workflows

  • Help turn emerging agent development and improvement techniques into reliable, reusable product capabilities

  • Improve reliability, observability, debuggability, and performance across NeMo Platform, SDKs, plugins, jobs, and developer workflows

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Offensive Security
jobs.excerpt: Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy.
jobs.description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

About Liftoff Security Team

The Liftoff Security team protects Liftoff's customers, users, and employees. We architect Liftoff's security posture, build the tools and systems that defend it, and partner with engineering teams as they ship new products and features. Our work spans the entire stack — infrastructure, web, mobile, and IT — and we approach security from a software engineering standpoint, scaling our impact through automation and well-designed tools. As our Security Engineer, Offensive Security, you will own internal offensive testing and lead the move from point-in-time penetration tests to continuous, AI-assisted testing. You will independently plan assessments, safely validate vulnerabilities, work with engineering teams through remediation and retesting, and build sustained knowledge of our source code and systems. You will contribute across application, cloud, and infrastructure security, support Accelerate and MX as priorities change, and share the team's on-call and incident-response work.

Responsibilities

  • Independently plan and execute internal penetration tests across applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and corporate systems; prioritize assessments by risk and business impact.
  • Define testing scope and rules of engagement with system owners, assess production risk, and choose safe methods for validating vulnerabilities.
  • Combine hands-on testing with source-code review and architectural analysis to find vulnerabilities and demonstrate realistic attack paths.
  • Partner with engineering teams to explain findings, agree on practical fixes, track remediation, and retest to confirm the risk is resolved.
  • Maintain knowledge of Liftoff’s systems and attack surface, revisit high-risk attack paths as systems change, and turn confirmed findings into repeatable tests.
  • Build testing tools and workflows that combine hands-on assessments with ongoing automated testing and remediation validation.
  • Make security testing self-service where practical through reusable tests, documented assessment and retesting workflows, and clear remediation guidance.
  • Support the annual third-party penetration test for independent validation and customer and audit requirements; coordinate scope and follow findings through remediation.
  • Lead adoption of AI-assisted offensive security tooling: evaluate platforms and build workflows for code analysis, test generation, and finding triage; measure coverage, accuracy, and effort saved.
  • Partner with Detection & Response to turn validated attack paths and offensive findings into detection improvements and incident-response exercises.
  • Work across application, cloud, and infrastructure security as priorities change, including Accelerate and MX, and share the team’s on-call and incident-response rotation, including occasional off-hours response and post-incident follow-up.

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant security engineering experience, including substantial hands-on penetration testing of applications and infrastructure.
  • Excellent judgment in prioritizing testing by risk, assessing production impact, and safely validating exploits without unnecessary disruption.
  • Experience independently owning assessments and partnering with engineering teams from initial findings through remediation and retesting.
  • Write production-quality code for security tools and automation, review pull requests, and navigate large, unfamiliar codebases. Develop safe proof-of-concept code and independently validate AI-generated code and findings.
  • Strong understanding of application and API security, authentication and authorization, network security, and common vulnerability classes.
  • Hands-on experience assessing cloud and infrastructure security, including identity and access controls, configuration, and attack paths.
  • Ability to quickly understand complex systems and architecture and contribute across application, cloud, and infrastructure security.
  • Practical software engineering habits: testing, observability, version control, peer code review, continuous integration, and blameless postmortems.
  • Strong technical writing: clear assessment plans, proposals, reproducible findings, runbooks, and post-incident reviews that support engineering decisions. Explain exploitability and business impact clearly in writing and conversation.
  • Willingness to share the security team’s on-call and incident-response responsibilities, including occasional off-hours response.

Desirable qualifications

  • Experience with Go, Python, Clojure, or JavaScript; ability to work across languages matters more than a specific language.
  • Experience building AI-assisted security testing workflows and measuring the accuracy and usefulness of their results.
  • Experience securing large-scale cloud systems, mobile advertising, or other high-volume SaaS environments.

Why This Role is Exciting

  • Ownership & Impact: Build and own our in-house offensive security capability, from selecting assessments to confirming fixes.
  • Broad Attack Surface: Test applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and corporate systems with access to source code and engineering context.
  • Engineering Partnership: Work with teams that value security and stay involved through remediation and retesting.
  • Room to Grow: Move from point-in-time penetration tests to continuous testing and lead adoption of AI-assisted offensive security tools.

Hands-On Technical Work: Investigate complex systems, validate vulnerabilities safely, and build tools that make testing more effective.

Compensation:

The following are our base salary ranges for this role:

  • SF Bay Area, Los Angeles/Orange County, NYC, Seattle: $200,000 - $250,000 plus bonus
  • All other cities and towns in our approved states: $184,000 - $220,000 plus bonus
